note: L20 — quinto lotto di human missions, 40k parole

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|name|6432|0
units.english: Care package to <planet>
units.italian: Pacco di generi di conforto per <planet>

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|description|6433|0
units.english: An activist named Torrey has asked you to take a care package to her friend, an NCO named Irene in the Southern Mutual Defense Pact militia, stationed on <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Un'attivista di nome Torrey ti ha chiesto di portare un pacco di generi di conforto alla sua amica, una sottufficiale di nome Irene della milizia del Patto di Difesa Meridionale (SMDP), di stanza su <destination>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|Among the bustle of the spaceport, one figure catches your attention. A woman stands alone on one side of the passageway with a bubble of space around her that is maintained by sheer force of personality. She doesn't seem to be saying anything, at least. As you get closer, you notice a large package at her feet. Something about you catches her attention, and she looks you in the eye and beckons.|6449|0
units.english: Among the bustle of the spaceport, one figure catches your attention. A woman stands alone on one side of the passageway with a bubble of space around her that is maintained by sheer force of personality. She doesn't seem to be saying anything, at least. As you get closer, you notice a large package at her feet. Something about you catches her attention, and she looks you in the eye and beckons.
units.italian: Fra il viavai dello spazioporto, una figura attira la tua attenzione. Una donna sta sola da un lato del passaggio, con una bolla di spazio intorno a sé mantenuta dalla sola forza della personalità. Non sembra stia dicendo niente, almeno. Avvicinandoti, noti un grosso pacco ai suoi piedi. Qualcosa in te le cattura l'attenzione: ti guarda negli occhi e ti fa cenno.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	(Go over to her.)|6451|0
units.english: (Go over to her.)
units.italian: (Vai da lei.)

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	(Ignore her.)|6452|0
units.english: (Ignore her.)
units.italian: (Ignala.)

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	You make your way through the crowd to the edge of her bubble. As soon as you do, she extends her hand. "I'm Torrey. Torrey Dupont."|6454|0
units.english: You make your way through the crowd to the edge of her bubble. As soon as you do, she extends her hand. "I'm Torrey. Torrey Dupont."
units.italian: Ti fai strada tra la folla fino al bordo della sua bolla. Appena ci arrivi, lei ti tende la mano. "Sono Torrey. Torrey Dupont."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	You take the hand and shake it. "<first> <last>."|6455|0
units.english: You take the hand and shake it. "<first> <last>."
units.italian: Prendi la mano e la stringi. "<first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	"I can tell you're an independent captain. I would like to hire you to transport a package." Torrey indicates the box beside her with a nudge of her toe.|6456|0
units.english: "I can tell you're an independent captain. I would like to hire you to transport a package." Torrey indicates the box beside her with a nudge of her toe.
units.italian: "Si vede che sei un capitano indipendente. Vorrei assumerti per trasportare un pacco." Torrey indica la scatola accanto a sé con un colpo di punta del piede.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	"What's in the box?"|6458|0
units.english: "What's in the box?"
units.italian: "Che cosa c'è nella scatola?"

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	"Why can't you send it via the job board?"|6459|0
units.english: "Why can't you send it via the job board?"
units.italian: "Perché non lo spedisci tramite la bacheca degli incarichi?"

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	She glances down at it. "It's nothing too special - some local stuff from around here. Mostly foods and things that you just can't get made the same anywhere else."|6461|0
units.english: She glances down at it. "It's nothing too special - some local stuff from around here. Mostly foods and things that you just can't get made the same anywhere else."
units.italian: Abbassa lo sguardo sulla scatola. "Niente di speciale, roba del posto, di qui. Per lo più cibo e cose che non si trovano fatte allo stesso modo da nessun'altra parte."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	"Why can't you send it via the job board?" you ask.|6462|0
units.english: "Why can't you send it via the job board?" you ask.
units.italian: "Perché non lo spedisci tramite la bacheca degli incarichi?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	Torrey gives a sardonic smile. "Well, yes; the thing is, I'm sending it to a friend who's an NCO in the militia for the Southern Mutual Defense Pact. Normally, of course, that would be fine, but... then there's who I am." She reaches into a pocket and pulls out a piece of paper - a printout of a news headline. "Protests Block Access To Council Chambers For Fourth Straight Day." Underneath the headline is a picture of Torrey holding up a sign decrying recent actions by the government.|6464|0
units.english: Torrey gives a sardonic smile. "Well, yes; the thing is, I'm sending it to a friend who's an NCO in the militia for the Southern Mutual Defense Pact. Normally, of course, that would be fine, but... then there's who I am." She reaches into a pocket and pulls out a piece of paper - a printout of a news headline. "Protests Block Access To Council Chambers For Fourth Straight Day." Underneath the headline is a picture of Torrey holding up a sign decrying recent actions by the government.
units.italian: Torrey fa un sorriso sarcastico. "Beh, sì; il fatto è che lo mando a un'amica che è sottufficiale nella milizia del Patto di Difesa Meridionale. Normalmente, certo, non sarebbe un problema, ma... poi c'è chi sono io." Fruga in una tasca e tira fuori un foglio: la stampa di un titolo di giornale. "Le proteste bloccano l'accesso alle sale del Consiglio per il quarto giorno consecutivo." Sotto il titolo c'è una foto di Torrey che regge un cartello contro le recenti azioni del governo.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	"So you see," she continues, "I'm already being watched by the Republic government. What with the rumors lately, I really don't want to do anything that would throw any suspicion onto Irene, but..." She glances down at the box. "She's really been missing some of the stuff from home, and I don't want to make her life less pleasant because of what I've been doing."|6465|0
units.english: "So you see," she continues, "I'm already being watched by the Republic government. What with the rumors lately, I really don't want to do anything that would throw any suspicion onto Irene, but..." She glances down at the box. "She's really been missing some of the stuff from home, and I don't want to make her life less pleasant because of what I've been doing."
units.italian: "Quindi vedi," continua, "sono già sotto osservazione del governo della Repubblica. Con le voci che girano ultimamente, non voglio davvero fare niente che possa gettare sospetti su Irene, ma..." Abbassa lo sguardo sulla scatola. "Le manca davvero un sacco la roba di casa, e non voglio renderle la vita meno piacevole per quello che faccio."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	"All right; I'll deliver the package."|6467|0
units.english: "All right; I'll deliver the package."
units.italian: "Va bene, consegno io il pacco."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	"I don't support those protests, or the people who participate in them."|6469|0
units.english: "I don't support those protests, or the people who participate in them."
units.italian: "Non appoggio quelle proteste, né chi vi partecipa."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	"If you're being watched, then I might get in trouble too. Sorry."|6470|0
units.english: "If you're being watched, then I might get in trouble too. Sorry."
units.italian: "Se sei sotto osservazione, potrei finire nei guai anch'io. Spiacente."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	Torrey grimaces, but nods. "That's understandable. Well, have a good day, then." She turns back to looking out at the passing crowds, and you head back on your way.|6471|0
units.english: Torrey grimaces, but nods. "That's understandable. Well, have a good day, then." She turns back to looking out at the passing crowds, and you head back on your way.
units.italian: Torrey fa una smorfia, ma annuisce. "È comprensibile. Beh, buona giornata, allora." Torna a guardare la folla che passa, e tu riprendi la tua strada.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	Torrey breaks out into a brilliant grin. "Well, that's great news, then. You'll find Irene at the militia base on <destination> - that's Gunnery Sergeant Irene Brower. I do appreciate this. You'll be paid upon receipt of the package, too, lest you think my appreciation is all I can give."|6474|0
units.english: Torrey breaks out into a brilliant grin. "Well, that's great news, then. You'll find Irene at the militia base on <destination> - that's Gunnery Sergeant Irene Brower. I do appreciate this. You'll be paid upon receipt of the package, too, lest you think my appreciation is all I can give."
units.italian: Torrey si apre in un sorriso smagliante. "Beh, è un'ottima notizia, allora. Troverai Irene alla base della milizia su <destination>: è il sergente d'artiglieria Irene Brower. Ti sono davvero grata. Sarai pagato alla consegna del pacco, comunque, che tu non creda che la mia gratitudine sia tutto quello che posso dare."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	She picks up the package and hands it to you; it's surprisingly heavy, but doesn't seem to shift or rattle at all as you settle it in your arms to carry to your ship.|6475|0
units.english: She picks up the package and hands it to you; it's surprisingly heavy, but doesn't seem to shift or rattle at all as you settle it in your arms to carry to your ship.
units.italian: Raccoglie il pacco e te lo porge; è sorprendentemente pesante, ma non sembra spostarsi né tintinnare mentre lo sistemi fra le braccia per portarlo alla nave.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|log|6479|0
units.english: Torrey Dupont, an activist, is friends with SMDP militia NCO Irene Brower. You delivered a package for them.
units.italian: Torrey Dupont, un'attivista, è amica della sottufficiale della milizia del SMDP Irene Brower. Ho consegnato un pacco per loro.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|You arrive at the militia base on <destination>, and ask at the gate for Gunnery Sergeant Irene Brower. After a few minutes, a compact young woman with close-cropped blonde hair appears and walks over. When she sees the package at your feet, her face splits into a lopsided grin and her steps quicken. "I see you've brought me a package; this must be from Torrey! She said she was sending something."|6481|0
units.english: You arrive at the militia base on <destination>, and ask at the gate for Gunnery Sergeant Irene Brower. After a few minutes, a compact young woman with close-cropped blonde hair appears and walks over. When she sees the package at your feet, her face splits into a lopsided grin and her steps quicken. "I see you've brought me a package; this must be from Torrey! She said she was sending something."
units.italian: Arrivi alla base della milizia su <destination> e al cancello chiedi del sergente d'artiglieria Irene Brower. Dopo qualche minuto compare una giovane donna compatta, con i capelli biondi tagliati cortissimi, che ti viene incontro. Quando vede il pacco ai tuoi piedi, il viso le si apre in un sorriso storto e accelera il passo. "Vedo che mi hai portato un pacco; dev'essere di Torrey! Aveva detto che mi avrebbe mandato qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	You nod, introduce yourself, and briefly recount your meeting with her friend on <origin>. Irene laughs. "Yep, that's her. Well, thank you so much for bringing this." She hefts the heavy box with no apparent effort, gives you a firm nod, and turns to head back into the base.|6482|0
units.english: You nod, introduce yourself, and briefly recount your meeting with her friend on <origin>. Irene laughs. "Yep, that's her. Well, thank you so much for bringing this." She hefts the heavy box with no apparent effort, gives you a firm nod, and turns to head back into the base.
units.italian: Annuisci, ti presenti e racconti brevemente del tuo incontro con la sua amica su <origin>. Irene ride. "Sì, è proprio lei. Beh, grazie mille per avermelo portato." Solleva la scatola pesante senza apparente sforzo, ti fa un cenno deciso del capo e si volta per rientrare nella base.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	Before going more than three steps, she stops and turns back to you. "Oh, sorry - I'll authorize your payment as soon as I get back to my room. I don't have it with me."|6483|0
units.english: Before going more than three steps, she stops and turns back to you. "Oh, sorry - I'll authorize your payment as soon as I get back to my room. I don't have it with me."
units.italian: Prima di fare tre passi, si ferma e torna verso di te. "Oh, scusa: autorizzo il tuo pagamento appena torno in camera. Non ce l'ho con me."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 1|	Sure enough, less than five minutes later, your communicator bleeps and reports that <payment> have been credited to your account.|6484|0
units.english: Sure enough, less than five minutes later, your communicator bleeps and reports that <payment> have been credited to your account.
units.italian: E infatti, meno di cinque minuti dopo, il tuo comunicatore trilla e segnala che <payment> sono stati accreditati sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|As you step out of your ship, you spot a familiar face: Irene Brower, the gunnery sergeant you delivered a care package to before the war, though she seems to have master sergeant insignia now. She's on crutches, with what looks like a brand-new prosthetic leg. When she spots you, her pained face brightens. "Hey, I know you! You brought me that package from Tor before. Thanks!" She shifts her weight, then winces and shifts it back.|6495|0
units.english: As you step out of your ship, you spot a familiar face: Irene Brower, the gunnery sergeant you delivered a care package to before the war, though she seems to have master sergeant insignia now. She's on crutches, with what looks like a brand-new prosthetic leg. When she spots you, her pained face brightens. "Hey, I know you! You brought me that package from Tor before. Thanks!" She shifts her weight, then winces and shifts it back.
units.italian: Appena scendi dalla nave, scorgi un viso noto: Irene Brower, la sergente d'artiglieria a cui avevi consegnato un pacco di generi di conforto prima della guerra, anche se ora sembra avere i distintivi da sergente maggiore. È su due stampelle, con quella che sembra una protesi alla gamba nuovissima. Quando ti vede, il suo viso sofferente si illumina. "Ehi, ti conosco! Mi hai portato quel pacco da Tor, tempo fa. Grazie!" Sposta il peso, sussulta e lo riporta dov'era.

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	She notices you looking at her leg, and grins lopsidedly. "Yeah. My CO thought it was a good idea to follow Voigt's plan to suppress the pirates on Greenrock. To be honest, I agreed with him at the time." She pauses a moment. "Now, not so sure, and not just because a blown-out shield capacitor lost me a leg. I heard what happened on Thule, both the good and the bad of it."|6496|0
units.english: She notices you looking at her leg, and grins lopsidedly. "Yeah. My CO thought it was a good idea to follow Voigt's plan to suppress the pirates on Greenrock. To be honest, I agreed with him at the time." She pauses a moment. "Now, not so sure, and not just because a blown-out shield capacitor lost me a leg. I heard what happened on Thule, both the good and the bad of it."
units.italian: Si accorge che guardi la sua gamba e sorride storto. "Sì. Il mio comandante ha pensato che fosse una buona idea seguire il piano di Voigt per sopprimere i pirati su Greenrock. A dire il vero, allora ero d'accordo con lui." Si ferma un momento. "Ora non ne sono più tanto sicura, e non solo perché un condensatore di scudi esploso mi è costato una gamba. Ho sentito cos'è successo su Thule, il bene e il male."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	"I'm so sorry for your loss."|6498|0
units.english: "I'm so sorry for your loss."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace tanto per la tua perdita."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	"So... that prosthetic is very new, then?"|6500|0
units.english: "So... that prosthetic is very new, then?"
units.italian: "Quindi... quella protesi è molto recente, allora?"

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	"With that prosthetic, soon you'll have a leg up on the rest of us, eh?"|6502|0
units.english: "With that prosthetic, soon you'll have a leg up on the rest of us, eh?"
units.italian: "Con quella protesi, presto avrai un piede avanti rispetto a tutti noi, eh?"

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	She grins broadly at your pun. "Yep! Just here to get a float chair for the first few weeks of adjustment."|6503|0
units.english: She grins broadly at your pun. "Yep! Just here to get a float chair for the first few weeks of adjustment."
units.italian: Lei sorride apertamente al tuo gioco di parole. "Sì! Sono qui solo per ritirare una sedia a levitazione per le prime settimane di adattamento."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	She waves it off, but her face softens. "Thanks. I'm here to pick up a float chair, for the first six weeks of adjustment."|6506|0
units.english: She waves it off, but her face softens. "Thanks. I'm here to pick up a float chair, for the first six weeks of adjustment."
units.italian: Scaccia la cosa con un gesto, ma il viso le si addolcisce. "Grazie. Sono qui per ritirare una sedia a levitazione, per le prime sei settimane di adattamento."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	She nods. "Yep, just came from getting it fitted, and gotta check in at the quartermaster's to get myself a float chair for the first six weeks of adjustment to it."|6509|0
units.english: She nods. "Yep, just came from getting it fitted, and gotta check in at the quartermaster's to get myself a float chair for the first six weeks of adjustment to it."
units.italian: Annuisce. "Sì, vengo giusto da averla provata, e devo passare dal quartiermastro a prendermi una sedia a levitazione per le prime sei settimane di adattamento."

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	"Six months of medical leave, then I'll be back in action. And hopefully assigned to ships a little less eager to jump into the thick of it when it's not really necessary, eh?"|6511|0
units.english: "Six months of medical leave, then I'll be back in action. And hopefully assigned to ships a little less eager to jump into the thick of it when it's not really necessary, eh?"
units.italian: "Sei mesi di congedo medico, poi torno in servizio. E speriamo che mi assegnino a navi un po' meno desiderose di buttarsi nella mischia quando non serve davvero, eh?"

units.id: mission:Care Package to South 2|	You join in her wry chuckle, then she gives you a wave with one crutch and bids you farewell.|6512|0
units.english: You join in her wry chuckle, then she gives you a wave with one crutch and bids you farewell.
units.italian: Ti unisci alla sua risata amara, poi lei ti saluta con una stampella e si congeda.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|name|6518|0
units.english: Search for Artemis Renard
units.italian: Cercare Artemis Renard

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|description|6519|0
units.english: Bring a missing racing pilot's father to <destination> by <date>, passing through the <waypoints> systems. You will be paid <payment>.
units.italian: Porta su <destination> il padre di una pilota da corsa scomparsa entro <date>, passando per i sistemi <waypoints>. Ti saranno pagati <payment>.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|While wandering the <origin> spaceport, waiting for your ship to be refueled, you notice a commotion near one of the other hangars; someone appears to be shouting. As you approach the disturbance, you see a well-dressed older man engaged in a heated discussion with a Navy officer beside a parked Frigate being loaded with supplies. After a few more shouts and a dismissive wave by the officer, the man turns away, exasperated - then spots you and walks over.|6536|0
units.english: While wandering the <origin> spaceport, waiting for your ship to be refueled, you notice a commotion near one of the other hangars; someone appears to be shouting. As you approach the disturbance, you see a well-dressed older man engaged in a heated discussion with a Navy officer beside a parked Frigate being loaded with supplies. After a few more shouts and a dismissive wave by the officer, the man turns away, exasperated - then spots you and walks over.
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto di <origin>, aspettando che la nave faccia rifornimento, noti un trambusto vicino a uno degli altri hangar; qualcuno sembra gridare. Avvicinandoti al disturbio, vedi un anziano ben vestito che discute animatamente con un ufficiale della Marina accanto a una Frigate parcheggiata che viene caricata di rifornimenti. Dopo altri due gridi e un gesto sprezzante dell'ufficiale, l'uomo si volta esasperato, poi ti nota e viene verso di te.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"You," the man says, "you're an independent captain, aren't you? You take jobs for credits?" He winces a little bit after he says it, maybe a little embarrassed by his bluntness.|6537|0
units.english: "You," the man says, "you're an independent captain, aren't you? You take jobs for credits?" He winces a little bit after he says it, maybe a little embarrassed by his bluntness.
units.italian: "Tu," dice l'uomo, "sei un capitano indipendente, vero? Accetti incarichi per crediti?" Sussulta un po' dopo averlo detto, forse un po' imbarazzato dalla sua bruschezza.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"I'm Captain <last>, and yes, I do."|6539|0
units.english: "I'm Captain <last>, and yes, I do."
units.italian: "Sono il Capitano <last>, e sì, li accetto."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"It depends on the job."|6540|0
units.english: "It depends on the job."
units.italian: "Dipende dall'incarico."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"Oh. That's good to hear. I'm sorry for being so brusque with you - my daughter's ship has gone missing. She's a racing pilot, the best to come out of the Paradise Worlds three times over. It's got to be foul play: pirates or a jealous competitor. That's what I told that useless Navy woman, that they've got to put out a search, but she says that she has to have authorization..." He pauses for a moment, realizing he's gone off-track.|6542|0
units.english: "Oh. That's good to hear. I'm sorry for being so brusque with you - my daughter's ship has gone missing. She's a racing pilot, the best to come out of the Paradise Worlds three times over. It's got to be foul play: pirates or a jealous competitor. That's what I told that useless Navy woman, that they've got to put out a search, but she says that she has to have authorization..." He pauses for a moment, realizing he's gone off-track.
units.italian: "Oh. È bello sentirlo. Scusa se sono stato così brusco: la nave di mia figlia è scomparsa. È una pilota da corsa, la migliore uscita dai Mondi Paradisiaci tre volte di fila. Dev'essere un crimine: pirati o un rivale geloso. È quello che ho detto a quell'inutile donna della Marina, che devono avviare una ricerca, ma lei dice che le serve un'autorizzazione..." Si ferma un momento, rendendosi conto di essere andato fuori strada.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	He sighs. "It's search-and-rescue; my daughter's ship has gone missing. She's a racing pilot, the best to come out of the Paradise Worlds three times over. It's got to be foul play: pirates or a jealous competitor. That's what I told that useless Navy woman, that they've got to put out a search, but she says that she has to have authorization..." He pauses for a moment, realizing he's gone off-track.|6545|0
units.english: He sighs. "It's search-and-rescue; my daughter's ship has gone missing. She's a racing pilot, the best to come out of the Paradise Worlds three times over. It's got to be foul play: pirates or a jealous competitor. That's what I told that useless Navy woman, that they've got to put out a search, but she says that she has to have authorization..." He pauses for a moment, realizing he's gone off-track.
units.italian: Sospira. "È una ricerca e soccorso; la nave di mia figlia è scomparsa. È una pilota da corsa, la migliore uscita dai Mondi Paradisiaci tre volte di fila. Dev'essere un crimine: pirati o un rivale geloso. È quello che ho detto a quell'inutile donna della Marina, che devono avviare una ricerca, ma lei dice che le serve un'autorizzazione..." Si ferma un momento, rendendosi conto di essere andato fuori strada.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"Again, I'm sorry. You don't need to hear all that. The loop was through Mirfak. I just need to know if you can take me to <planet> and scan for her transponder in those uninhabited systems north of there. Money is no object."|6547|0
units.english: "Again, I'm sorry. You don't need to hear all that. The loop was through Mirfak. I just need to know if you can take me to <planet> and scan for her transponder in those uninhabited systems north of there. Money is no object."
units.italian: "Di nuovo scusa. Non hai bisogno di sentire tutto questo. Il circuito passava per Mirfak. Devo solo sapere se puoi portarmi su <planet> e scansionare il suo trasponder in quei sistemi disabitati a nord. Il denaro non è un problema."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"I'd be happy to help."|6549|0
units.english: "I'd be happy to help."
units.italian: "Sarei felice di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"I'm sorry, but I can't transport you. You'll have to find another captain."|6551|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I can't transport you. You'll have to find another captain."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non posso trasportarla. Dovrà trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	A flicker of emotions crosses the man's face: anger, scorn, resignation. "I thought you'd be better than those Navy bastards," he says, shaking his head. "Well, I hope I can find someone in this place with a shred of decency before she dies out there." He walks away, his disappointment heavy in the air.|6552|0
units.english: A flicker of emotions crosses the man's face: anger, scorn, resignation. "I thought you'd be better than those Navy bastards," he says, shaking his head. "Well, I hope I can find someone in this place with a shred of decency before she dies out there." He walks away, his disappointment heavy in the air.
units.italian: Un guizzo di emozioni attraversa il viso dell'uomo: rabbia, disprezzo, rassegnazione. "Pensavo fossi meglio di quei bastardi della Marina," dice, scuotendo la testa. "Beh, spero di trovare qualcuno in questo posto con un po' di decenza prima che muoia là fuori." Se ne va, con la delusione pesante nell'aria.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	The man exhales, relieved. "Thank you so much," he says. "My name is August Renard, and my daughter is Artemis. She's out there, I know it, but we'd better get moving soon."|6555|0
units.english: The man exhales, relieved. "Thank you so much," he says. "My name is August Renard, and my daughter is Artemis. She's out there, I know it, but we'd better get moving soon."
units.italian: L'uomo espira, sollevato. "Grazie mille," dice. "Mi chiamo August Renard, e mia figlia è Artemis. È là fuori, lo so, ma è meglio che ci muoviamo presto."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"My ship is as fast as they come. We'll find her in no time."|6557|0
units.english: "My ship is as fast as they come. We'll find her in no time."
units.italian: "La mia nave è veloce come poche. La troveremo in men che non si dica."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"Artemis Renard? I think I heard she won something recently... maybe in Betelgeuse?"|6559|0
units.english: "Artemis Renard? I think I heard she won something recently... maybe in Betelgeuse?"
units.italian: "Artemis Renard? Credo di aver sentito che ha vinto qualcosa di recente... forse a Betelgeuse?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"Ah, yes," the man says with pride in his voice. "The Betelgeuse Classic. Contestants run a circuit of every planet and major moon in the system and hit every marker in an equatorial orbit without refueling. They've been doing it since the Firebird was new, and no one's done it faster than my daughter - no one. She's the best; that's how I know something's gone wrong. Tell your people to warm up the engines."|6560|0
units.english: "Ah, yes," the man says with pride in his voice. "The Betelgeuse Classic. Contestants run a circuit of every planet and major moon in the system and hit every marker in an equatorial orbit without refueling. They've been doing it since the Firebird was new, and no one's done it faster than my daughter - no one. She's the best; that's how I know something's gone wrong. Tell your people to warm up the engines."
units.italian: "Ah, sì," dice l'uomo con orgoglio nella voce. "La Betelgeuse Classic. I concorrenti fanno un giro di ogni pianeta e di ogni luna maggiore del sistema e toccano ogni boa in orbita equatoriale senza rifornire. Si corre da quando il Firebird era nuovo, e nessuno l'ha fatto più in fretta di mia figlia, nessuno. È la migliore; è così che so che qualcosa è andato storto. Dica ai suoi di scaldare i motori."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	"I appreciate your pride in your ship. I've heard 'fast as they come' for twenty years now, and I've never needed it more than today."|6563|0
units.english: "I appreciate your pride in your ship. I've heard 'fast as they come' for twenty years now, and I've never needed it more than today."
units.italian: "Apprezzo l'orgoglio per la sua nave. Sento dire 'veloce come poche' da vent'anni, e non ne ho mai avuto bisogno più di oggi."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|	You lead Mr. Renard to your ship, which he boards with unusual nimbleness and comfort for an old man from the Paradise Worlds.|6565|0
units.english: You lead Mr. Renard to your ship, which he boards with unusual nimbleness and comfort for an old man from the Paradise Worlds.
units.italian: Guidi il signor Renard alla tua nave, e lui sale con un'agilità e una disinvoltura insolite per un vecchio dei Mondi Paradisiaci.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 1|dialog|6568|0
units.english: You've passed through all three systems outlined in the search plan, running long-range deep scans for Artemis Renard's transponder in each, but all you've gotten back is static. As far as you can tell, she's not in any of them.
units.italian: Hai attraversato tutti e tre i sistemi indicati nel piano di ricerca, eseguendo in ciascuno scansioni profonde a lungo raggio per il trasponder di Artemis Renard, ma hai ricevuto solo statica. Da quanto puoi dire, non è in nessuno di essi.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|name|6575|0
units.english: Return to <planet>
units.italian: Ritorno su <planet>

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|description|6576|0
units.english: You have decided not to continue the search for Artemis Renard. Return her grieving father August to <destination>.
units.italian: Hai deciso di non continuare la ricerca di Artemis Renard. Riporta a <destination> suo padre August, in lutto.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|You were unable to find Artemis Renard in any of the three uninhabited systems, and you have watched hope fade into desperation in her father with each successive failure. You can't imagine he's been getting much sleep.|6584|0
units.english: You were unable to find Artemis Renard in any of the three uninhabited systems, and you have watched hope fade into desperation in her father with each successive failure. You can't imagine he's been getting much sleep.
units.italian: Non sei riuscito a trovare Artemis Renard in nessuno dei tre sistemi disabitati, e hai visto la speranza di suo padre trasformarsi in disperazione a ogni fallimento successivo. Non immagini che abbia dormito molto.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	During the landing on <origin>, you notice that there is a great deal of race infrastructure still in place around the planet and spaceport: large camera drones remain in low orbit, and the spaceport is filled with a variety of ships in racing livery. A mostly depleted Navy contingent remains, empty areas testifying to the ongoing hunt, while the few remaining officers interview racers, organizers, and spectators. The spaceport seems busier and more hectic than usual.|6585|0
units.english: During the landing on <origin>, you notice that there is a great deal of race infrastructure still in place around the planet and spaceport: large camera drones remain in low orbit, and the spaceport is filled with a variety of ships in racing livery. A mostly depleted Navy contingent remains, empty areas testifying to the ongoing hunt, while the few remaining officers interview racers, organizers, and spectators. The spaceport seems busier and more hectic than usual.
units.italian: Durante l'atterraggio su <origin>, noti che intorno al pianeta e allo spazioporto c'è ancora molta infrastruttura della corsa: grandi droni-telecamera restano in orbita bassa, e lo spazioporto è pieno di navi con i colori delle scuderie. Resta un contingente della Marina in gran parte ridotto, con zone vuote che testimoniano la caccia in corso, mentre i pochi ufficiali rimasti intervistano piloti, organizzatori e spettatori. Lo spazioporto sembra più animato e caotico del solito.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"I've got to speak with the race coordinators here," says Mr. Renard, striding towards the marshal station. "I see the marshals are back from searching. Syndicate idiots, probably didn't even notice she was missing 'til it was on the news. We've got to keep looking. Will you meet me back here in the spaceport in an hour or two? I'll double your fee."|6586|0
units.english: "I've got to speak with the race coordinators here," says Mr. Renard, striding towards the marshal station. "I see the marshals are back from searching. Syndicate idiots, probably didn't even notice she was missing 'til it was on the news. We've got to keep looking. Will you meet me back here in the spaceport in an hour or two? I'll double your fee."
units.italian: "Devo parlare con i coordinatori della corsa, qui," dice il signor Renard, incamminandosi verso la stazione dei commissari. "Vedo che i commissari sono tornati dalle ricerche. Idioti del Sindacato, probabilmente non si sono nemmeno accorti che mancava finché non è finita sui notiziari. Dobbiamo continuare a cercare. Ci vediamo qui allo spazioporto fra un'ora o due? Raddoppio la paga."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"Of course. We're going to find her."|6588|0
units.english: "Of course. We're going to find her."
units.italian: "Certo. La troveremo."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"I'm sorry, but I can't help any more."|6590|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I can't help any more."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non posso aiutare oltre."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"Fine," he says, "then take your money." He slams a credit chip for <payment> in your hand and storms off into the spaceport, on the verge of tears.|6593|0
units.english: "Fine," he says, "then take your money." He slams a credit chip for <payment> in your hand and storms off into the spaceport, on the verge of tears.
units.italian: "Bene," dice, "allora prenditi i tuoi soldi." Ti sbatte in mano un chip di credito da <payment> e se ne va infuriato nello spazioporto, sul punto di piangere.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	Much later, you receive a request to take him to Glory.|6594|0
units.english: Much later, you receive a request to take him to Glory.
units.italian: Molto più tardi, ricevi una richiesta di portarlo su Glory.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"You're a saint for this," he says, and hands you a credit chip for <payment>. "We have to find her.|6597|0
units.english: "You're a saint for this," he says, and hands you a credit chip for <payment>. "We have to find her.
units.italian: "Sei un santo," dice, e ti porge un chip di credito da <payment>. "Dobbiamo trovarla.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"Meet me in the spaceport in a couple of hours. I want to look for clues."|6598|0
units.english: "Meet me in the spaceport in a couple of hours. I want to look for clues."
units.italian: "Ci vediamo allo spazioporto fra un paio d'ore. Voglio cercare indizi."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	When you meet August Renard, he looks no better than when he left the <ship>. However, he does manage to speak. "Please take me to <planet>, captain. It's better to lead the search remotely from there than deal with these people in person."|6601|0
units.english: When you meet August Renard, he looks no better than when he left the <ship>. However, he does manage to speak. "Please take me to <planet>, captain. It's better to lead the search remotely from there than deal with these people in person."
units.italian: Quando incontri August Renard, non ha un aspetto migliore di quando è sceso dalla <ship>. Riesce però a parlare. "La prego, mi porti su <planet>, capitano. È meglio dirigere la ricerca da lontano che avere a che fare con questa gente di persona."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"I guess."|6603|0
units.english: "I guess."
units.italian: "Immagino."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"Sorry. You'll have to find another captain."|6605|0
units.english: "Sorry. You'll have to find another captain."
units.italian: "Spiacente. Dovrà trovare un altro capitano."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|log|6608|0
units.english: Conducted a brief search but was unable to find anything of the famous racing pilot Artemis Renard. Returned her grieving father home to Glory.
units.italian: Ho condotto una breve ricerca senza trovare nulla della famosa pilota da corsa Artemis Renard. Ho riportato a Glory suo padre, in lutto.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|log|6609|0
units.english: August Renard contracted me to help look for his daughter Artemis, a racing pilot who went missing. Unable to find the woman, but returned her father home to Glory.
units.italian: August Renard mi ha ingaggiato per cercare sua figlia Artemis, una pilota da corsa scomparsa. Non sono riuscito a trovarla, ma ho riportato a Glory suo padre.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|As the advanced medical facilities of <planet> rise up to greet the <ship>, August comes to meet you on the bridge. "Captain, I would like to thank you for attempting to find my daughter, even though the attempt ended poorly. Thank you for that, at least." He then prepares to exit the ship, outside of which a veritable army of attendants are waiting.|6611|0
units.english: As the advanced medical facilities of <planet> rise up to greet the <ship>, August comes to meet you on the bridge. "Captain, I would like to thank you for attempting to find my daughter, even though the attempt ended poorly. Thank you for that, at least." He then prepares to exit the ship, outside of which a veritable army of attendants are waiting.
units.italian: Mentre le strutture mediche avanzate di <planet> si alzano davanti alla <ship>, August viene a incontrarti sul ponte. "Capitano, vorrei ringraziarla per aver tentato di trovare mia figlia, anche se il tentativo è finito male. Almeno grazie per questo." Poi si prepara a uscire dalla nave, fuori dalla quale aspetta un vero e proprio esercito di attendenti.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	"Weren't you going to pay me?"|6613|0
units.english: "Weren't you going to pay me?"
units.italian: "Non doveva pagarmi?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	(Leave him alone.)|6615|0
units.english: (Leave him alone.)
units.italian: (Lascialo stare.)

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	August is escorted to a Shuttle which has just landed on the pad next to the <ship>, waves to you as he goes in, and launches to another part of the planet.|6616|0
units.english: August is escorted to a Shuttle which has just landed on the pad next to the <ship>, waves to you as he goes in, and launches to another part of the planet.
units.italian: August viene accompagnato a uno Shuttle appena atterrato sulla piazzola accanto alla <ship>, ti saluta con la mano mentre entra e parte verso un'altra parte del pianeta.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	August turns. "What! After what you've done, crashed my hopes, you expect me to pay you! Why would you think that? Fine!" He throws a credit chip at you and exits the <ship> in a huff.|6621|0
units.english: August turns. "What! After what you've done, crashed my hopes, you expect me to pay you! Why would you think that? Fine!" He throws a credit chip at you and exits the <ship> in a huff.
units.italian: August si volta. "Cosa! Dopo quello che hai fatto, dopo aver distrutto le mie speranze, ti aspetti che ti paghi! Perché mai dovresti pensarlo? Va bene!" Ti lancia un chip di credito e esce dalla <ship> indignato.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Ended|	When you access the credit chip, you find it is only worth <payment>.|6622|0
units.english: When you access the credit chip, you find it is only worth <payment>.
units.italian: Quando controlli il chip di credito, scopri che vale solo <payment>.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|name|6625|0
units.english: Search for Artemis Renard
units.italian: Cercare Artemis Renard

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|description|6626|0
units.english: Search the system of <system> for Artemis Renard, especially <planet>.
units.italian: Cerca Artemis Renard nel sistema <system>, soprattutto su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|The displays in the spaceport hangar flicker with a news broadcast: sweeping aerial views of the spaceport alongside photos of Artemis Renard beside her red-and-white Flivver, wearing a calm, confident expression. Beneath the images, the screen reads "CORE CHAMPIONSHIP CATASTROPHE: MISSING MISS RENARD MYSTIFIES MILLIONS."|6640|0
units.english: The displays in the spaceport hangar flicker with a news broadcast: sweeping aerial views of the spaceport alongside photos of Artemis Renard beside her red-and-white Flivver, wearing a calm, confident expression. Beneath the images, the screen reads "CORE CHAMPIONSHIP CATASTROPHE: MISSING MISS RENARD MYSTIFIES MILLIONS."
units.italian: Gli schermi nell'hangar dello spazioporto sfarfallano con un notiziario: riprese aeree dello spazioporto che scorrono accanto a foto di Artemis Renard accanto al suo Flivver rosso e bianco, con un'espressione calma e sicura. Sotto le immagini, lo schermo recita "CATASTROFE AL CAMPIONATO CORE: LA SCOMPARSA DELLA SIGNORINA RENARD CONFONDE MILIONI DI PERSONE".

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	(Watch the news broadcast.)|6642|0
units.english: (Watch the news broadcast.)
units.italian: (Guarda il notiziario.)

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	(Wait for Mr. Renard to return.)|6643|0
units.english: (Wait for Mr. Renard to return.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che torni il signor Renard.)

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	The voice of an eerily calm anchor plays over more vignettes of the race infrastructure. "... and, of course, today's top story: three-time Centurion-Division, Paradise Circuit racing champion Artemis Renard has been officially declared 'missing' after she did not return here to Sunracer after this year's Megaparsec Core Championship. The search effort has been ongoing for days now, led by Megaparsec with support from the Republic Navy and Syndicated Security. The head of the event, Quinn Emerson, put out the following statement:|6645|0
units.english: The voice of an eerily calm anchor plays over more vignettes of the race infrastructure. "... and, of course, today's top story: three-time Centurion-Division, Paradise Circuit racing champion Artemis Renard has been officially declared 'missing' after she did not return here to Sunracer after this year's Megaparsec Core Championship. The search effort has been ongoing for days now, led by Megaparsec with support from the Republic Navy and Syndicated Security. The head of the event, Quinn Emerson, put out the following statement:
units.italian: La voce di un conduttore stranamente calmo accompagna altre immagini dell'infrastruttura della corsa. "... e, naturalmente, la notizia principale di oggi: Artemis Renard, tre volte campionessa della Paradise Circuit nella divisione Centurione, è stata ufficialmente dichiarata 'scomparsa' dopo non essere tornata qui a Sunracer al termine del Campionato Core Megaparsec di quest'anno. Le ricerche vanno avanti da giorni, guidate da Megaparsec con il supporto della Marina della Repubblica e della Sicurezza del Sindacato. Il responsabile dell'evento, Quinn Emerson, ha diffuso la seguente dichiarazione:

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"'We at Megaparsec put the greatest attention into ensuring the safety and well-being of all our event participants and guests. Over the past forty-eight hours, our search teams have fully scanned the Volax, Cardax, Moktar, Bellatrix, and Menkar systems, and we are working in conjunction with the Republic and Syndicate to fully scour their territories belonging to the circuit as well. Ms. Renard's family can rest assured that if she's out there, we'll find her.'|6646|0
units.english: "'We at Megaparsec put the greatest attention into ensuring the safety and well-being of all our event participants and guests. Over the past forty-eight hours, our search teams have fully scanned the Volax, Cardax, Moktar, Bellatrix, and Menkar systems, and we are working in conjunction with the Republic and Syndicate to fully scour their territories belonging to the circuit as well. Ms. Renard's family can rest assured that if she's out there, we'll find her.'
units.italian: "'Noi di Megaparsec dedichiamo la massima attenzione a garantire la sicurezza e il benessere di tutti i partecipanti e gli ospiti dei nostri eventi. Nelle ultime quarantotto ore le nostre squadre di ricerca hanno scansionato completamente i sistemi Volax, Cardax, Moktar, Bellatrix e Menkar, e stiamo lavorando con la Repubblica e il Sindacato per setacciare anche i loro territori che fanno parte del circuito. La famiglia della signorina Renard può stare certa che, se è là fuori, la troveremo.'

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"'Artemis Renard, daughter of terraforming magnates August and Louisa Renard, is perhaps best known for shattering the record for the Betelgeuse Classic in last year's race, crossing the finish line nearly fifteen minutes faster than the record set by Jackson Lee over twenty years ago. She was last seen flying her ship, the Moonfox, a white and red Lionheart Flivver with race registration B-168, in the Diphda system. Anyone with information regarding her whereabouts is encouraged to contact Syndicate or Navy authorities, as well as the Megaparsec Racing Events Commission, and may be entitled to monetary reward if such information leads to the retrieval of Ms. Renard or her ship.'"|6647|0
units.english: "'Artemis Renard, daughter of terraforming magnates August and Louisa Renard, is perhaps best known for shattering the record for the Betelgeuse Classic in last year's race, crossing the finish line nearly fifteen minutes faster than the record set by Jackson Lee over twenty years ago. She was last seen flying her ship, the Moonfox, a white and red Lionheart Flivver with race registration B-168, in the Diphda system. Anyone with information regarding her whereabouts is encouraged to contact Syndicate or Navy authorities, as well as the Megaparsec Racing Events Commission, and may be entitled to monetary reward if such information leads to the retrieval of Ms. Renard or her ship.'"
units.italian: "'Artemis Renard, figlia dei magnati della terraformazione August e Louisa Renard, è forse nota soprattutto per aver polverizzato il record della Betelgeuse Classic nella corsa dell'anno scorso, tagliando il traguardo quasi quindici minuti prima del record stabilito da Jackson Lee oltre vent'anni fa. È stata vista l'ultima volta mentre pilotava la sua nave, la Moonfox, un Lionheart Flivver bianco e rosso con matricola di gara B-168, nel sistema Diphda. Chiunque abbia informazioni sul suo paradero è invitato a contattare le autorità del Sindacato o della Marina, nonché la Commissione per gli eventi di corsa Megaparsec, e potrebbe avere diritto a una ricompensa in denaro se tali informazioni porteranno al ritrovamento della signorina Renard o della sua nave.'"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	The broadcast then ends, going to an advertisement for the Megaparsec Splinter.|6648|0
units.english: The broadcast then ends, going to an advertisement for the Megaparsec Splinter.
units.italian: Il notiziario termina, passando a una pubblicità del Megaparsec Splinter.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	Several minutes later, you see Mr. Renard returning from the terminal side of the spaceport, looking frustrated. "Idiots!" he shouts. "They couldn't find their legs in a dressing room! They tell me that they had 'some network and monitoring issues' and that they don't have surveillance for the entire last leg of the race. I told Artemis to never trust these Syndicate amateurs."|6651|0
units.english: Several minutes later, you see Mr. Renard returning from the terminal side of the spaceport, looking frustrated. "Idiots!" he shouts. "They couldn't find their legs in a dressing room! They tell me that they had 'some network and monitoring issues' and that they don't have surveillance for the entire last leg of the race. I told Artemis to never trust these Syndicate amateurs."
units.italian: Diversi minuti dopo, vedi il signor Renard tornare dal lato del terminal dello spazioporto, con l'aria frustrata. "Idioti!" grida. "Non troverebbero le loro gambe in uno spogliatoio! Mi dicono che hanno avuto 'qualche problema di rete e di monitoraggio' e che non hanno le riprese dell'intera ultima tappa della corsa. Ho detto ad Artemis di non fidarsi mai di questi dilettanti del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'm sure they're trying their best."|6653|0
units.english: "I'm sure they're trying their best."
units.italian: "Sono certo che stanno facendo del loro meglio."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"'Network and monitoring issues' sounds suspicious."|6654|0
units.english: "'Network and monitoring issues' sounds suspicious."
units.italian: "'Problemi di rete e di monitoraggio' suona sospetto."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Do you have a plan for where to go next?"|6656|0
units.english: "Do you have a plan for where to go next?"
units.italian: "Ha un piano su dove andare adesso?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Well their best isn't very good, is it! They don't notice that their number-one pilot has been missing for days? I'll get the best lawyers in the Republic to drag Megaparsec through court 'till the only thing left they'll be able to sell is scrap!"|6658|0
units.english: "Well their best isn't very good, is it! They don't notice that their number-one pilot has been missing for days? I'll get the best lawyers in the Republic to drag Megaparsec through court 'till the only thing left they'll be able to sell is scrap!"
units.italian: "Beh, il loro meglio non è un granché, no? Non si accorgono che la loro pilota numero uno manca da giorni? Troverò i migliori avvocati della Repubblica per trascinare Megaparsec in tribunale finché non gli resterà da vendere solo il ferro vecchio!"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"What you said about 'network and monitoring issues' sounded suspicious."|6660|0
units.english: "What you said about 'network and monitoring issues' sounded suspicious."
units.italian: "Quello che ha detto sui 'problemi di rete e di monitoraggio' suonava sospetto."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"So what's the plan from here?"|6661|0
units.english: "So what's the plan from here?"
units.italian: "Allora qual è il piano da qui?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	Mr. Renard suddenly speaks more quietly. "I thought so too. I think it might have been sabotage."|6664|0
units.english: Mr. Renard suddenly speaks more quietly. "I thought so too. I think it might have been sabotage."
units.italian: Il signor Renard parla all'improvviso più piano. "Lo pensavo anch'io. Credo che potrebbe essere stato un sabotaggio."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"What do you mean?" you ask.|6665|0
units.english: "What do you mean?" you ask.
units.italian: "Che cosa vuole dire?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Every day that Artemis is lost, the odds on her plummet and the bets on her competitors skyrocket. I've spent enough time making money to know that there's no faster way to bruise a competitor than scandal. I think someone sabotaged the race and went after my daughter because they knew it would make headlines, and they knew they could cash in by betting on underdogs."|6666|0
units.english: "Every day that Artemis is lost, the odds on her plummet and the bets on her competitors skyrocket. I've spent enough time making money to know that there's no faster way to bruise a competitor than scandal. I think someone sabotaged the race and went after my daughter because they knew it would make headlines, and they knew they could cash in by betting on underdogs."
units.italian: "Ogni giorno che Artemis resta dispersa, le quote su di lei crollano e le puntate sui suoi rivali schizzano alle stelle. Ho passato abbastanza tempo a fare soldi per sapere che non c'è modo più rapido di colpire un concorrente di uno scandalo. Credo che qualcuno abbia sabotato la corsa e sia andato dietro a mia figlia perché sapeva che avrebbe fatto notizia, e sapeva che avrebbe potuto guadagnarci puntando sugli sfavoriti."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Who do you think did it?"|6668|0
units.english: "Who do you think did it?"
units.italian: "Chi pensi che sia stato?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'm not sure I'm convinced. Couldn't she just have crashed?"|6670|0
units.english: "I'm not sure I'm convinced. Couldn't she just have crashed?"
units.italian: "Non sono sicuro di esserne convinto. Non potrebbe semplicemente essersi schiantata?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	Mr. Renard scoffs. "She's been named the best racing pilot in the Republic three times! She didn't just crash."|6671|0
units.english: Mr. Renard scoffs. "She's been named the best racing pilot in the Republic three times! She didn't just crash."
units.italian: Il signor Renard sbuffa. "È stata nominata tre volte la miglior pilota da corsa della Repubblica! Non si è semplicemente schiantata."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Fair enough. So if this was sabotage, who do you think did it?"|6673|0
units.english: "Fair enough. So if this was sabotage, who do you think did it?"
units.italian: "Giusto. Quindi, se è stato un sabotaggio, chi pensi che sia stato?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I didn't mean to cast doubt on her skill; I just meant that I'm not sure this has to be a conspiracy."|6674|0
units.english: "I didn't mean to cast doubt on her skill; I just meant that I'm not sure this has to be a conspiracy."
units.italian: "Non volevo mettere in dubbio la sua abilità; dicevo solo che non sono sicuro che debba per forza essere un complotto."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'm not sure," Mr. Renard says, "Maybe the Syndicate, maybe Betelgeuse or Lionheart. Even an ambitious pirate. Each could benefit from betting on such a high-profile race."|6677|0
units.english: "I'm not sure," Mr. Renard says, "Maybe the Syndicate, maybe Betelgeuse or Lionheart. Even an ambitious pirate. Each could benefit from betting on such a high-profile race."
units.italian: "Non ne sono sicuro," dice il signor Renard, "forse il Sindacato, forse Betelgeuse o Lionheart. Persino un pirata ambizioso. Ognuno potrebbe guadagnarci puntando su una corsa così seguita."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"So what's your plan? How are we going to find her?"|6679|0
units.english: "So what's your plan? How are we going to find her?"
units.italian: "Allora qual è il suo piano? Come la troveremo?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	Mr. Renard sighs. "Maybe not. I just want her back, you know." He pulls out a photo of her, moving it slightly between his fingers so that it is evenly lit; it looks a couple of years younger than the one on the news broadcast. "They said she was last seen in Diphda. If she was going north, as she should have been, then we should keep looking in Acamar. It's an uninhabited system, and with surveillance down, whatever went wrong would have happened long before anyone else even entered the system."|6682|0
units.english: Mr. Renard sighs. "Maybe not. I just want her back, you know." He pulls out a photo of her, moving it slightly between his fingers so that it is evenly lit; it looks a couple of years younger than the one on the news broadcast. "They said she was last seen in Diphda. If she was going north, as she should have been, then we should keep looking in Acamar. It's an uninhabited system, and with surveillance down, whatever went wrong would have happened long before anyone else even entered the system."
units.italian: Il signor Renard sospira. "Forse no. Voglio solo riaverla, sai." Tira fuori una sua foto, spostandola leggermente fra le dita perché sia illuminata in modo uniforme; sembra più vecchia di un paio d'anni rispetto a quella del notiziario. "Dicono che sia stata vista l'ultima volta in Diphda. Se andava a nord, come doveva, allora dovremmo continuare a cercare in Acamar. È un sistema disabitato, e con la sorveglianza spenta, qualunque cosa sia andata storta dev'essere successa molto prima che chiunque altro entrasse nel sistema."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'll set a course for Acamar."|6684|0
units.english: "I'll set a course for Acamar."
units.italian: "Imposto la rotta per Acamar."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'm sorry that this happened, but I'm afraid I can't help."|6686|0
units.english: "I'm sorry that this happened, but I'm afraid I can't help."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace che sia successo, ma temo di non poter aiutare."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Then you're just like the rest of those fools!" Mr. Renard stomps off in a rage.|6687|0
units.english: "Then you're just like the rest of those fools!" Mr. Renard stomps off in a rage.
units.italian: "Allora sei come tutti gli altri idioti!" Il signor Renard se ne va furioso.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"They said she was last seen in Diphda. If she was going north, as she should have been, they probably caught up to her in Acamar. It's an uninhabited system, and with surveillance down, whoever did it could have disabled her ship before any of the other racers entered the system.|6690|0
units.english: "They said she was last seen in Diphda. If she was going north, as she should have been, they probably caught up to her in Acamar. It's an uninhabited system, and with surveillance down, whoever did it could have disabled her ship before any of the other racers entered the system.
units.italian: "Dicono che sia stata vista l'ultima volta in Diphda. Se andava a nord, come doveva, probabilmente l'hanno raggiunta in Acamar. È un sistema disabitato, e con la sorveglianza spenta, chi l'ha fatto potrebbe aver neutralizzato la sua nave prima che qualsiasi altro concorrente entrasse nel sistema.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'll set a course for Acamar."|6692|0
units.english: "I'll set a course for Acamar."
units.italian: "Imposto la rotta per Acamar."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'm sorry that this happened, but I'm afraid I can't help."|6694|0
units.english: "I'm sorry that this happened, but I'm afraid I can't help."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace che sia successo, ma temo di non poter aiutare."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Then you're just like the rest of those fools!" Mr. Renard stomps off in a rage.|6695|0
units.english: "Then you're just like the rest of those fools!" Mr. Renard stomps off in a rage.
units.italian: "Allora sei come tutti gli altri idioti!" Il signor Renard se ne va furioso.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Thank you, Captain. We need to get moving immediately."|6698|0
units.english: "Thank you, Captain. We need to get moving immediately."
units.italian: "Grazie, Capitano. Dobbiamo muoverci subito."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|Upon entering the Acamar system, your sensors detect a faint radio signal coming from the third planet in the system, but you realize that the radio signal is a result of the electrical discharges from the planet's atmosphere produced by the many volcanoes on the surface. After calibrating your sensors to account for this, you are unable to detect any transponder signal matching Artemis' ship.|6703|0
units.english: Upon entering the Acamar system, your sensors detect a faint radio signal coming from the third planet in the system, but you realize that the radio signal is a result of the electrical discharges from the planet's atmosphere produced by the many volcanoes on the surface. After calibrating your sensors to account for this, you are unable to detect any transponder signal matching Artemis' ship.
units.italian: Entrando nel sistema Acamar, i sensori rilevano un debole segnale radio dal terzo pianeta del sistema, ma ti rendi conto che il segnale è prodotto dalle scariche elettriche dell'atmosfera, generate dai molti vulcani sulla superficie. Dopo aver calibrato i sensori per tenerne conto, non riesci a rilevare alcun trasponder compatibile con la nave di Artemis.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	Mr. Renard paces around the bridge of the <ship>, prodding at consoles. "Are you sure you checked it? Is that the right frequency?"|6704|0
units.english: Mr. Renard paces around the bridge of the <ship>, prodding at consoles. "Are you sure you checked it? Is that the right frequency?"
units.italian: Il signor Renard va avanti e indietro sul ponte della <ship>, armeggiando con le console. "Sei sicuro di aver controllato? È la frequenza giusta?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Is there anywhere else she could be?"|6706|0
units.english: "Is there anywhere else she could be?"
units.italian: "C'è qualche altro posto dove potrebbe essere?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Please calm down."|6708|0
units.english: "Please calm down."
units.italian: "La prego, si calmi."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Calm! Calm? You expect me to be calm? If your daughter was missing would you be calm?"|6709|0
units.english: "Calm! Calm? You expect me to be calm? If your daughter was missing would you be calm?"
units.italian: "Calmo! Calmo? Ti aspetti che sia calmo? Se tua figlia fosse scomparsa, saresti calmo?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'm sorry. Is there anywhere else she could be?"|6711|0
units.english: "I'm sorry. Is there anywhere else she could be?"
units.italian: "Mi dispiace. C'è qualche altro posto dove potrebbe essere?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'm sure I wouldn't know."|6713|0
units.english: "I'm sure I wouldn't know."
units.italian: "Non saprei proprio."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	(Ignore the question.)|6714|0
units.english: (Ignore the question.)
units.italian: (Ignora la domanda.)

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	August seems to suddenly calm down. "I suppose you wouldn't.|6715|0
units.english: August seems to suddenly calm down. "I suppose you wouldn't.
units.italian: August sembra calmarsi all'improvviso. "Immagino di no.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Anyway, I'm not sure if she could even be anywhere else. The route went north from here, up through Elnath and Nihal and then through the uninhabited systems back to Mirfak. But we've checked every one of those systems and haven't seen a signal." He stops for a moment, sitting down and putting his head in his hands. "We should have found her!"|6716|0
units.english: "Anyway, I'm not sure if she could even be anywhere else. The route went north from here, up through Elnath and Nihal and then through the uninhabited systems back to Mirfak. But we've checked every one of those systems and haven't seen a signal." He stops for a moment, sitting down and putting his head in his hands. "We should have found her!"
units.italian: "Comunque, non sono sicuro che potrebbe essere altrove. La rotta andava a nord da qui, su attraverso Elnath e Nihal e poi attraverso i sistemi disabitati fino a Mirfak. Ma li abbiamo controllati tutti, e non abbiamo visto un segnale." Si ferma un momento, si siede e si prende la testa fra le mani. "Avremmo dovuto trovarla!"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I'm not sure. The route went north from here, up through Elnath and Nihal and then through the uninhabited systems back to Mirfak. But we've checked every one of those systems! We should have seen a signal!" He stops for a moment, sitting down and putting his head in his hands. "We should have found her!"|6719|0
units.english: "I'm not sure. The route went north from here, up through Elnath and Nihal and then through the uninhabited systems back to Mirfak. But we've checked every one of those systems! We should have seen a signal!" He stops for a moment, sitting down and putting his head in his hands. "We should have found her!"
units.italian: "Non ne sono sicuro. La rotta andava a nord da qui, su attraverso Elnath e Nihal e poi attraverso i sistemi disabitati fino a Mirfak. Ma li abbiamo controllati tutti! Avremmo dovuto vedere un segnale!" Si ferma un momento, si siede e si prende la testa fra le mani. "Avremmo dovuto trovarla!"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	You clear the rest of your crew off the bridge to give him some space.|6721|0
units.english: You clear the rest of your crew off the bridge to give him some space.
units.italian: Fai uscire il resto dell'equipaggio dal ponte per lasciargli un po' di spazio.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"I suppose I should just give you your money and go home," he rasps.|6722|0
units.english: "I suppose I should just give you your money and go home," he rasps.
units.italian: "Immagino che dovrei solo darti i tuoi soldi e andarmene a casa," gracchia.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Perhaps that would be best."|6724|0
units.english: "Perhaps that would be best."
units.italian: "Forse sarebbe la cosa migliore."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	(Suggest a different system.)|6726|0
units.english: (Suggest a different system.)
units.italian: (Suggerisci un altro sistema.)

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"What about there," you say, pointing to the neighboring system. "Kugel. It's off the circuit, so no one will have searched there, but if her hyperdrive malfunctioned or was sabotaged, she might have ended up there. It's only a single jump away."|6729|0
units.english: "What about there," you say, pointing to the neighboring system. "Kugel. It's off the circuit, so no one will have searched there, but if her hyperdrive malfunctioned or was sabotaged, she might have ended up there. It's only a single jump away."
units.italian: "E là?" dici, indicando il sistema vicino. "Kugel. È fuori dal circuito, quindi nessuno l'ha cercata, ma se il suo iperpropulsore si è guastato o è stato sabotato, potrebbe essere finita là. È a un solo salto."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"Okay," he says, wiping his eyes with the corners of his sleeves. "Kugel it is, Captain."|6730|0
units.english: "Okay," he says, wiping his eyes with the corners of his sleeves. "Kugel it is, Captain."
units.italian: "Va bene," dice, asciugandosi gli occhi con gli angoli delle maniche. "Kugel sia, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"You're just like all the rest of those captains, don't care about their passengers, only seek to be paid." August Renard sighs. "But, I suppose that is to be expected. If nobody will help, giving up is the only option.|6734|0
units.english: "You're just like all the rest of those captains, don't care about their passengers, only seek to be paid." August Renard sighs. "But, I suppose that is to be expected. If nobody will help, giving up is the only option.
units.italian: "Sei come tutti gli altri capitani, non ti importa dei passeggeri, cerchi solo di essere pagato." August Renard sospira. "Ma immagino che fosse prevedibile. Se nessuno vuole aiutare, arrendersi è l'unica opzione.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Continued|	"At least take me back to Glory."|6735|0
units.english: "At least take me back to Glory."
units.italian: "Almeno riportami su Glory."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Failed|name|6749|0
units.english: Take August to <planet>
units.italian: Porta August su <planet>

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Failed|description|6750|0
units.english: After your failed search for Artemis Renard, take her father, August, back to <destination>.
units.italian: Dopo la ricerca fallita di Artemis Renard, riporta a <destination> suo padre August.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Failed|As the advanced medical facilities of <planet> rise up to greet the <ship>, August comes to meet you on the bridge. "Captain, I would like to thank you for attempting to find my daughter, even though the attempt ended poorly. Thank you for that, at least." He then prepares to exit the ship, outside of which a veritable army of attendants are waiting.|6761|0
units.english: As the advanced medical facilities of <planet> rise up to greet the <ship>, August comes to meet you on the bridge. "Captain, I would like to thank you for attempting to find my daughter, even though the attempt ended poorly. Thank you for that, at least." He then prepares to exit the ship, outside of which a veritable army of attendants are waiting.
units.italian: Mentre le strutture mediche avanzate di <planet> si alzano davanti alla <ship>, August viene a incontrarti sul ponte. "Capitano, vorrei ringraziarla per aver tentato di trovare mia figlia, anche se il tentativo è finito male. Almeno grazie per questo." Poi si prepara a uscire dalla nave, fuori dalla quale aspetta un vero e proprio esercito di attendenti.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Failed|	"Weren't you going to pay me?"|6763|0
units.english: "Weren't you going to pay me?"
units.italian: "Non doveva pagarmi?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Failed|	(Leave him alone.)|6765|0
units.english: (Leave him alone.)
units.italian: (Lascialo stare.)

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Failed|	August is escorted to a Shuttle which has just landed on the pad next to the <ship>, waves to you as he goes in, and launches to another part of the planet.|6766|0
units.english: August is escorted to a Shuttle which has just landed on the pad next to the <ship>, waves to you as he goes in, and launches to another part of the planet.
units.italian: August viene accompagnato a uno Shuttle appena atterrato sulla piazzola accanto alla <ship>, ti saluta con la mano mentre entra e parte verso un'altra parte del pianeta.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Failed|	August turns. "What! After what you've done, crashed my hopes, you expect me to pay you? Why would you think that? Fine!" He throws a credit chip at you and exits the <ship> in a huff.|6771|0
units.english: August turns. "What! After what you've done, crashed my hopes, you expect me to pay you? Why would you think that? Fine!" He throws a credit chip at you and exits the <ship> in a huff.
units.italian: August si volta. "Cosa! Dopo quello che hai fatto, dopo aver distrutto le mie speranze, ti aspetti che ti paghi? Perché mai dovresti pensarlo? Va bene!" Ti lancia un chip di credito e esce dalla <ship> indignato.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 2 - Failed|	When you access the credit chip, you find it is only worth <payment>.|6772|0
units.english: When you access the credit chip, you find it is only worth <payment>.
units.italian: Quando controlli il chip di credito, scopri che vale solo <payment>.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|name|6776|0
units.english: Return Artemis Renard
units.italian: Riportare Artemis Renard

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|description|6777|0
units.english: You have found Artemis Renard. Transport her and her father back to <destination>.
units.italian: Hai trovato Artemis Renard. Trasporta lei e suo padre su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|Upon reaching the planet, you pinpoint the radio signal to a valley in the southern hemisphere. You descend through a raging sandstorm; you have to rely entirely on instruments as the view from the <ship>'s bridge is almost entirely obscured. Soon, your scanners report that the source of the signal is less than a kilometer out, and after a few moments more, you begin to discern the vague shape of a crashed Flivver through the haze of dust. You land the <ship> next to the wreck, and both you and Mr. Renard go to exit the ship.|6785|0
units.english: Upon reaching the planet, you pinpoint the radio signal to a valley in the southern hemisphere. You descend through a raging sandstorm; you have to rely entirely on instruments as the view from the <ship>'s bridge is almost entirely obscured. Soon, your scanners report that the source of the signal is less than a kilometer out, and after a few moments more, you begin to discern the vague shape of a crashed Flivver through the haze of dust. You land the <ship> next to the wreck, and both you and Mr. Renard go to exit the ship.
units.italian: Raggiunto il pianeta, individui il segnale radio in una valle dell'emisfero meridionale. Scendi attraverso una tempesta di sabbia furiosa; devi affidarti interamente agli strumenti, perché la vista dal ponte della <ship> è quasi del tutto oscurata. Presto gli scanner segnalano che la fonte del segnale è a meno di un chilometro, e dopo qualche altro momento cominci a distinguere la sagoma vaga di un Flivver schiantato attraverso la foschia di polvere. Fai atterrare la <ship> accanto al relitto, e sia tu sia il signor Renard vi accingete a uscire.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	Visibility is even worse on foot, and while August shouts over the howling wind, you cannot tell what he is saying. As you clear the front part of your own ship, you see the crashed ship before you.|6786|0
units.english: Visibility is even worse on foot, and while August shouts over the howling wind, you cannot tell what he is saying. As you clear the front part of your own ship, you see the crashed ship before you.
units.italian: La visibilità a piedi è ancora peggiore, e mentre August grida sopra il vento ululante non riesci a capire che cosa dica. Quando superi la parte anteriore della tua nave, vedi davanti a te la nave schiantata.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	Mr. Renard shouts with what you believe to be joy at seeing the parachute and scattered flares. The two of you wade through the sand and increasingly dense scattered debris as quickly as you can until you arrive at the rear hatch of the crashed Flivver. You struggle to turn the lock but eventually force it open, briefly letting the sand-filled air rush into the interior of the ship before you close it behind you. Inside, the ship is dark and depowered but more or less intact. At the front of the craft, sitting in the half-submerged cockpit, is the woman you saw on the broadcast, wiping the sand from her face.|6788|0
units.english: Mr. Renard shouts with what you believe to be joy at seeing the parachute and scattered flares. The two of you wade through the sand and increasingly dense scattered debris as quickly as you can until you arrive at the rear hatch of the crashed Flivver. You struggle to turn the lock but eventually force it open, briefly letting the sand-filled air rush into the interior of the ship before you close it behind you. Inside, the ship is dark and depowered but more or less intact. At the front of the craft, sitting in the half-submerged cockpit, is the woman you saw on the broadcast, wiping the sand from her face.
units.italian: Il signor Renard grida quello che credi sia di gioia vedendo il paracadute e i razzi di segnalazione sparsi. Vi fate strada nella sabbia e fra i detriti sempre più fitti il più in fretta possibile, finché arrivate al portello posteriore del Flivver schiantato. Lotti per girare la serratura ma alla fine riesci a forzarla, lasciando per un attimo entrare l'aria piena di sabbia nell'interno della nave prima di richiuderla dietro di voi. Dentro, la nave è buia e senza alimentazione ma più o meno intatta. A prua, seduta nell'abitacolo mezzo sommerso, c'è la donna che hai visto al notiziario, che si asciuga la sabbia dal viso.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Hmph," she says, somewhat weakly. "I thought you were going to be the Navy."|6789|0
units.english: "Hmph," she says, somewhat weakly. "I thought you were going to be the Navy."
units.italian: "Hmph," dice, un po' debolmente. "Pensavo che sareste stati della Marina."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	Mr. Renard rushes to her and the two embrace.|6790|0
units.english: Mr. Renard rushes to her and the two embrace.
units.italian: Il signor Renard le corre incontro e i due si abbracciano.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"And who's this?" Artemis asks.|6791|0
units.english: "And who's this?" Artemis asks.
units.italian: "E chi è questo?" chiede Artemis.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Captain <first> <last> of the <ship>."|6793|0
units.english: "Captain <first> <last> of the <ship>."
units.italian: "Il Capitano <first> <last> della <ship>."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"I'm here to get you out of here."|6794|0
units.english: "I'm here to get you out of here."
units.italian: "Sono qui per portarti fuori di qui."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"A pilot, eh? I can appreciate that. I'd appreciate it more if you could fly me out of here, though."|6797|0
units.english: "A pilot, eh? I can appreciate that. I'd appreciate it more if you could fly me out of here, though."
units.italian: "Un pilota, eh? Lo apprezzo. Apprezzerei di più se potessi portarmi via da qui volando, però."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"My ship is landed outside. Follow me."|6799|0
units.english: "My ship is landed outside. Follow me."
units.italian: "La mia nave è atterrata fuori. Seguimi."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"I have some questions."|6801|0
units.english: "I have some questions."
units.italian: "Ho qualche domanda."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	Artemis coughs. "Later, okay?"|6802|0
units.english: Artemis coughs. "Later, okay?"
units.italian: Artemis tossisce. "Dopo, okay?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"A real professional, eh? I can appreciate that. I think I'm about ready to get to it, then, if that's all right with you."|6805|0
units.english: "A real professional, eh? I can appreciate that. I think I'm about ready to get to it, then, if that's all right with you."
units.italian: "Un vero professionista, eh? Lo apprezzo. Credo di essere quasi pronta a mettermi in marcia, allora, se per te va bene."
