units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"My ship is landed outside. Follow me."|6807|0
units.english: "My ship is landed outside. Follow me."
units.italian: "La mia nave è atterrata fuori. Seguimi."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"I have some questions."|6809|0
units.english: "I have some questions."
units.italian: "Ho qualche domanda."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	Artemis coughs. "Later, okay?"|6810|0
units.english: Artemis coughs. "Later, okay?"
units.italian: Artemis tossisce. "Dopo, okay?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	The three of you exit the crashed Flivver and make the journey back to the <ship>. Artemis stumbles several times but the two of you steady her and eventually make it to your ship's airlock. You wipe the sand from your face and fetch your ship's first aid equipment, but to your surprise upon returning, Artemis seems remarkably uninjured despite the crash.|6812|0
units.english: The three of you exit the crashed Flivver and make the journey back to the <ship>. Artemis stumbles several times but the two of you steady her and eventually make it to your ship's airlock. You wipe the sand from your face and fetch your ship's first aid equipment, but to your surprise upon returning, Artemis seems remarkably uninjured despite the crash.
units.italian: Uscite tutti e tre dal Flivver schiantato e fate il percorso di ritorno alla <ship>. Artemis inciampa più volte, ma voi due la sorreggete e alla fine arrivate alla camera stagna della nave. Ti asciughi la sabbia dal viso e prendi il kit di primo soccorso della nave, ma con tua sorpresa, al tuo ritorno, Artemis sembra notevolmente illesa nonostante lo schianto.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Oh, shove off, Captain. I'm fine. Automated drogue system in the ship, safety first, spare no expense. Wouldn't mind a visit to your galley, though."|6813|0
units.english: "Oh, shove off, Captain. I'm fine. Automated drogue system in the ship, safety first, spare no expense. Wouldn't mind a visit to your galley, though."
units.italian: "Oh, lasci perdere, Capitano. Sto bene. Sistema di frenata automatico con drogue sulla nave: prima la sicurezza, senza badare a spese. Non mi dispiacerebbe però fare un salto nella tua cambusa."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Of course."|6815|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Drogue system? Like parachutes? I hadn't considered that."|6817|0
units.english: "Drogue system? Like parachutes? I hadn't considered that."
units.italian: "Sistema con drogue? Come i paracadute? Non ci avevo pensato."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Really? What is it with you spacers and 'going down with the ship' anyway?"|6818|0
units.english: "Really? What is it with you spacers and 'going down with the ship' anyway?"
units.italian: "Davvero? Che cosa avete voi spaziali con l'idea di 'andare giù con la nave'?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	You don't think you've ever seen someone devour a sleeve of freeze-dried peas as quickly or with as much verve as Artemis does. After eating her way through the <ship>'s entire stock of several other varieties of packaged food, she eventually slows down, though the hungry look on her face remains. Her father sits beside her, holding her hand tightly.|6820|0
units.english: You don't think you've ever seen someone devour a sleeve of freeze-dried peas as quickly or with as much verve as Artemis does. After eating her way through the <ship>'s entire stock of several other varieties of packaged food, she eventually slows down, though the hungry look on her face remains. Her father sits beside her, holding her hand tightly.
units.italian: Non credi di aver mai visto qualcuno divorare una confezione di piselli liofilizzati con la rapidità e l'entusiasmo con cui lo fa Artemis. Dopo essersi fatta fuori l'intera scorta della <ship> di diverse altre varietà di cibo confezionato, alla fine rallenta, anche se lo sguardo affamato le resta sul viso. Suo padre le siede accanto, tenendole stretta la mano.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"I suppose you have some questions," she says, "both of you. Well, I hope you do, at least."|6821|0
units.english: "I suppose you have some questions," she says, "both of you. Well, I hope you do, at least."
units.italian: "Immagino che abbiate qualche domanda," dice, "tutti e due. Beh, almeno spero di sì."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Why did you crash?"|6823|0
units.english: "Why did you crash?"
units.italian: "Perché ti sei schiantata?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"That was a beautiful ship you had there. I've never seen a Flivver quite like that."|6824|0
units.english: "That was a beautiful ship you had there. I've never seen a Flivver quite like that."
units.italian: "Era una bella nave quella che avevi. Non ho mai visto un Flivver così."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"I'll leave the questions to your father."|6826|0
units.english: "I'll leave the questions to your father."
units.italian: "Lascio le domande a tuo padre."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"I really do not know. We checked everything before launch, everything, and yet during the jump the Moonfox's hyperdrive malfunctioned, knocking me out. When I woke up, I was in the wrong system and the Flivver was hurtling away from the star. Luckily, the engines hadn't been harmed too much, so I was able to turn around and thrust in the direction of <origin>, but then the batteries gave out and the generator stopped working. So I ended up stranded on a planet with no way of calling for help - the flares had triggered when I crashed, being unable to slow down without thrusters. Well, now you know. Is there anything else?"|6831|0
units.english: "I really do not know. We checked everything before launch, everything, and yet during the jump the Moonfox's hyperdrive malfunctioned, knocking me out. When I woke up, I was in the wrong system and the Flivver was hurtling away from the star. Luckily, the engines hadn't been harmed too much, so I was able to turn around and thrust in the direction of <origin>, but then the batteries gave out and the generator stopped working. So I ended up stranded on a planet with no way of calling for help - the flares had triggered when I crashed, being unable to slow down without thrusters. Well, now you know. Is there anything else?"
units.italian: "Davvero non lo so. Abbiamo controllato tutto prima del lancio, tutto, eppure durante il salto l'iperpropulsore della Moonfox si è guastato e mi ha fatto perdere i sensi. Quando mi sono svegliata ero nel sistema sbagliato e il Flivver sfrecciava lontano dalla stella. Per fortuna i motori non erano troppo danneggiati, così sono riuscita a girarmi e a spingere in direzione di <origin>, ma poi le batterie si sono esaurite e il generatore ha smesso di funzionare. Così sono finita bloccata su un pianeta senza modo di chiedere aiuto: i razzi si sono attivati quando mi sono schiantata, non riuscendo a rallentare senza i propulsori. Beh, ora lo sai. C'è altro?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	August asks, "Do you think someone could have sabotaged the hyperdrive? Any suspicious Syndicate employees hanging around? Any anything out of the ordinary?"|6832|0
units.english: August asks, "Do you think someone could have sabotaged the hyperdrive? Any suspicious Syndicate employees hanging around? Any anything out of the ordinary?"
units.italian: August chiede: "Pensi che qualcuno possa aver sabotato l'iperpropulsore? Qualche dipendente del Sindacato sospetto in giro? Qualcosa di fuori dall'ordinario?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Not that I remember," replies Artemis. "This rarely happens in spaceship racing, but it's still happened. A one-in-a-million chance, perhaps. I wouldn't worry about it too much."|6833|0
units.english: "Not that I remember," replies Artemis. "This rarely happens in spaceship racing, but it's still happened. A one-in-a-million chance, perhaps. I wouldn't worry about it too much."
units.italian: "Non che ricordi," risponde Artemis. "Succede raramente nelle corse spaziali, ma è già successo. Una possibilità su un milione, forse. Non me ne preoccuperei troppo."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"That was a beautiful ship you had there. I've never seen a Flivver quite like that."|6835|0
units.english: "That was a beautiful ship you had there. I've never seen a Flivver quite like that."
units.italian: "Era una bella nave quella che avevi. Non ho mai visto un Flivver così."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Alright."|6838|0
units.english: "Alright."
units.italian: "Va bene."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"You have good taste, Captain. It's modified for racing: lighter hull plating, no weapon mounts, ample engines, of course. We've got a dozen for all the different races, but that one was a personal favorite."|6843|0
units.english: "You have good taste, Captain. It's modified for racing: lighter hull plating, no weapon mounts, ample engines, of course. We've got a dozen for all the different races, but that one was a personal favorite."
units.italian: "Hai buon gusto, Capitano. È modificata per le corse: corazzatura più leggera, nessun supporto per le armi, motori abbondanti, naturalmente. Ne abbiamo una dozzina per le diverse gare, ma quella era la mia preferita."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"Why did you crash?|6845|0
units.english: "Why did you crash?
units.italian: "Perché ti sei schiantata?

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"I have no more questions."|6849|0
units.english: "I have no more questions."
units.italian: "Non ho altre domande."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	Artemis nods. "Well, could we head back to <planet> now? It'll be nice to get home after all this commotion and discomfort."|6851|0
units.english: Artemis nods. "Well, could we head back to <planet> now? It'll be nice to get home after all this commotion and discomfort."
units.italian: Artemis annuisce. "Beh, possiamo tornare su <planet> adesso? Sarà bello tornare a casa dopo tutto questo trambusto e disagio."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	Artemis and her father head off to their bunks, talking all the way. You chart a course for <destination>.|6852|0
units.english: Artemis and her father head off to their bunks, talking all the way. You chart a course for <destination>.
units.italian: Artemis e suo padre si avviano ai loro posti letto, parlando per tutto il tragitto. Tracci una rotta per <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|log|6857|0
units.english: Helped a Paradisian find his missing daughter, a racing pilot who crashed on Sandswell.
units.italian: Ho aiutato un Paradisiaco a ritrovare la figlia scomparsa, una pilota da corsa schiantatasi su Sandswell.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|log|6858|0
units.english: Helped August find his daughter Artemis Renard, a racing pilot who crashed on the uninhabited planet of Sandswell after her hyperdrive malfunctioned.
units.italian: Ho aiutato August a ritrovare sua figlia Artemis Renard, una pilota da corsa schiantatasi sul pianeta disabitato di Sandswell dopo che il suo iperpropulsore si è guastato.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|As the advanced medical facilities of <planet> rush up and past the ship, August comes to the bridge. "Truly, thank you, Captain, for sticking through this mess with me, and for continuing to search even when hope was gone.|6860|0
units.english: As the advanced medical facilities of <planet> rush up and past the ship, August comes to the bridge. "Truly, thank you, Captain, for sticking through this mess with me, and for continuing to search even when hope was gone.
units.italian: Mentre le strutture mediche avanzate di <planet> scorrono davanti alla nave, August viene sul ponte. "Davvero, grazie, Capitano, per aver affrontato questo pasticcio con me, e per aver continuato a cercare anche quando la speranza era finita.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	"I would like to reward you with a payment of <payment> for your services, and apologize for the inconvenience this might have caused you."|6861|0
units.english: "I would like to reward you with a payment of <payment> for your services, and apologize for the inconvenience this might have caused you."
units.italian: "Vorrei ricompensarla con un pagamento di <payment> per i suoi servizi, e scusarmi per il disturbo che questo può averle causato."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer 3|	Soon afterwards, the Renards head out of the <ship>. The moment they exit the hatch, a veritable army of attendants appears out of nowhere, ready to help them move the five feet to a Shuttle that has just landed on a pad next to you. August waves, and steps in.|6862|0
units.english: Soon afterwards, the Renards head out of the <ship>. The moment they exit the hatch, a veritable army of attendants appears out of nowhere, ready to help them move the five feet to a Shuttle that has just landed on a pad next to you. August waves, and steps in.
units.italian: Poco dopo, i Renard escono dalla <ship>. Appena varcano il portello, un vero e proprio esercito di attendenti compare dal nulla, pronto ad aiutarli a percorrere un metro e mezzo fino a uno Shuttle appena atterrato su una piazzola accanto a te. August ti saluta con la mano ed entra.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|name|6868|0
units.english: Visit Artemis Renard
units.italian: Fare visita ad Artemis Renard

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|description|6869|0
units.english: Retrieve some "surplus equipment" from Artemis Renard on <destination>.
units.italian: Recupera un po' di "equipaggiamento in surplus" da Artemis Renard su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|While you are checking your incoming messages, you notice one from Artemis Renard, the crashed racing pilot who you rescued a couple months ago.|6877|0
units.english: While you are checking your incoming messages, you notice one from Artemis Renard, the crashed racing pilot who you rescued a couple months ago.
units.italian: Mentre controlli i messaggi in arrivo, ne noti uno di Artemis Renard, la pilota da corsa schiantatasi che hai salvato un paio di mesi fa.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	"Captain <last>,|6878|0
units.english: "Captain <last>,
units.italian: "Capitano <last>,

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	"I'd like to thank you again for your timely rescue. Recovering from the ordeal has been a long process, of course, but a worthwhile one. As I've been working my way back into the various circuits, we've built up a surplus of increasingly outdated equipment. While we could, of course, simply have it scrapped locally, we were hoping that you might join us on <destination> to see if you can put it to better use."|6879|0
units.english: "I'd like to thank you again for your timely rescue. Recovering from the ordeal has been a long process, of course, but a worthwhile one. As I've been working my way back into the various circuits, we've built up a surplus of increasingly outdated equipment. While we could, of course, simply have it scrapped locally, we were hoping that you might join us on <destination> to see if you can put it to better use."
units.italian: "Vorrei ringraziarla ancora per il suo tempestivo salvataggio. Riprendersi dall'accaduto è stato un processo lungo, naturalmente, ma ne è valsa la pena. Mentre mi sto reinserendo nei vari circuiti, abbiamo accumulato un surplus di equipaggiamento sempre più obsoleto. Certo, potremmo semplicemente farlo rottamare qui, ma speravamo che volesse raggiungerci su <destination> per vedere se riesce a farne un uso migliore."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|		Sincerely,|6880|0
units.english: Sincerely,
units.italian: Cordialmente,

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|			Artemis Renard|6881|0
units.english: Artemis Renard
units.italian: Artemis Renard

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|log|6884|0
units.english: Was given a Racing Flivver as additional compensation for helping find Artemis Renard.
units.italian: Ho ricevuto un Racing Flivver come compenso aggiuntivo per aver aiutato a trovare Artemis Renard.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|As Glory again rises to greet your ship, you receive a hail from a spacecraft that comes up alongside your ship. "Ho, Captain! Why don't you come to our estate, instead of the main landing port? It'll be easier." August Renard is leaning out the cockpit of a fancy Racing Flivver, looking much happier than when you first met him.|6886|0
units.english: As Glory again rises to greet your ship, you receive a hail from a spacecraft that comes up alongside your ship. "Ho, Captain! Why don't you come to our estate, instead of the main landing port? It'll be easier." August Renard is leaning out the cockpit of a fancy Racing Flivver, looking much happier than when you first met him.
units.italian: Mentre Glory si alza di nuovo davanti alla tua nave, ricevi un segnale da un vascello che si affianca. "Ehi, Capitano! Perché non vieni alla nostra tenuta, invece che al porto principale? È più comodo." August Renard è spenzolato dall'abitacolo di un elegante Racing Flivver, e sembra molto più felice di quando l'hai conosciuto.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	You redirect your ship in the direction the Flivver is going, noticing that it has the same name as Artemis' ship which crashed on Sandswell.|6887|0
units.english: You redirect your ship in the direction the Flivver is going, noticing that it has the same name as Artemis' ship which crashed on Sandswell.
units.italian: Orienti la nave nella direzione in cui va il Flivver, notando che porta lo stesso nome della nave di Artemis, quella schiantatasi su Sandswell.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	Soon, the dense main city of <planet> gives way to a perfectly-terraformed countryside with only one mar - a gigantic personal skyscraper that must be hundreds of meters high. A few landing pads are set in a neat array next to it, and the B-168 "Moonfox" lands on one of these, beckoning for you to land on another.|6888|0
units.english: Soon, the dense main city of <planet> gives way to a perfectly-terraformed countryside with only one mar - a gigantic personal skyscraper that must be hundreds of meters high. A few landing pads are set in a neat array next to it, and the B-168 "Moonfox" lands on one of these, beckoning for you to land on another.
units.italian: Presto la densa città principale di <planet> lascia il posto a una campagna perfettamente terraformata, con una sola macchia: un gigantesco grattacielo privato, alto centinaia di metri. Accanto ci sono alcune piazzole di atterraggio disposte in bell'ordine, e il B-168 "Moonfox" si posa su una di queste, facendoti cenno di atterrare su un'altra.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	(Land on one of the pads.)|6890|0
units.english: (Land on one of the pads.)
units.italian: (Atterra su una delle piazzole.)

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	"What about my fleet?"|6892|0
units.english: "What about my fleet?"
units.italian: "E la mia flotta?"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	"You have a mansion here!"|6896|0
units.english: "You have a mansion here!"
units.italian: "Avete una villa qui!"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	"Later, later," Artemis shouts. "We'll talk in a place where we needn't yell."|6897|0
units.english: "Later, later," Artemis shouts. "We'll talk in a place where we needn't yell."
units.italian: "Dopo, dopo," grida Artemis. "Parleremo in un posto dove non dobbiamo urlare."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	August calls, "You can let your fleet stay at the main spaceport; I'm afraid there's not room here."|6899|0
units.english: August calls, "You can let your fleet stay at the main spaceport; I'm afraid there's not room here."
units.italian: August chiama: "Puoi lasciare la flotta allo spazioporto principale; temo che qui non ci sia posto."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	As you exit the <ship>, you notice that the Flivver has been painted in the same colors as your ship.|6902|0
units.english: As you exit the <ship>, you notice that the Flivver has been painted in the same colors as your ship.
units.italian: Mentre esci dalla <ship>, noti che il Flivver è stato verniciato con gli stessi colori della tua nave.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	August approaches. "Artemis wanted to give you something as a present for saving her life, and we were wondering if you would like to have this Flivver. We've managed to refurbish it enough that it should be perfectly functional, and if you want a fast ship there's nothing in the sky that can beat you."|6903|0
units.english: August approaches. "Artemis wanted to give you something as a present for saving her life, and we were wondering if you would like to have this Flivver. We've managed to refurbish it enough that it should be perfectly functional, and if you want a fast ship there's nothing in the sky that can beat you."
units.italian: August si avvicina. "Artemis voleva darti qualcosa in regalo per averle salvato la vita, e ci chiedevamo se ti piacerebbe avere questo Flivver. Siamo riusciti a rimetterlo a nuovo abbastanza da renderlo perfettamente funzionante, e se vuoi una nave veloce non c'è nulla nel cielo che possa batterti."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	August leads you up the steps into the palatial mansion and into a large whitewashed room with a golden table. On the table lie keys for the starship Artemis used in her most recent race.|6904|0
units.english: August leads you up the steps into the palatial mansion and into a large whitewashed room with a golden table. On the table lie keys for the starship Artemis used in her most recent race.
units.italian: August ti guida su per gli scalini nella villa principesca e in una grande sala imbiancata con un tavolo dorato. Sul tavolo ci sono le chiavi della nave stellare che Artemis ha usato nella sua ultima corsa.

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|give|6906|0
units.english: B-168 "Moonfox"
units.italian: B-168 "Moonfox"

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	"Well, I hope you like it." Artemis approaches. "It's been servicing me for quite a while, ever since I started racing. Unfortunately it's not fast enough anymore, even after the millions we spent on rebuilding it after the crash on Sandswell. Hopefully you'll be able to put it to better use." She smiles. "Of course, it would also be a good ship to sell, if you need the money."|6907|0
units.english: "Well, I hope you like it." Artemis approaches. "It's been servicing me for quite a while, ever since I started racing. Unfortunately it's not fast enough anymore, even after the millions we spent on rebuilding it after the crash on Sandswell. Hopefully you'll be able to put it to better use." She smiles. "Of course, it would also be a good ship to sell, if you need the money."
units.italian: "Beh, spero che ti piaccia." Si avvicina Artemis. "Mi ha servito per parecchio tempo, da quando ho cominciato a correre. Purtroppo non è più veloce abbastanza, anche dopo i milioni che abbiamo speso per ricostruirla dopo lo schianto su Sandswell. Spero che saprai farne un uso migliore." Sorride. "Naturalmente sarebbe anche una buona nave da vendere, se ti servono i soldi."

units.id: mission:Lost Racer Epilogue|	After spending another half an hour or so catching up, you say your goodbyes to the pair and head back to the main spaceport.|6908|0
units.english: After spending another half an hour or so catching up, you say your goodbyes to the pair and head back to the main spaceport.
units.italian: Dopo un'altra mezz'ora passata a raccontarvi le novità, vi salutate e torni allo spazioporto principale.

units.id: ship:Racing Flivver|description|6965|0
units.english: One of champion racer Artemis Renard's many beloved racing crafts, this Lionheart Flivver has been so heavily modified you're not sure if it can even be considered one. Its sleek, elegant lines belie its underlying power: the oversized engines hum with energy and roar to life with spine-bending force at the gentlest touch of the controls, propelling the craft and its pilot to the stars like butterflies on a moonbeam.
units.italian: Una delle tante amate navi da corsa della campionessa Artemis Renard, questo Lionheart Flivver è stato modificato così pesantemente che non sei sicuro si possa ancora considerare tale. Le sue linee eleganti e affusolate smentiscono la potenza che nasconde: i motori sovradimensionati ronzano di energia e ruggiscono alla vita con una forza che piega la schiena al più lieve tocco dei comandi, spingendo il mezzo e il suo pilota verso le stelle come farfalle su un raggio di luna.

units.id: ship:Racing Flivver|description|6966|0
units.english: A gift to you for saving Artemis' life after it was pulled from the sand where she crashed post-race, the Renard family has spared no expense in restoring the craft to gleaming perfection.
units.italian: Regalo per aver salvato la vita di Artemis dopo che è stato tirato fuori dalla sabbia dove si era schiantata al termine della corsa, la famiglia Renard non ha badato a spese per riportarlo a una perfezione scintillante.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|name|6972|0
units.english: Moving House
units.italian: Trasloco

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|description|6973|0
units.english: An anarchist named Kris has asked you to help move them and <cargo> from <planet stopovers> to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Una persona anarchica di nome Kris ti ha chiesto di aiutarla a traslocare con <cargo> da <planet stopovers> a <destination>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|As you walk through the spaceport, you see someone ahead making very obvious disruptions in the flow of the crowd. They're going up to various people and talking to them, usually very briefly, before moving on to someone else. Before you know it, "someone else" is you.|6988|0
units.english: As you walk through the spaceport, you see someone ahead making very obvious disruptions in the flow of the crowd. They're going up to various people and talking to them, usually very briefly, before moving on to someone else. Before you know it, "someone else" is you.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, vedi più avanti qualcuno che crea disturbi molto evidenti nel flusso della folla. Si avvicina a varie persone e parla con loro, di solito molto brevemente, prima di passare a qualcun altro. Prima che tu te ne accorga, "qualcun altro" sei tu.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	"You, you're a captain. Will you give me a ride? I need to get back to <stopovers>, pack up my things, and travel to <destination>." Their hair is slicked back to match their sharp suit.|6989|0
units.english: "You, you're a captain. Will you give me a ride? I need to get back to <stopovers>, pack up my things, and travel to <destination>." Their hair is slicked back to match their sharp suit.
units.italian: "Tu, sei un capitano. Mi daresti un passaggio? Devo tornare su <stopovers>, fare i bagagli e viaggiare fino a <destination>." I capelli sono tirati indietro con la brillantina, in tono con l'abito affilato.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	"Sure, as long as you can pay."|6991|0
units.english: "Sure, as long as you can pay."
units.italian: "Certo, purché tu possa pagare."

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	"No, I've got better things to do."|6993|0
units.english: "No, I've got better things to do."
units.italian: "No, ho cose migliori da fare."

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	Just like with the others, as soon as you decline, they move on to someone else.|6994|0
units.english: Just like with the others, as soon as you decline, they move on to someone else.
units.italian: Come con gli altri, appena rifiuti passa a qualcun altro.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	They stop in surprise, then nod briefly. "I'll be at your ship within an hour."|6998|0
units.english: They stop in surprise, then nod briefly. "I'll be at your ship within an hour."
units.italian: Kris si ferma di colpo, poi annuisce brevemente. "Sarò alla tua nave entro un'ora."

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	An hour later, you see them approach the <ship> carrying a small suitcase. They've exchanged their formal appearance for a button-down shirt and skirt with their hair loose, hanging down to their shoulders. They walk right up to you and stick out a hand. "Kris Brecht, they/them."|6999|0
units.english: An hour later, you see them approach the <ship> carrying a small suitcase. They've exchanged their formal appearance for a button-down shirt and skirt with their hair loose, hanging down to their shoulders. They walk right up to you and stick out a hand. "Kris Brecht, they/them."
units.italian: Un'ora dopo, vedi Kris avvicinarsi alla <ship> con una piccola valigia. Ha cambiato l'aspetto formale con una camicia abbottonata e una gonna, e i capelli sciolti le arrivano alle spalle. Ti viene dritto davanti e ti tende la mano. "Kris Brecht, they/them."

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	(Shake their hand.)|7001|0
units.english: (Shake their hand.)
units.italian: (Stringi la mano.)

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	(Just stare.)|7003|0
units.english: (Just stare.)
units.italian: (Limitati a fissare.)

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	You stare at Kris' unorthodox getup while they stand there with their hand out for a few beats. Then they sigh and take it back. "Will this be a problem?" They gesture to themselves.|7004|0
units.english: You stare at Kris' unorthodox getup while they stand there with their hand out for a few beats. Then they sigh and take it back. "Will this be a problem?" They gesture to themselves.
units.italian: Fissi l'abbigliamento poco ortodosso di Kris mentre resta lì con la mano tesa per qualche secondo. Poi sospira e la ritira. "Sarà un problema?" Accenna a sé con un gesto.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	"No, I was just surprised."|7006|0
units.english: "No, I was just surprised."
units.italian: "No, ero solo sorpreso."

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	"I don't think I can carry someone like you."|7008|0
units.english: "I don't think I can carry someone like you."
units.italian: "Non credo di poter portare uno come te."

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	Their expression turns cold. "Right. I get it. Someone like me." They turn and stalk away.|7009|0
units.english: Their expression turns cold. "Right. I get it. Someone like me." They turn and stalk away.
units.italian: L'espressione di Kris si fa fredda. "Certo. Ho capito. Uno come me." Si volta e se ne va a grandi passi.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	Their confident demeanor returns, and they nod. "I can have that effect on people. Glad to see you're not another of those stuck-up establishment types. Well, all the rest of my stuff is on <stopovers>, so we'd better get going!"|7013|0
units.english: Their confident demeanor returns, and they nod. "I can have that effect on people. Glad to see you're not another of those stuck-up establishment types. Well, all the rest of my stuff is on <stopovers>, so we'd better get going!"
units.italian: Torna l'aria sicura, e Kris annuisce. "Faccio questo effetto alla gente. Meglio così, non sei un altro di quei tipi impettiti da establishment. Beh, il resto delle mie cose è su <stopovers>, quindi è meglio muoversi!"

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	You shake their hand. "<first> <last>. That's all you've got with you?"|7017|0
units.english: You shake their hand. "<first> <last>. That's all you've got with you?"
units.italian: Stringi la mano di Kris. "<first> <last>. Tutto qui quello che hai?"

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	Kris nods. "All the rest of my stuff is on <stopovers>. I was just here for a meeting with some others who feel like I do about the establishment."|7018|0
units.english: Kris nods. "All the rest of my stuff is on <stopovers>. I was just here for a meeting with some others who feel like I do about the establishment."
units.italian: Kris annuisce. "Tutto il resto è su <stopovers>. Ero qui solo per un incontro con altri che la pensano come me sull'establishment."

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	"The... establishment?"|7022|0
units.english: "The... establishment?"
units.italian: "L'establishment...?"

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	(Just let it pass.)|7023|0
units.english: (Just let it pass.)
units.italian: (Lascia perdere.)

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	Kris nods again. "Yeah, y'know, The Man!|7025|0
units.english: Kris nods again. "Yeah, y'know, The Man!
units.italian: Kris annuisce di nuovo. "Sì, sai, il Sistema!

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	"I don't support government or any of its tools, and I've heard that the South is more open to this kind of philosophy and lifestyle."|7027|0
units.english: "I don't support government or any of its tools, and I've heard that the South is more open to this kind of philosophy and lifestyle."
units.italian: "Non sostengo il governo né nessuno dei suoi strumenti, e ho sentito che il Sud è più aperto a questo tipo di filosofia e di stile di vita."

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	Before you can say more, they walk past you onto the <ship>. "Which did you say my berth was again...?"|7028|0
units.english: Before you can say more, they walk past you onto the <ship>. "Which did you say my berth was again...?"
units.italian: Prima che tu possa dire altro, Kris ti passa accanto e sale sulla <ship>. "Come dicevi che si chiamava il mio posto letto...?"

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|As you traveled to <planet stopovers>, you found yourself frequently listening to Kris' opinions on the subject of governments. While they had some very good points, other times they would spend hours ranting about things that seem completely impractical and without a solid foundation. If it weren't for the fact that they were unfailingly polite otherwise, and eager to help with chores around the ship, you would've declared the cockpit off-limits.|7033|0
units.english: As you traveled to <planet stopovers>, you found yourself frequently listening to Kris' opinions on the subject of governments. While they had some very good points, other times they would spend hours ranting about things that seem completely impractical and without a solid foundation. If it weren't for the fact that they were unfailingly polite otherwise, and eager to help with chores around the ship, you would've declared the cockpit off-limits.
units.italian: Mentre viaggiavate verso <planet stopovers>, ti sei ritrovato spesso ad ascoltare le opinioni di Kris in materia di governi. A volte aveva argomenti molto validi, altre passava ore a strillare di cose del tutto impraticabili e senza fondamenta. Se non fosse stato per una cortesia mai venuta meno e per la voglia di dare una mano nelle faccende della nave, avresti dichiarato il ponte off-limits.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	Still, you are somewhat relieved that when you arrive, both of you are too out of breath from moving furniture to talk more.|7034|0
units.english: Still, you are somewhat relieved that when you arrive, both of you are too out of breath from moving furniture to talk more.
units.italian: Sei comunque un po' sollevato che, all'arrivo, siate entrambi troppo senza fiato per spostare mobili e parlare ancora.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|	You soon have it loaded up, though, and start the trip south to <destination>.|7035|0
units.english: You soon have it loaded up, though, and start the trip south to <destination>.
units.italian: Presto è tutto caricato, e cominciate il viaggio verso sud fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|log|7039|0
units.english: An anarchist committed enough to their ideals to move to the South in hopes of finding a less statist community.
units.italian: Una persona anarchica abbastanza fedele ai propri ideali da trasferirsi nel Sud nella speranza di trovare una comunità meno statalista.

units.id: mission:Moving House 1|At last, you reach <planet>, and Kris enthusiastically unloads their possessions into a waiting transport van. Before they disappear, they press a credit chip for <payment> into your hands and assure you that you are a valuable ally to the "anti-statist movement."|7041|0
units.english: At last, you reach <planet>, and Kris enthusiastically unloads their possessions into a waiting transport van. Before they disappear, they press a credit chip for <payment> into your hands and assure you that you are a valuable ally to the "anti-statist movement."
units.italian: Alla fine raggiungete <planet>, e Kris scarica con entusiasmo le sue cose in un furgone di trasporto che aspetta. Prima di sparire, ti mette in mano un chip di credito da <payment> e ti assicura che sei una risorsa preziosa per il "movimento anti-statalista".

units.id: mission:Moving House 2|name|7059|0
units.english: Moving House, Again
units.italian: Trasloco, di nuovo

units.id: mission:Moving House 2|description|7060|0
units.english: Kris is unsatisfied with life on <destination> and wants your help to move.
units.italian: Kris non è soddisfatta della vita su <destination> e chiede il tuo aiuto per trasferirsi.

units.id: mission:Moving House 2|When you check your messages upon landing, you notice one from an unfamiliar source. At first, you think it's a scam, because it tries to redirect you through three different servers, but then you see it calls you "ally of the anti-statist movement."|7069|0
units.english: When you check your messages upon landing, you notice one from an unfamiliar source. At first, you think it's a scam, because it tries to redirect you through three different servers, but then you see it calls you "ally of the anti-statist movement."
units.italian: Quando controlli i messaggi all'atterraggio, ne noti uno da una fonte sconosciuta. All'inizio pensi a una truffa, perché prova a farti passare per tre server diversi, ma poi vedi che ti chiama "alleato del movimento anti-statalista".

units.id: mission:Moving House 2|	Sure enough, it's from Kris Brecht, the anarchist you transported to <planet>. "You have to come and get me. I can't stand living here any longer!" It includes directions to a home somewhere on <planet> where you last saw Kris, but nothing more.|7070|0
units.english: Sure enough, it's from Kris Brecht, the anarchist you transported to <planet>. "You have to come and get me. I can't stand living here any longer!" It includes directions to a home somewhere on <planet> where you last saw Kris, but nothing more.
units.italian: E infatti viene da Kris Brecht, che hai trasportato su <planet>. "Devi venire a prendermi. Non sopporto più di vivere qui!" Il messaggio include le indicazioni per una casa da qualche parte su <planet>, dove hai visto Kris l'ultima volta, e niente altro.

units.id: mission:Moving House 2|	(Accept.)|7072|0
units.english: (Accept.)
units.italian: (Accetta.)

units.id: mission:Moving House 2|	(Decline.)|7074|0
units.english: (Decline.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Moving House 2|You arrive on <planet>, rent a local transport, and make your way to the location specified. When you knock on the door, Kris bursts out almost instantly. This time, they've got on a ruffly skirt, a button-down shirt, and suspenders, and their hair is in a tight bun. "Finally!" they say. "Everything's packed already; we just need to load it in and get to the spaceport."|7078|0
units.english: You arrive on <planet>, rent a local transport, and make your way to the location specified. When you knock on the door, Kris bursts out almost instantly. This time, they've got on a ruffly skirt, a button-down shirt, and suspenders, and their hair is in a tight bun. "Finally!" they say. "Everything's packed already; we just need to load it in and get to the spaceport."
units.italian: Arrivi su <planet>, noleggi un mezzo locale e ti dirigi al luogo indicato. Quando bussi alla porta, Kris schizza fuori quasi all'istante. Questa volta indossa una gonna con volant, una camicia abbottonata e le bretelle, e i capelli sono raccolti in uno chignon stretto. "Finalmente!" dice. "È già tutto pronto; dobbiamo solo caricarlo e andare allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Moving House 2|	It takes much less time to load everything this time than the last time you helped Kris move, and soon they hop in the driver's seat of the van, calling to you, "I'll meet you at the spaceport in an hour or two!"|7079|0
units.english: It takes much less time to load everything this time than the last time you helped Kris move, and soon they hop in the driver's seat of the van, calling to you, "I'll meet you at the spaceport in an hour or two!"
units.italian: Caricare tutto richiede molto meno tempo dell'ultima volta che hai aiutato Kris a traslocare, e presto sale al posto di guida del furgone, gridandoti: "Ci vediamo allo spazioporto fra un'ora o due!"

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|name|7082|0
units.english: Moving House, Again
units.italian: Trasloco, di nuovo

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|description|7083|0
units.english: Kris is unsatisfied on <origin> and wants your help to move to <destination> instead. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Kris non è soddisfatta su <origin> e vuole il tuo aiuto per trasferirsi invece su <destination>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|Kris' possessions fit more easily into your hold this time - it seems like they really do have less than before. Once they're loaded in and Kris climbs aboard, they open their mouth to begin what is sure to be another of their interminable tirades on the power of the state.|7092|0
units.english: Kris' possessions fit more easily into your hold this time - it seems like they really do have less than before. Once they're loaded in and Kris climbs aboard, they open their mouth to begin what is sure to be another of their interminable tirades on the power of the state.
units.italian: Le cose di Kris entrano più facilmente nella stiva questa volta: sembra che ne abbiano davvero meno di prima. Una volta caricato tutto, Kris sale a bordo e apre la bocca per cominciare quella che sarà senz'altro un'altra delle sue interminabili filippiche sul potere dello Stato.

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|	(Try to change the subject.)|7094|0
units.english: (Try to change the subject.)
units.italian: (Prova a cambiare argomento.)

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|	(Let them talk.)|7096|0
units.english: (Let them talk.)
units.italian: (Lascia che parli.)

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|	Surprisingly, Kris begins by talking about how uncomfortable the ever-damp weather on <origin> is, and how they'll be glad to be properly dry for the first time in weeks. This doesn't last, though, as soon talk of the planet brings up the other people there.|7097|0
units.english: Surprisingly, Kris begins by talking about how uncomfortable the ever-damp weather on <origin> is, and how they'll be glad to be properly dry for the first time in weeks. This doesn't last, though, as soon talk of the planet brings up the other people there.
units.italian: Con sorpresa, Kris comincia parlando di quanto sia sgradevole il clima sempre umido di <origin>, e di quanto sarà contenta di essere finalmente all'asciutto per la prima volta in settimane. Non dura, però: presto il discorso sul pianeta arriva alle altre persone che ci vivono.

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|	You ask, "So, what is it about <origin> you can't stand? Is it the damp weather?"|7101|0
units.english: You ask, "So, what is it about <origin> you can't stand? Is it the damp weather?"
units.italian: Chiedi: "Allora, che cosa non sopporti di <origin>? Il clima umido?"

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|	A fire kindles in Kris' eyes, and a righteous fury seems to possess them. "I thought when I came here that I'd be among like-minded souls. There's barely any government to speak of here! But then when the war started, they were aaaaall sooooo delighted with the so-called Free Worlds! 'Free!' They're just another state!"|7104|0
units.english: A fire kindles in Kris' eyes, and a righteous fury seems to possess them. "I thought when I came here that I'd be among like-minded souls. There's barely any government to speak of here! But then when the war started, they were aaaaall sooooo delighted with the so-called Free Worlds! 'Free!' They're just another state!"
units.italian: Si accende una scintilla negli occhi di Kris, e una furia giusta sembra impossessarsene. "Quando sono arrivata qui pensavo di essere tra anime affini. Di governo, qui, non ce n'è quasi! Ma poi, quando è cominciata la guerra, erano tuuuutti cooosì felici dei cosiddetti Free Worlds! 'Liberi!' Sono solo un altro Stato!"

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|	Kris continues in this vein as you complete your pre-flight checks. Fortunately, they do at least mention your destination is <destination> during their rant.|7105|0
units.english: Kris continues in this vein as you complete your pre-flight checks. Fortunately, they do at least mention your destination is <destination> during their rant.
units.italian: Kris continua su questo tono mentre completi i controlli pre-volo. Per fortuna, almeno, durante la filippica menziona che la destinazione è <destination>.

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|You arrive at Thule, and Kris once more eagerly unloads their belongings into a local transport. As with the previous journey, they were a strange combination of genuinely polite and helpful and deeply aggravating.|7111|0
units.english: You arrive at Thule, and Kris once more eagerly unloads their belongings into a local transport. As with the previous journey, they were a strange combination of genuinely polite and helpful and deeply aggravating.
units.italian: Arrivate a Thule, e Kris scarica di nuovo con entusiasmo le sue cose in un mezzo locale. Come nel viaggio precedente, Kris univa una cortesia e una disponibilità sincere a una capacità di irritare davvero profonda.

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|	Now, though, they stand on the tarmac and take in great lungfuls of air, proclaiming it "the air of true freedom." You're somewhat more skeptical of how the locals will treat them, being an outsider, but... well, maybe they'll actually get along.|7112|0
units.english: Now, though, they stand on the tarmac and take in great lungfuls of air, proclaiming it "the air of true freedom." You're somewhat more skeptical of how the locals will treat them, being an outsider, but... well, maybe they'll actually get along.
units.italian: Ora però se ne sta sul piazzale a prendere grandi boccate d'aria, proclamandola "l'aria della vera libertà". Tu sei un po' più scettico su come i locali accoglieranno una persona di fuori, ma... beh, forse andrà davvero d'accordo con loro.

units.id: mission:Moving House 3|	Kris skips back up the ramp to hand you a credit chip for <payment> before taking their transport and heading off to whatever is awaiting them out there on <planet>.|7113|0
units.english: Kris skips back up the ramp to hand you a credit chip for <payment> before taking their transport and heading off to whatever is awaiting them out there on <planet>.
units.italian: Kris torna di corsa su per la rampa a consegnarti un chip di credito da <payment>, poi prende il suo mezzo e parte verso qualunque cosa lo attenda là fuori su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|name|7117|0
units.english: Transport Burnbecks to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporta i Burnbeck su <planet>

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|description|7118|0
units.english: The Burnbeck family was stranded by the bombings, and needs <bunks> bunks free for transport back home to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: La famiglia Burnbeck è rimasta bloccata dai bombardamenti e ha bisogno di <bunks> posti letto liberi per tornare a casa, su <destination>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|No sooner have you entered the spaceport than you are bowled over by a trio of adults, two women and a man, with a teenager trailing close behind them.|7133|0
units.english: No sooner have you entered the spaceport than you are bowled over by a trio of adults, two women and a man, with a teenager trailing close behind them.
units.italian: Non hai nemmeno messo piede nello spazioporto che vieni travolto da tre adulti, due donne e un uomo, con una persona adolescente che li segue da vicino.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	"Oh - sorry!" the older of the two women exclaims. She puts out a hand to help you up, then gets a better look at you as you take it, stand, and dust yourself off. "Wait; are you a ship captain?" she says after a moment.|7134|0
units.english: "Oh - sorry!" the older of the two women exclaims. She puts out a hand to help you up, then gets a better look at you as you take it, stand, and dust yourself off. "Wait; are you a ship captain?" she says after a moment.
units.italian: "Oh, scusi!" esclama la più anziana delle due donne. Ti porge una mano per aiutarti a rialzarti, poi ti guarda meglio mentre la prendi, ti alzi e ti spolveri. "Aspetti: lei è un capitano di nave?" dice dopo un momento.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	"<first> <last>, captain of the <ship>," you reply. "Why?"|7135|0
units.english: "<first> <last>, captain of the <ship>," you reply. "Why?"
units.italian: "<first> <last>, capitano della <ship>," rispondi. "Perché?"

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	"Oh! You may be the answer to our prayers, dearie!" She and the others have now gotten themselves a bit more organized, and you can tell that they must be a family. Confirming this, the woman says, "I'm Shirley Burnbeck, and this is my husband Darren. These are our children, Erin and Leigh." The other, younger woman, Erin, greets you with a smile, while the teen, Leigh, glances at you before turning their gaze towards the ground. "We were on vacation here on <origin> when news of the secession and those awful bombings came out. Well, I don't need to tell you, it's caused us some trouble! Or, well, maybe I do, because we're from <destination>, down in what they're now calling the Free Worlds!"|7136|0
units.english: "Oh! You may be the answer to our prayers, dearie!" She and the others have now gotten themselves a bit more organized, and you can tell that they must be a family. Confirming this, the woman says, "I'm Shirley Burnbeck, and this is my husband Darren. These are our children, Erin and Leigh." The other, younger woman, Erin, greets you with a smile, while the teen, Leigh, glances at you before turning their gaze towards the ground. "We were on vacation here on <origin> when news of the secession and those awful bombings came out. Well, I don't need to tell you, it's caused us some trouble! Or, well, maybe I do, because we're from <destination>, down in what they're now calling the Free Worlds!"
units.italian: "Oh! Potrebbe essere la risposta alle nostre preghiere, caro!" Lei e gli altri si sono nel frattempo un po' riorganizzati, e capisci che devono essere una famiglia. A confermarlo, la donna dice: "Sono Shirley Burnbeck, e lui è mio marito Darren. Loro sono i nostri figli, Erin e Leigh." L'altra donna, più giovane, Erin, ti saluta con un sorriso, mentre l'adolescente, Leigh, ti lancia un'occhiata e poi abbassa lo sguardo a terra. "Eravamo in vacanza qui su <origin> quando sono uscite le notizie della secessione e di quei terribili bombardamenti. Beh, non serve che glielo dica, ci ha causato dei problemi! O forse sì, perché siamo di <destination>, giù in quello che ora chiamano Free Worlds!"

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	Her husband cuts in, "Anyway, the short of it is that we really need to get home, and right now, none of the regular services are running from here to <planet> because of the likelihood of war. Could you possibly take the four of us back home? We... can't pay a lot, right now, but we can pay."|7137|0
units.english: Her husband cuts in, "Anyway, the short of it is that we really need to get home, and right now, none of the regular services are running from here to <planet> because of the likelihood of war. Could you possibly take the four of us back home? We... can't pay a lot, right now, but we can pay."
units.italian: Il marito interviene: "Comunque, in breve: dobbiamo davvero tornare a casa, e in questo momento nessun servizio regolare parte da qui per <planet>, vista la probabilità di guerra. Potrebbe portare noi quattro a casa? Non... possiamo pagare molto, adesso, ma possiamo pagare."

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	"Of course. I wouldn't leave people stranded like this."|7139|0
units.english: "Of course. I wouldn't leave people stranded like this."
units.italian: "Certamente. Non lascerei mai delle persone bloccate così."

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	"Sorry, I'm not headed that way. Best of luck."|7141|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not headed that way. Best of luck."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non vado in quella direzione. Buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	Four faces fall in front of you, and after a moment, they gather up their luggage again and start heading out the doors they crashed into you in. Shirley nods sadly as she goes, and says, "Well, I guess we understand. We'll find a way home somehow..."|7142|0
units.english: Four faces fall in front of you, and after a moment, they gather up their luggage again and start heading out the doors they crashed into you in. Shirley nods sadly as she goes, and says, "Well, I guess we understand. We'll find a way home somehow..."
units.italian: Quattro volti si intristiscono davanti a te, e dopo un momento raccolgono di nuovo i bagagli e si avviano verso le porte da cui ti sono piombati addosso. Shirley annuisce tristemente andandosene e dice: "Beh, credo che possiamo capire. Troveremo un modo per tornare a casa..."

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	Four faces light up in front of you, and after a moment, they gather up their luggage again, and stand expectantly. "Well, where should we go?"|7146|0
units.english: Four faces light up in front of you, and after a moment, they gather up their luggage again, and stand expectantly. "Well, where should we go?"
units.italian: Quattro volti si illuminano davanti a te, e dopo un momento raccolgono di nuovo i bagagli e restano lì in attesa. "Beh, dove dobbiamo andare?"

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	You direct them to the berth where your ship is currently being refueled, and they all bustle off, seeming much more hopeful and relieved.|7147|0
units.english: You direct them to the berth where your ship is currently being refueled, and they all bustle off, seeming much more hopeful and relieved.
units.italian: Li indirizzi al posto letto dove la tua nave sta facendo rifornimento, e se ne vanno tutti in fretta, con un'aria molto più speranzosa e sollevata.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|log|7152|0
units.english: Shirley, Darren, Leigh, and Erin Burnbeck were vacationing in the Paradise Worlds when Geminus and Martini were bombed, stranding them. You helped them get back home.
units.italian: Shirley, Darren, Leigh ed Erin Burnbeck erano in vacanza nei Mondi Paradisiaci quando Geminus e Martini sono stati bombardati, e sono rimasti bloccati. Li ho aiutati a tornare a casa.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|The trip south with the Burnbecks was mostly quite pleasant, but while they stop short of openly blaming them for the bombings on Geminus and Martini, they are very angry at the Free Worlds for seceding from the Republic. "We were perfectly happy belonging to the Republic," Darren said one evening in the mess. "I mean, seriously, did those people way down in, where is it, Zug? Bourne? Did they even think about the regular people and how this would affect them? Affect us?"|7154|0
units.english: The trip south with the Burnbecks was mostly quite pleasant, but while they stop short of openly blaming them for the bombings on Geminus and Martini, they are very angry at the Free Worlds for seceding from the Republic. "We were perfectly happy belonging to the Republic," Darren said one evening in the mess. "I mean, seriously, did those people way down in, where is it, Zug? Bourne? Did they even think about the regular people and how this would affect them? Affect us?"
units.italian: Il viaggio verso sud con i Burnbeck è stato per lo più piacevole, ma, pur senza accusarli apertamente dei bombardamenti su Geminus e Martini, sono molto arrabbiati con i Free Worlds per la secessione dalla Repubblica. "Noi eravamo perfettamente felici di appartenere alla Repubblica," ha detto Darren una sera in mensa. "Cioè, seriamente, quelle persone laggiù, dov'è, Zug? Bourne? Hanno pensato anche alla gente comune e a come questo l'avrebbe colpita? Colpita noi?"

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 1|	While some of their complaints seem a bit selfish, it's hard to argue with the fact that this has disrupted a lot of lives. After touching down on <planet>, Darren, Leigh, and Erin joyfully run into the arms of their friends and family here. Shirley hangs back to hand you a credit chip for <payment> and thank you warmly (and at some length) for your help in getting home, before heading out to join her family in their reunion.|7155|0
units.english: While some of their complaints seem a bit selfish, it's hard to argue with the fact that this has disrupted a lot of lives. After touching down on <planet>, Darren, Leigh, and Erin joyfully run into the arms of their friends and family here. Shirley hangs back to hand you a credit chip for <payment> and thank you warmly (and at some length) for your help in getting home, before heading out to join her family in their reunion.
units.italian: Alcune delle loro lamentele sembrano un po' egoistiche, ma è difficile obiettare sul fatto che tutto questo ha sconvolto molte vite. Dopo l'atterraggio su <planet>, Darren, Leigh ed Erin corrono con gioia fra le braccia di amici e parenti. Shirley resta indietro per consegnarti un chip di credito da <payment> e ringraziarti calorosamente (e a lungo) per l'aiuto nel tornare a casa, prima di raggiungere la famiglia nella sua reunion.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 2|While walking through the spaceport, you are surprised to see Shirley and Darren Burnbeck, along with a young man, who you recognize as Leigh after a few seconds. They greet you warmly, reassure you that Erin is just off to university on Zug and so couldn't join them on this vacation, and invite you to have dinner with them at the spaceport cafe.|7167|0
units.english: While walking through the spaceport, you are surprised to see Shirley and Darren Burnbeck, along with a young man, who you recognize as Leigh after a few seconds. They greet you warmly, reassure you that Erin is just off to university on Zug and so couldn't join them on this vacation, and invite you to have dinner with them at the spaceport cafe.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, con sorpresa vedi Shirley e Darren Burnbeck, insieme a un giovane che dopo qualche secondo riconosci come Leigh. Ti salutano calorosamente, ti rassicurano che Erin è appena partita per l'università su Zug e quindi non ha potuto unirsi a loro in vacanza, e ti invitano a cena con loro al caffè dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 2|	(Accept.)|7169|0
units.english: (Accept.)
units.italian: (Accetta.)

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 2|	(Decline.)|7171|0
units.english: (Decline.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 2|	You apologize, and they reassure you it's fine and thank you once again.|7172|0
units.english: You apologize, and they reassure you it's fine and thank you once again.
units.italian: Ti scusi, e loro ti rassicurano che non è un problema e ti ringraziano ancora.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 2|	You join them, and they listen raptly to your stories of participating in the Free Worlds' campaign to remain independent from the Republic. When you talk about transporting the Earth ambassadors to Bourne, Darren shakes his head in something like admiration.|7176|0
units.english: You join them, and they listen raptly to your stories of participating in the Free Worlds' campaign to remain independent from the Republic. When you talk about transporting the Earth ambassadors to Bourne, Darren shakes his head in something like admiration.
units.italian: Ti unisci a loro, e ascoltano rapiti i tuoi racconti della partecipazione alla campagna dei Free Worlds per restare indipendenti dalla Repubblica. Quando parli del trasporto degli ambasciatori della Terra su Bourne, Darren scuote la testa in quello che sembra ammirazione.

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 2|	"You know," he says, "I was never quite sure that the Free Worlds hadn't really been behind those awful bombings, but now, it looks like I was wrong. In fact, I think I might have been wrong about a lot of things about the Free Worlds Council and Senate, back then. It's still true that they've upended our lives, but from what I've seen of their actions since, especially with the pirates, they really do seem to have the best interests of the people here in the South at heart."|7177|0
units.english: "You know," he says, "I was never quite sure that the Free Worlds hadn't really been behind those awful bombings, but now, it looks like I was wrong. In fact, I think I might have been wrong about a lot of things about the Free Worlds Council and Senate, back then. It's still true that they've upended our lives, but from what I've seen of their actions since, especially with the pirates, they really do seem to have the best interests of the people here in the South at heart."
units.italian: "Sa," dice, "non ero mai del tutto sicuro che i Free Worlds non fossero davvero dietro quei terribili bombardamenti, ma ora sembra che mi sbagliassi. Anzi, credo di essermi sbagliato su molte cose del Consiglio e del Senato dei Free Worlds, allora. È ancora vero che ci hanno sconvolto la vita, ma da quello che ho visto delle loro azioni da allora, soprattutto con i pirati, sembra davvero che abbiano a cuore gli interessi della gente qui nel Sud."

units.id: mission:Stranded In Paradise 2|	After a round of compliments and words of solidarity from the other members of the family, you finish up your dinners and bid them goodbye.|7178|0
units.english: After a round of compliments and words of solidarity from the other members of the family, you finish up your dinners and bid them goodbye.
units.italian: Dopo un giro di complimenti e parole di solidarietà dagli altri membri della famiglia, finite le cene e vi salutate.

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|name|7183|0
units.english: Fiance to <planet>
units.italian: Il fidanzato per <planet>

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|description|7184|0
units.english: Tom, formerly a marketer for the Syndicate, is going to live with his fiance on <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Tom, un tempo responsabile marketing per il Sindacato, va a vivere con il suo fidanzato su <destination>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|Walking through the spaceport, you see a man in a very neat suit standing by the side of the concourse holding a sign reading "Transport To <planet>" in beautiful lettering.|7197|0
units.english: Walking through the spaceport, you see a man in a very neat suit standing by the side of the concourse holding a sign reading "Transport To <planet>" in beautiful lettering.
units.italian: Attraversando lo spazioporto, vedi un uomo in un abito molto curato in piedi ai bordi dell'atrio, con un cartello che recita "Trasporto per <planet>" in una calligrafia bellissima.

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|	(Walk towards him.)|7199|0
units.english: (Walk towards him.)
units.italian: (Vai verso di lui.)

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|	(Ignore him.)|7200|0
units.english: (Ignore him.)
units.italian: (Ignalo.)

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|	He turns a very professional smile on you and introduces himself. "My name is Tom Ardwright. My fiance is the Agriculture Minister on <destination>, down in the Free Worlds. We had planned to get married up here in a few months, but, well..." He gestures around at the general situation. "So I'm heading down to <planet> instead. Can you help?"|7202|0
units.english: He turns a very professional smile on you and introduces himself. "My name is Tom Ardwright. My fiance is the Agriculture Minister on <destination>, down in the Free Worlds. We had planned to get married up here in a few months, but, well..." He gestures around at the general situation. "So I'm heading down to <planet> instead. Can you help?"
units.italian: Ti rivolge un sorriso molto professionale e si presenta. "Mi chiamo Tom Ardwright. Il mio fidanzato è il Ministro dell'Agricoltura su <destination>, giù nei Free Worlds. Avevamo in programma di sposarci quassù fra qualche mese, ma, beh..." Accenna alla situazione generale intorno. "Quindi vado giù su <planet>, invece. Puoi aiutarmi?"

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|	"You're in luck; I'm the captain of the <ship>."|7204|0
units.english: "You're in luck; I'm the captain of the <ship>."
units.italian: "Sei fortunato: sono il capitano della <ship>."

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|	"I can't help."|7206|0
units.english: "I can't help."
units.italian: "Non posso aiutarti."

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|	Tom sighs and nods. "Thanks for hearing me out. Best of luck, wherever you end up."|7207|0
units.english: Tom sighs and nods. "Thanks for hearing me out. Best of luck, wherever you end up."
units.italian: Tom sospira e annuisce. "Grazie per avermi ascoltato. Buona fortuna, ovunque finirai."

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|	Tom's whole posture relaxes as his professional grin becomes a genuine smile. "Wow. This really means so much to me. You said it was the <ship>? I'll be on board in an hour."|7211|0
units.english: Tom's whole posture relaxes as his professional grin becomes a genuine smile. "Wow. This really means so much to me. You said it was the <ship>? I'll be on board in an hour."
units.italian: Tutta la postura di Tom si distende e il suo sorriso professionale diventa un sorriso vero. "Wow. Questo significa davvero molto per me. Dicevi che è la <ship>? Sarò a bordo fra un'ora."

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|log|7216|0
units.english: Tom Ardwright was a marketer for the Syndicate, but moved south to live with his fiance Carl Chamberlain after war broke out.
units.italian: Tom Ardwright era un responsabile marketing del Sindacato, ma si è trasferito a sud per vivere con il fidanzato Carl Chamberlain dopo lo scoppio della guerra.

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|During the trip to <destination>, you had several conversations with Tom on a wide range of topics, including his fiance, Carl, as well as his job as a marketer and designer for a division of Syndicated Systems - at least until he quit. "It'll be a shame to see my work for the Syndicate be replaced, but I don't regret leaving. Carl's got big plans in store for <planet>, now that we aren't stuck with the Republic's shoestring budget, and I wouldn't miss them for the galaxy."|7219|0
units.english: During the trip to <destination>, you had several conversations with Tom on a wide range of topics, including his fiance, Carl, as well as his job as a marketer and designer for a division of Syndicated Systems - at least until he quit. "It'll be a shame to see my work for the Syndicate be replaced, but I don't regret leaving. Carl's got big plans in store for <planet>, now that we aren't stuck with the Republic's shoestring budget, and I wouldn't miss them for the galaxy."
units.italian: Durante il viaggio verso <destination> hai avuto diverse conversazioni con Tom su un'ampia gamma di argomenti, compreso il suo fidanzato Carl e il suo lavoro di responsabile marketing e designer per una divisione di Syndicated Systems, almeno finché non si è licenziato. "Sarà un peccato vedere il mio lavoro per il Sindacato sostituito, ma non mi pento di essere andato via. Carl ha grandi progetti per <planet>, ora che non siamo più bloccati dal bilancio da quattro soldi della Repubblica, e non me li perderei per nulla al mondo."

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 1|	You stand at the foot of the ramp accepting Tom's fare of <payment> and bidding him farewell as Carl runs across the tarmac toward you. You step back as they practically leap into each other's arms, reuniting in spite of these tumultuous times.|7220|0
units.english: You stand at the foot of the ramp accepting Tom's fare of <payment> and bidding him farewell as Carl runs across the tarmac toward you. You step back as they practically leap into each other's arms, reuniting in spite of these tumultuous times.
units.italian: Resti ai piedi della rampa a incassare la tariffa di <payment> e a salutare Tom, mentre Carl attraversa di corsa il piazzale verso di voi. Fai un passo indietro mentre i due si gettano praticamente l'uno nelle braccia dell'altro, ricongiungendosi nonostante questi tempi burrascosi.

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 2|After landing, you receive a message from Tom and Carl. Attached are photos of their wedding on Cornucopia, as well as a letter:|7233|0
units.english: After landing, you receive a message from Tom and Carl. Attached are photos of their wedding on Cornucopia, as well as a letter:
units.italian: Dopo l'atterraggio, ricevi un messaggio da Tom e Carl. In allegato ci sono le foto del loro matrimonio su Cornucopia, e una lettera:

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 2|Dear <first> <last>,|7235|0
units.english: Dear <first> <last>,
units.italian: Cari <first> <last>,

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 2|	We are delighted to announce that despite the many hardships around us in these times, the two of us were married three days ago at the Hart's Hill Vineyard on Cornucopia. This would not have been possible without you, and we thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Please enjoy these photos from the wedding.|7236|0
units.english: We are delighted to announce that despite the many hardships around us in these times, the two of us were married three days ago at the Hart's Hill Vineyard on Cornucopia. This would not have been possible without you, and we thank you from the bottom of our hearts. Please enjoy these photos from the wedding.
units.italian: Siamo felici di annunciare che, nonostante le molte difficoltà che ci circondano in questi tempi, ci siamo sposati tre giorni fa alla Hart's Hill Vineyard, su Cornucopia. Non sarebbe stato possibile senza di te, e ti ringraziamo dal profondo del cuore. Ti preghiamo di goderti queste foto del matrimonio.

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 2|				Tom & Carl Ardwright-Chamberlain|7237|0
units.english: Tom & Carl Ardwright-Chamberlain
units.italian: Tom e Carl Ardwright-Chamberlain

units.id: mission:Southern Fiance 2|	You recognize Tom's style in the design of the photo set, which includes a photo of them on the tarmac at the Cornucopia spaceport where they were reunited after the uncertainty of the war parted them.|7239|0
units.english: You recognize Tom's style in the design of the photo set, which includes a photo of them on the tarmac at the Cornucopia spaceport where they were reunited after the uncertainty of the war parted them.
units.italian: Riconosci lo stile di Tom nel design della serie di foto, che comprende una loro immagine sul piazzale dello spazioporto di Cornucopia, dove si sono riuniti dopo che l'incertezza della guerra li aveva separati.

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|name|7244|0
units.english: Refugee family to <planet>
units.italian: Famiglia di profughi per <planet>

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|description|7245|0
units.english: Transport a family of <bunks> refugees and <cargo> to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Trasporta una famiglia di <bunks> profughi e <cargo> su <destination>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|A young family of three is walking around the spaceport talking to merchant captains. From the looks of it, they're not having much luck.|7262|0
units.english: A young family of three is walking around the spaceport talking to merchant captains. From the looks of it, they're not having much luck.
units.italian: Una giovane famiglia di tre persone gira per lo spazioporto parlando con capitani mercantili. A quanto pare, non hanno molta fortuna.

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	(Approach them.)|7264|0
units.english: (Approach them.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati a loro.)

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	(Ignore them.)|7265|0
units.english: (Ignore them.)
units.italian: (Ignali.)

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	The parents introduce themselves as Penny Little and Rosa Perkins. Their young child is named Eduardo. Penny asks, "Any chance you're willing to take us and <tons> of our belongings to <destination>? We're concerned that the war between the Republic and the Free Worlds are going to get dangerous, so we want to raise Eduardo on a Quarg planet instead. We can pay <payment>."|7267|0
units.english: The parents introduce themselves as Penny Little and Rosa Perkins. Their young child is named Eduardo. Penny asks, "Any chance you're willing to take us and <tons> of our belongings to <destination>? We're concerned that the war between the Republic and the Free Worlds are going to get dangerous, so we want to raise Eduardo on a Quarg planet instead. We can pay <payment>."
units.italian: I genitori si presentano come Penny Little e Rosa Perkins. Il loro bambino si chiama Eduardo. Penny chiede: "Per caso saresti disposto a portare noi e <tons> delle nostre cose su <destination>? Temiamo che la guerra fra la Repubblica e i Free Worlds diventi pericolosa, quindi vogliamo crescere Eduardo su un pianeta dei Quarg. Possiamo pagare <payment>."

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|label|7268|0
units.english: main choice
units.italian: main choice

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	"Why were those other captains refusing to take you?"|7270|0
units.english: "Why were those other captains refusing to take you?"
units.italian: "Perché quegli altri capitani rifiutavano di prendervi?"

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	"What do you mean, 'Quarg planet'?"|7274|0
units.english: "What do you mean, 'Quarg planet'?"
units.italian: "In che senso, 'pianeta dei Quarg'?"

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	"The Quarg let humans live on one of their planets?"|7279|0
units.english: "The Quarg let humans live on one of their planets?"
units.italian: "I Quarg lasciano vivere gli umani su uno dei loro pianeti?"

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	"Sure, I can take you."|7285|0
units.english: "Sure, I can take you."
units.italian: "Certo, posso portarvi."

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	"Sorry, I'm not headed that way."|7287|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not headed that way."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non vado in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|label|7289|0
units.english: other captains
units.italian: other captains

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	"I think many of them are a bit distrustful of the Quarg. Plus, people are just generally more on edge these days with the tensions between the Free Worlds and the Republic, so they're less interested in flying somewhere unfamiliar. While I do understand those feelings, it seems to me that humans have done much worse to each other than the Quarg have ever done to us."|7292|0
units.english: "I think many of them are a bit distrustful of the Quarg. Plus, people are just generally more on edge these days with the tensions between the Free Worlds and the Republic, so they're less interested in flying somewhere unfamiliar. While I do understand those feelings, it seems to me that humans have done much worse to each other than the Quarg have ever done to us."
units.italian: "Credo che molti di loro diffidino un po' dei Quarg. E poi in questi giorni la gente è più tesa del solito per le tensioni fra Free Worlds e Repubblica, quindi è meno interessata a volare in posti che non conosce. Capisco questi sentimenti, ma mi sembra che gli umani si siano fatti cose molto peggiori di quelle che i Quarg abbiano mai fatto a noi."

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|label|7294|0
units.english: quarg
units.italian: quarg

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	She looks a bit surprised that you don't already know. "The Quarg are an advanced alien species that live in a corner of human space, near Tarazed. I honestly don't know that much else about them, but I've heard that they prefer to stay out of human matters. You could try talking to them if you want to know more.|7297|0
units.english: She looks a bit surprised that you don't already know. "The Quarg are an advanced alien species that live in a corner of human space, near Tarazed. I honestly don't know that much else about them, but I've heard that they prefer to stay out of human matters. You could try talking to them if you want to know more.
units.italian: Sembra un po' sorpresa che tu non lo sappia già. "I Quarg sono una specie aliena avanzata che vive in un angolo dello spazio umano, vicino a Tarazed. Sinceramente non so molto altro su di loro, ma ho sentito che preferiscono restare fuori dalle faccende umane. Potresti provare a parlarci, se vuoi saperne di più.

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|	"There's a planet they control that has too much gravity for them, but is just right for humans, so they let humans settle there under their protection. Or at least that's what I've heard."|7300|0
units.english: "There's a planet they control that has too much gravity for them, but is just right for humans, so they let humans settle there under their protection. Or at least that's what I've heard."
units.italian: "C'è un pianeta che controllano, con una gravità troppo alta per loro ma giusta per gli umani, così lasciano che gli umani ci si stabiliscano sotto la loro protezione. O almeno così ho sentito."

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|dialog|7307|0
units.english: Penny and Rosa thank you for getting them safely to <destination>, handing you <payment> for your troubles. You wish them and Eduardo the best of luck starting their new life away from a potential war in human space.
units.italian: Penny e Rosa ti ringraziano per averle portate sane e salve su <destination>, consegnandoti <payment> per il disturbo. Auguri a loro e a Eduardo ogni fortuna nell'iniziare una nuova vita lontano da una possibile guerra nello spazio umano.

units.id: mission:FW Refugees to Humanika|log|7308|0
units.english: A young family who wanted to escape a potential war in human space. Took them to the planet Humanika, where the Quarg let humans settle.
units.italian: Una giovane famiglia che voleva sfuggire a una possibile guerra nello spazio umano. Li ho portati sul pianeta Humanika, dove i Quarg lasciano stabilirsi gli umani.

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|name|7312|0
units.english: Derelict Treasure Map
units.italian: Mappa del tesoro del relitto

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|description|7313|0
units.english: Follow the treasure map you found in a derelict ship to <destination>.
units.italian: Segui la mappa del tesoro che hai trovato in una nave abbandonata fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|Upon landing on <origin> you take out the treasure map you recovered from the derelict ship. The map gives detailed instructions about where the treasure was buried on the sparsely populated world of <destination>. However, the map's creator claims to have obtained some kind of alien weapons that disrupts a ship's electrical systems. The outlandish claim seems to bring doubt to the validity of the map.|7319|0
