units.english: Upon landing on <origin> you take out the treasure map you recovered from the derelict ship. The map gives detailed instructions about where the treasure was buried on the sparsely populated world of <destination>. However, the map's creator claims to have obtained some kind of alien weapons that disrupts a ship's electrical systems. The outlandish claim seems to bring doubt to the validity of the map.
units.italian: Atterrando su <origin> tiri fuori la mappa del tesoro recuperata dalla nave abbandonata. La mappa dà istruzioni dettagliate su dove sia sepolto il tesoro sul mondo scarsamente popolato di <destination>. Però chi ha fatto la mappa sostiene di aver ottenuto una specie di armi aliene che perturbano i sistemi elettrici di una nave. L'affermazione stravagante sembra gettare dubbi sulla validità della mappa.

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|	(Follow the map.)|7321|0
units.english: (Follow the map.)
units.italian: (Segui la mappa.)

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|	(Throw the map away, it's probably fake.)|7323|0
units.english: (Throw the map away, it's probably fake.)
units.italian: (Butta via la mappa, sarà un falso.)

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|Flying low over <planet> you follow the instructions to an isolated valley where you promptly land and get to digging. After hours of shoveling the hard soil you're met with a thunk as you strike metal.|7329|0
units.english: Flying low over <planet> you follow the instructions to an isolated valley where you promptly land and get to digging. After hours of shoveling the hard soil you're met with a thunk as you strike metal.
units.italian: Volando basso su <planet> segui le istruzioni fino a una valle isolata, dove atterri subito e ti metti a scavare. Dopo ore di badile sul terreno duro, senti un tonfo: hai colpito del metallo.

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|	Opening the cache reveals a large store of credits along with the alien weapons the map's owner wrote about. You marvel at their strange design and wonder at their power.|7332|0
units.english: Opening the cache reveals a large store of credits along with the alien weapons the map's owner wrote about. You marvel at their strange design and wonder at their power.
units.italian: Aprendo la cassa trovi una grande quantità di crediti insieme alle armi aliene di cui scriveva il proprietario della mappa. Ti meravigli del loro disegno strano e ti chiedi quale sia la loro potenza.

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|	(Loot the treasure.)|7334|0
units.english: (Loot the treasure.)
units.italian: (Prendi il tesoro.)

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|	Opening the cache reveals a large store of credits along with two Hai Ion Cannons. These must be the alien weapons the map's owner wrote about.|7337|0
units.english: Opening the cache reveals a large store of credits along with two Hai Ion Cannons. These must be the alien weapons the map's owner wrote about.
units.italian: Aprendo la cassa trovi una grande quantità di crediti insieme a due cannoni ionici degli Hai. Devono essere le armi aliene di cui scriveva il proprietario della mappa.

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|	(Loot the treasure.)|7339|0
units.english: (Loot the treasure.)
units.italian: (Prendi il tesoro.)

units.id: mission:Derelict Treasure Map: Ion Cannons|	You grab the <payment> credits, and with the assistance of some machinery you bring the weapons back to your ship.|7341|0
units.english: You grab the <payment> credits, and with the assistance of some machinery you bring the weapons back to your ship.
units.italian: Prendi i <payment> crediti e, con l'aiuto di un po' di macchinari, porti le armi sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 1|name|7345|0
units.english: Lost Family Investment
units.italian: Investimento di famiglia perduto

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 1|description|7346|0
units.english: Return the credits you found in a derelict ship to the family it belongs to by traveling to <destination>.
units.italian: Restituisci alla famiglia a cui appartengono i crediti che hai trovato in una nave abbandonata, viaggiando fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 1|Upon landing on <origin> you take out the text log you recovered alongside the case of <payment> from the derelict ship. The log reveals the credits were the result of a risky investment in an attempt to buy a better life for the captain of the ship, Colin Sawyer, and his family. You assume that the captain never made it home, and looking further into the personal log you find that the family used to reside on <destination>.|7353|0
units.english: Upon landing on <origin> you take out the text log you recovered alongside the case of <payment> from the derelict ship. The log reveals the credits were the result of a risky investment in an attempt to buy a better life for the captain of the ship, Colin Sawyer, and his family. You assume that the captain never made it home, and looking further into the personal log you find that the family used to reside on <destination>.
units.italian: Atterrando su <origin> tiri fuori il registro recuperato insieme alla custodia di <payment> dalla nave abbandonata. Il registro rivela che i crediti erano il frutto di un investimento rischioso, fatto per tentare di comprare una vita migliore al capitano della nave, Colin Sawyer, e alla sua famiglia. Presumi che il capitano non sia mai tornato a casa, e scavando nel registro personale scopri che la famiglia risiedeva su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 1|	Perhaps the family still lives there.|7354|0
units.english: Perhaps the family still lives there.
units.italian: Forse la famiglia vive ancora là.

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 1|	(Attempt to return the credits.)|7356|0
units.english: (Attempt to return the credits.)
units.italian: (Tenta di restituire i crediti.)

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 1|	(Keep the credits to myself.)|7358|0
units.english: (Keep the credits to myself.)
units.italian: (Tieni i crediti per te.)

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 1|	You decide to keep the money. After all, it's not every day that you find a score worth <payment>.|7361|0
units.english: You decide to keep the money. After all, it's not every day that you find a score worth <payment>.
units.italian: Decidi di tenerti i soldi. Dopotutto, non capita tutti i giorni di trovare un bottino da <payment>.

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|name|7366|0
units.english: Lost Family Investment
units.italian: Investimento di famiglia perduto

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|description|7367|0
units.english: Return the credits you found in a derelict ship to the family it belongs to by traveling to <destination>.
units.italian: Restituisci alla famiglia a cui appartengono i crediti che hai trovato in una nave abbandonata, viaggiando fino a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|Upon landing on <origin> you take a transport out to the small farm indicated in the log as the home of Captain Sawyer's family. After knocking on the door of the farmhouse a man opens the door and asks, "Can I help you?"|7373|0
units.english: Upon landing on <origin> you take a transport out to the small farm indicated in the log as the home of Captain Sawyer's family. After knocking on the door of the farmhouse a man opens the door and asks, "Can I help you?"
units.italian: Atterrando su <origin> prendi un mezzo di trasporto fino alla piccola fattoria indicata nel registro come casa della famiglia del capitano Sawyer. Dopo aver bussato alla porta della casa colonica, un uomo apre e chiede: "Posso aiutarla?"

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	"Do you know a Colin Sawyer?"|7375|0
units.english: "Do you know a Colin Sawyer?"
units.italian: "Conosce un certo Colin Sawyer?"

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	"Do the Sawyers live here?"|7376|0
units.english: "Do the Sawyers live here?"
units.italian: "I Sawyer vivono qui?"

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	"Sawyer? Yeah, that's the family that sold me this here farm. If you're looking for them I believe they moved to a more populated planet, own some big corporation now." The man gives you the Sawyers' new place of residence on <destination> and bids you farewell.|7377|0
units.english: "Sawyer? Yeah, that's the family that sold me this here farm. If you're looking for them I believe they moved to a more populated planet, own some big corporation now." The man gives you the Sawyers' new place of residence on <destination> and bids you farewell.
units.italian: "Sawyer? Sì, è la famiglia che mi ha venduto questa fattoria. Se li cerca, credo si siano trasferiti su un pianeta più popolato, ora hanno una qualche grande azienda." L'uomo ti dà il nuovo indirizzo dei Sawyer su <destination> e ti saluta.

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|It doesn't take long to find the Sawyers' home on <planet>. The building makes it clear that the family has done well for themselves. After a quick explanation to the desk clerk that you have something important to give, you take an elevator ride to the penthouse. You ring the buzzer and are greeted by a woman in her late fifties. "A delivery?" she asks.|7383|0
units.english: It doesn't take long to find the Sawyers' home on <planet>. The building makes it clear that the family has done well for themselves. After a quick explanation to the desk clerk that you have something important to give, you take an elevator ride to the penthouse. You ring the buzzer and are greeted by a woman in her late fifties. "A delivery?" she asks.
units.italian: Ci vuole poco a trovare la casa dei Sawyer su <planet>. L'edificio dice chiaramente che la famiglia se l'è cavata bene. Dopo una breve spiegazione all'addetta della reception, che hai qualcosa di importante da consegnare, prendi l'ascensore fino all'attico. Suoni il campanello e ti accoglie una donna sulla cinquantina abbondante. "Una consegna?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	"Do you know a Colin Sawyer?"|7385|0
units.english: "Do you know a Colin Sawyer?"
units.italian: "Conosce un certo Colin Sawyer?"

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	A scowl appears on her face as she spits out a response. "What do you know of my Da? That deadbeat left me and my family with next to nothing."|7386|0
units.english: A scowl appears on her face as she spits out a response. "What do you know of my Da? That deadbeat left me and my family with next to nothing."
units.italian: Un cipiglio le compare sul viso mentre sputa la risposta. "Che cosa sa di mio padre? Quel lavativo ci ha lasciato, me e la mia famiglia, con quasi nulla."

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	"I don't know what happened to him personally, but I found this case of credits and a log explaining how he was trying to invest in a better life for his family."|7388|0
units.english: "I don't know what happened to him personally, but I found this case of credits and a log explaining how he was trying to invest in a better life for his family."
units.italian: "Non so che cosa gli sia successo personalmente, ma ho trovato questa custodia di crediti e un registro che spiega come stesse cercando di investire in una vita migliore per la sua famiglia."

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	"I believe he died before he was able to bring back his business investment to your family. Here's his personal log, it explains everything."|7389|0
units.english: "I believe he died before he was able to bring back his business investment to your family. Here's his personal log, it explains everything."
units.italian: "Credo che sia morto prima di poter riportare alla vostra famiglia il frutto del suo investimento. Ecco il suo registro personale, spiega tutto."

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	She takes the log from you and quickly scrolls through it, emotion washing over her features as she reads. Eventually she looks up, and with all the anger towards her father gone, she speaks. "Thank you for this. All these years I had believed he had just taken our money and run off. But knowing he had been trying to help is worth more than all the credits in the galaxy. Take them and then some as a reward for bringing me this last piece of him."|7390|0
units.english: She takes the log from you and quickly scrolls through it, emotion washing over her features as she reads. Eventually she looks up, and with all the anger towards her father gone, she speaks. "Thank you for this. All these years I had believed he had just taken our money and run off. But knowing he had been trying to help is worth more than all the credits in the galaxy. Take them and then some as a reward for bringing me this last piece of him."
units.italian: Prende il registro e lo scorre in fretta, con l'emozione che le attraversa il viso mentre legge. Alla fine alza lo sguardo e, con tutta la rabbia verso il padre svanita, parla. "Grazie. Per tutti questi anni ho creduto che avesse preso i nostri soldi ed era scappato. Ma sapere che stava cercando di aiutarci vale più di tutti i crediti della galassia. Prenda questi, e qualcosa in più, come ricompensa per avermi portato quest'ultimo pezzo di lui."

units.id: mission:Derelict Family Investment 2|	You leave the building with a total of <payment> from both the case and Ms. Sawyer.|7391|0
units.english: You leave the building with a total of <payment> from both the case and Ms. Sawyer.
units.italian: Esci dall'edificio con un totale di <payment> fra la custodia e la signorina Sawyer.

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|name|7395|0
units.english: Transport family home to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporta la famiglia a casa su <planet>

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|description|7396|0
units.english: A family worried about the potential destruction within the Free Worlds wants to cut their vacation short and go home to <destination>. They promise to "pay you very well."
units.italian: Una famiglia preoccupata per la possibile distruzione nei Free Worlds vuole interrompere la vacanza e tornare a casa su <destination>. Promette di "pagarti molto bene".

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|After looking around <origin>'s spaceport, you head back to your ship to find a middle-aged couple and two grade-school girls (probably their daughters, you reason) waiting for you at your landing pad. While the man tries to resolve an argument between the two girls, the lady notices you immediately and begins to approach you.|7409|0
units.english: After looking around <origin>'s spaceport, you head back to your ship to find a middle-aged couple and two grade-school girls (probably their daughters, you reason) waiting for you at your landing pad. While the man tries to resolve an argument between the two girls, the lady notices you immediately and begins to approach you.
units.italian: Dopo aver girato per lo spazioporto di <origin>, torni alla nave e trovi ad aspettarti sulla piazzola una coppia di mezza età e due bambine delle elementari (probabilmente le loro figlie, ragioni). Mentre l'uomo cerca di risolvere un litigio fra le due bambine, la signora ti nota subito e comincia ad avvicinarsi.

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|	"Thank goodness you're here," she says. "We've been going from ship to ship looking for transport back home to <destination>. This war has caught us right in the middle of our vacation and we can't risk being anywhere near here when the Navy attacks, especially with our little angels," she gestures toward her daughters, now in a full-blown fight.|7410|0
units.english: "Thank goodness you're here," she says. "We've been going from ship to ship looking for transport back home to <destination>. This war has caught us right in the middle of our vacation and we can't risk being anywhere near here when the Navy attacks, especially with our little angels," she gestures toward her daughters, now in a full-blown fight.
units.italian: "Meno male che è qui," dice. "Andiamo di nave in nave cercando un trasporto per tornare a casa su <destination>. Questa guerra ci ha colti proprio nel mezzo della vacanza e non possiamo rischiare di stare da queste parti quando la Marina attacca, soprattutto con i nostri piccoli angeli," accenna verso le figlie, ormai in piena lite.

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|	She looks back at you pleadingly. "If you can find the time to take us to <planet>, we will pay you very well."|7411|0
units.english: She looks back at you pleadingly. "If you can find the time to take us to <planet>, we will pay you very well."
units.italian: Ti guarda di nuovo con aria supplichevole. "Se può trovare il tempo di portarci su <planet>, la pagheremo molto bene."

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|	"Sure, I'll take you."|7413|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll take you."
units.italian: "Certo, vi porto."

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|	"Okay, but that's pretty far. This better be worth it."|7414|0
units.english: "Okay, but that's pretty far. This better be worth it."
units.italian: "Va bene, ma è parecchio lontano. Meglio che ne valga la pena."

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|	"No, I don't think so. Sorry."|7415|0
units.english: "No, I don't think so. Sorry."
units.italian: "No, non credo. Spiacente."

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|	"Then it's a deal," she says as she gives you a firm handshake. The whole family gets onto the <ship> without a word, leaving you to load their many bags and cases.|7418|0
units.english: "Then it's a deal," she says as she gives you a firm handshake. The whole family gets onto the <ship> without a word, leaving you to load their many bags and cases.
units.italian: "Allora affare fatto," dice, stringendoti la mano con fermezza. La famiglia sale sulla <ship> senza dire una parola, lasciando a te il compito di caricare le loro molte borse e valigie.

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|You're not sure if you've ever met a more pretentious and entitled family. The girls fought non-stop, and every family member complained constantly about the lack of luxury accommodations on your ship. Once you land on <planet>, the lady gives you <payment> and the family leaves without a word of thanks; they never even tell you their names. Considering what they put you through they should have paid you more, but nonetheless you're happy to be rid of them.|7431|0
units.english: You're not sure if you've ever met a more pretentious and entitled family. The girls fought non-stop, and every family member complained constantly about the lack of luxury accommodations on your ship. Once you land on <planet>, the lady gives you <payment> and the family leaves without a word of thanks; they never even tell you their names. Considering what they put you through they should have paid you more, but nonetheless you're happy to be rid of them.
units.italian: Non sei sicuro di aver mai incontrato una famiglia più pretenziosa e piena di pretese. Le bambine litigavano senza sosta, e ogni membro della famiglia si lamentava continuamente della mancanza di sistemazioni di lusso sulla tua nave. Una volta atterrato su <planet>, la signora ti dà <payment> e la famiglia se ne va senza un grazie; non ti dicono nemmeno i loro nomi. Considerato quello che ti hanno fatto passare, avrebbero dovuto pagarti di più, ma sei comunque contento di esserteli levati di torno.

units.id: mission:Returning to Paradise|You're not sure if you've ever met a more pretentious and entitled family. The girls fought non-stop, but fortunately, the family was satisfied with the luxury accommodations on your ship. Once you land on <planet>, the lady gives you <payment> and the family leave without a word of thanks; they never even tell you their names. Nonetheless, you're happy to be rid of them.|7437|0
units.english: You're not sure if you've ever met a more pretentious and entitled family. The girls fought non-stop, but fortunately, the family was satisfied with the luxury accommodations on your ship. Once you land on <planet>, the lady gives you <payment> and the family leave without a word of thanks; they never even tell you their names. Nonetheless, you're happy to be rid of them.
units.italian: Non sei sicuro di aver mai incontrato una famiglia più pretenziosa e piena di pretese. Le bambine litigavano senza sosta, ma per fortuna la famiglia si è detta soddisfatta delle sistemazioni di lusso sulla tua nave. Una volta atterrato su <planet>, la signora ti dà <payment> e la famiglia se ne va senza un grazie; non ti dicono nemmeno i loro nomi. Sei comunque contento di esserteli levati di torno.

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|While passing through the spaceport, you notice a few energetic pilots gathered around a computer terminal, invested in some sort of conversation. One of the pilots speaks louder than the rest, sometimes getting looks from others in the spaceport. "You've fooled me before, and I reckoned you were this time! And here I thought them dang things were old news!" The pilot lets out a hearty chuckle. "Even nowadays them Firkins are still getting names!" After another minute or two, the group walks away from the terminal and out of your sight.|7450|0
units.english: While passing through the spaceport, you notice a few energetic pilots gathered around a computer terminal, invested in some sort of conversation. One of the pilots speaks louder than the rest, sometimes getting looks from others in the spaceport. "You've fooled me before, and I reckoned you were this time! And here I thought them dang things were old news!" The pilot lets out a hearty chuckle. "Even nowadays them Firkins are still getting names!" After another minute or two, the group walks away from the terminal and out of your sight.
units.italian: Passando per lo spazioporto, noti alcuni piloti pieni di energia radunati intorno a un terminale, presi da una specie di conversazione. Uno di loro parla più forte degli altri, attirando a tratti gli sguardi di chi è nello spazioporto. "Mi hai già fregato una volta, e pensavo che lo stessi facendo anche adesso! E dire che credevo che 'ste diavolerie fossero roba vecchia!" Il pilota si fa una bella risata. "Anche oggigiorno 'sti Firkin si beccano ancora un nome!" Dopo un altro paio di minuti, il gruppo si allontana dal terminale e ti esce di vista.

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	(Go see what this is about.)|7452|0
units.english: (Go see what this is about.)
units.italian: (Vai a vedere di che si tratta.)

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	(Ignore it.)|7453|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignoralo.)

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	You walk up to the computer terminal, and on it is displayed a news article with a title that reads "Popular Votes For Ship Name Poll - Unexpected Results." The article is about a small transport company hearkening back to older times with a special transport voyage centered around a Hogshead space liner. You recall that, back in their day, Hogsheads were sort of a business fad because of endless discussion and nicknames based on the shape of their engine pods. Nowadays, the ship has all but lost the charm it once had, but it seems a good number of pilots are interested in this ordeal.|7456|0
units.english: You walk up to the computer terminal, and on it is displayed a news article with a title that reads "Popular Votes For Ship Name Poll - Unexpected Results." The article is about a small transport company hearkening back to older times with a special transport voyage centered around a Hogshead space liner. You recall that, back in their day, Hogsheads were sort of a business fad because of endless discussion and nicknames based on the shape of their engine pods. Nowadays, the ship has all but lost the charm it once had, but it seems a good number of pilots are interested in this ordeal.
units.italian: Ti avvicini al terminale, dove è visualizzato un articolo di giornale con un titolo che recita "Voto popolare per il nome di una nave: risultati inattesi". L'articolo parla di una piccola compagnia di trasporti che guarda ai tempi passati con un viaggio speciale incentrato su un transatlantico spaziale Hogshead. Ricordi che, ai loro tempi, gli Hogshead erano una specie di moda nel settore, per via delle infinite discussioni e dei soprannomi basati sulla forma dei loro pod motore. Oggi la nave ha quasi del tutto perso il fascino di un tempo, ma sembra che un buon numero di piloti sia interessato a questa vicenda.

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	For the event, the transport company decided to have a public poll to name the ship, and while initial suggestions were casual names such as "Stark Lady" or "Timelight", some of the most popular ones are actually a collection of joke names - ones you would imagine a toddler would have come up with. Apparently, the names have gotten enough attention and enjoyment out of pilots that the company decided to take the top five most popular results and hold a vote on them.|7457|0
units.english: For the event, the transport company decided to have a public poll to name the ship, and while initial suggestions were casual names such as "Stark Lady" or "Timelight", some of the most popular ones are actually a collection of joke names - ones you would imagine a toddler would have come up with. Apparently, the names have gotten enough attention and enjoyment out of pilots that the company decided to take the top five most popular results and hold a vote on them.
units.italian: Per l'evento la compagnia ha deciso di indire un sondaggio pubblico per dare un nome alla nave, e mentre le proposte iniziali erano nomi sobri come "Stark Lady" o "Timelight", alcune delle più votate sono in realtà una raccolta di nomi scherzosi, di quelli che ti aspetteresti da un bambino di due anni. A quanto pare i nomi hanno attirato abbastanza attenzione e divertimento fra i piloti che la compagnia ha deciso di prendere i cinque risultati più votati e metterli ai voti.

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	Would you like to vote on the name as well?|7458|0
units.english: Would you like to vote on the name as well?
units.italian: Vuoi votare anche tu per il nome?

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	(Yes.)|7460|0
units.english: (Yes.)
units.italian: (Sì.)

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	(No.)|7461|0
units.english: (No.)
units.italian: (No.)

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	You navigate the article until you are directed to the poll itself, presenting you with the top five options.|7463|0
units.english: You navigate the article until you are directed to the poll itself, presenting you with the top five options.
units.italian: Scorri l'articolo finché non vieni indirizzato al sondaggio stesso, che ti presenta le prime cinque opzioni.

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	Star Empress|7465|0
units.english: Star Empress
units.italian: Star Empress

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	Tycho's Legacy|7466|0
units.english: Tycho's Legacy
units.italian: Tycho's Legacy

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	Shippy McShipface|7467|0
units.english: Shippy McShipface
units.italian: Shippy McShipface

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	It's Dark Here|7468|0
units.english: It's Dark Here
units.italian: It's Dark Here

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	What Asteroid|7469|0
units.english: What Asteroid
units.italian: What Asteroid

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma|	After you make your selection, a "thank you" message appears, telling you that the result of the poll will be broadcast on the news once the voting period has finished. Afterwards, you go back about your business.|7472|0
units.english: After you make your selection, a "thank you" message appears, telling you that the result of the poll will be broadcast on the news once the voting period has finished. Afterwards, you go back about your business.
units.italian: Dopo aver fatto la tua scelta compare un messaggio di "grazie", che ti informa che il risultato del sondaggio sarà trasmesso al notiziario al termine del periodo di voto. Poi torni alle tue faccende.

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma II|As you are walking around the spaceport, you see that more than a few pilots are watching the news on nearby displays. There are mixed emotions amongst the crowd - some pilots are having a good laugh while others seem disappointed or even confused. You aren't sure what this is about until, lo and behold, the result of that Hogshead naming poll from a while ago is clearly shown on a display - Shippy McShipface. You can't say it's all that much worse than some of the names you've heard pirates give their ships before, but it still seems silly that the transport company is actually going through with the name.|7486|0
units.english: As you are walking around the spaceport, you see that more than a few pilots are watching the news on nearby displays. There are mixed emotions amongst the crowd - some pilots are having a good laugh while others seem disappointed or even confused. You aren't sure what this is about until, lo and behold, the result of that Hogshead naming poll from a while ago is clearly shown on a display - Shippy McShipface. You can't say it's all that much worse than some of the names you've heard pirates give their ships before, but it still seems silly that the transport company is actually going through with the name.
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, vedi che più di qualche pilota sta guardando il notiziario sugli schermi vicini. Le emozioni sono contrastanti: alcuni piloti si fanno una bella risata, altri sembrano delusi o persino confusi. Non capisci di che si tratta finché, guarda un po', sullo schermo compare chiaramente il risultato di quel sondaggio sul nome dell'Hogshead di tempo prima: Shippy McShipface. Non puoi dire che sia molto peggio di certi nomi che hai sentito dare dai pirati alle loro navi, ma sembra comunque sciocco che la compagnia di trasporti stia davvero andando fino in fondo con quel nome.

units.id: mission:Hogshead's Dilemma II|	All of the hyped discussions around Hogsheads in the past gave them a brief but strong popularity amongst transport organizations looking to grab the average passenger's attention. In the end, the company responsible for this naming poll got what they wanted, and a little bit of the Hogshead's spirit has been brought back, along with the interest of several pilots. Perhaps the name "Shippy McShipface" is fitting after all.|7487|0
units.english: All of the hyped discussions around Hogsheads in the past gave them a brief but strong popularity amongst transport organizations looking to grab the average passenger's attention. In the end, the company responsible for this naming poll got what they wanted, and a little bit of the Hogshead's spirit has been brought back, along with the interest of several pilots. Perhaps the name "Shippy McShipface" is fitting after all.
units.italian: Tutte le discussioni entusiaste sugli Hogshead del passato avevano dato loro una popolarità breve ma forte fra le organizzazioni di trasporto che cercavano di catturare l'attenzione del passeggero medio. Alla fine la compagnia responsabile di questo sondaggio ha ottenuto quello che voleva, e un po' dello spirito dell'Hogshead è tornato, insieme all'interesse di diversi piloti. Forse il nome "Shippy McShipface" è adatto, dopotutto.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|name|7493|0
units.english: Lost dog to <planet>
units.italian: Cane perduto per <planet>

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|description|7494|0
units.english: Bring Caesar, a dog you found on <origin>, to their owners on <destination>.
units.italian: Porta Caesar, un cane che hai trovato su <origin>, dai suoi padroni su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|Your walk from the <ship> takes you out of <origin>'s bustling spaceport and into the overtly welcoming and carefully inoffensive streets of the spaceport town. Each path seems to be saturated with tourists and purpose-built to whisk travelers further away from their ships and deeper into the preternatural radiance of this Paradise World. The hand-crafted beauty is inescapable, a never-ending sequence of breathtaking views.|7501|0
units.english: Your walk from the <ship> takes you out of <origin>'s bustling spaceport and into the overtly welcoming and carefully inoffensive streets of the spaceport town. Each path seems to be saturated with tourists and purpose-built to whisk travelers further away from their ships and deeper into the preternatural radiance of this Paradise World. The hand-crafted beauty is inescapable, a never-ending sequence of breathtaking views.
units.italian: La tua passeggiata dalla <ship> ti porta fuori dall'affollato spazioporto di <origin> e nelle strade apertamente accoglienti e accuratamente inoffensive della cittadina portuale. Ogni sentiero sembra saturo di turisti e costruito apposta per portare i viaggiatori sempre più lontano dalle navi e più a fondo nel fulgore soprannaturale di questo Mondo Paradisiaco. La bellezza artigianale è ineludibile, una sequenza senza fine di viste mozzafiato.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	As you walk, you eventually come across a perfectly manicured garden park named "Parc Manifold." You approach the gates to discover a ticket office, with signs advertising a free entry promotion this week only, crossing out the 3,400 credit regular admission fee.|7502|0
units.english: As you walk, you eventually come across a perfectly manicured garden park named "Parc Manifold." You approach the gates to discover a ticket office, with signs advertising a free entry promotion this week only, crossing out the 3,400 credit regular admission fee.
units.italian: Mentre cammini, arrivi infine a un giardino perfettamente curato chiamato "Parc Manifold". Ti avvicini ai cancelli e trovi una biglietteria, con cartelli che pubblicizzano una promozione a ingresso gratuito valida solo questa settimana, con il prezzo normale di 3.400 crediti barrato.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Go to the park.)|7504|0
units.english: (Go to the park.)
units.italian: (Vai al parco.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Head back to my ship.)|7506|0
units.english: (Head back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla nave.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	You have more important things to do than wander around an expensive terraformed garden.|7508|0
units.english: You have more important things to do than wander around an expensive terraformed garden.
units.italian: Hai cose più importanti da fare che girare per un costoso giardino terraformato.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	The park has been meticulously sculpted so that no matter where you stand, it appears as though you are in the center of a lush naturalist painting. Colorful, comforting flora bleed away from you at all angles, and adorable yet inaccessible fauna seem to hug the very periphery of your every step.|7512|0
units.english: The park has been meticulously sculpted so that no matter where you stand, it appears as though you are in the center of a lush naturalist painting. Colorful, comforting flora bleed away from you at all angles, and adorable yet inaccessible fauna seem to hug the very periphery of your every step.
units.italian: Il parco è stato scolpito con cura perché, da qualunque parte tu stia, sembri essere al centro di un lussureggiante dipinto naturalista. Flora colorata e rassicurante si irradia via da te in ogni direzione, e una fauna adorabile ma irraggiungibile sembra stringersi ai margini di ogni tuo passo.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	The air is clear and crisp, and even the crunch of leaves and thud of the earth beneath your feet seems somehow delicious and satisfying. Finally, the sun begins to set and you remember from the signs that the park closes soon.|7513|0
units.english: The air is clear and crisp, and even the crunch of leaves and thud of the earth beneath your feet seems somehow delicious and satisfying. Finally, the sun begins to set and you remember from the signs that the park closes soon.
units.italian: L'aria è limpida e frizzante, e persino lo scricchiolio delle foglie e il tonfo della terra sotto i piedi sembrano in qualche modo deliziosi e appaganti. Alla fine il sole comincia a tramontare e ti ricordi dai cartelli che il parco chiude presto.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	As you approach the exit to the park a small dog pads over to you and looks at you with mournful eyes. It seems to be alone, with no owner anywhere in sight.|7514|0
units.english: As you approach the exit to the park a small dog pads over to you and looks at you with mournful eyes. It seems to be alone, with no owner anywhere in sight.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini all'uscita del parco, un cagnolino ti si avvicina piano e ti guarda con occhi lamentosi. Sembra solo, senza nessun padrone in vista.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Call to the dog.)|7516|0
units.english: (Call to the dog.)
units.italian: (Chiama il cane.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Ignore the dog.)|7518|0
units.english: (Ignore the dog.)
units.italian: (Ignala il cane.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	You ignore the dog and eventually it sulks away to interact with another patron of the park. As you return to your ship it begins to get dark, and you feel your day of quiet contemplation come to a close.|7520|0
units.english: You ignore the dog and eventually it sulks away to interact with another patron of the park. As you return to your ship it begins to get dark, and you feel your day of quiet contemplation come to a close.
units.italian: Ignori il cane e alla fine se ne va mogio a interagire con un altro frequentatore del parco. Mentre torni alla nave comincia a fare buio, e senti che la tua giornata di quieta contemplazione volge al termine.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|label|7523|0
units.english: dog lover
units.italian: dog lover

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	"Come here," you call to the dog, which looks to be a poodle mix, and it obediently does as you command. You see that the dog is a male and check his collar:|7524|0
units.english: "Come here," you call to the dog, which looks to be a poodle mix, and it obediently does as you command. You see that the dog is a male and check his collar:
units.italian: "Vieni qui," chiami il cane, che sembra un incrocio con un barbone, e quello obbedisce ubbidiente al tuo comando. Vedi che è un maschio e controlli il collare:

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	"Caesar Augustus - Property of the Mitchells"|7526|0
units.english: "Caesar Augustus - Property of the Mitchells"
units.italian: "Caesar Augustus - Proprietà dei Mitchell"

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	3 Mitchell Drive|7527|0
units.english: 3 Mitchell Drive
units.italian: 3 Mitchell Drive

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	Palmyra City, Avalonia District,|7528|0
units.english: Palmyra City, Avalonia District,
units.italian: Palmyra City, distretto di Avalonia,

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	Glory, Wazn System|7529|0
units.english: Glory, Wazn System
units.italian: Glory, sistema Wazn

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	"That's odd," you say to Caesar. "How did you get lost on the wrong planet, huh boy?"|7531|0
units.english: "That's odd," you say to Caesar. "How did you get lost on the wrong planet, huh boy?"
units.italian: "Che strano," dici a Caesar. "Come ti sei perso sul pianeta sbagliato, eh ragazzo?"

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Take Caesar to his owners on Glory.)|7533|0
units.english: (Take Caesar to his owners on Glory.)
units.italian: (Porta Caesar dai suoi padroni su Glory.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Leave Caesar here.)|7535|0
units.english: (Leave Caesar here.)
units.italian: (Lascia Caesar qui.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	Perhaps his owners are on vacation and will be back looking for him any minute. Although it's getting dark and no one seems to be around, you decide the best course of action is to leave Caesar where you found him.|7539|0
units.english: Perhaps his owners are on vacation and will be back looking for him any minute. Although it's getting dark and no one seems to be around, you decide the best course of action is to leave Caesar where you found him.
units.italian: Forse i suoi padroni sono in vacanza e torneranno a cercarlo da un momento all'altro. Anche se si sta facendo buio e non sembra esserci nessuno in giro, decidi che la cosa migliore è lasciare Caesar dove l'hai trovato.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	As you turn away, Caesar begins to whine, but he soon quiets down when you don't come back to pick him up. Looking back, you notice him slinking off into the shadow of a perfectly manicured shrub.|7540|0
units.english: As you turn away, Caesar begins to whine, but he soon quiets down when you don't come back to pick him up. Looking back, you notice him slinking off into the shadow of a perfectly manicured shrub.
units.italian: Mentre ti volti, Caesar comincia a guaire, ma presto tace quando non torni a prenderlo. Guardandoti indietro, lo vedi allontanarsi nell'ombra di un cespuglio perfettamente curato.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|label|7543|0
units.english: take him
units.italian: take him

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	"Well, come on boy," you say. "Let's go."|7544|0
units.english: "Well, come on boy," you say. "Let's go."
units.italian: "Beh, andiamo ragazzo," dici. "Muoviti."

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	Caesar eagerly follows you back to your ship. He seems greatly relieved to be with you, and not left all alone at the park.|7545|0
units.english: Caesar eagerly follows you back to your ship. He seems greatly relieved to be with you, and not left all alone at the park.
units.italian: Caesar ti segue con entusiasmo fino alla nave. Sembra molto sollevato di essere con te, e non di essere rimasto tutto solo al parco.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	Once back on your ship, you make sure he's fed, watered, and settled in for his interstellar journey.|7546|0
units.english: Once back on your ship, you make sure he's fed, watered, and settled in for his interstellar journey.
units.italian: Una volta sulla nave ti assicuri che mangi, beva e si sistemi per il viaggio interstellare.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|Caesar has been very obedient the whole trip, much to your relief. He lies down by the airlock while your ship sets down in the local Palmyra spaceport, which is enclosed on all sides by a squalid urban landscape - the honeycombed homes of the humble help. You rent a vehicle and take yourself and Caesar beyond the blighted city and out into the pleasant, picture-perfect paradise of the affluent. One princely estate after another rolls past you as you drive deeper into the rural domains of the Republic's super-wealthy. Eventually, you come across a large metal gate that reads, "Mitchell Ranch."|7555|0
units.english: Caesar has been very obedient the whole trip, much to your relief. He lies down by the airlock while your ship sets down in the local Palmyra spaceport, which is enclosed on all sides by a squalid urban landscape - the honeycombed homes of the humble help. You rent a vehicle and take yourself and Caesar beyond the blighted city and out into the pleasant, picture-perfect paradise of the affluent. One princely estate after another rolls past you as you drive deeper into the rural domains of the Republic's super-wealthy. Eventually, you come across a large metal gate that reads, "Mitchell Ranch."
units.italian: Caesar è stato molto obbediente per tutto il viaggio, con tuo grande sollievo. Si sdraia vicino alla camera stagna mentre la nave scende nello spazioporto locale di Palmyra, circondato su ogni lato da un paesaggio urbano squallido: le case a nido d'ape della povera gente che serve i ricchi. Noleggi un veicolo e porti te e Caesar oltre la città degradata, fuori nella piacevole e perfetta oasi dei benestanti. Una tenuta principesca dopo l'altra scorrono accanto a te mentre ti addentri nei domini rurali dei super-ricchi della Repubblica. Alla fine arrivi a un grande cancello di metallo che recita: "Mitchell Ranch".

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|label|7558|0
units.english: transported pookie
units.italian: transported pookie

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|Caesar has been very obedient the whole trip, unlike certain other dogs you've transported in the past. He lays down by the airlock while your ship sets down in the local Palmyra spaceport, which is enclosed on all sides by a squalid urban landscape - the honeycombed homes of the humble help. You rent a vehicle and take yourself and Caesar beyond the blighted city and out into the pleasant picture-perfect paradise of the affluent. One princely estate after another rolls past you as you drive deeper into the rural domains of the Republic's super-wealthy. Eventually, you come across a large metal gate that reads, "Mitchell Ranch."|7559|0
units.english: Caesar has been very obedient the whole trip, unlike certain other dogs you've transported in the past. He lays down by the airlock while your ship sets down in the local Palmyra spaceport, which is enclosed on all sides by a squalid urban landscape - the honeycombed homes of the humble help. You rent a vehicle and take yourself and Caesar beyond the blighted city and out into the pleasant picture-perfect paradise of the affluent. One princely estate after another rolls past you as you drive deeper into the rural domains of the Republic's super-wealthy. Eventually, you come across a large metal gate that reads, "Mitchell Ranch."
units.italian: Caesar è stato molto obbediente per tutto il viaggio, a differenza di certi altri cani che hai trasportato in passato. Si sdraia vicino alla camera stagna mentre la nave scende nello spazioporto locale di Palmyra, circondato su ogni lato da un paesaggio urbano squallido: le case a nido d'ape della povera gente che serve i ricchi. Noleggi un veicolo e porti te e Caesar oltre la città degradata, fuori nella piacevole e perfetta oasi dei benestanti. Una tenuta principesca dopo l'altra scorrono accanto a te mentre ti addentri nei domini rurali dei super-ricchi della Repubblica. Alla fine arrivi a un grande cancello di metallo che recita: "Mitchell Ranch".

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	You spend another forty-five minutes of driving down long winding roads, past various outbuildings, lodges, retreats, guest houses, and hobby barns. At long last, you arrive at the massive central mansion. Waiting at the bottom of stone stairs is a footman who opens the door for you and summons the senior butler.|7562|0
units.english: You spend another forty-five minutes of driving down long winding roads, past various outbuildings, lodges, retreats, guest houses, and hobby barns. At long last, you arrive at the massive central mansion. Waiting at the bottom of stone stairs is a footman who opens the door for you and summons the senior butler.
units.italian: Passi altri quarantacinque minuti di guida lungo strade lunghe e tortuose, oltre varie dépendance, padiglioni, ritiri, case per gli ospiti e fienili per hobby. Alla fine arrivi alla grande villa centrale. In fondo alle scale di pietra aspetta un valletto che ti apre la porta e convoca il maggiordomo anziano.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	The butler arrives and looks you over unhappily. "The lady of the manor is not expecting... guests. Perhaps, you've misread your appointment, or more likely, arrived at the wrong estate."|7563|0
units.english: The butler arrives and looks you over unhappily. "The lady of the manor is not expecting... guests. Perhaps, you've misread your appointment, or more likely, arrived at the wrong estate."
units.italian: Il maggiordomo arriva e ti squadra senza entusiasmo. "La signora della tenuta non aspetta... ospiti. Forse ha letto male il suo appuntamento, o più probabilmente è arrivato alla tenuta sbagliata."

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Show Caesar to the butler and ask to see his owner.)|7565|0
units.english: (Show Caesar to the butler and ask to see his owner.)
units.italian: (Mostra Caesar al maggiordomo e chiedi di vedere il suo padrone.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	The butler's frown deepens as you show Caesar to him.|7567|0
units.english: The butler's frown deepens as you show Caesar to him.
units.italian: Il cipiglio del maggiordomo si fa più profondo quando gli mostri Caesar.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	He sighs and says, "Card, please." He holds out a silver tray and awaits your calling card.|7568|0
units.english: He sighs and says, "Card, please." He holds out a silver tray and awaits your calling card.
units.italian: Sospira e dice: "Il biglietto da visita, prego." Tende un vassoio d'argento e aspetta la tua carta.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Explain that I don't have a calling card.)|7570|0
units.english: (Explain that I don't have a calling card.)
units.italian: (Spiega che non hai un biglietto da visita.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	(Place my card on the tray.)|7572|0
units.english: (Place my card on the tray.)
units.italian: (Metti il mio biglietto sul vassoio.)

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	The butler's eyebrows rise in the slightest hint of surprise when you place your card on the tray. He promptly turns and disappears into the overlarge house. You, Caesar, and the footman all wait for half an hour before a woman arrives at the front entrance, wearing an exceedingly complicated gown.|7576|0
units.english: The butler's eyebrows rise in the slightest hint of surprise when you place your card on the tray. He promptly turns and disappears into the overlarge house. You, Caesar, and the footman all wait for half an hour before a woman arrives at the front entrance, wearing an exceedingly complicated gown.
units.italian: Le sopracciglia del maggiordomo si alzano appena, in un accenno di sorpresa, quando metti il biglietto sul vassoio. Si volta subito e sparisce nella casa enorme. Tu, Caesar e il valletto aspettate mezz'ora prima che una donna arrivi all'ingresso principale, indossando un abito estremamente complicato.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|label|7579|0
units.english: no card
units.italian: no card

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	The butler smiles smugly. "How unfortunate. In that case, I have no choice but to bring you in through the servants' entrance. It's only proper."|7580|0
units.english: The butler smiles smugly. "How unfortunate. In that case, I have no choice but to bring you in through the servants' entrance. It's only proper."
units.italian: Il maggiordomo sorride con sufficienza. "Che sfortuna. In tal caso non ho altra scelta che farla entrare dall'ingresso della servitù. È il minimo."

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	Instead of taking you up the wide stairs to the beautifully inscribed wooden doors, he ushers you around the side to a small plain door. You are left there with the footman to wait.|7581|0
units.english: Instead of taking you up the wide stairs to the beautifully inscribed wooden doors, he ushers you around the side to a small plain door. You are left there with the footman to wait.
units.italian: Invece di portarti su per l'ampia scalinata fino alle porte di legno finemente intagliate, ti accompagna di lato, a una piccola porta semplice. Resti lì con il valletto ad aspettare.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	Three quarters of an hour later, a woman wearing an exceedingly impractical dress arrives.|7582|0
units.english: Three quarters of an hour later, a woman wearing an exceedingly impractical dress arrives.
units.italian: Tre quarti d'ora dopo arriva una donna che indossa un abito estremamente poco pratico.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	"Mr. Boolinbrook says you've brought back my darling See-See?" She looks down her nose at you and waits for your response.|7585|0
units.english: "Mr. Boolinbrook says you've brought back my darling See-See?" She looks down her nose at you and waits for your response.
units.italian: "Il signor Boolinbrook dice che mi ha riportato il mio adorato See-See?" Ti guarda dall'alto in basso e aspetta la tua risposta.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	"Your dog is safe and sound with me."|7587|0
units.english: "Your dog is safe and sound with me."
units.italian: "Il suo cane è sano e salvo con me."

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	"I found Caesar alone, out in a park on Calda."|7588|0
units.english: "I found Caesar alone, out in a park on Calda."
units.italian: "Ho trovato Caesar da solo, in un parco su Calda."

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	"Here he is. You're welcome."|7589|0
units.english: "Here he is. You're welcome."
units.italian: "Eccolo. Prego."

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	Before you can respond, Caesar starts yapping happily and runs up to the lady.|7591|0
units.english: Before you can respond, Caesar starts yapping happily and runs up to the lady.
units.italian: Prima che tu possa rispondere, Caesar comincia ad abbaiare felice e corre dalla signora.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	She snatches up the dog and draws it to her bosom. "Oh my darling See-See! It has been most dreadful waiting for news of you!"|7592|0
units.english: She snatches up the dog and draws it to her bosom. "Oh my darling See-See! It has been most dreadful waiting for news of you!"
units.italian: Lei afferra il cane e se lo stringe al petto. "Oh, mio adorato See-See! È stato tremendo aspettare notizie di te!"

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	After a moment she turns her attention back to you, looking slightly softer than before. "See-See tires of the parks here, and so every Tuesday I send him to Calda for a change of pace. It's good for his constitution, you know. Anyway, the horrid man who normally ferries our dogs on these little excursions had some sort of episode. A stroke, or a heart attack - you get the idea. He had an assistant return the dogs, but in the confusion, they forgot my little See-See. I was sure some gauche tourist would have snatched him up and eaten him by now."|7593|0
units.english: After a moment she turns her attention back to you, looking slightly softer than before. "See-See tires of the parks here, and so every Tuesday I send him to Calda for a change of pace. It's good for his constitution, you know. Anyway, the horrid man who normally ferries our dogs on these little excursions had some sort of episode. A stroke, or a heart attack - you get the idea. He had an assistant return the dogs, but in the confusion, they forgot my little See-See. I was sure some gauche tourist would have snatched him up and eaten him by now."
units.italian: Dopo un momento torna a guardare te, con un'aria leggermente più morbida di prima. "See-See si stanca dei parchi di qui, così ogni martedì lo mando su Calda per cambiare aria. Fa bene alla sua costituzione, sa. Comunque, l'uomo orribile che di solito porta i nostri cani in queste piccole gite ha avuto una specie di crisi. Un ictus, o un infarto, si fa un'idea. Ha fatto riportare i cani da un assistente, ma nella confusione si sono dimenticati del mio piccolo See-See. Ero sicura che qualche turista volgare l'avrebbe preso e mangiato ormai."

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	She turns her attention back to the dog and speaks to him in baby talk. "But, instead, this gallant captain saved you!"|7594|0
units.english: She turns her attention back to the dog and speaks to him in baby talk. "But, instead, this gallant captain saved you!"
units.italian: Torna a dedicarsi al cane e gli parla con la voce da bebè. "Invece questo galante capitano ti ha salvato!"

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	The lady snaps her fingers, and the butler is immediately at her side. "We must make this person whole. I can't be perceived as owing favors to vagabonds. Imagine the talk!"|7595|0
units.english: The lady snaps her fingers, and the butler is immediately at her side. "We must make this person whole. I can't be perceived as owing favors to vagabonds. Imagine the talk!"
units.italian: La signora schiocca le dita, e il maggiordomo è subito al suo fianco. "Dobbiamo risarcire questa persona. Non posso dare l'impressione di dover favori a dei vagabondi. Si immagini le chiacchiere!"

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	The butler quickly procures a credit chip and shows it to her, accepting a curt nod for approval. "I realize that this is probably a fortune to you," she says. "I recommend you find a financial advisor and invest it well."|7596|0
units.english: The butler quickly procures a credit chip and shows it to her, accepting a curt nod for approval. "I realize that this is probably a fortune to you," she says. "I recommend you find a financial advisor and invest it well."
units.italian: Il maggiordomo procura subito un chip di credito e glielo mostra, ricevendo un cenno secco di approvazione. "Mi rendo conto che per lei questa sia probabilmente una fortuna," dice. "Le consiglio di trovare un consulente finanziario e di investirla bene."

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	With that, she turns and leaves; the butler likewise disappears, and you're escorted by the footman back to your vehicle.|7597|0
units.english: With that, she turns and leaves; the butler likewise disappears, and you're escorted by the footman back to your vehicle.
units.italian: Detto questo si volta e se ne va; il maggiordomo sparisce allo stesso modo, e il valletto ti riaccompagna al veicolo.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog|	You look down at the credit chip in your hand and read its value: <payment>.|7598|0
units.english: You look down at the credit chip in your hand and read its value: <payment>.
units.italian: Abbassi lo sguardo sul chip di credito in mano e ne leggi il valore: <payment>.

units.id: mission:Lost Dog: Homeward Bound|As you're walking through the spaceport, your eye is drawn to a marginally familiar figure on a nearby newsfeed. Although you can't make out exactly what it is saying over the din, you are able to gather that Caesar, the little lost dog you ran into on Calda, has become something of a minor celebrity after it managed to get back home to Glory all by itself. The newsfeed scrolls down to show images of the dog skiing, sneaking onto transports, and riding automatic farming equipment.|7613|0
units.english: As you're walking through the spaceport, your eye is drawn to a marginally familiar figure on a nearby newsfeed. Although you can't make out exactly what it is saying over the din, you are able to gather that Caesar, the little lost dog you ran into on Calda, has become something of a minor celebrity after it managed to get back home to Glory all by itself. The newsfeed scrolls down to show images of the dog skiing, sneaking onto transports, and riding automatic farming equipment.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, il tuo occhio è attirato da una figura vagamente familiare su un notiziario vicino. Anche se non riesci a capire bene che cosa dice sopra il brusio, riesci a dedurre che Caesar, il cagnolino perduto che hai incontrato su Calda, è diventato una specie di piccola celebrità dopo essere riuscito a tornare a casa a Glory tutto da solo. Il notiziario scorre verso il basso mostrando immagini del cane che scia, si infila di nascosto sui trasporti e cavalca macchinari agricoli automatici.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	At the bottom of each sign are the directions to get to the exhibition. It appears to be located in a warehouse yard nearby, where the spaceport district borders the city that surrounds it.|7655|0
units.english: At the bottom of each sign are the directions to get to the exhibition. It appears to be located in a warehouse yard nearby, where the spaceport district borders the city that surrounds it.
units.italian: In fondo a ogni cartello ci sono le indicazioni per raggiungere la mostra. Sembra che si trovi in un cortile di magazzini qui vicino, dove il distretto dello spazioporto confina con la città che lo circonda.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	(Check it out.)|7657|0
units.english: (Check it out.)

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	(Not interested.)|7658|0
units.english: (Not interested.)

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	Following the signage, you notice a substantial group of people gathered in front of a large warehouse that stands out amongst the rest of the warehouses in the yard. As you wait in the queue, a young woman lines up behind you with a readily apparent exuberance and asks you, "Just out of curiosity, how much do you know about Hope and its history?"|7661|0
units.english: Following the signage, you notice a substantial group of people gathered in front of a large warehouse that stands out amongst the rest of the warehouses in the yard. As you wait in the queue, a young woman lines up behind you with a readily apparent exuberance and asks you, "Just out of curiosity, how much do you know about Hope and its history?"
units.italian: Seguendo le indicazioni, noti un gruppo consistente di persone radunato davanti a un grande magazzino che spicca fra gli altri del cortile. Mentre aspetti in coda, una giovane donna si mette in fila dietro di te con un'esuberanza ben visibile e ti chiede: "Solo per curiosità, quanto sai di Hope e della sua storia?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Not much at all."|7663|0
units.english: "Not much at all."
units.italian: "Non molto, a dire il vero."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I come from the Dirt Belt, but I really don't know too much about what happened on Hope."|7664|0
units.english: "I come from the Dirt Belt, but I really don't know too much about what happened on Hope."
units.italian: "Vengo dalla Dirt Belt, ma non so granché di quello che è successo su Hope."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I've been there myself and know what happened, but other than that I don't know."|7667|0
units.english: "I've been there myself and know what happened, but other than that I don't know."
units.italian: "Ci sono stato io stesso e so cos'è successo, ma a parte quello non so nulla."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I've been there myself, actually, and met some people affected by it."|7673|0
units.english: "I've been there myself, actually, and met some people affected by it."
units.italian: "Ci sono stato io stesso, in realtà, e ho conosciuto alcune persone coinvolte."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I haven't been there myself, but I know people who have been affected by it."|7682|0
units.english: "I haven't been there myself, but I know people who have been affected by it."
units.italian: "Non ci sono stato di persona, ma conosco gente che ne è stata colpita."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Well then it's a good thing you're seeing Adelita's exhibition on Hope. It's really moving. You'll learn a lot about the tragedy and what Parliament and the Paradise Worlds did to everybody who tried to help," she adds somewhat sullenly. "You know, this was their first work that really got them famous in the interplanetary scene, but they've been forced to close it, so today's their final day. I had to see it one more time before they went."|7687|0
units.english: "Well then it's a good thing you're seeing Adelita's exhibition on Hope. It's really moving. You'll learn a lot about the tragedy and what Parliament and the Paradise Worlds did to everybody who tried to help," she adds somewhat sullenly. "You know, this was their first work that really got them famous in the interplanetary scene, but they've been forced to close it, so today's their final day. I had to see it one more time before they went."
units.italian: "Beh, allora è una fortuna che tu veda la mostra di Adelita su Hope. È davvero commovente. Imparerai molto sulla tragedia e su quello che il Parlamento e i Mondi Paradisiaci hanno fatto a tutti quelli che cercavano di aiutare," aggiunge con una certa amarezza. "Sai, questa è stata la loro prima opera che li ha resi davvero famosi sulla scena interplanetaria, ma sono stati costretti a chiuderla, quindi oggi è il loro ultimo giorno. Dovevo vederla ancora una volta prima che andassero via."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|label|7690|0
units.english: been to hope
units.italian: been to hope

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Oh, wow! It must have been a harrowing experience. Adelita does a powerful job of giving you the whole story, though, and I bet you'll still learn a lot. You might even feel as if you've been transported back there yourself," she says. "You know, this was their first work that really got them famous in the interplanetary scene, but they've been forced to close it and today's their final day. I had to see it one more time before they went."|7691|0
units.english: "Oh, wow! It must have been a harrowing experience. Adelita does a powerful job of giving you the whole story, though, and I bet you'll still learn a lot. You might even feel as if you've been transported back there yourself," she says. "You know, this was their first work that really got them famous in the interplanetary scene, but they've been forced to close it and today's their final day. I had to see it one more time before they went."
units.italian: "Oh, wow! Dev'essere stata un'esperienza angosciante. Adelita però fa un lavoro potente nel raccontarti tutta la storia, e scommetto che imparerai comunque molto. Potresti persino sentirti come se fossi stato riportato là," dice. "Sai, questa è stata la loro prima opera che li ha resi davvero famosi sulla scena interplanetaria, ma sono stati costretti a chiuderla e oggi è il loro ultimo giorno. Dovevo vederla ancora una volta prima che andassero via."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Who's Adelita?"|7695|0
units.english: "Who's Adelita?"
units.italian: "Chi è Adelita?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Why did they have to close it?"|7696|0
units.english: "Why did they have to close it?"
units.italian: "Perché hanno dovuto chiuderla?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"They're an independent journalistic collective all about the injustices of human civilization. No one knows who they really are, but Adelita's work is what inspired me to study journalism. Their use of mixed media, their eye for story telling... I just love it. I know you're going to love it too," she says.|7699|0
units.english: "They're an independent journalistic collective all about the injustices of human civilization. No one knows who they really are, but Adelita's work is what inspired me to study journalism. Their use of mixed media, their eye for story telling... I just love it. I know you're going to love it too," she says.
units.italian: "Sono un collettivo giornalistico indipendente che si occupa delle ingiustizie della civiltà umana. Nessuno sa chi siano davvero, ma è il lavoro di Adelita che mi ha ispirato a studiare giornalismo. L'uso dei media misti, l'occhio per la narrazione... lo adoro. So che lo adorerai anche tu," dice.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Well, this exhibition used to be permanent, but the planetary government was pressured by the Paradise Planets to force Adelita to leave. What Parliament and the Paradise Planets did to the people of Hope was abhorrent. Now Adelita's bringing light to it, and they're being silenced. It's wrong."|7703|0
units.english: "Well, this exhibition used to be permanent, but the planetary government was pressured by the Paradise Planets to force Adelita to leave. What Parliament and the Paradise Planets did to the people of Hope was abhorrent. Now Adelita's bringing light to it, and they're being silenced. It's wrong."
units.italian: "Beh, questa mostra una volta era permanente, ma il governo planetario è stato messo sotto pressione dai Pianeti Paradisiaci per costringere Adelita ad andarsene. Quello che il Parlamento e i Pianeti Paradisiaci hanno fatto alla gente di Hope è stato abominevole. Ora Adelita lo porta alla luce, e viene messa a tacere. È sbagliato."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	You reach the entrance to the exhibition soon enough. Inside is a large room filled with photos, videos, interviews, and other mixed media. They focus on three groups: the refugees of Hope, the Navy that saved them, and the Paradise Worlds that protested the evacuation. At one end of the warehouse, there is an installation with nearly a hundred original protest signs from rallies against the Dirt Belt and the Republic Navy; some of them are quite crude and tasteless. It's a strong rebuke to see those displayed here, so close to the Paradise Planets.|7706|0
units.english: You reach the entrance to the exhibition soon enough. Inside is a large room filled with photos, videos, interviews, and other mixed media. They focus on three groups: the refugees of Hope, the Navy that saved them, and the Paradise Worlds that protested the evacuation. At one end of the warehouse, there is an installation with nearly a hundred original protest signs from rallies against the Dirt Belt and the Republic Navy; some of them are quite crude and tasteless. It's a strong rebuke to see those displayed here, so close to the Paradise Planets.
units.italian: Arrivi presto all'ingresso della mostra. Dentro c'è una grande sala piena di foto, video, interviste e altri media misti. Si concentrano su tre gruppi: i profughi di Hope, la Marina che li ha salvati e i Mondi Paradisiaci che hanno protestato contro l'evacuazione. A un'estremità del magazzino c'è un'installazione con quasi cento cartelli originali delle manifestazioni contro la Dirt Belt e la Marina della Repubblica; alcuni sono piuttosto volgari e di cattivo gusto. Vederli esposti qui, così vicino ai Pianeti Paradisiaci, è un forte rimbrotto.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	There are many, many photos, but one in particular catches your eye. It's of a woman standing in line to board a ship, a baby held at her hip and a look of sadness and determination on her face. The mother and child's cheeks, rosy and chapped, stand out in contrast with the cold blues in the background.|7707|0
units.english: There are many, many photos, but one in particular catches your eye. It's of a woman standing in line to board a ship, a baby held at her hip and a look of sadness and determination on her face. The mother and child's cheeks, rosy and chapped, stand out in contrast with the cold blues in the background.
units.italian: Ci sono moltissime foto, ma una in particolare cattura la tua attenzione. È di una donna in fila per salire su una nave, con un bambino tenuto al fianco e un'espressione di tristezza e determinazione sul viso. Le guance della madre e del bambino, rosee e screpolate, spiccano in contrasto con i blu freddi dello sfondo.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	You head toward the exit, but as the automatic doors open, an arctic blast pummels into you from out of nowhere. Instead of <origin>'s spaceport, you find yourself in a life-sized 3D representation of the evacuation of Hope, complete with simulated climate effects and a projected horizon. There are huge Navy Cruisers and Auxiliaries in a snowy field near a small town gradually being covered by ash as hundreds of refugees slowly board. But what stands out most is the massive volcano erupting in the background.|7708|0
units.english: You head toward the exit, but as the automatic doors open, an arctic blast pummels into you from out of nowhere. Instead of <origin>'s spaceport, you find yourself in a life-sized 3D representation of the evacuation of Hope, complete with simulated climate effects and a projected horizon. There are huge Navy Cruisers and Auxiliaries in a snowy field near a small town gradually being covered by ash as hundreds of refugees slowly board. But what stands out most is the massive volcano erupting in the background.
units.italian: Ti dirigi verso l'uscita, ma appena le porte automatiche si aprono un soffio artico ti investe dal nulla. Invece dello spazioporto di <origin>, ti ritrovi in una rappresentazione 3D a grandezza naturale dell'evacuazione di Hope, completa di effetti climatici simulati e di un orizzonte proiettato. Ci sono enormi incrociatori e ausiliarie della Marina in un campo innevato vicino a una piccola città che viene gradualmente coperta dalla cenere mentre centinaia di profughi salgono lentamente a bordo. Ma quello che spicca di più è il gigantesco vulcano che erutta sullo sfondo.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"It's more of a collage than an exact rendering," says the young woman you met in line, having followed you all this way. "They took 3D recordings from different moments and areas of Hope and edited them together in various loops. The volcano was actually on the other side of the planet, for example. The magic of editing. What do you think?"|7709|0
units.english: "It's more of a collage than an exact rendering," says the young woman you met in line, having followed you all this way. "They took 3D recordings from different moments and areas of Hope and edited them together in various loops. The volcano was actually on the other side of the planet, for example. The magic of editing. What do you think?"
units.italian: "È più un collage che una riproduzione esatta," dice la giovane donna conosciuta in fila, che ti ha seguito fin qui. "Hanno preso registrazioni 3D da momenti e zone diverse di Hope e le hanno montate insieme in vari loop. Il vulcano, per esempio, era in realtà dall'altra parte del pianeta. La magia del montaggio. Che ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Impressive."|7711|0
units.english: "Impressive."
units.italian: "Impressionante."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"It's alright."|7712|0
units.english: "It's alright."
units.italian: "Non male."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Isn't that a bit deceptive?"|7713|0
units.english: "Isn't that a bit deceptive?"
units.italian: "Non è un po' ingannevole?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I've been here ten times and I always manage to be awestruck," the woman replies. "Enjoy the exhibition while you still can!" She heads for the exit.|7716|0
units.english: "I've been here ten times and I always manage to be awestruck," the woman replies. "Enjoy the exhibition while you still can!" She heads for the exit.
units.italian: "Sono venuta qui dieci volte e riesco sempre a restare a bocca aperta," risponde la donna. "Goditi la mostra finché puoi!" Si dirige verso l'uscita.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	(Continue wandering around the exhibit.)|7718|0
units.english: (Continue wandering around the exhibit.)
units.italian: (Continua a girare per la mostra.)

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	(Go to the exit.)|7720|0
units.english: (Go to the exit.)
units.italian: (Vai all'uscita.)

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Deceptive?! No," the woman responds in a ruffled manner. "If you call this deception you must have a distaste for the media," she chuckles. "This form of journalism is as authentic as journalism gets! Now, of course Adelita takes creative liberties, but it's all in the pursuit of education and justice.|7724|0
units.english: "Deceptive?! No," the woman responds in a ruffled manner. "If you call this deception you must have a distaste for the media," she chuckles. "This form of journalism is as authentic as journalism gets! Now, of course Adelita takes creative liberties, but it's all in the pursuit of education and justice.
units.italian: "Ingannevole?! No," risponde la donna, un po' stizzita. "Se chiami questo inganno, devi avere in antipatia i media," ridacchia. "Questa forma di giornalismo è autentica quanto il giornalismo possa esserlo! Certo, Adelita si prende qualche libertà creativa, ma è tutto in nome dell'educazione e della giustizia.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Well, for what it's worth, I've been here ten times and I always manage to be awestruck," the woman says. "Enjoy the exhibition while you still can." She heads for the exit.|7725|0
units.english: "Well, for what it's worth, I've been here ten times and I always manage to be awestruck," the woman says. "Enjoy the exhibition while you still can." She heads for the exit.
units.italian: "Beh, per quel che vale, sono venuta qui dieci volte e riesco sempre a restare a bocca aperta," dice la donna. "Goditi la mostra finché puoi." Si dirige verso l'uscita.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	(Continue wandering around the exhibit.)|7727|0
units.english: (Continue wandering around the exhibit.)
units.italian: (Continua a girare per la mostra.)

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	(Go to the exit.)|7728|0
units.english: (Go to the exit.)
units.italian: (Vai all'uscita.)

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	Inside houses, you see families frantically gathering their belongings and running for the Navy ships. You walk down one of the lines of refugees, observing each person - their faces harried, frightened, resolute. From the corner of your eye, you notice that a Navy officer slips in the snow, and as you look around, a young man helps him up. Wandering around the exhibit gives you a sense of the desperation of the people as they evacuate, though it's a bit disconcerting when the occasional hologram walks through you.|7735|0
units.english: Inside houses, you see families frantically gathering their belongings and running for the Navy ships. You walk down one of the lines of refugees, observing each person - their faces harried, frightened, resolute. From the corner of your eye, you notice that a Navy officer slips in the snow, and as you look around, a young man helps him up. Wandering around the exhibit gives you a sense of the desperation of the people as they evacuate, though it's a bit disconcerting when the occasional hologram walks through you.
units.italian: Dentro le case vedi famiglie che raccolgono freneticamente le loro cose e corrono verso le navi della Marina. Cammini lungo una delle file di profughi, osservando ognuno: i volti affannati, spaventati, risoluti. Con la coda dell'occhio noti un ufficiale della Marina che scivola nella neve, e guardandoti intorno vedi un giovane che lo aiuta a rialzarsi. Girare per la mostra ti dà il senso della disperazione della gente mentre evacua, anche se è un po' inquietante quando ogni tanto un ologramma ti attraversa.

units.italian: move on

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	As you move on, you're startled to find yourself face-to-face with the woman holding the baby, right where they were in the photo. She takes little steps toward the ship while bouncing the baby on her hip. A young woman with a camera and a respirator covering her face walks up to her, asks a question, and begins to take photos.|7742|0
units.english: As you move on, you're startled to find yourself face-to-face with the woman holding the baby, right where they were in the photo. She takes little steps toward the ship while bouncing the baby on her hip. A young woman with a camera and a respirator covering her face walks up to her, asks a question, and begins to take photos.
units.italian: Mentre prosegui, sussulti nel trovarti faccia a faccia con la donna che tiene il bambino, proprio dove erano nella foto. Fa piccoli passi verso la nave mentre dondola il bambino sul fianco. Una giovane con una telecamera e un respiratore che le copre il viso le si avvicina, le fa una domanda e comincia a scattare foto.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	Suddenly, the entire projection disappears in a disorienting flash, leaving you in a cordoned-off section of the warehouse. The exhibit is nearly empty as a woman walks up to you. "One of the authors loves that moment too. That's probably why she fought so hard to have that part left in." She mutters something about a "security risk" under her breath, and then turns her attention back to you.|7743|0
units.english: Suddenly, the entire projection disappears in a disorienting flash, leaving you in a cordoned-off section of the warehouse. The exhibit is nearly empty as a woman walks up to you. "One of the authors loves that moment too. That's probably why she fought so hard to have that part left in." She mutters something about a "security risk" under her breath, and then turns her attention back to you.
