units.italian: All'improvviso l'intera proiezione sparisce in un lampo disorientante, lasciandoti in una sezione transennata del magazzino. La mostra è quasi vuota quando una donna ti si avvicina. "Anche a una delle autrici piace molto quel momento. Probabilmente è per questo che ha lottato tanto perché quella parte restasse." Borbotta qualcosa su un "rischio per la sicurezza" fra i denti, poi torna a dedicarti la sua attenzione.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Oh, how rude of me," she says, offering her hand. "My name is Mariel. I organize these exhibitions and act as a spokesperson for Adelita. And you are?"|7744|0
units.english: "Oh, how rude of me," she says, offering her hand. "My name is Mariel. I organize these exhibitions and act as a spokesperson for Adelita. And you are?"
units.italian: "Oh, che scortese che sono," dice, porgendoti la mano. "Mi chiamo Mariel. Organizzo queste mostre e faccio da portavoce per Adelita. E lei è?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I'm <first> <last>."|7746|0
units.english: "I'm <first> <last>."
units.italian: "Sono <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I'm Captain <last>."|7748|0
units.english: "I'm Captain <last>."
units.italian: "Sono il Capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Captain," she says, her eyes lighting up. "Well, as you may know, this is the last day of the exhibition. The captain I hired to transport everything back to <planet> is not only rude, but is now late. I would much rather have it in the hands of someone who appreciates the work. I was going to pay him 60,000 credits, but I'll pay you <payment> to take his contract instead given the short notice. What do you say?"|7750|0
units.english: "Captain," she says, her eyes lighting up. "Well, as you may know, this is the last day of the exhibition. The captain I hired to transport everything back to <planet> is not only rude, but is now late. I would much rather have it in the hands of someone who appreciates the work. I was going to pay him 60,000 credits, but I'll pay you <payment> to take his contract instead given the short notice. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Capitano," dice, con gli occhi che le si illuminano. "Beh, come forse saprà, oggi è l'ultimo giorno della mostra. Il capitano che ho assunto per riportare tutto su <planet> non solo è sgarbato, ma ora è anche in ritardo. Preferirei di gran lunga affidarlo a qualcuno che apprezza il lavoro. Gli avrei pagato 60.000 crediti, ma pagherò lei <payment> per prendere il suo contratto, visto il poco preavviso. Che ne dice?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Right," she says. "Hey, would you happen to know any ships which can take on <tons> of this exhibition's equipment to <destination>? As you may know, this is the last day of the exhibition. The captain I hired to transport everything is not only rude, but is now late, and I need someone to take his contract on short notice."|7754|0
units.english: "Right," she says. "Hey, would you happen to know any ships which can take on <tons> of this exhibition's equipment to <destination>? As you may know, this is the last day of the exhibition. The captain I hired to transport everything is not only rude, but is now late, and I need someone to take his contract on short notice."
units.italian: "Giusto," dice. "Ehi, per caso conosce qualche nave che possa portare <tons> di attrezzatura di questa mostra su <destination>? Come forse saprà, oggi è l'ultimo giorno della mostra. Il capitano che ho assunto per il trasporto non solo è sgarbato, ma ora è anche in ritardo, e mi serve qualcuno che prenda il suo contratto con poco preavviso."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Well, I'm the captain of the <ship>."|7756|0
units.english: "Well, I'm the captain of the <ship>."
units.italian: "Beh, sono il capitano della <ship>."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Sorry, I can't help you."|7757|0
units.english: "Sorry, I can't help you."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non posso aiutarla."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	Mariel's eyes light up. "Great! I was going to pay him 60,000 credits, but I'll pay you <payment> to take his contract instead. What do you say?"|7760|0
units.english: Mariel's eyes light up. "Great! I was going to pay him 60,000 credits, but I'll pay you <payment> to take his contract instead. What do you say?"
units.italian: Gli occhi di Mariel si illuminano. "Ottimo! Gli avrei pagato 60.000 crediti, ma pagherò lei <payment> per prendere il suo contratto. Che ne dice?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I would love to."|7764|0
units.english: "I would love to."
units.italian: "Mi piacerebbe molto."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I've got more pressing matters at hand."|7766|0
units.english: "I've got more pressing matters at hand."
units.italian: "Ho cose più urgenti da fare."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Oh. I thought that would be a pretty good deal for you, especially given the chance to meet the artists. But it's your call."|7768|0
units.english: "Oh. I thought that would be a pretty good deal for you, especially given the chance to meet the artists. But it's your call."
units.italian: "Oh. Pensavo sarebbe stato un buon affare per lei, soprattutto con la possibilità di conoscere gli artisti. Ma decide lei."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Okay, I'll do it."|7770|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"I'm sorry, I can't take the job."|7771|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, I can't take the job."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non posso prendere l'incarico."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"Great!" Mariel says. "I will have our crew get everything ready to load at your ship promptly."|7775|0
units.english: "Great!" Mariel says. "I will have our crew get everything ready to load at your ship promptly."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice Mariel. "Faccio preparare subito tutto alla nostra squadra perché sia caricato sulla sua nave."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	After a couple hours, the whole exhibition is packed up and ready for transport to <planet>.|7776|0
units.english: After a couple hours, the whole exhibition is packed up and ready for transport to <planet>.
units.italian: Dopo un paio d'ore l'intera mostra è imballata e pronta per il trasporto su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	"That's unfortunate. I'll have to find someone else, then." Mariel glances at her watch. "Well, anyway, the exhibition has closed. I'm going to have to ask you to leave."|7780|0
units.english: "That's unfortunate. I'll have to find someone else, then." Mariel glances at her watch. "Well, anyway, the exhibition has closed. I'm going to have to ask you to leave."
units.italian: "Che peccato. Dovrò trovare qualcun altro, allora." Mariel dà un'occhiata all'orologio. "Beh, comunque, la mostra è chiusa. Devo chiederle di andare."

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	Following her, you find the true exit of the warehouse and go back out onto the more familiar grounds of <origin>'s spaceport.|7784|0
units.english: Following her, you find the true exit of the warehouse and go back out onto the more familiar grounds of <origin>'s spaceport.
units.italian: Seguendola, trovi la vera uscita del magazzino e torni fuori sul terreno più familiare dello spazioporto di <origin>.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|dialog|7788|0
units.english: You arrive on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the exhibition installations has not arrived yet. Better depart and wait for your escorts to enter the system.
units.italian: Arrivi su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con il carico delle installazioni della mostra non è ancora arrivata. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le tue scorte entrino nel sistema.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|log|7791|0
units.english: Saw an impressive exhibition on the Evacuation of Hope and ended up with a job taking the whole thing to Moonshake.
units.italian: Ho visto una mostra impressionante sull'evacuazione di Hope e mi sono ritrovato con un incarico per portarla tutta a Moonshake.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|After navigating the thick fog of Moonshake's atmosphere, you find a motley crew waiting on your landing pad. After they're done taking Adelita's cargo away, one of the crew walks up to you and hands you a credit chip for <payment> and a note. It reads:|7795|0
units.english: After navigating the thick fog of Moonshake's atmosphere, you find a motley crew waiting on your landing pad. After they're done taking Adelita's cargo away, one of the crew walks up to you and hands you a credit chip for <payment> and a note. It reads:
units.italian: Dopo aver attraversato la fitta nebbia dell'atmosfera di Moonshake, trovi una squadra eterogenea ad aspettarti sulla piazzola. Quando hanno finito di portare via il carico di Adelita, uno della squadra ti si avvicina e ti mette in mano un chip di credito da <payment> e un biglietto. Dice:

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|	Meet me at the Common Grounds Cafe in the spaceport if you're interested in assisting us with a new project. Make sure you're not followed.|7797|0
units.english: Meet me at the Common Grounds Cafe in the spaceport if you're interested in assisting us with a new project. Make sure you're not followed.
units.italian: Ci vediamo al Common Grounds Cafe, nello spazioporto, se ti interessa aiutarci con un nuovo progetto. Assicurati di non essere seguito.

units.id: mission:Adelita 1|		-Adelita Zero|7798|0
units.english: -Adelita Zero
units.italian: -Adelita Zero

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|name|7805|0
units.english: Film Syndicate sweatshop on <planet>
units.italian: Filmare una fabbrica di sfruttamento del Sindacato su <planet>

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|description|7806|0
units.english: Participate in an unauthorized filming of a Syndicate sweatshop on <destination>. You will be paid <payment> after you complete the entire job.
units.italian: Partecipa a una ripresa non autorizzata di una fabbrica di sfruttamento del Sindacato su <destination>. Ti saranno pagati <payment> al completamento dell'intero incarico.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|It takes a while to navigate through the bustling spaceport and the almost viscous fog of <origin>. After finding an information screen, you're able to get to the Common Grounds Cafe, which has a funky vibe to it and is quite busy. Nobody seems to recognize you, so you take a seat at a booth and order something to eat.|7818|0
units.english: It takes a while to navigate through the bustling spaceport and the almost viscous fog of <origin>. After finding an information screen, you're able to get to the Common Grounds Cafe, which has a funky vibe to it and is quite busy. Nobody seems to recognize you, so you take a seat at a booth and order something to eat.
units.italian: Ci vuole un po' per orientarti fra lo spazioporto affollato e la nebbia quasi viscosa di <origin>. Dopo aver trovato uno schermo informativo, riesci ad arrivare al Common Grounds Cafe, che ha un'atmosfera originale ed è piuttosto pieno. Nessuno sembra riconoscerti, così ti siedi in un separé e ordini qualcosa da mangiare.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	Before your meal arrives, however, a woman with dark hair, maybe in her late thirties, sits down across from you and hails the server. She cheerfully orders a smoothie with a long list of ingredients, many of which you have neither heard of nor can pronounce.|7819|0
units.english: Before your meal arrives, however, a woman with dark hair, maybe in her late thirties, sits down across from you and hails the server. She cheerfully orders a smoothie with a long list of ingredients, many of which you have neither heard of nor can pronounce.
units.italian: Prima che arrivi il tuo pasto, però, una donna dai capelli scuri, forse sulla tarda trentina, si siede di fronte a te e chiama il cameriere. Ordina allegramente un frullato con una lunga lista di ingredienti, molti dei quali non hai mai sentito né sai pronunciare.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Sorry for the cloak and dagger bit," the woman says to you finally. "We have enemies in high places. So Captain <last>, what did you think of the exhibition?"|7820|0
units.english: "Sorry for the cloak and dagger bit," the woman says to you finally. "We have enemies in high places. So Captain <last>, what did you think of the exhibition?"
units.italian: "Scusa per la parte da cappa e spada," dice infine la donna. "Abbiamo nemici in alto loco. Allora, Capitano <last>, che cosa hai pensato della mostra?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"I found it quite moving."|7822|0
units.english: "I found it quite moving."
units.italian: "L'ho trovata molto commovente."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"It was okay."|7823|0
units.english: "It was okay."
units.italian: "Non era male."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"It was too political for me."|7825|0
units.english: "It was too political for me."
units.italian: "Per me era troppo politica."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"I'm glad you liked it," she says, smiling.|7828|0
units.english: "I'm glad you liked it," she says, smiling.
units.italian: "Sono contenta che ti sia piaciuta," dice, sorridendo.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Not exactly a rave review, but you're entitled to your opinion," she says, smiling.|7832|0
units.english: "Not exactly a rave review, but you're entitled to your opinion," she says, smiling.
units.italian: "Non è esattamente una recensione entusiasta, ma hai diritto alla tua opinione," dice, sorridendo.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Oh. Unfortunately for many, everything is political. It was political when the Paradise Worlds tried to block the evacuation. And it was political when the Navy did it anyway without the permission of Parliament. And the same goes for every single act of oppression and liberation since the dawn of humanity. Our oppressors are very political. Maybe you have the hope of being one someday: wealthy, authoritarian, exploitative. Or maybe you just don't care. Either way, you don't sound like a good fit for this project. But thanks for transporting the installations," she says with a smile. She gets her smoothie to-go and walks out.|7836|0
units.english: "Oh. Unfortunately for many, everything is political. It was political when the Paradise Worlds tried to block the evacuation. And it was political when the Navy did it anyway without the permission of Parliament. And the same goes for every single act of oppression and liberation since the dawn of humanity. Our oppressors are very political. Maybe you have the hope of being one someday: wealthy, authoritarian, exploitative. Or maybe you just don't care. Either way, you don't sound like a good fit for this project. But thanks for transporting the installations," she says with a smile. She gets her smoothie to-go and walks out.
units.italian: "Oh. Purtroppo per molti, tutto è politico. È stato politico quando i Mondi Paradisiaci hanno cercato di bloccare l'evacuazione. Ed è stato politico quando la Marina l'ha fatta comunque senza il permesso del Parlamento. E lo stesso vale per ogni singolo atto di oppressione e di liberazione dall'alba dell'umanità. I nostri oppressori sono molto politici. Forse hai la speranza di diventarlo anche tu un giorno: ricco, autoritario, sfruttatore. O forse semplicemente non ti importa. In ogni caso, non mi sembri adatto a questo progetto. Ma grazie per aver trasportato le installazioni," dice con un sorriso. Prende il suo frullato da asporto ed esce.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"I heard from Mariel that you saw me take the photos of the woman and her baby," she says. "I really liked that moment, but not many notice it." She takes a quick glance around before leaning in closer. "We need a captain to transport a team to one planet, quickly land on another, and then pick up the team and return here with everyone safe and sound. I can't tell you much more than that until you accept, but it's nothing too dicey. It's a dangerous universe, though, so who knows?" She looks at you expectantly.|7840|0
units.english: "I heard from Mariel that you saw me take the photos of the woman and her baby," she says. "I really liked that moment, but not many notice it." She takes a quick glance around before leaning in closer. "We need a captain to transport a team to one planet, quickly land on another, and then pick up the team and return here with everyone safe and sound. I can't tell you much more than that until you accept, but it's nothing too dicey. It's a dangerous universe, though, so who knows?" She looks at you expectantly.
units.italian: "Ho saputo da Mariel che mi hai visto fare le foto alla donna con il bambino," dice. "Quel momento mi piaceva molto, ma pochi lo notano." Dà una rapida occhiata intorno prima di avvicinarsi di più. "Ci serve un capitano per portare una squadra su un pianeta, atterrare rapidamente su un altro, e poi riprendere la squadra e tornare qui con tutti sani e salvi. Non posso dirti molto di più finché non accetti, ma non è niente di troppo rischioso. Però è un universo pericoloso, quindi chi lo sa?" Ti guarda in attesa.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Oh, and we have to leave today. It will pay, of course. <payment>. So, what do you say? Are you in or out?" When she finishes speaking, your order is served while she drinks her smoothie.|7841|0
units.english: "Oh, and we have to leave today. It will pay, of course. <payment>. So, what do you say? Are you in or out?" When she finishes speaking, your order is served while she drinks her smoothie.
units.italian: "Oh, e dobbiamo partire oggi. Sarà pagato, naturalmente. <payment>. Allora, che ne dici? Ci stai o no?" Quando finisce di parlare arriva la tua ordinazione, mentre lei beve il suo frullato.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"In."|7843|0
units.english: "In."
units.italian: "Dentro."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Out."|7844|0
units.english: "Out."
units.italian: "Fuori."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Great. My name is Alejandra, but call me Ale. Here's the plan: you're going to drop me and a friend off at <planet>, where we'll film the conditions in a secret Syndicate sweatshop.|7847|0
units.english: "Great. My name is Alejandra, but call me Ale. Here's the plan: you're going to drop me and a friend off at <planet>, where we'll film the conditions in a secret Syndicate sweatshop.
units.italian: "Ottimo. Mi chiamo Alejandra, ma chiamami Ale. Ecco il piano: tu lasci me e un'amica su <planet>, dove filmeremo le condizioni in una fabbrica di sfruttamento segreta del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Thing is, these aren't just poorly paid factory workers. They're slaves. As you can imagine, we can't get in as regular workers, so with a bit of hacking, we got ourselves jobs on-site as private security. We know that one of the Syndicate's 'trusted contractors' is getting the slaves from the pirates on Covert, and we also know where they're doing the transaction.|7848|0
units.english: "Thing is, these aren't just poorly paid factory workers. They're slaves. As you can imagine, we can't get in as regular workers, so with a bit of hacking, we got ourselves jobs on-site as private security. We know that one of the Syndicate's 'trusted contractors' is getting the slaves from the pirates on Covert, and we also know where they're doing the transaction.
units.italian: "Il fatto è che non sono semplici operai sottopagati. Sono schiavi. Come puoi immaginare, non possiamo entrare come operai normali, così con un po' di hacking ci siamo procurati dei posti sul posto come sicurezza privata. Sappiamo che uno dei 'fornitori fidati' del Sindacato prende gli schiavi dai pirati su Covert, e sappiamo anche dove fanno la transazione.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"So while we get the footage we need in the factories, you'll be going with my associate, Bunker, to spy on the Syndicate's rendezvous with the pirates on Hippocrates."|7849|0
units.english: "So while we get the footage we need in the factories, you'll be going with my associate, Bunker, to spy on the Syndicate's rendezvous with the pirates on Hippocrates."
units.italian: "Quindi, mentre noi giriamo il materiale che ci serve nelle fabbriche, tu andrai con il mio socio Bunker a spiare l'incontro del Sindacato con i pirati su Hippocrates."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Hold on, pirates?"|7851|0
units.english: "Hold on, pirates?"
units.italian: "Un momento, pirati?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Won't this get me in trouble with the Syndicate?"|7852|0
units.english: "Won't this get me in trouble with the Syndicate?"
units.italian: "Questo non mi metterà nei guai con il Sindacato?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Don't worry, Bunker is a pro, and we have an array of long-range stealth drones that do the spying. You won't be anywhere near them. You might encounter some lone pirates on the way though, so you'll need to be quick."|7855|0
units.english: "Don't worry, Bunker is a pro, and we have an array of long-range stealth drones that do the spying. You won't be anywhere near them. You might encounter some lone pirates on the way though, so you'll need to be quick."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, Bunker è un professionista, e abbiamo una serie di droni stealth a lungo raggio che fanno le spie. Non sarai da nessuna parte vicino a loro. Potresti però incontrare qualche pirata solitario lungo la strada, quindi dovrai essere rapido."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Well, I did say we had enemies in high places, didn't I? But don't worry. Bunker's a pro. We have an array of long-range stealth drones that do the spying. You won't be anywhere near them, though pirates do frequent the system, so you'll need to be quick."|7859|0
units.english: "Well, I did say we had enemies in high places, didn't I? But don't worry. Bunker's a pro. We have an array of long-range stealth drones that do the spying. You won't be anywhere near them, though pirates do frequent the system, so you'll need to be quick."
units.italian: "Beh, avevo detto che abbiamo nemici in alto loco, no? Ma non preoccuparti. Bunker è un professionista. Abbiamo una serie di droni stealth a lungo raggio che fanno le spie. Non sarai da nessuna parte vicino a loro, però i pirati frequentano il sistema, quindi dovrai essere rapido."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Got it."|7863|0
units.english: "Got it."
units.italian: "Capito."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Sorry, I don't like the sound of this."|7864|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't like the sound of this."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non mi piace come suona."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	She waves to the server for the bill as she finishes the last gulp of her smoothie. "Let's go. Everyone will be meeting at the landing pad shortly."|7867|0
units.english: She waves to the server for the bill as she finishes the last gulp of her smoothie. "Let's go. Everyone will be meeting at the landing pad shortly."
units.italian: Fa un cenno al cameriere per il conto mentre finisce l'ultimo sorso di frullato. "Andiamo. Si ritrovano tutti alla piazzola fra poco."

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	You go back to the <ship>'s landing pad, and sure enough, there are two people with backpacks and a few cases waiting for you. They introduce themselves as River and Bunker, and they enthusiastically stow their equipment away without a hitch.|7868|0
units.english: You go back to the <ship>'s landing pad, and sure enough, there are two people with backpacks and a few cases waiting for you. They introduce themselves as River and Bunker, and they enthusiastically stow their equipment away without a hitch.
units.italian: Torni alla piazzola della <ship> e, come previsto, ci sono due persone con zaini e alcune valigie ad aspettarti. Si presentano come River e Bunker, e sistemano con entusiasmo la loro attrezzatura senza intoppi.

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"Good. Now that that's done with, let's load up," says Bunker, before letting out a holler. "Taking down the Man. I love it!"|7869|0
units.english: "Good. Now that that's done with, let's load up," says Bunker, before letting out a holler. "Taking down the Man. I love it!"
units.italian: "Bene. Ora che è fatto, carichiamo," dice Bunker, prima di lasciarsi andare a un urlo. "Buttare giù il Sistema. Adoro!"

units.id: mission:Adelita 2|	"I'm sorry to hear that... I suppose it just wasn't meant to be." She gulps down her smoothie at lightning speed before leaving just as quickly.|7873|0
units.english: "I'm sorry to hear that... I suppose it just wasn't meant to be." She gulps down her smoothie at lightning speed before leaving just as quickly.
units.italian: "Mi dispiace sentirlo... suppongo che non fosse destino." Butta giù il frullato alla velocità della luce prima di andarsene altrettanto in fretta.

units.id: mission:Adelita 3|name|7882|0
units.english: Film slave transaction
units.italian: Filmare la transazione di schiavi

units.id: mission:Adelita 3|description|7883|0
units.english: Do a flyby of <destination> while Bunker spies on the slave transaction. You will be paid <payment> after you complete the entire job.
units.italian: Sorvola <destination> mentre Bunker spia la transazione di schiavi. Ti saranno pagati <payment> al completamento dell'intero incarico.

units.id: mission:Adelita 3|You drop off Ale and River at the spaceport, watching as they try to seem neither visibly embarrassed to be in their security uniforms nor uncomfortable with their disguises, even though they're now virtually indistinguishable from other Syndicate personnel. Bunker can't stop laughing at them. Everyone wishes each other luck as the two walk off, and you and Bunker go back to the <ship> and prepare for the journey to <planet>.|7895|0
units.english: You drop off Ale and River at the spaceport, watching as they try to seem neither visibly embarrassed to be in their security uniforms nor uncomfortable with their disguises, even though they're now virtually indistinguishable from other Syndicate personnel. Bunker can't stop laughing at them. Everyone wishes each other luck as the two walk off, and you and Bunker go back to the <ship> and prepare for the journey to <planet>.
units.italian: Lasci Ale e River allo spazioporto, guardandole mentre cercano di non sembrare visibilmente imbarazzate nelle loro uniformi di sicurezza né a disagio con i loro travestimenti, anche se ormai sono praticamente indistinguibili dal resto del personale del Sindacato. Bunker non riesce a smettere di ridere. Tutti si augurano buona fortuna mentre le due si allontanano, e tu e Bunker tornate alla <ship> e vi preparate al viaggio verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|name|7904|0
units.english: Take the film to <planet>
units.italian: Porta il filmato su <planet>

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|description|7905|0
units.english: Take the film to <destination>, where the rest of the Adelita group remained behind. You will be paid <payment> after you complete the entire job.
units.italian: Porta il filmato su <destination>, dove il resto del gruppo di Adelita è rimasto. Ti saranno pagati <payment> al completamento dell'intero incarico.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|As you enter <origin>'s atmosphere Bunker explains that you need to find a place to land in order for him to be able to release the drones. Luckily on this part of <origin>, it's not hard to find a remote canyon within range of the target area.|7917|0
units.english: As you enter <origin>'s atmosphere Bunker explains that you need to find a place to land in order for him to be able to release the drones. Luckily on this part of <origin>, it's not hard to find a remote canyon within range of the target area.
units.italian: Mentre entri nell'atmosfera di <origin> Bunker ti spiega che devi trovare un posto dove atterrare perché lui possa rilasciare i droni. Per fortuna in questa parte di <origin> non è difficile trovare un canyon isolato a portata della zona bersaglio.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	Bunker locates a sheltered outcrop near the <ship> and releases the drones from a briefcase he took with him; the drones are so small you can't make them out. He then unpacks the drones' controller and display feed and sets it up on a flat boulder, using a smaller rock as a stool to sit on while he prepares the drones. "Okay, they're on autopilot to the rendezvous site."|7918|0
units.english: Bunker locates a sheltered outcrop near the <ship> and releases the drones from a briefcase he took with him; the drones are so small you can't make them out. He then unpacks the drones' controller and display feed and sets it up on a flat boulder, using a smaller rock as a stool to sit on while he prepares the drones. "Okay, they're on autopilot to the rendezvous site."
units.italian: Bunker individua un affioramento roccioso riparato vicino alla <ship> e libera i droni da una valigetta che si era portato; i droni sono così piccoli che non riesci a distinguerli. Poi apre il controller e il display dei droni e li sistema su un masso piatto, usando una roccia più piccola come sgabello mentre li prepara. "Ok, sono in pilota automatico verso il punto d'incontro."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	As you watch the display, the drones arrive on site, and you can see a lone Syndicate-built freighter with a security detail posted in front of the loading ramp. "The pirates must be late," says Bunker, smirking. "Typical. I'm going to scatter the drones and set a proximity alert."|7919|0
units.english: As you watch the display, the drones arrive on site, and you can see a lone Syndicate-built freighter with a security detail posted in front of the loading ramp. "The pirates must be late," says Bunker, smirking. "Typical. I'm going to scatter the drones and set a proximity alert."
units.italian: Mentre guardi il display, i droni arrivano sul posto, e vedi un mercantile solitario di costruzione del Sindacato con una squadra di sicurezza schierata davanti alla rampa di carico. "I pirati devono essere in ritardo," dice Bunker, con un sorriso sfrontato. "Tipico. Sparpaglio i droni e imposto un allarme di prossimità."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	He hums to himself for a while before he turns to you and starts talking again. "You know, there's a part of me that would much rather be liberating slaves instead of filming them, but for now it seems like this is the best way for me to help. Say we did liberate them right now; there's just going to be another slave ship tomorrow. But if we create political and social pressure, that could stop the slave ships forever."|7920|0
units.english: He hums to himself for a while before he turns to you and starts talking again. "You know, there's a part of me that would much rather be liberating slaves instead of filming them, but for now it seems like this is the best way for me to help. Say we did liberate them right now; there's just going to be another slave ship tomorrow. But if we create political and social pressure, that could stop the slave ships forever."
units.italian: Canticchia fra sé per un po', poi si volta verso di te e ricomincia a parlare. "Sai, c'è una parte di me che preferirebbe di gran lunga liberare gli schiavi invece di filmarli, ma per ora sembra che questo sia il modo migliore per aiutare. Mettiamo che li liberassimo adesso: domani ci sarebbe solo un'altra nave di schiavi. Ma se creiamo pressione politica e sociale, potremmo fermare le navi di schiavi per sempre."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"I think you're right."|7922|0
units.english: "I think you're right."
units.italian: "Credo che tu abbia ragione."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"What about doing both?"|7923|0
units.english: "What about doing both?"
units.italian: "E fare entrambe le cose?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Are you sure it's that simple?"|7925|0
units.english: "Are you sure it's that simple?"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro che sia così semplice?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Thank you! It's good to hear someone who's optimistic about this. Way too many people are unconscious about slavery in our civilization, or they believe there's nothing anybody can do about it. If we can-" A chirp from the proximity alert cuts him off.|7928|0
units.english: "Thank you! It's good to hear someone who's optimistic about this. Way too many people are unconscious about slavery in our civilization, or they believe there's nothing anybody can do about it. If we can-" A chirp from the proximity alert cuts him off.
units.italian: "Grazie! Fa bene sentire qualcuno che è ottimista su questo. Troppe persone sono inconsapevoli della schiavitù nella nostra civiltà, o credono che nessuno possa farci nulla. Se riusciamo a..." Un trillo dell'allarme di prossimità lo interrompe.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Of course not. And that's why I'm working here instead, to make sure there'll be a time and place in the future where we can finally declare the galaxy free of slavery. What if-" A chirp from the proximity alert cuts him off.|7932|0
units.english: "Of course not. And that's why I'm working here instead, to make sure there'll be a time and place in the future where we can finally declare the galaxy free of slavery. What if-" A chirp from the proximity alert cuts him off.
units.italian: "Certo che no. Ed è per questo che lavoro qui invece, per assicurarmi che in futuro ci siano un tempo e un luogo in cui poter finalmente dichiarare la galassia libera dalla schiavitù. E se..." Un trillo dell'allarme di prossimità lo interrompe.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Now you're talking! But it would take a lot of planning to do it without killing the people we're trying to liberate. You know they'll use those poor people as human shields. Say we-" A chirp from the proximity alert cuts him off.|7936|0
units.english: "Now you're talking! But it would take a lot of planning to do it without killing the people we're trying to liberate. You know they'll use those poor people as human shields. Say we-" A chirp from the proximity alert cuts him off.
units.italian: "Così si parla! Ma servirebbe molta pianificazione per farlo senza uccidere le persone che cerchiamo di liberare. Sai che useranno quei poveretti come scudi umani. Mettiamo che..." Un trillo dell'allarme di prossimità lo interrompe.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Showtime!" he exclaims, rubbing his hands together. Both of you watch as a Vanguard flying pirate colors, accompanied by a small flotilla of Quicksilver escorts, lands near the security detail, probably deafening them with the sound of their repulsors. As soon as the loading ramp is down, the security detail gets to work herding the slaves from one ship to another - hitting, shoving, and shouting at anyone that moves too slowly for their liking.|7939|0
units.english: "Showtime!" he exclaims, rubbing his hands together. Both of you watch as a Vanguard flying pirate colors, accompanied by a small flotilla of Quicksilver escorts, lands near the security detail, probably deafening them with the sound of their repulsors. As soon as the loading ramp is down, the security detail gets to work herding the slaves from one ship to another - hitting, shoving, and shouting at anyone that moves too slowly for their liking.
units.italian: "Si va in scena!" esclama, strofinandosi le mani. Guardate entrambi mentre un Vanguard con i colori dei pirati, accompagnato da una piccola flottiglia di Quicksilver di scorta, atterra vicino alla squadra di sicurezza, probabilmente assordandola con il rumore dei repulsori. Appena la rampa è abbassata, la squadra di sicurezza si mette al lavoro per condurre gli schiavi da una nave all'altra: colpendo, spingendo e urlando contro chiunque si muova troppo lentamente per i loro gusti.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Pigs," blurts out Bunker. He zooms in on two men talking a few meters away from everyone else. One is in a suit, the other a black hooded robe. "Must be the leaders," he whispers as if they can hear him. Just then, the hooded man looks up to the sky as if he sees something. He motions, and the Quicksilvers fire up their engines.|7940|0
units.english: "Pigs," blurts out Bunker. He zooms in on two men talking a few meters away from everyone else. One is in a suit, the other a black hooded robe. "Must be the leaders," he whispers as if they can hear him. Just then, the hooded man looks up to the sky as if he sees something. He motions, and the Quicksilvers fire up their engines.
units.italian: "Maiali," sbuffa Bunker. Zoom su due uomini che parlano a qualche metro dagli altri. Uno in abito, l'altro in una veste nera con cappuccio. "Devono essere i capi," sussurra come se potessero sentirlo. Proprio allora l'uomo incappucciato alza lo sguardo al cielo come se vedesse qualcosa. Fa un cenno, e i Quicksilver accendono i motori.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Oh, I don't like the look of this," says Bunker.|7941|0
units.english: "Oh, I don't like the look of this," says Bunker.
units.italian: "Oh, non mi piace per niente," dice Bunker.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Did he see us?"|7943|0
units.english: "Did he see us?"
units.italian: "Ci ha visti?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Call back the drones now."|7945|0
units.english: "Call back the drones now."
units.italian: "Richiama subito i droni."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"I think we'll have to leave the drones behind."|7947|0
units.english: "I think we'll have to leave the drones behind."
units.italian: "Credo che dovremo lasciare i droni."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Keep filming."|7949|0
units.english: "Keep filming."
units.italian: "Continua a filmare."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"I don't know. I think we oughta get going," says Bunker, grimacing.|7951|0
units.english: "I don't know. I think we oughta get going," says Bunker, grimacing.
units.italian: "Non lo so. Credo che dovremmo andarcene," dice Bunker, con una smorfia.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Okay. Call the drones back."|7953|0
units.english: "Okay. Call the drones back."
units.italian: "Ok. Richiama i droni."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"That's an order!"|7955|0
units.english: "That's an order!"
units.italian: "Questo è un ordine!"

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"You're the captain, you decide whether we go or not," Bunker responds in a sore tone. Meanwhile, you continue to watch the display. It takes a couple minutes before the last of the slaves are loaded, followed by the security team. The two men in the suit and hood are the last to board their ships.|7957|0
units.english: "You're the captain, you decide whether we go or not," Bunker responds in a sore tone. Meanwhile, you continue to watch the display. It takes a couple minutes before the last of the slaves are loaded, followed by the security team. The two men in the suit and hood are the last to board their ships.
units.italian: "Sei tu il capitano, decidi tu se andiamo o no," risponde Bunker in tono risentito. Intanto tu continui a guardare il display. Passano un paio di minuti prima che l'ultimo degli schiavi sia caricato, seguito dalla squadra di sicurezza. I due uomini in abito e con il cappuccio sono gli ultimi a salire sulle loro navi.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	You hear the sudden hum of repulsors overhead, replaced simultaneously by the reports of particle cannons from the Quicksilvers! You think you hear Bunker swear as he leaps off his seat, the both of you running towards the <ship>, dirt and rock kicking up around you from strafing particle fire- until you're engulfed by a searing yellow beam that splits your body apart as a Quicksilver finally finds its mark.|7958|0
units.english: You hear the sudden hum of repulsors overhead, replaced simultaneously by the reports of particle cannons from the Quicksilvers! You think you hear Bunker swear as he leaps off his seat, the both of you running towards the <ship>, dirt and rock kicking up around you from strafing particle fire- until you're engulfed by a searing yellow beam that splits your body apart as a Quicksilver finally finds its mark.
units.italian: Senti all'improvviso il ronzio dei repulsori sopra la testa, sostituito nello stesso istante dagli spari dei cannoni a particelle dei Quicksilver! Credi di sentire Bunker imprecare mentre schizza giù dal suo posto, e correte entrambi verso la <ship>, con terra e rocce che schizzano intorno a voi per il fuoco a particelle radente, finché non vieni inghiottito da un raggio giallo incandescente che ti divide il corpo in due quando un Quicksilver finalmente trova il bersaglio.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|label|7961|0
units.english: see us
units.italian: see us

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"I have no idea," says Bunker. "But it's probably time to go."|7962|0
units.english: "I have no idea," says Bunker. "But it's probably time to go."
units.italian: "Non ne ho idea," dice Bunker. "Ma è probabilmente ora di andare."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Call back the drones now."|7964|0
units.english: "Call back the drones now."
units.italian: "Richiama subito i droni."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"I think we have to leave the drones behind."|7966|0
units.english: "I think we have to leave the drones behind."
units.italian: "Credo che dobbiamo lasciare i droni."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|label|7968|0
units.english: no can do
units.italian: no can do

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	Bunker hits the recall button for the drones anyway. "This display is a low resolution proxy," explains Bunker. "If we leave the drones, we'll lose all the footage we need. It looks like the Quicksilvers aren't coming straight for us. We have time. The drones are less than two minutes out."|7969|0
units.english: Bunker hits the recall button for the drones anyway. "This display is a low resolution proxy," explains Bunker. "If we leave the drones, we'll lose all the footage we need. It looks like the Quicksilvers aren't coming straight for us. We have time. The drones are less than two minutes out."
units.italian: Bunker preme comunque il pulsante di richiamo dei droni. "Questo display è un proxy a bassa risoluzione," spiega Bunker. "Se lasciamo i droni, perdiamo tutto il materiale che ci serve. Sembra che i Quicksilver non vengano dritti verso di noi. Abbiamo tempo. I droni sono a meno di due minuti."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"We're leaving. Now!"|7971|0
units.english: "We're leaving. Now!"
units.italian: "Ce ne andiamo. Adesso!"

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Fine. Get to the <ship> and lock down the drones as soon as they land. We take off on your mark."|7972|0
units.english: "Fine. Get to the <ship> and lock down the drones as soon as they land. We take off on your mark."
units.italian: "Va bene. Vai alla <ship> e blocca i droni appena atterrano. Decolliamo al tuo segnale."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"I can't let you do that, <first>," says Bunker, standing between you and the controls. "The drones are almost here. It'll take me no time to lock them down once we're on the <ship>, then we're out of here.|7975|0
units.english: "I can't let you do that, <first>," says Bunker, standing between you and the controls. "The drones are almost here. It'll take me no time to lock them down once we're on the <ship>, then we're out of here.
units.italian: "Non posso lasciarti fare questo, <first>," dice Bunker, mettendosi fra te e i comandi. "I droni sono quasi qui. Mi ci vorrà un attimo per bloccarli una volta sulla <ship>, poi ce ne andiamo.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	(Force him to stand down.)|7977|0
units.english: (Force him to stand down.)
units.italian: (Costringilo a obbedire.)

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	(Get back to the <ship> and let Bunker lock down the drones.)|7979|0
units.english: (Get back to the <ship> and let Bunker lock down the drones.)
units.italian: (Torna alla <ship> e lascia che Bunker blocchi i droni.)

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	You nod, and Bunker immediately packs up the entire controller and display set, packing it away in his briefcase in seconds.|7981|0
units.english: You nod, and Bunker immediately packs up the entire controller and display set, packing it away in his briefcase in seconds.
units.italian: Annuisci, e Bunker impacchetta subito l'intero set di controller e display, riponendolo nella valigetta in pochi secondi.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|label|7984|0
units.english: call drones
units.italian: call drones

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	"Aye aye, Captain," he says as he hits a button. "Drone ETA: two minutes, fifteen seconds." He packs up the entire controller and display set and has it packed away in his briefcase in seconds.|7985|0
units.english: "Aye aye, Captain," he says as he hits a button. "Drone ETA: two minutes, fifteen seconds." He packs up the entire controller and display set and has it packed away in his briefcase in seconds.
units.italian: "Sissignore, Capitano," dice premendo un pulsante. "Arrivo droni: due minuti e quindici secondi." Impacchetta l'intero set di controller e display e lo ripone nella valigetta in pochi secondi.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	The both of you race onboard the <ship> and you prepare it for take off while Bunker heads to the cargo bay to receive the drones. "Lock down the drones as soon as they arrive and get belted in," you say over the comms to Bunker. "We'll take off on your mark."|7988|0
units.english: The both of you race onboard the <ship> and you prepare it for take off while Bunker heads to the cargo bay to receive the drones. "Lock down the drones as soon as they arrive and get belted in," you say over the comms to Bunker. "We'll take off on your mark."
units.italian: Correte entrambi a bordo della <ship> e tu la prepari al decollo mentre Bunker va nella stiva a ricevere i droni. "Blocca i droni appena arrivano e allacciati," dici a Bunker via radio. "Decolliamo al tuo segnale."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	Less than a minute later, you hear Bunker's reply. "Drones are locked down and ready to go."|7989|0
units.english: Less than a minute later, you hear Bunker's reply. "Drones are locked down and ready to go."
units.italian: Meno di un minuto dopo senti la risposta di Bunker. "Droni bloccati e pronti."

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	You immediately raise the shields and take off. The moment you pull out of the canyon, pirate Quicksilvers appear from every direction; not far behind them, the Vanguard you saw earlier. You shunt the <ship>'s repulsors into full blast and accelerate into space with the pirates in hot pursuit.|7990|0
units.english: You immediately raise the shields and take off. The moment you pull out of the canyon, pirate Quicksilvers appear from every direction; not far behind them, the Vanguard you saw earlier. You shunt the <ship>'s repulsors into full blast and accelerate into space with the pirates in hot pursuit.
units.italian: Alzi subito gli scudi e decolli. Appena esci dal canyon, da ogni direzione compaiono Quicksilver pirata; poco dietro, il Vanguard che avevi visto prima. Mandi i repulsori della <ship> a piena potenza e acceleri nello spazio con i pirati alle calcagna.

units.id: mission:Adelita 4|	You get up and point your pistol at Bunker while ordering him to stand down. "Don't do this," he says, shrinking from you as he puts his hands up. As you are restraining him you hear the sudden hum of repulsors overhead, replaced simultaneously by the reports of particle cannons from the Quicksilvers! You find yourself letting go of Bunker, the both of you running towards the <ship>, dirt and rock kicking up around you from strafing particle fire- until you're engulfed by a searing yellow beam that splits your body apart as a Quicksilver finally finds its mark.|7994|0
units.english: You get up and point your pistol at Bunker while ordering him to stand down. "Don't do this," he says, shrinking from you as he puts his hands up. As you are restraining him you hear the sudden hum of repulsors overhead, replaced simultaneously by the reports of particle cannons from the Quicksilvers! You find yourself letting go of Bunker, the both of you running towards the <ship>, dirt and rock kicking up around you from strafing particle fire- until you're engulfed by a searing yellow beam that splits your body apart as a Quicksilver finally finds its mark.
units.italian: Ti alzi e punti la pistola su Bunker ordinandogli di obbedire. "Non farlo," dice, ritraendosi da te mentre alza le mani. Mentre lo stai immobilizzando senti all'improvviso il ronzio dei repulsori sopra la testa, sostituito nello stesso istante dagli spari dei cannoni a particelle dei Quicksilver! Ti ritrovi a lasciare andare Bunker, e correte entrambi verso la <ship>, con terra e rocce che schizzano intorno a voi per il fuoco a particelle radente, finché non vieni inghiottito da un raggio giallo incandescente che ti divide il corpo in due quando un Quicksilver finalmente trova il bersaglio.

units.id: mission:Adelita 5|name|8016|0
units.english: Return Adelita to <planet>
units.italian: Riporta Adelita su <planet>

units.id: mission:Adelita 5|description|8017|0
units.english: Bring everyone back to <destination>. You will be paid <payment> after you complete the entire job.
units.italian: Riporta tutti su <destination>. Ti saranno pagati <payment> al completamento dell'intero incarico.

units.id: mission:Adelita 5|You managed to deal with the Quicksilvers and arrive on <origin> alive. As soon as you land, Ale and River rush on board, obviously relieved to be out of their disguises, and they spend a lot of time talking with Bunker about his part of the mission. Although exhausted, all of them are eager to get back and process what they filmed - both emotionally and literally.|8028|0
units.english: You managed to deal with the Quicksilvers and arrive on <origin> alive. As soon as you land, Ale and River rush on board, obviously relieved to be out of their disguises, and they spend a lot of time talking with Bunker about his part of the mission. Although exhausted, all of them are eager to get back and process what they filmed - both emotionally and literally.
units.italian: Sei riuscito a cavartela con i Quicksilver e ad arrivare su <origin> vivo. Appena atterri, Ale e River si precipitano a bordo, evidentemente sollevate di essersi tolte i travestimenti, e passano molto tempo a parlare con Bunker della sua parte della missione. Anche se esausti, tutti non vedono l'ora di tornare ed elaborare quello che hanno filmato, emotivamente e letteralmente.

units.id: mission:Adelita 5|	"That was horrible, but we got it done," Ale mumbles. "Can we leave now?"|8029|0
units.english: "That was horrible, but we got it done," Ale mumbles. "Can we leave now?"
units.italian: "È stato orribile, ma ce l'abbiamo fatta," borbotta Ale. "Possiamo andare adesso?"

units.id: mission:Adelita 5|log|8037|0
units.english: Helped the underground journalism collective "Adelita" gather video evidence of Syndicate participation in the slave trade while escaping from pirates.
units.italian: Ho aiutato il collettivo di giornalismo clandestino "Adelita" a raccogliere prove video della partecipazione del Sindacato al commercio di schiavi, sfuggendo ai pirati.

units.id: mission:Adelita 5|Ale, River, and Bunker look glad to be back on <planet>. "Being there in person was bad enough," Ale grumbles as she looks through a stack of folders on her datapad. "Now we have to watch it over and over again to edit it into something presentable."|8039|0
units.english: Ale, River, and Bunker look glad to be back on <planet>. "Being there in person was bad enough," Ale grumbles as she looks through a stack of folders on her datapad. "Now we have to watch it over and over again to edit it into something presentable."
units.italian: Ale, River e Bunker sembrano contenti di essere tornati su <planet>. "Esserci di persona è stato già abbastanza brutto," borbotta Ale guardando una pila di cartelle sul suo datapad. "Ora dobbiamo guardarlo ancora e ancora per montarlo in qualcosa di presentabile."

units.id: mission:Adelita 5|	As they are leaving, Ale hands you a stack of credit chips totaling <payment>. "There's a bonus in there for you. We really couldn't have done it without you," she tells you with a bittersweet smile. "Of course, you'll be one of the first to know when it's done."|8040|0
units.english: As they are leaving, Ale hands you a stack of credit chips totaling <payment>. "There's a bonus in there for you. We really couldn't have done it without you," she tells you with a bittersweet smile. "Of course, you'll be one of the first to know when it's done."
units.italian: Mentre se ne vanno, Ale ti mette in mano una pila di chip di credito per un totale di <payment>. "C'è un bonus per te. Davvero non ce l'avremmo fatta senza di te," ti dice con un sorriso agrodolce. "Naturalmente sarai tra i primi a saperlo quando sarà finito."

units.id: mission:Adelita 5|	She starts off to join River and Bunker out in the spaceport before turning around one last time in the doorway. "We might be in need of you for some future projects too, Captain <last>. But goodbye for now. Stay safe on the star lanes!"|8041|0
units.english: She starts off to join River and Bunker out in the spaceport before turning around one last time in the doorway. "We might be in need of you for some future projects too, Captain <last>. But goodbye for now. Stay safe on the star lanes!"
units.italian: Si avvia per raggiungere River e Bunker nello spazioporto, poi si volta un'ultima volta sulla porta. "Potremmo aver bisogno di te anche per qualche progetto futuro, Capitano <last>. Ma per ora addio. Stai al sicuro sulle rotte stellari!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|name|8046|0
units.english: Rescue kidnapped man in <waypoints>
units.italian: Salvare l'uomo rapito in <waypoints>

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|description|8047|0
units.english: You have received a mysterious distress call from an alleged abductee in the <waypoints> system. Head there to see if you can find the signal's source.
units.italian: Hai ricevuto una misteriosa chiamata di soccorso da un presunto rapito nel sistema <waypoints>. Vai là per vedere se riesci a trovare la fonte del segnale.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|As you are walking through the spaceport, you are startled by a sudden loud beeping from a nearby computer terminal. The computer is unattended and the screen is blinking on and off.|8059|0
units.english: As you are walking through the spaceport, you are startled by a sudden loud beeping from a nearby computer terminal. The computer is unattended and the screen is blinking on and off.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, sussulti per un improvviso e forte bip da un terminale vicino. Il computer è incustodito e lo schermo lampeggia.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	(Check it out.)|8061|0
units.english: (Check it out.)
units.italian: (Controlla di che si tratta.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	(Ignore it.)|8062|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignoralo.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	When you approach, you are greeted by plain text on the terminal's screen:|8064|0
units.english: When you approach, you are greeted by plain text on the terminal's screen:
units.italian: Quando ti avvicini, ti accoglie del testo semplice sullo schermo del terminale:

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|		"SOS: Megaparsec employee kidnapped by pirates, can't respond. <waypoints> standard coordinates: RAD AU 30.12 LAT 0.2 LON 303.9. Life in danger, need urgent rescue. Cannot otherwise communicate, all signals monitored. Please help!"|8065|0
units.english: "SOS: Megaparsec employee kidnapped by pirates, can't respond. <waypoints> standard coordinates: RAD AU 30.12 LAT 0.2 LON 303.9. Life in danger, need urgent rescue. Cannot otherwise communicate, all signals monitored. Please help!"
units.italian: "SOS: dipendente Megaparsec rapito dai pirati, non posso rispondere. Coordinate standard <waypoints>: RAD AU 30.12 LAT 0.2 LON 303.9. Vita in pericolo, serve soccorso urgente. Non posso comunicare altrimenti, tutti i segnali sono monitorati. Vi prego, aiutatemi!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	You note that the message appears to be coming from an emergency transmitter commonly found on many small shuttles and escape pods. There is no shortage of pirates in <waypoints>, which is only a system away from Megaparsec's headquarters on <planet>. Presumably, you'll be expected to head there after rescuing the Megaparsec employee.|8066|0
units.english: You note that the message appears to be coming from an emergency transmitter commonly found on many small shuttles and escape pods. There is no shortage of pirates in <waypoints>, which is only a system away from Megaparsec's headquarters on <planet>. Presumably, you'll be expected to head there after rescuing the Megaparsec employee.
units.italian: Noti che il messaggio sembra venire da un trasmettitore d'emergenza, comune su molte navette piccole e capsule di salvataggio. Di pirati in <waypoints> non c'è carenza, ed è a un solo sistema dalla sede di Megaparsec su <planet>. Presumibilmente ti aspetterai di andare là dopo aver salvato il dipendente Megaparsec.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	(Head to <waypoints>.)|8068|0
units.english: (Head to <waypoints>.)
units.italian: (Vai su <waypoints>.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	(Ignore it and walk away.)|8070|0
units.english: (Ignore it and walk away.)
units.italian: (Ignalo e allontanati.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|When you enter <waypoints>, your sensors detect a pirate Vanguard and a derelict Emergency Shuttle aimlessly drifting near the coordinates in the original message. Almost immediately, you receive a message from the pirate ship.|8077|0
units.english: When you enter <waypoints>, your sensors detect a pirate Vanguard and a derelict Emergency Shuttle aimlessly drifting near the coordinates in the original message. Almost immediately, you receive a message from the pirate ship.
units.italian: Quando entri in <waypoints>, i sensori rilevano un Vanguard pirata e un'Emergency Shuttle abbandonata che va alla deriva senza meta vicino alle coordinate del messaggio originale. Quasi subito ricevi un messaggio dalla nave pirata.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"You were unwise to get involved in our business. Hand over that pompous salesman Howard, and I'll let you live."|8078|0
units.english: "You were unwise to get involved in our business. Hand over that pompous salesman Howard, and I'll let you live."
units.italian: "Non sei stato saggio a immischiarti nei nostri affari. Consegnaci quel venditore pomposo di Howard e ti lascio vivere."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Uhhh... hand over who?"|8080|0
units.english: "Uhhh... hand over who?"
units.italian: "Ehm... consegnare chi?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"I don't negotiate with pirates!"|8081|0
units.english: "I don't negotiate with pirates!"
units.italian: "Non tratto con i pirati!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"You can take him, but I don't know where he is."|8083|0
units.english: "You can take him, but I don't know where he is."
units.italian: "Puoi prenderlo, ma non so dove sia."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Bah, you spineless buffoon! Your lies won't save you or that useless salesman. I'll find him in your ship's wreckage!"|8084|0
units.english: "Bah, you spineless buffoon! Your lies won't save you or that useless salesman. I'll find him in your ship's wreckage!"
units.italian: "Bah, vile buffone! Le tue bugie non salveranno te né quel venditore inutile. Lo troverò fra i rottami della tua nave!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Aye, then I won't negotiate with you! Prepare to meet your end!"|8087|0
units.english: "Aye, then I won't negotiate with you! Prepare to meet your end!"
units.italian: "Ah, allora non tratto con te! Preparati alla fine!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	The Vanguard's engines roar to life and you see a baker's half-dozen guns take aim at your ship, ready to fire.|8089|0
units.english: The Vanguard's engines roar to life and you see a baker's half-dozen guns take aim at your ship, ready to fire.
units.italian: I motori del Vanguard ruggiscono e vedi una mezza dozzina di cannoni puntati sulla tua nave, pronti a sparare.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|dialog|8097|0
units.english: The crew of the Golden Jewel are no more. You think you can make out the pirate captain drifting in space nearby.
units.italian: L'equipaggio del Golden Jewel non esiste più. Ti sembra di distinguere il capitano pirata che va alla deriva nello spazio qui vicino.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|dialog|8104|0
units.english: You watch as the Emergency Shuttle you're supposed to save explodes into a cloud of debris.
units.italian: Vedi l'Emergency Shuttle che dovresti salvare esplodere in una nuvola di detriti.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|You board the Emergency Shuttle to see its desperate and nearly incoherent occupant. "Oh thank the stars, thank you! Captain, you've got to save me - please! I'm Howard. I promise you a reward if you can fix up this tin can so I can get to my office on <planet>! I'm with Megaparsec, I can make it worth your while!"|8106|0
units.english: You board the Emergency Shuttle to see its desperate and nearly incoherent occupant. "Oh thank the stars, thank you! Captain, you've got to save me - please! I'm Howard. I promise you a reward if you can fix up this tin can so I can get to my office on <planet>! I'm with Megaparsec, I can make it worth your while!"
units.italian: Sali sull'Emergency Shuttle e trovi il suo occupante disperato e quasi incoerente. "Oh, grazie alle stelle, grazie! Capitano, deve salvarmi, la prego! Sono Howard. Le prometto una ricompensa se riesce a rimettere in sesto questa lattina così posso arrivare al mio ufficio su <planet>! Lavoro per Megaparsec, posso rendere la cosa vantaggiosa per lei!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Sounds good."|8108|0
units.english: "Sounds good."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"What's the deal with you and that pirate?"|8110|0
units.english: "What's the deal with you and that pirate?"
units.italian: "Che rapporto hai con quel pirata?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	Howard takes a breath and seems to calm himself. "That pirate was a potential investor in the firm I work for. We had a disagreement over the terms and it obviously got quite out of hand. I'll need to find a new business partner now..." He trails off. Time to get Howard back to <planet>.|8111|0
units.english: Howard takes a breath and seems to calm himself. "That pirate was a potential investor in the firm I work for. We had a disagreement over the terms and it obviously got quite out of hand. I'll need to find a new business partner now..." He trails off. Time to get Howard back to <planet>.
units.italian: Howard prende fiato e sembra calmarsi. "Quel pirata era un potenziale investitore dell'azienda per cui lavoro. Abbiamo avuto un disaccordo sui termini e la cosa è chiaramente sfuggita di mano. Ora dovrò trovarmi un nuovo socio..." Si perde. È ora di riportare Howard su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|log|8115|0
units.english: Rescued a Syndicate salesman kidnapped by pirates, who then offered an investment opportunity.
units.italian: Ho salvato un venditore del Sindacato rapito dai pirati, che poi mi ha offerto un'opportunità di investimento.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|log|8116|0
units.english: A polished yet insecure Megaparsec businessman, Howard is a salesman known for brokering investment deals. While polite, Howard seems rarely concerned with ethics or personal connections, instead focusing on transactions that further his own interests.
units.italian: Uomo d'affari di Megaparsec curato ma insicuro, Howard è un venditore noto per mediare accordi di investimento. Cortese, ma sembra raramente interessato all'etica o ai rapporti personali, concentrandosi invece sulle transazioni che servono i propri interessi.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|When you land on <planet>, Howard is waiting for you at the spaceport, looking much more collected than he was on the Emergency Shuttle. "Thank you, truly. I'm Howard Vendeur, Investor Relations Associate with Megaparsec Incorporated. Anyway, I've managed to scrounge up my savings. It's not much to someone like you, I'm afraid. Just over ninety thousand credits.|8118|0
units.english: When you land on <planet>, Howard is waiting for you at the spaceport, looking much more collected than he was on the Emergency Shuttle. "Thank you, truly. I'm Howard Vendeur, Investor Relations Associate with Megaparsec Incorporated. Anyway, I've managed to scrounge up my savings. It's not much to someone like you, I'm afraid. Just over ninety thousand credits.
units.italian: Quando atterri su <planet>, Howard ti aspetta allo spazioporto, molto più composto di com'era sull'Emergency Shuttle. "Grazie, davvero. Sono Howard Vendeur, addetto alle relazioni con gli investitori di Megaparsec Incorporated. Comunque, sono riuscito a racimolare i miei risparmi. Temo che per uno come lei non siano gran che. Poco più di novantamila crediti.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"However, I see you're clearly a captain of means. I'd have to pull a few strings, but I could get you into a private placement of a Megaparsec Inc. perpetual bond. To purchase a perpetual bond of Megaparsec Inc. I will need one million credits and for you to sign a few documents. This round is quite generous, with promised returns of over 35% per annum, to continue, of course, into perpetuity, paid out to you as a daily dividend of 1,000 credits."|8119|0
units.english: "However, I see you're clearly a captain of means. I'd have to pull a few strings, but I could get you into a private placement of a Megaparsec Inc. perpetual bond. To purchase a perpetual bond of Megaparsec Inc. I will need one million credits and for you to sign a few documents. This round is quite generous, with promised returns of over 35% per annum, to continue, of course, into perpetuity, paid out to you as a daily dividend of 1,000 credits."
units.italian: "Vedo però che lei è chiaramente un capitano di mezzi. Dovrei tirare qualche filo, ma potrei farla entrare in un collocamento privato di un'obbligazione perpetua di Megaparsec Inc. Per acquistare un'obbligazione perpetua di Megaparsec Inc. mi serviranno un milione di crediti e la sua firma su qualche documento. Questo giro è piuttosto generoso, con rendimenti promessi superiori al 35% annuo, per continuare, naturalmente, in perpetuo, pagati a lei come dividendo giornaliero di 1.000 crediti."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Sure, I'll invest. What do I need to do?"|8121|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll invest. What do I need to do?"
units.italian: "Certo, investo. Che cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Megaparsec? I thought that was part of the Syndicate."|8123|0
units.english: "Megaparsec? I thought that was part of the Syndicate."
units.italian: "Megaparsec? Pensavo facesse parte del Sindacato."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Private placement? Does that mean I own part of the Syndicate?"|8124|0
units.english: "Private placement? Does that mean I own part of the Syndicate?"
units.italian: "Collocamento privato? Vuol dire che possiedo una parte del Sindacato?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"No thanks. I'll take the money, please."|8126|0
units.english: "No thanks. I'll take the money, please."
units.italian: "No, grazie. Prendo i soldi, per favore."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Megaparsec Incorporated is a proud affiliate of Syndicated Systems that accepts some private outside investment. We specialize in the design and manufacture of innovative, fast, and lightweight high-performance commercial and military space vehicles. Though a relatively young shipyard, our ships can still outmaneuver and outgun almost anything their size. Would you like to invest?"|8129|0
units.english: "Megaparsec Incorporated is a proud affiliate of Syndicated Systems that accepts some private outside investment. We specialize in the design and manufacture of innovative, fast, and lightweight high-performance commercial and military space vehicles. Though a relatively young shipyard, our ships can still outmaneuver and outgun almost anything their size. Would you like to invest?"
units.italian: "Megaparsec Incorporated è un'orgogliosa affiliata di Syndicated Systems che accetta alcuni investimenti privati esterni. Siamo specializzati nella progettazione e nella produzione di veicoli spaziali commerciali e militari innovativi, veloci, leggeri e ad alte prestazioni. Anche se è un cantiere relativamente giovane, le nostre navi riescono comunque a superare in manovra e in potenza di fuoco quasi tutto ciò che ha le loro dimensioni. Le interessa investire?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Sure, I'll invest. What do I need to do?"|8131|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll invest. What do I need to do?"
units.italian: "Certo, investo. Che cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Nope, I'll stick with the 90k."|8133|0
units.english: "Nope, I'll stick with the 90k."
units.italian: "No, resto con i 90mila."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Not quite. You will be a lender to an affiliate of Syndicated Systems - Megaparsec Incorporated. As a privately held business, there are few opportunities to invest, and even fewer people who are permitted to. It's quite an exclusive investment, with high returns, I might add. Would you like to invest with us?"|8136|0
units.english: "Not quite. You will be a lender to an affiliate of Syndicated Systems - Megaparsec Incorporated. As a privately held business, there are few opportunities to invest, and even fewer people who are permitted to. It's quite an exclusive investment, with high returns, I might add. Would you like to invest with us?"
units.italian: "Non proprio. Lei sarà un creditore di un'affiliata di Syndicated Systems: Megaparsec Incorporated. Essendo un'azienda a capitale privato, ci sono poche occasioni di investire, e ancora meno persone autorizzate a farlo. È un investimento piuttosto esclusivo, con rendimenti elevati, aggiungerei. Le interessa investire con noi?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Sure, I'll invest. What do I need to do?"|8138|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll invest. What do I need to do?"
units.italian: "Certo, investo. Che cosa devo fare?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Nope, I'll stick with the 90k."|8139|0
units.english: "Nope, I'll stick with the 90k."
units.italian: "No, resto con i 90mila."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Excellent. I'll need to get approval for the bond sale and set up the paperwork. Feel free to come by my kiosk in the spaceport here later today if you're ready to invest, or another time if you need longer. Remember, you'll need to have at least one million credits for the bond purchase, and I'll need you to transport me to Hephaestus to take care of a few other administrative tasks."|8142|0
units.english: "Excellent. I'll need to get approval for the bond sale and set up the paperwork. Feel free to come by my kiosk in the spaceport here later today if you're ready to invest, or another time if you need longer. Remember, you'll need to have at least one million credits for the bond purchase, and I'll need you to transport me to Hephaestus to take care of a few other administrative tasks."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Dovrò ottenere l'approvazione per la vendita dell'obbligazione e preparare le carte. Passi pure dal mio chiosco qui allo spazioporto più tardi oggi, se è pronto a investire, o un altro giorno se le serve più tempo. Ricordi che le serviranno almeno un milione di crediti per l'acquisto dell'obbligazione, e che dovrà trasportarmi su Hephaestus per sbrigare qualche altra pratica amministrativa."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|label|8144|0
units.english: pay up
units.italian: pay up

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 1|	"Erhm, yes, of course. Here you are, my savings of ninety-one thousand, nine hundred and fifty one credits. I remain in your debt, and if you still want to invest in us, I will be here."|8145|0
units.english: "Erhm, yes, of course. Here you are, my savings of ninety-one thousand, nine hundred and fifty one credits. I remain in your debt, and if you still want to invest in us, I will be here."
units.italian: "Ehm, sì, certo. Ecco, i miei risparmi: novantunomila novecentocinquantuno crediti. Resto in debito con lei, e se vuole ancora investire con noi, sarò qui."

units.id: ship:Emergency Shuttle|description|8204|0
units.english: This Emergency Shuttle is custom-built, designed to be attached to a larger ship and to serve as a lifeboat if the need arises. It is intentionally designed to maximize the number of people it can carry to safety, but has very little space for outfits.
units.italian: Questa Emergency Shuttle è costruita su misura per essere agganciata a una nave più grande e servire da scialuppa di salvataggio in caso di bisogno. È progettata intenzionalmente per massimizzare il numero di persone che può portare in salvo, ma ha pochissimo spazio per gli equipaggiamenti.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|name|8209|0
units.english: Purchase bond on <planet>
units.italian: Acquistare l'obbligazione su <planet>

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|description|8210|0
units.english: Bring Howard to <destination> in order to finish the paperwork you'll need to finalize your bond agreement with Megaparsec Incorporated.
units.italian: Porta Howard su <destination> per completare le carte necessarie a finalizzare l'accordo obbligazionario con Megaparsec Incorporated.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|blocked|8214|0
units.english: Howard has offered you an investment opportunity, but mentioned that it'll cost you a million credits up front, and you'll need space on your ship to transport him elsewhere. Better come back when you have that, plus a few more credits.
units.italian: Howard ti ha offerto un'opportunità di investimento, ma ha detto che ti costerà un milione di crediti in anticipo e che ti servirà spazio sulla nave per trasportarlo altrove. Meglio tornare quando avrai quella somma, più qualche credito in più.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|You visit the kiosk location Howard gave you at the spaceport, where he immediately spots you and approaches. When he arrives, he thanks you profusely and excitedly tells you what an exclusive offer you've received to be able to purchase a Megaparsec bond.|8221|0
units.english: You visit the kiosk location Howard gave you at the spaceport, where he immediately spots you and approaches. When he arrives, he thanks you profusely and excitedly tells you what an exclusive offer you've received to be able to purchase a Megaparsec bond.
units.italian: Vai al chiosco che Howard ti ha indicato allo spazioporto, dove lui ti individua subito e ti viene incontro. Quando arriva, ti ringrazia profusamente e ti dice tutto eccitato che offerta esclusiva hai ricevuto, poter acquistare un'obbligazione Megaparsec.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"To reiterate, in order to purchase a perpetual Megaparsec Incorporated bond you will need to provide us with an up-front payment of one million credits, and sign some legal documents. Our promised returns are over 35% per annum, which we expect to continue into perpetuity, paid out to you as a daily dividend of 1,000 credits. Do you accept these terms?"|8222|0
units.english: "To reiterate, in order to purchase a perpetual Megaparsec Incorporated bond you will need to provide us with an up-front payment of one million credits, and sign some legal documents. Our promised returns are over 35% per annum, which we expect to continue into perpetuity, paid out to you as a daily dividend of 1,000 credits. Do you accept these terms?"
units.italian: "Per ripetere: per acquistare un'obbligazione perpetua di Megaparsec Incorporated dovrà versarci un pagamento anticipato di un milione di crediti e firmare alcuni documenti legali. I nostri rendimenti promessi sono superiori al 35% annuo, che ci aspettiamo continuino in perpetuo, pagati a lei come dividendo giornaliero di 1.000 crediti. Accetta questi termini?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"Sure, here's the one million credits."|8224|0
units.english: "Sure, here's the one million credits."
units.italian: "Certo, ecco il milione di crediti."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"I want to look through these documents before signing."|8226|0
units.english: "I want to look through these documents before signing."
units.italian: "Voglio leggere questi documenti prima di firmare."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"Can I get a lawyer to review this?"|8227|0
units.english: "Can I get a lawyer to review this?"
units.italian: "Posso farli rivedere da un avvocato?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"I need more time to think about this."|8229|0
units.english: "I need more time to think about this."
units.italian: "Mi serve più tempo per pensarci."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"No, I'd prefer not to become an investor."|8231|0
units.english: "No, I'd prefer not to become an investor."
units.italian: "No, preferisco non diventare investitore."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|label|8233|0
units.english: looking through
units.italian: looking through

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	Howard chuckles as if your request were absurd.|8234|0
units.english: Howard chuckles as if your request were absurd.
units.italian: Howard ridacchia come se la tua richiesta fosse assurda.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"Sure, sure, feel free to peruse the first page. But, uh, let me remind you -- this credit agreement is 101 pages long, over 87,000 words. Unless you've got degrees in Syndicate & Megaparsec regulatory investment law and all day to read, I suggest you focus on the highlighted parts. Time is money, my friend, and this deal won't wait forever!"|8235|0
units.english: "Sure, sure, feel free to peruse the first page. But, uh, let me remind you -- this credit agreement is 101 pages long, over 87,000 words. Unless you've got degrees in Syndicate & Megaparsec regulatory investment law and all day to read, I suggest you focus on the highlighted parts. Time is money, my friend, and this deal won't wait forever!"
units.italian: "Certo, certo, sfogli pure la prima pagina. Ma, ehm, mi lasci ricordare che questo contratto di credito è lungo 101 pagine, più di 87.000 parole. A meno che lei non abbia lauree in diritto degli investimenti regolamentati del Sindacato e di Megaparsec e tutta la giornata per leggere, le suggerisco di concentrarsi sulle parti evidenziate. Il tempo è denaro, amico mio, e questo affare non aspetterà per sempre!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	Howard slides the cover and first page toward you and taps it impatiently with his pen.|8236|0
units.english: Howard slides the cover and first page toward you and taps it impatiently with his pen.
units.italian: Howard fa scivolare verso di te la copertina e la prima pagina e vi picchietta sopra con impazienza la penna.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	(Take a look at what Howard slid over.)|8238|0
units.english: (Take a look at what Howard slid over.)
units.italian: (Dai un'occhiata a quello che Howard ha fatto scivolare.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"Alright, I'll sign."|8239|0
