Con la firma in calce, l'Investitore dichiara di aver ricevuto il presente Contratto e accetta i termini e le condizioni in esso stabiliti.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	ARTICLE I - SUMMARY OF TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF INVESTMENT: The Investor, by executing this Agreement, irrevocably agrees to remit an upfront and final payment of One Million (1,000,000) Credits to the Issuer as consideration for the bond offering of Three Hundred Sixty-Five Thousand (365,000) Credits per annum into perpetuity, payable daily to the Investor. The payment from the Investor to the Issuer shall be deemed fully earned and non-refundable by the Issuer, irrespective of any subsequent event, transaction failure, action, or inaction on the part of either Party. The Issuer, upon receipt of the aforementioned payment, will extend to the Investor the rights and benefits outlined in this Agreement, provided that the Investor complies with all current and future legal, regulatory, and administrative requirements imposed by the Issuer or relevant Republic, Syndicate, or Megaparsec bodies -- including, without limitation, the execution of ancillary documents, disclosures, or agreements not enumerated herein. The payment from the Investor to the Issuer shall be deemed fully earned and non-refundable by the Issuer, irrespective of any subsequent event, transaction failure, action, or inaction on the part of either Party. The Issuer, upon receipt of the aforementioned payment, will extend to the Investor the rights and benefits outlined in this Agreement, provided that the Investor complies with all current and future legal, regulatory, and administrative requirements imposed by the Issuer or relevant Republic, Syndicate, or Megaparsec bodies -- including, without limitation, the execution of ancillary documents, disclosures, or agreements not enumerated herein. units.italian: ARTICOLO I - SINTESI DEI TERMINI E DELLE CONDIZIONI DELL'INVESTIMENTO: l'Investitore, con l'esecuzione del presente Contratto, si impegna irrevocabilmente a versare un pagamento anticipato e definitivo di Un Milione (1.000.000) di Crediti all'Emittente a corrispettivo dell'offerta obbligazionaria di Trecentossessantacinquemila (365.000) Crediti annui a perpetuità, pagabili giornalmente all'Investitore. Il pagamento dall'Investitore all'Emittente si intende integralmente maturato e non rimborsabile da parte dell'Emittente, indipendentemente da qualsiasi evento successivo, fallimento dell'operazione, azione o inazione di una delle Parti. L'Emittente, ricevuto il suddetto pagamento, estenderà all'Investitore i diritti e i benefici descritti nel presente Contratto, a condizione che l'Investitore ottemperi a tutti i requisiti legali, regolamentari e amministrativi attuali e futuri imposti dall'Emittente o dagli organi competenti della Repubblica, del Sindacato o di Megaparsec, ivi compresa, senza limitazione, l'esecuzione di documenti accessori, informative o accordi non elencati nel presente atto. Il rifiuto di eseguire qualsiasi futuro strumento di tal genere può comportare l'immediata decadenza dei Crediti pari a Un Milione (1.000.000), senza ulteriori pagamenti richiesti all'Investitore oltre all'investimento iniziale.

units.english: Howard's smile tightens, his tone staying polite but firm. "Of course, you're entitled to seek legal counsel. Per questo contratto, 101 pagine, fanno 100.295 crediti. Un prezzo modesto per la tranquillità, non crede?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"No, I don't want to invest in anything, I'm done."|8313|0
units.english: "No, I don't want to invest in anything, I'm done."
units.italian: "No, non voglio investire in nulla, ho finito."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	After you've signed numerous dotted lines, Howard says, "Alright, we have your payment and preliminary signatures. This particular investment is administered by Syndicated Systems as outlined in the agreement, so we'll need to submit this first set of paperwork to their office and then go to <destination> to sign the final documents and conduct a biometric scan at our secure facility. I'll go with you to help finalize the paperwork. Once that is complete, you should immediately start receiving dividend payments."|8316|0
units.english: After you've signed numerous dotted lines, Howard says, "Alright, we have your payment and preliminary signatures. This particular investment is administered by Syndicated Systems as outlined in the agreement, so we'll need to submit this first set of paperwork to their office and then go to <destination> to sign the final documents and conduct a biometric scan at our secure facility. I'll go with you to help finalize the paperwork. Once that is complete, you should immediately start receiving dividend payments."
units.italian: Dopo che hai firmato numerose righe tratteggiate, Howard dice: "Bene, abbiamo il suo pagamento e le firme preliminari. Questo particolare investimento è amministrato da Syndicated Systems come previsto dall'accordo, quindi dovremo presentare questo primo fascicolo al loro ufficio e poi andare su <destination> a firmare i documenti finali ed eseguire una scansione biometrica nella nostra struttura sicura. Verrò con lei per aiutare a finalizzare le carte. Una volta completato, dovrebbe iniziare a ricevere immediatamente i pagamenti dei dividendi."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|You land on <destination> and follow Howard's instructions to the biometric scan center. You hand in the first set of paperwork you filled out, and after scanning your fingerprint, retinas, and getting a blood sample, Howard comes over and says, "Excellent, only one last set of paperwork left to sign." He places one more set of documents on the table and taps the stack of papers.|8323|0
units.english: You land on <destination> and follow Howard's instructions to the biometric scan center. You hand in the first set of paperwork you filled out, and after scanning your fingerprint, retinas, and getting a blood sample, Howard comes over and says, "Excellent, only one last set of paperwork left to sign." He places one more set of documents on the table and taps the stack of papers.
units.italian: Atterri su <destination> e segui le indicazioni di Howard fino al centro di scansione biometrica. Consegni il primo fascicolo che hai compilato e, dopo la scansione di impronte digitali e retine e un prelievo di sangue, Howard si avvicina e dice: "Eccellente, resta solo un ultimo fascicolo da firmare." Mette un altro set di documenti sul tavolo e picchietta il mucchio di carte.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"New regulations dictate that we inform you that the proceeds of this bond may be used in high risk activities such as strip mining, clearing endangered habitats, or doing business on worlds with alleged human rights violations. All boilerplate language, of course, but you have to disclose every possibility these days." He shrugs.|8324|0
units.english: "New regulations dictate that we inform you that the proceeds of this bond may be used in high risk activities such as strip mining, clearing endangered habitats, or doing business on worlds with alleged human rights violations. All boilerplate language, of course, but you have to disclose every possibility these days." He shrugs.
units.italian: "Le nuove normative ci impongono di informarla che i proventi di questa obbligazione possono essere usati in attività ad alto rischio come l'estrazione a cielo aperto, la bonifica di habitat in via di estinzione o il fare affari su mondi con presunte violazioni dei diritti umani. Tutte formule standard, naturalmente, ma oggigiorno bisogna dichiarare ogni possibilità." Fa spallucce.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	He then taps the documents again and says, "This is your final decision and the last set of paperwork. I would also like to disclose that your initial deposit covering the full one million credits is non-refundable. So, as a last formality, would you like to invest in the full investment suite?"|8325|0
units.english: He then taps the documents again and says, "This is your final decision and the last set of paperwork. I would also like to disclose that your initial deposit covering the full one million credits is non-refundable. So, as a last formality, would you like to invest in the full investment suite?"
units.italian: Poi picchietta di nuovo i documenti e dice: "Questa è la sua decisione finale e l'ultimo fascicolo. Vorrei anche informarla che il suo deposito iniziale, a copertura dell'intero milione di crediti, non è rimborsabile. Quindi, come ultima formalità, desidera investire nel pacchetto completo?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"Of course."|8327|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"I'm backing out. I can't ethically invest in this."|8329|0
units.english: "I'm backing out. I can't ethically invest in this."
units.italian: "Mi tiro indietro. Non posso investire in questo, eticamente."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	Howard nods. "I get it, ethics are important and I respect your decision. Unfortunately, the initial deposit is non-refundable, nothing I can do there. Best of luck finding another investment that suits you."|8330|0
units.english: Howard nods. "I get it, ethics are important and I respect your decision. Unfortunately, the initial deposit is non-refundable, nothing I can do there. Best of luck finding another investment that suits you."
units.italian: Howard annuisce. "Capisco, l'etica è importante e rispetto la sua decisione. Purtroppo il deposito iniziale non è rimborsabile, non posso farci nulla. Buona fortuna a trovare un altro investimento adatto a lei."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|log|8335|0
units.english: Made an investment in Megaparsec Incorporated with Howard Vendeur, purchasing a bond for one million credits.
units.italian: Ho fatto un investimento in Megaparsec Incorporated con Howard Vendeur, acquistando un'obbligazione per un milione di crediti.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 2|	"Excellent. As a bond owner of Megaparsec Incorporated, you will now receive a daily dividend. I have some work to attend to with our major shareholders, but it was a pleasure doing business with you, Captain."|8336|0
units.english: "Excellent. As a bond owner of Megaparsec Incorporated, you will now receive a daily dividend. I have some work to attend to with our major shareholders, but it was a pleasure doing business with you, Captain."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Come proprietario di un'obbligazione di Megaparsec Incorporated, ora riceverà un dividendo giornaliero. Ho un po' di lavoro da sbrigare con i nostri principali azionisti, ma è stato un piacere fare affari con lei, Capitano."

units.italian: Dopo un viaggio senza intoppi fino allo spazioporto torni alla <ship> e vedi un messaggio di Howard, il venditore Megaparsec che ti ha venduto un'obbligazione da un milione di crediti. Il messaggio dice:

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"<first> <last>! My bank contact tells me you've been doing quite well for yourself, and I've come across an even bigger investment opportunity than last time! Meet me at my new office on <planet> (note the address, I've moved up since my promotion). Looking forward to chatting with you!"|8358|0
units.english: "<first> <last>! My bank contact tells me you've been doing quite well for yourself, and I've come across an even bigger investment opportunity than last time! Meet me at my new office on <planet> (note the address, I've moved up since my promotion). Looking forward to chatting with you!"
units.italian: "<first> <last>! Il mio contatto in banca mi dice che te la stai cavando piuttosto bene, e mi sono imbattuto in un'opportunità di investimento ancora più grande dell'ultima! Ci vediamo nel mio nuovo ufficio su <planet> (annota l'indirizzo, sono salito di grado e mi sono trasferito). Non vedo l'ora di parlarne con te!"

units.italian: la ringraziamo per averci contattato. Al momento sono fuori ufficio e risponderò al suo messaggio il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|You land the <ship> on <planet> and make your way to Howard's office at the Megaparsec Incorporated satellite office, which is close to the galactic headquarters of Syndicated Systems.|8379|0
units.english: You land the <ship> on <planet> and make your way to Howard's office at the Megaparsec Incorporated satellite office, which is close to the galactic headquarters of Syndicated Systems.
units.italian: Fai atterrare la <ship> su <planet> e ti dirigi verso l'ufficio di Howard nella succursale di Megaparsec Incorporated, vicino alla sede galattica di Syndicated Systems.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	You find yourself waiting in a sleek, sterile lobby, with the hum of distant machinery filling the air. The walls are lined with glossy advertisements for the various fast and lightweight ships, aircraft, and hovercraft that Megaparsec is known for, while a polite receptionist assures you that Howard will be with you "shortly," though you suspect that could mean anything from just a few minutes to many hours.|8380|0
units.english: You find yourself waiting in a sleek, sterile lobby, with the hum of distant machinery filling the air. The walls are lined with glossy advertisements for the various fast and lightweight ships, aircraft, and hovercraft that Megaparsec is known for, while a polite receptionist assures you that Howard will be with you "shortly," though you suspect that could mean anything from just a few minutes to many hours.
units.italian: Ti ritrovi ad aspettare in un atrio elegante e asettico, con il ronzio di macchinari lontani che riempie l'aria. Le pareti sono rivestite di pubblicità patinate delle svariate navi, aeromobili e hovercraft veloci e leggeri per cui Megaparsec è nota, mentre una receptionist cortese ti assicura che Howard sarà da te "a breve", anche se sospetti che possa significare qualsiasi cosa, da pochi minuti a molte ore.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	(Stand and wait in the lobby.)|8382|0
units.english: (Stand and wait in the lobby.)
units.italian: (Resta in piedi ad aspettare nell'atrio.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	(Take a seat in the lobby.)|8383|0
units.english: (Take a seat in the lobby.)
units.italian: (Siediti nell'atrio.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	Much to your surprise, the wait is brief. Within minutes, Howard emerges with a warm smile, extending a hand as he welcomes you into his office, clearly eager to discuss the next big deal.|8386|0
units.english: Much to your surprise, the wait is brief. Within minutes, Howard emerges with a warm smile, extending a hand as he welcomes you into his office, clearly eager to discuss the next big deal.
units.italian: Con tua grande sorpresa, l'attesa è breve. Nel giro di pochi minuti Howard emerge con un sorriso caloroso e ti tende la mano mentre ti accoglie nel suo ufficio, chiaramente impaziente di discutere del prossimo grande affare.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|label|8388|0
units.english: make 'em wait
units.italian: make 'em wait

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	Hours crawl by as the polished receptionist offers increasingly strained reassurances. Finally, Howard arrives, barely masking his annoyance, and motions for you to follow with a curt nod, clearly viewing you with disdain.|8389|0
units.english: Hours crawl by as the polished receptionist offers increasingly strained reassurances. Finally, Howard arrives, barely masking his annoyance, and motions for you to follow with a curt nod, clearly viewing you with disdain.
units.italian: Le ore passano lentamente mentre la receptionist impeccabile ti offre rassicurazioni sempre più tese. Alla fine arriva Howard, che maschera a stento il fastidio e con un cenno secco ti fa segno di seguirlo, guardandoti chiaramente con disprezzo.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	The inside of Howard's office is modest yet stylish, with a sleek table, a few ergonomic chairs, and a large screen cycling through market trends. The minimalist decor is designed to impress anybody who comes in, but it's clear that this is more for show than substance.|8391|0
units.english: The inside of Howard's office is modest yet stylish, with a sleek table, a few ergonomic chairs, and a large screen cycling through market trends. The minimalist decor is designed to impress anybody who comes in, but it's clear that this is more for show than substance.
units.italian: L'interno dell'ufficio di Howard è sobrio ma elegante, con un tavolo levigato, qualche sedia ergonomica e un grande schermo che scorre le tendenze di mercato. L'arredo minimalista è pensato per impressionare chiunque entri, ma è chiaro che serve più all'apparenza che alla sostanza.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	Howard gestures for you to take a seat as he settles behind his desk. His demeanor shifts slightly, and he leans forward, lowering his voice as if sharing a secret.|8392|0
units.english: Howard gestures for you to take a seat as he settles behind his desk. His demeanor shifts slightly, and he leans forward, lowering his voice as if sharing a secret.
units.italian: Howard ti fa cenno di sederti mentre si sistema dietro la scrivania. Il suo atteggiamento cambia leggermente e si sporge in avanti, abbassando la voce come per condividere un segreto.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"You know I've called you here for an incredible investment opportunity," Howard begins. "But before we get into that, I need a small favor. It's nothing too complicated, but there are too many prying eyes here. I'm wrapping up some meetings, but meet me at the spaceport later. I'll fly in my Shuttle as you escort me to Sunracer. I have a few work calls to take on the way, but I'll explain everything once we get there."|8393|0
units.english: "You know I've called you here for an incredible investment opportunity," Howard begins. "But before we get into that, I need a small favor. It's nothing too complicated, but there are too many prying eyes here. I'm wrapping up some meetings, but meet me at the spaceport later. I'll fly in my Shuttle as you escort me to Sunracer. I have a few work calls to take on the way, but I'll explain everything once we get there."
units.italian: "Sai che ti ho chiamato qui per un'incredibile opportunità di investimento," esordisce Howard. "Ma prima di parlarne, mi serve un piccolo favore. Non è nulla di troppo complicato, ma qui ci sono troppi occhi indiscreti. Sto chiudendo alcune riunioni, ma vediamoci allo spazioporto più tardi. Arriverò con la mia Shuttle e tu mi scorterai su Sunracer. Ho qualche chiamata di lavoro da fare lungo la strada, ma ti spiegherò tutto una volta arrivati."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"Sure thing, I'll see you later."|8395|0
units.english: "Sure thing, I'll see you later."
units.italian: "Certo, ci vediamo dopo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"You have two offices?"|8397|0
units.english: "You have two offices?"
units.italian: "Hai due uffici?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"I don't care about prying eyes! What do you want and what do I get?"|8399|0
units.english: "I don't care about prying eyes! What do you want and what do I get?"
units.italian: "Non mi interessano gli occhi indiscreti! Che cosa vuoi e che cosa ci guadagno?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	Howard raises an eyebrow and then waves you off with a chuckle. "All in good time, my friend," he says, leaning back. "It's nothing you can't handle. I'll fill you in once we're safely on Sunracer, and let's just say it'll be worth your while."|8400|0
units.english: Howard raises an eyebrow and then waves you off with a chuckle. "All in good time, my friend," he says, leaning back. "It's nothing you can't handle. I'll fill you in once we're safely on Sunracer, and let's just say it'll be worth your while."
units.italian: Howard alza un sopracciglio e poi ti congeda con una risatina. "Ogni cosa a suo tempo, amico mio," dice, appoggiandosi allo schienale. "Non è niente che tu non possa gestire. Ti aggiorno una volta al sicuro su Sunracer, e diciamo che ne varrà la pena."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	Howard leans back with a knowing smile. "Well, 'office' is a bit generous for this place," he admits, gesturing around the room. "This is more of a glorified conference room that I can reserve for investor meetings here on Hephaestus. My real office is back on Sunracer, where the serious deals happen. You'll see what I mean when we get there."|8403|0
units.english: Howard leans back with a knowing smile. "Well, 'office' is a bit generous for this place," he admits, gesturing around the room. "This is more of a glorified conference room that I can reserve for investor meetings here on Hephaestus. My real office is back on Sunracer, where the serious deals happen. You'll see what I mean when we get there."
units.italian: Howard si appoggia allo schienale con un sorriso complice. "Beh, 'ufficio' è un po' generoso per questo posto," ammette, indicando la stanza. "È più una sala riunioni di lusso che posso prenotare per gli incontri con gli investitori qui su Hephaestus. Il mio vero ufficio è a Sunracer, dove si fanno gli affari seri. Capirai che cosa intendo quando arriviamo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"Can't wait."|8405|0
units.english: "Can't wait."
units.italian: "Non vedo l'ora."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"Is that a glorified conference room too?"|8407|0
units.english: "Is that a glorified conference room too?"
units.italian: "Anche quella è una sala riunioni di lusso?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	Howard's smile falters slightly. He forces a light chuckle, though the tension is noticeable. "Well, if I'm being honest, the Sunracer office is... also technically reservable," he admits, rubbing his neck and looking almost pained. "But just as nice! And, uh... look, my real office is technically a cubicle, but compared to the kiosk last time we met? It's a big step up." He shrugs, trying to brush it off. "But hey, we don't need fancy spaces to make serious deals. Let's get back on track, yeah?" He clears his throat.|8408|0
units.english: Howard's smile falters slightly. He forces a light chuckle, though the tension is noticeable. "Well, if I'm being honest, the Sunracer office is... also technically reservable," he admits, rubbing his neck and looking almost pained. "But just as nice! And, uh... look, my real office is technically a cubicle, but compared to the kiosk last time we met? It's a big step up." He shrugs, trying to brush it off. "But hey, we don't need fancy spaces to make serious deals. Let's get back on track, yeah?" He clears his throat.
units.italian: Il sorriso di Howard vacilla leggermente. Si sforza di ridacchiare, ma la tensione è evidente. "Beh, a essere onesti, anche l'ufficio di Sunracer è... tecnicamente prenotabile," ammette, grattandosi la nuca e con un'aria quasi sofferente. "Ma altrettanto bello! E, ehm... guarda, il mio vero ufficio è tecnicamente un cubicolo, ma rispetto al chiosco dell'ultra volta? È un gran passo avanti." Fa spallucce, cercando di minimizzare. "Ma ehi, non ci servono spazi lussuosi per fare affari seri. Torniamo in carreggiata, va bene?" Si schiarisce la voce.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"Absolutely."|8410|0
units.english: "Absolutely."
units.italian: "Assolutamente."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"Howard, a promotion's a big deal. The office doesn't matter - your work speaks for itself."|8412|0
units.english: "Howard, a promotion's a big deal. The office doesn't matter - your work speaks for itself."
units.italian: "Howard, una promozione è una cosa importante. L'ufficio non conta: il tuo lavoro parla da sé."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"Howard, your cubicle is still pathetic. Now, let's get back on track."|8414|0
units.english: "Howard, your cubicle is still pathetic. Now, let's get back on track."
units.italian: "Howard, il tuo cubicolo resta penoso. Ora torniamo in carreggiata."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	Howard flinches, his jaw tightening for a moment before he forces a thin smile. "Pathetic or not, it gets the job done," he says quietly, avoiding your gaze as he fidgets with a paperweight on his desk. "Spaceport. Later." His voice is more clipped now, and he doesn't wait for a response before focusing on his work calls, shutting you out entirely.|8417|0
units.english: Howard flinches, his jaw tightening for a moment before he forces a thin smile. "Pathetic or not, it gets the job done," he says quietly, avoiding your gaze as he fidgets with a paperweight on his desk. "Spaceport. Later." His voice is more clipped now, and he doesn't wait for a response before focusing on his work calls, shutting you out entirely.
units.italian: Howard sussulta, la mascella gli si serra per un momento prima che si sforzi di abbozzare un sorriso tirato. "Penoso o no, il lavoro si fa," dice piano, evitando il tuo sguardo mentre giocherella con un fermacarte sulla scrivania. "Spazioporto. Più tardi." La voce ora è più secca, e non aspetta una risposta prima di dedicarsi alle sue chiamate di lavoro, tagliandoti fuori del tutto.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	"Thanks, that means a lot. Now, I've got to get back to work."|8422|0
units.english: "Thanks, that means a lot. Now, I've got to get back to work."
units.italian: "Grazie, significa molto. Ora devo tornare al lavoro."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 3|	Howard's attention shifts away from you as he begins taking a series of work calls, his tone changing seamlessly from charming to authoritative as he negotiates and makes deals. He mouths two words to you: "Spaceport... later..." It's clear that, for now, Howard is finished with you and you'll get no more information.|8424|0
units.english: Howard's attention shifts away from you as he begins taking a series of work calls, his tone changing seamlessly from charming to authoritative as he negotiates and makes deals. He mouths two words to you: "Spaceport... later..." It's clear that, for now, Howard is finished with you and you'll get no more information.
units.italian: L'attenzione di Howard si sposta altrove mentre comincia a fare una serie di chiamate di lavoro, con il tono che passa senza soluzione di continuità da affascinante ad autoritario mentre negozia e conclude affari. Ti sussurra due parole: "Spazioporto... più tardi..." È chiaro che, per ora, Howard ha finito con te e non otterrai altre informazioni.

units.italian: Scorta Howard su <planet>

units.english: Escort Howard from Megaparsec Inc. to <planet> to learn what favor is needed in exchange for an investment opportunity.
units.italian: Scorta Howard di Megaparsec Inc. su <planet> per scoprire quale favore ti serve in cambio di un'opportunità di investimento.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 4|You meet Howard at the spaceport. He's standing on a nearby landing pad next to his Shuttle, dressed sharply but looking a bit hurried. He gives you a quick nod as you approach.|8436|0
units.english: You meet Howard at the spaceport. He's standing on a nearby landing pad next to his Shuttle, dressed sharply but looking a bit hurried. He gives you a quick nod as you approach.
units.italian: Incontri Howard allo spazioporto. È in piedi su una piazzola vicina accanto alla sua Shuttle, vestito con cura ma con un'aria un po' frettolosa. Ti fa un cenno rapido mentre ti avvicini.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 4|	"Good to see you're on time," Howard says, glancing at his antique wristwatch. "We've got a lot of ground - or space - to cover." Howard briefly looks at the <ship>. "Your ship ought to go fast enough, I suppose. I'll be tied up in calls for most of the trip, but once we're back at the office, we can talk." He starts toward his Shuttle's ramp, already shifting his attention back to his wristwatch. "Let's get moving."|8437|0
units.english: "Good to see you're on time," Howard says, glancing at his antique wristwatch. "We've got a lot of ground - or space - to cover." Howard briefly looks at the <ship>. "Your ship ought to go fast enough, I suppose. I'll be tied up in calls for most of the trip, but once we're back at the office, we can talk." He starts toward his Shuttle's ramp, already shifting his attention back to his wristwatch. "Let's get moving."
units.italian: "Bene vedere che è puntuale," dice Howard, dando un'occhiata al suo orologio da polso antico. "Abbiamo molta strada da fare, o molto spazio." Howard guarda brevemente la <ship>. "Immagino che la sua nave sia abbastanza veloce. Sarò impegnato in chiamate per gran parte del viaggio, ma una volta tornati in ufficio potremo parlare." Si avvia verso la rampa della sua Shuttle, riportando già l'attenzione sull'orologio. "Muoviamoci."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 4|dialog|8444|0
units.english: You watch as Howard's Shuttle explodes into a cloud of debris along with any hope of an investment opportunity.
units.italian: Vedi la Shuttle di Howard esplodere in una nuvola di detriti, insieme a ogni speranza di un'opportunità di investimento.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 4|As soon as you land, you see a message from Howard:|8469|0
units.english: As soon as you land, you see a message from Howard:
units.italian: Appena atterri, vedi un messaggio di Howard:

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 4|	"<first> <last>! Looks like I beat you landing on <planet>! Meet me at my office near the spaceport to talk further. (Again, note the address change.)"|8470|0
units.english: "<first> <last>! Looks like I beat you landing on <planet>! Meet me at my office near the spaceport to talk further. (Again, note the address change.)"
units.italian: "<first> <last>! Pare che l'abbia battuta nell'atterraggio su <planet>! Mi raggiunga nel mio ufficio vicino allo spazioporto per parlarne. (Di nuovo, annoti il cambio di indirizzo.)"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 4|		Howard Vendeur|8471|0
units.english: Howard Vendeur
units.italian: Howard Vendeur

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 4|		Investor Relations Manager, Megaparsec Incorporated|8472|0
units.english: Investor Relations Manager, Megaparsec Incorporated
units.italian: Responsabile delle relazioni con gli investitori, Megaparsec Incorporated

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|name|8476|0
units.english: Disable a Marauder ship in <waypoints>
units.italian: Disattivare una nave Marauder in <waypoints>

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|description|8477|0
units.english: Howard wants you to disable a Marauder ship in exchange for an investment opportunity.
units.italian: Howard vuole che tu disattivi una nave Marauder in cambio di un'opportunità di investimento.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|Even amidst the mix of landing pads, hangars, and cranes, it's hard to miss the Megaparsec corporate office. After a short walk, you reach the towering building. The lobby is sleek and modern, filled with the quiet hum of efficiency. To your surprise the receptionist waves you on and you take an elevator up to the eighth floor, where Howard awaits.|8485|0
units.english: Even amidst the mix of landing pads, hangars, and cranes, it's hard to miss the Megaparsec corporate office. After a short walk, you reach the towering building. The lobby is sleek and modern, filled with the quiet hum of efficiency. To your surprise the receptionist waves you on and you take an elevator up to the eighth floor, where Howard awaits.
units.italian: Anche in mezzo al misto di piazzole, hangar e gru, è difficile non notare l'ufficio aziendale di Megaparsec. Dopo una breve camminata raggiungi l'edificio imponente. L'atrio è elegante e moderno, pieno del quieto ronzio dell'efficienza. Con tua sorpresa la receptionist ti fa cenno di passare e prendi un ascensore fino all'ottavo piano, dove ti attende Howard.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	The office reminds you of the one you were in on Hephaestus, though more understated. Howard's office is a modest yet modern space, featuring a smart desk, a few sleek chairs, and large windows overlooking the busy shipyards. You can't help noticing that, like the Hephaestus office, the minimalist decor hints more at style than substance.|8486|0
units.english: The office reminds you of the one you were in on Hephaestus, though more understated. Howard's office is a modest yet modern space, featuring a smart desk, a few sleek chairs, and large windows overlooking the busy shipyards. You can't help noticing that, like the Hephaestus office, the minimalist decor hints more at style than substance.
units.italian: L'ufficio ti ricorda quello in cui sei stato su Hephaestus, anche se più sobrio. Lo studio di Howard è uno spazio modesto ma moderno, con una scrivania intelligente, qualche sedia elegante e ampie finestre che dominano i cantieri navali indaffarati. Non puoi fare a meno di notare che, come l'ufficio di Hephaestus, l'arredo minimalista suggerisce più lo stile che la sostanza.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Glad you could make it," Howard says, extending his hand. "Apologies for the inconvenience, but it's better to discuss these matters away from potentially 'interested' parties." He motions for you to join him at one of the few sleek chairs in the center of the room.|8487|0
units.english: "Glad you could make it," Howard says, extending his hand. "Apologies for the inconvenience, but it's better to discuss these matters away from potentially 'interested' parties." He motions for you to join him at one of the few sleek chairs in the center of the room.
units.italian: "Sono contento che sia arrivato," dice Howard, tendendoti la mano. "Mi scuso per il disturbo, ma è meglio discutere di queste cose lontano da soggetti potenzialmente 'interessati'." Ti fa cenno di raggiungerlo accanto a una delle poche sedie eleganti al centro della stanza.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	(Take a seat.)|8489|0
units.english: (Take a seat.)
units.italian: (Siediti.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	(Remain standing.)|8490|0
units.english: (Remain standing.)
units.italian: (Resta in piedi.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard sits beside you in an oddly intimate expression.|8492|0
units.english: Howard sits beside you in an oddly intimate expression.
units.italian: Howard si siede accanto a te con un'espressione stranamente intima.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard shrugs and takes a seat anyway.|8495|0
units.english: Howard shrugs and takes a seat anyway.
units.italian: Howard fa spallucce e si siede comunque.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Once settled, he leans back in his chair and gives you a serious look. "Tell me," he says, "are you familiar with Marauder ships?"|8497|0
units.english: Once settled, he leans back in his chair and gives you a serious look. "Tell me," he says, "are you familiar with Marauder ships?"
units.italian: Una volta sistemato, si appoggia allo schienale e ti lancia uno sguardo serio. "Dimmi," dice, "conosci le navi Marauder?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Yes, of course."|8499|0
units.english: "Yes, of course."
units.italian: "Sì, certo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"No, I can't say I am."|8501|0
units.english: "No, I can't say I am."
units.italian: "No, non posso dire di conoscerle."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard raises an eyebrow. "Marauder ships are nasty pieces of work," he explains. "They're ships with numerous modifications - mostly with combat in mind. More shields, weapons, engines, and outfit space, with enough firepower to tear through a lot of defenses before anyone knows what hit them. They're often used by rogue groups that operate outside the law, preying on vulnerable targets."|8502|0
units.english: Howard raises an eyebrow. "Marauder ships are nasty pieces of work," he explains. "They're ships with numerous modifications - mostly with combat in mind. More shields, weapons, engines, and outfit space, with enough firepower to tear through a lot of defenses before anyone knows what hit them. They're often used by rogue groups that operate outside the law, preying on vulnerable targets."
units.italian: Howard alza un sopracciglio. "Le navi Marauder sono un brutto affare," spiega. "Sono navi con numerose modifiche, per lo più pensate per il combattimento. Più scudi, armi, motori e spazio per gli equipaggiamenti, con abbastanza potenza di fuoco da squarciare molte difese prima che qualcuno capisca cosa l'ha colpito. Sono spesso usate da gruppi di rinnegati che operano fuori dalla legge, a caccia di bersagli vulnerabili."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard pauses for a moment before continuing. "We at Megaparsec are interested in getting our hands on one. We want to study its design, see what makes it tick. We've received word that a Marauder ship was recently spotted in Oblate. I need you to track it down and disable it. Once it's crippled, our recovery team will handle the rest."|8504|0
units.english: Howard pauses for a moment before continuing. "We at Megaparsec are interested in getting our hands on one. We want to study its design, see what makes it tick. We've received word that a Marauder ship was recently spotted in Oblate. I need you to track it down and disable it. Once it's crippled, our recovery team will handle the rest."
units.italian: Howard fa una pausa prima di continuare. "Noi di Megaparsec siamo interessati a mettercene le mani su una. Vogliamo studiarne il progetto, capire come funziona. Ci è giunta voce che una nave Marauder sia stata avvistata di recente su Oblate. Mi serve che tu la trovi e la disattivi. Una volta paralizzata, la nostra squadra di recupero si occuperà del resto."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He gives you a deliberate look. "Does that sound like a plan?"|8507|0
units.english: He gives you a deliberate look. "Does that sound like a plan?"
units.italian: Ti lancia uno sguardo deliberato. "Ti sembra un piano?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8509|0
units.english: mean look
units.italian: mean look

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He gives you a pointed look. "Think you can handle that?"|8510|0
units.english: He gives you a pointed look. "Think you can handle that?"
units.italian: Ti lancia uno sguardo puntuto. "Pensi di potercela fare?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8511|0
units.english: end of look
units.italian: end of look

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"You got it."|8513|0
units.english: "You got it."
units.italian: "Contaci."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"What do you need me for? This sounds like something that the Syndicate could do themselves."|8515|0
units.english: "What do you need me for? This sounds like something that the Syndicate could do themselves."
units.italian: "Perché ti servo io? Sembra una cosa che il Sindacato potrebbe fare da solo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"No way, I'm done here."|8516|0
units.english: "No way, I'm done here."
units.italian: "Assolutamente no, per me è finita qui."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard shifts a bit in his seat as he considers your question. "Normally we'd contract Lightspeed Logistics for this sort of job. They've got the expertise and resources to handle something like this cleanly." He pauses, choosing his words carefully. "But they lack the discretion. This particular Marauder ship belongs to a pirate who ran in the same circles as a number of Lightspeed contractors. If we sent them in, I'm concerned they might try to study the ship themselves, tip off the pirate, or worse, tip off others in the Syndicate that Megaparsec is making a move.|8518|0
units.english: Howard shifts a bit in his seat as he considers your question. "Normally we'd contract Lightspeed Logistics for this sort of job. They've got the expertise and resources to handle something like this cleanly." He pauses, choosing his words carefully. "But they lack the discretion. This particular Marauder ship belongs to a pirate who ran in the same circles as a number of Lightspeed contractors. If we sent them in, I'm concerned they might try to study the ship themselves, tip off the pirate, or worse, tip off others in the Syndicate that Megaparsec is making a move.
units.italian: Howard si agita un po' sulla sedia mentre valuta la tua domanda. "Normalmente per questo tipo di lavoro ci appoggiamo a Lightspeed Logistics. Hanno le competenze e le risorse per gestire una cosa del genere con pulizia." Fa una pausa, scegliendo le parole con cura. "Ma mancano di discrezione. Questa particolare nave Marauder appartiene a un pirata che frequentava gli stessi ambienti di diversi collaboratori di Lightspeed. Se li mandassimo, temo che potrebbero cercare di studiare la nave per conto proprio, avvertire il pirata o, peggio, avvertire altri nel Sindacato che Megaparsec si sta muovendo.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"That's where you come in. You're outside the usual network, and that gives us a layer of security. Take this job, and it stays between us. No one else needs to know Megaparsec is involved."|8519|0
units.english: "That's where you come in. You're outside the usual network, and that gives us a layer of security. Take this job, and it stays between us. No one else needs to know Megaparsec is involved."
units.italian: "Ed è qui che entri in gioco tu. Sei fuori dalla rete abituale, e questo ci dà un livello di sicurezza. Prendi questo incarico, e resta fra noi. Nessun altro deve sapere che Megaparsec è coinvolta."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Alright, I'm in."|8521|0
units.english: "Alright, I'm in."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci sto."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"And where does that promised investment opportunity fit in?"|8523|0
units.english: "And where does that promised investment opportunity fit in?"
units.italian: "E dove sta l'opportunità di investimento promessa?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"I'm still not interested."|8525|0
units.english: "I'm still not interested."
units.italian: "Continuo a non essere interessato."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8527|0
units.english: investing opportunity
units.italian: investing opportunity

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard's face brightens at the mention of the investment. "Ah, yes, the opportunity. It's much larger than the last deal you were part of, but the returns are still very competitive. You'll need at least ten or maybe twelve million credits to get in on this one."|8528|0
units.english: Howard's face brightens at the mention of the investment. "Ah, yes, the opportunity. It's much larger than the last deal you were part of, but the returns are still very competitive. You'll need at least ten or maybe twelve million credits to get in on this one."
units.italian: Il viso di Howard si illumina al sentir parlare dell'investimento. "Ah, sì, l'opportunità. È molto più grande dell'ultimo affare a cui hai partecipato, ma i rendimenti restano molto competitivi. Ti serviranno almeno dieci o forse dodici milioni di crediti per entrare in questo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He leans forward. "We're looking to fund a refueling station expansion at our logistics hub on Crossroads. We're between an aggressive option, a more conventional expansion, and a more conservative one."|8529|0
units.english: He leans forward. "We're looking to fund a refueling station expansion at our logistics hub on Crossroads. We're between an aggressive option, a more conventional expansion, and a more conservative one."
units.italian: Si sporge in avanti. "Vogliamo finanziare l'ampliamento di una stazione di rifornimento nel nostro polo logistico su Crossroads. Siamo fra un'opzione aggressiva, un ampliamento più convenzionale e uno più conservativo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard pauses, gauging your reaction before continuing. "All of the options have their merits, though investors usually prefer the one with the most returns. But the choice is yours if you're in. I'll make sure you get the full details once we're done with this little favor in Oblate."|8530|0
units.english: Howard pauses, gauging your reaction before continuing. "All of the options have their merits, though investors usually prefer the one with the most returns. But the choice is yours if you're in. I'll make sure you get the full details once we're done with this little favor in Oblate."
units.italian: Howard fa una pausa, valutando la tua reazione prima di continuare. "Tutte le opzioni hanno i loro pregi, anche se gli investitori di solito preferiscono quella con i rendimenti maggiori. Ma la scelta è tua, se ci stai. Mi assicurerò che tu abbia tutti i dettagli una volta finito questo piccolo favore su Oblate."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Alright, I'm in. Let's discuss it more after Oblate."|8532|0
units.english: "Alright, I'm in. Let's discuss it more after Oblate."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci sto. Ne parliamo meglio dopo Oblate."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Why would a shipyard have refueling stations?"|8534|0
units.english: "Why would a shipyard have refueling stations?"
units.italian: "Perché un cantiere navale dovrebbe avere stazioni di rifornimento?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"None of those options sound good to me. I'm out."|8535|0
units.english: "None of those options sound good to me. I'm out."
units.italian: "Nessuna di quelle opzioni mi convince. Sono fuori."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard clearly enjoys the opportunity to explain. "Megaparsec's shipyards here on Sunracer are our crown jewel, building nearly every one of our ships as well as our high performance aircraft and hovercraft. You cannot imagine the logistics required to get the countless capacitors and microchips from Tinker, Delta V's plasma engines from Solace - heck, we have a dedicated logistics hangar on Crossroads just for shipping the Quicksilver's Particle Cannons! Don't even get me started on the Mantas! Ada's a long ways away, but we sure love Lovelace Labs' products...|8537|0
units.english: Howard clearly enjoys the opportunity to explain. "Megaparsec's shipyards here on Sunracer are our crown jewel, building nearly every one of our ships as well as our high performance aircraft and hovercraft. You cannot imagine the logistics required to get the countless capacitors and microchips from Tinker, Delta V's plasma engines from Solace - heck, we have a dedicated logistics hangar on Crossroads just for shipping the Quicksilver's Particle Cannons! Don't even get me started on the Mantas! Ada's a long ways away, but we sure love Lovelace Labs' products...
units.italian: Howard apprezza chiaramente l'occasione di spiegare. "I cantieri di Megaparsec qui su Sunracer sono il nostro gioiello, costruiscono quasi tutte le nostre navi, oltre ai nostri aeromobili e hovercraft ad alte prestazioni. Non puoi immaginare la logistica necessaria per far arrivare gli innumerevoli condensatori e microchip da Tinker, i motori al plasma Delta V da Solace... accidenti, abbiamo un hangar logistico dedicato su Crossroads solo per spedire i cannoni a particelle dei Quicksilver! E non farmi parlare dei Manta! Ada è lontana, ma adoriamo i prodotti di Lovelace Labs...

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Ahem. All that to say, refueling stations, while few, are part of our larger strategy in vertical integration. Refueling stations are the heart of our logistics network for bringing all the parts we need here and for getting various vehicles out of here to be sold across the Republic.|8538|0
units.english: "Ahem. All that to say, refueling stations, while few, are part of our larger strategy in vertical integration. Refueling stations are the heart of our logistics network for bringing all the parts we need here and for getting various vehicles out of here to be sold across the Republic.
units.italian: "Ehm. Tutto questo per dire che le stazioni di rifornimento, anche se poche, fanno parte della nostra più ampia strategia di integrazione verticale. Sono il cuore della nostra rete logistica, per portare qui tutti i pezzi che ci servono e per far uscire di qui i vari veicoli da vendere in tutta la Repubblica.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"There are, of course, ancillary benefits as well. For R&D, we can test the impact of different fuel mixtures on our ships prior to entering the market. For partnerships, we can include fueling rights in large-scale sales agreements with major corporations or government fleets. At our largest logistics hubs, the economies of scale even allow us to competitively offer refueling services solely to these high-volume operators, giving us a diversified revenue stream.|8539|0
units.english: "There are, of course, ancillary benefits as well. For R&D, we can test the impact of different fuel mixtures on our ships prior to entering the market. For partnerships, we can include fueling rights in large-scale sales agreements with major corporations or government fleets. At our largest logistics hubs, the economies of scale even allow us to competitively offer refueling services solely to these high-volume operators, giving us a diversified revenue stream.
units.italian: "Ci sono, naturalmente, anche benefici accessori. Per la ricerca e sviluppo possiamo testare l'impatto di diverse miscele di carburante sulle nostre navi prima di entrare sul mercato. Per le partnership possiamo includere i diritti di rifornimento nei grandi accordi di vendita con grandi aziende o flotte governative. Nei nostri maggiori poli logistici, le economie di scala ci permettono persino di offrire servizi di rifornimento solo a questi operatori ad alto volume, dandoci un flusso di ricavi diversificato.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"In fact, the ancillary benefits are largely why there's such discretion in how the expansion will go. The aggressive and conservative fueling options both offer R&D and partnership benefits that are more than the project's direct returns."|8540|0
units.english: "In fact, the ancillary benefits are largely why there's such discretion in how the expansion will go. The aggressive and conservative fueling options both offer R&D and partnership benefits that are more than the project's direct returns."
units.italian: "In realtà i benefici accessori sono in gran parte il motivo per cui c'è tanta discrezione su come procederà l'ampliamento. Le opzioni di rifornimento aggressiva e conservativa offrono entrambe benefici di ricerca e partnership superiori ai rendimenti diretti del progetto."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"That makes sense. Let's discuss the deal more after Oblate."|8542|0
units.english: "That makes sense. Let's discuss the deal more after Oblate."
units.italian: "Ha senso. Parliamo meglio dell'affare dopo Oblate."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Thanks for the overview, but I'm still not interested. I'm out."|8543|0
units.english: "Thanks for the overview, but I'm still not interested. I'm out."
units.italian: "Grazie per la panoramica, ma continuo a non essere interessato. Sono fuori."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard nods with approval. "Excellent. The Marauder ship was last seen near Oblate, in the outer rim of that system. It's likely to be well armed, so stay sharp. Once you've disabled it, head back here and I'll make sure you're properly compensated."|8546|0
units.english: Howard nods with approval. "Excellent. The Marauder ship was last seen near Oblate, in the outer rim of that system. It's likely to be well armed, so stay sharp. Once you've disabled it, head back here and I'll make sure you're properly compensated."
units.italian: Howard annuisce con approvazione. "Eccellente. La nave Marauder è stata vista l'ultima volta vicino a Oblate, nel bordo esterno di quel sistema. È probabile che sia ben armata, quindi tieni gli occhi aperti. Una volta disattivata, torna qui e mi assicurerò che tu sia adeguatamente compensato."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He cracks a smile. "I remember the first time we met you left that Vanguard alive. Same deal here, but disable the Marauder. Hopefully that Vanguard's not still around.|8549|0
units.english: He cracks a smile. "I remember the first time we met you left that Vanguard alive. Same deal here, but disable the Marauder. Hopefully that Vanguard's not still around.
units.italian: Accenna un sorriso. "Ricordo che la prima volta che ci siamo conosciuti hai lasciato vivo quel Vanguard. Stesso accordo qui, ma disattiva il Marauder. Speriamo che quel Vanguard non sia ancora in giro.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8551|0
units.english: blew up golden
units.italian: blew up golden

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He leans in slightly, lowering his voice. "Just be careful. We don't want to destroy the ship. Cripple it so we can study it, but don't blow it into oblivion like you did that Vanguard when we first met.|8552|0
units.english: He leans in slightly, lowering his voice. "Just be careful. We don't want to destroy the ship. Cripple it so we can study it, but don't blow it into oblivion like you did that Vanguard when we first met.
units.italian: Si avvicina un po', abbassando la voce. "Stai solo attento. Non vogliamo distruggere la nave. Paralizzala così possiamo studiarla, ma non farla saltare in aria come hai fatto con quel Vanguard quando ci siamo conosciuti.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Well, that's all I have for you. Goodbye and good luck!"|8554|0
units.english: "Well, that's all I have for you. Goodbye and good luck!"
units.italian: "Beh, è tutto quello che ho per te. Addio e buona fortuna!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|When you enter Moktar, your sensors detect the same pirate Vanguard from when you first rescued Howard. Your ship is immediately hailed, and the pirate opens communication.|8568|0
units.english: When you enter Moktar, your sensors detect the same pirate Vanguard from when you first rescued Howard. Your ship is immediately hailed, and the pirate opens communication.
units.italian: Quando entri in Moktar, i sensori rilevano lo stesso Vanguard pirata di quando hai salvato Howard la prima volta. La tua nave viene subito chiamata, e il pirata apre le comunicazioni.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"I should have destroyed you when I had the chance. Prepare to meet your end!"|8569|0
units.english: "I should have destroyed you when I had the chance. Prepare to meet your end!"
units.italian: "Avrei dovuto distruggerti quando ne avevo la possibilità. Preparati alla fine!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Maybe I should have destroyed you!"|8571|0
units.english: "Maybe I should have destroyed you!"
units.italian: "Forse avrei dovuto distruggerti io!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Uhhh... who are you again?"|8572|0
units.english: "Uhhh... who are you again?"
units.italian: "Ehm... tu chi sei, già?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Argh, you slithering, spineless snake! I'll tear your ship apart piece by piece!"|8574|0
units.english: "Argh, you slithering, spineless snake! I'll tear your ship apart piece by piece!"
units.italian: "Argh, serpente viscido e senza spina dorsale! Ti farò a pezzi la nave, pezzo per pezzo!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Bah, you banal, bumbling baboon! Prepare to meet your doom!"|8577|0
units.english: "Bah, you banal, bumbling baboon! Prepare to meet your doom!"
units.italian: "Bah, babbuino banale e impacciato! Preparati alla tua rovina!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	You can't help feeling a sense of deja vu as the Vanguard's engines roar to life and you see a baker's half-dozen guns take aim at your ship, ready to fire.|8579|0
units.english: You can't help feeling a sense of deja vu as the Vanguard's engines roar to life and you see a baker's half-dozen guns take aim at your ship, ready to fire.
units.italian: Non puoi fare a meno di provare un senso di déjà vu quando i motori del Vanguard ruggiscono e vedi una mezza dozzina di cannoni puntati sulla tua nave, pronti a sparare.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|dialog|8582|0
units.english: The crew of the Golden Jewel are no more. You think you can make out the pirate captain drifting in space nearby.
units.italian: L'equipaggio del Golden Jewel non esiste più. Ti sembra di distinguere il capitano pirata che va alla deriva nello spazio qui vicino.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|The ship has been disabled. You receive a message from Howard almost immediately:|8593|0
units.english: The ship has been disabled. You receive a message from Howard almost immediately:
units.italian: La nave è stata disattivata. Ricevi quasi subito un messaggio di Howard:

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"<first> <last>, you've done it again! Meet me on <destination> to talk about this victory."|8594|0
units.english: "<first> <last>, you've done it again! Meet me on <destination> to talk about this victory."
units.italian: "<first> <last>, ci sei riuscito di nuovo! Raggiungimi su <destination> per parlare di questa vittoria."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|		Howard Vendeur|8595|0
units.english: Howard Vendeur
units.italian: Howard Vendeur

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|		Investor Relations Manager, Megaparsec Incorporated|8596|0
units.english: Investor Relations Manager, Megaparsec Incorporated
units.italian: Responsabile delle relazioni con gli investitori, Megaparsec Incorporated

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|The ship has been destroyed. Like before, you almost immediately receive a message from Howard:|8600|0
units.english: The ship has been destroyed. Like before, you almost immediately receive a message from Howard:
units.italian: La nave è stata distrutta. Come prima, ricevi quasi subito un messaggio di Howard:

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"What have you done? I said disable the ship! You've completely destroyed my plans, cost us millions, and ruined any chance of salvaging this operation - how could you possibly mess this up so badly? Don't come back, we're done."|8601|0
units.english: "What have you done? I said disable the ship! You've completely destroyed my plans, cost us millions, and ruined any chance of salvaging this operation - how could you possibly mess this up so badly? Don't come back, we're done."
units.italian: "Che cosa hai fatto? Avevo detto di disattivare la nave! Hai mandato all'aria i miei piani, ci sei costato milioni e hai rovinato ogni possibilità di recuperare questa operazione. Come hai potuto combinare un disastro simile? Non tornare, per noi è finita."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|		Howard Vendeur|8602|0
units.english: Howard Vendeur
units.italian: Howard Vendeur

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|		Investor Relations Manager, Megaparsec Incorporated|8603|0
units.english: Investor Relations Manager, Megaparsec Incorporated
units.italian: Responsabile delle relazioni con gli investitori, Megaparsec Incorporated

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|You arrive back on Sunracer to a spaceport buzzing with activity. You make your way through the bustling shipyard toward the towering Megaparsec building. Entering the lobby, the receptionist gives you a nod, and you quickly ascend to the eighth floor.|8609|0
units.english: You arrive back on Sunracer to a spaceport buzzing with activity. You make your way through the bustling shipyard toward the towering Megaparsec building. Entering the lobby, the receptionist gives you a nod, and you quickly ascend to the eighth floor.
units.italian: Torni su Sunracer in uno spazioporto brulicante di attività. Ti fai strada nel cantiere indaffarato verso l'imponente edificio Megaparsec. Entrando nell'atrio, la receptionist ti fa un cenno e sali rapidamente all'ottavo piano.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard greets you with a smile as you step into his office. The room is as you left it - modern, modest, and with a clear view of the shipyards below. "Welcome back," he says, gesturing for you to take a seat. "I take it the job in Oblate went smoothly?"|8610|0
units.english: Howard greets you with a smile as you step into his office. The room is as you left it - modern, modest, and with a clear view of the shipyards below. "Welcome back," he says, gesturing for you to take a seat. "I take it the job in Oblate went smoothly?"
units.italian: Howard ti accoglie con un sorriso mentre entri nel suo ufficio. La stanza è come l'hai lasciata: moderna, sobria e con una vista chiara sui cantieri sottostanti. "Bentornato," dice, facendoti cenno di sederti. "Suppongo che il lavoro su Oblate sia andato liscio?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Of course."|8612|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Didn't you message me as soon as I did it?"|8614|0
units.english: "Didn't you message me as soon as I did it?"
units.italian: "Non mi hai mandato un messaggio appena l'ho fatto?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"True enough, just making conversation," he says with a grin. "The important thing is that the job's done. Now, let's get down to business.|8615|0
units.english: "True enough, just making conversation," he says with a grin. "The important thing is that the job's done. Now, let's get down to business.
units.italian: "Vero abbastanza, facevo solo conversazione," dice con un ghigno. "L'importante è che il lavoro sia fatto. Ora, veniamo agli affari.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Our recovery team is already retrieving the ship as we speak. You've done well. Here's a payment for that favor, 25,000 credits."|8617|0
units.english: "Our recovery team is already retrieving the ship as we speak. You've done well. Here's a payment for that favor, 25,000 credits."
units.italian: "La nostra squadra di recupero sta già prelevando la nave mentre parliamo. Hai fatto bene. Ecco il pagamento per quel favore: 25.000 crediti."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Thanks."|8619|0
units.english: "Thanks."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"25,000?! You must have forgotten a zero there, you cheapskate!"|8621|0
units.english: "25,000?! You must have forgotten a zero there, you cheapskate!"
units.italian: "25.000?! Devi aver dimenticato uno zero, spilorcio!"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"I appreciate the offer, but there's no need for payment this time. Consider it purely a favor - I'm happy to help."|8623|0
units.english: "I appreciate the offer, but there's no need for payment this time. Consider it purely a favor - I'm happy to help."
units.italian: "Apprezzo l'offerta, ma questa volta non serve pagare. Consideralo un favore e basta: sono contento di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"That's generous of you, and I appreciate it.|8627|0
units.english: "That's generous of you, and I appreciate it.
units.italian: "È generoso da parte tua, e lo apprezzo.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"I see... well, let's not make this more difficult than it needs to be," he says in a clipped tone. "I'll transfer another 175,000 credits now to make it an even 200,000. But in the future, I'd appreciate it if you would remember the privilege you have of working with Megaparsec Incorporated.|8630|0
units.english: "I see... well, let's not make this more difficult than it needs to be," he says in a clipped tone. "I'll transfer another 175,000 credits now to make it an even 200,000. But in the future, I'd appreciate it if you would remember the privilege you have of working with Megaparsec Incorporated.
units.italian: "Capisco... bene, non rendiamo la cosa più difficile del necessario," dice in tono secco. "Bonificherò subito altri 175.000 crediti per arrivare a 200.000 tondi. Ma in futuro apprezzerei se ricordasse il privilegio che ha di lavorare con Megaparsec Incorporated.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8634|0
units.english: investment opps
units.italian: investment opps

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Now, let's talk about that investment opportunity."|8635|0
units.english: "Now, let's talk about that investment opportunity."
units.italian: "Ora parliamo di quell'opportunità di investimento."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard pulls up a holographic display on the digital screen behind him. Various charts and projections flash by. "Ready for the pitch?"|8636|0
units.english: Howard pulls up a holographic display on the digital screen behind him. Various charts and projections flash by. "Ready for the pitch?"
units.italian: Howard apre un display olografico sullo schermo digitale alle sue spalle. Grafici e proiezioni varie scorrono. "Pronto per il discorso di vendita?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"You know it."|8638|0
units.english: "You know it."
units.italian: "Lo sai."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Of course."|8639|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Here's what we're looking at. Megaparsec Incorporated is expanding a refueling station on Crossroads, and we're likely going to go with a conventional expansion. But don't let the term 'conventional' fool you, because Megaparsec rarely expands its refueling stations - this is the first time in over a decade. When we do, it's because we've identified a strategic location that will skyrocket profits. These opportunities are as rare as they come, and most investors never even hear about them. But you've proven yourself, and that's why you're getting a seat at the table."|8640|0
units.english: "Here's what we're looking at. Megaparsec Incorporated is expanding a refueling station on Crossroads, and we're likely going to go with a conventional expansion. But don't let the term 'conventional' fool you, because Megaparsec rarely expands its refueling stations - this is the first time in over a decade. When we do, it's because we've identified a strategic location that will skyrocket profits. These opportunities are as rare as they come, and most investors never even hear about them. But you've proven yourself, and that's why you're getting a seat at the table."
units.italian: "Ecco di che cosa si tratta. Megaparsec Incorporated sta ampliando una stazione di rifornimento su Crossroads, e probabilmente andremo con un ampliamento convenzionale. Ma non si lasci ingannare dalla parola 'convenzionale', perché Megaparsec amplia raramente le sue stazioni di rifornimento: è la prima volta in oltre un decennio. Quando lo facciamo, è perché abbiamo individuato una posizione strategica che farà schizzare i profitti. Occasioni così sono rarissime, e la maggior parte degli investitori non ne sente nemmeno parlare. Ma tu ti sei dimostrato all'altezza, ed è per questo che hai un posto al tavolo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He pauses, letting the weight of his words sink in. "Getting in on this is a once-in-a-lifetime chance. We're talking about a key hub on a high-traffic trade route, with a captive market of ships desperate for fuel. The returns will be solid... and dependable. Opportunities like this don't just come around, and when they do, they go fast."|8641|0
units.english: He pauses, letting the weight of his words sink in. "Getting in on this is a once-in-a-lifetime chance. We're talking about a key hub on a high-traffic trade route, with a captive market of ships desperate for fuel. The returns will be solid... and dependable. Opportunities like this don't just come around, and when they do, they go fast."
units.italian: Fa una pausa, lasciando che il peso delle sue parole faccia effetto. "Entrare in questo è un'occasione irripetibile. Parliamo di un nodo chiave su una rotta commerciale ad alto traffico, con un mercato captive di navi disperate di carburante. I rendimenti saranno solidi... e affidabili. Occasioni così non capitano tutti i giorni, e quando capitano vanno via in fretta."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Okay."|8643|0
units.english: "Okay."
units.italian: "Ok."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Thanks, but I'll be speeding away from this investment."|8644|0
units.english: "Thanks, but I'll be speeding away from this investment."
units.italian: "Grazie, ma me ne andrò a tutta velocità da questo investimento."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Excellent. The price for this investment is ten million credits for a solid 5400 credit per day return. Don't worry about pulling out your wallet just yet - I've pulled a few strings with our friends at the bank. They're willing to structure a loan for you through our Finance Division, no upfront payment needed. You'll just need to sign a few documents to get things moving."|8648|0
units.english: "Excellent. The price for this investment is ten million credits for a solid 5400 credit per day return. Don't worry about pulling out your wallet just yet - I've pulled a few strings with our friends at the bank. They're willing to structure a loan for you through our Finance Division, no upfront payment needed. You'll just need to sign a few documents to get things moving."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Il prezzo di questo investimento è di dieci milioni di crediti per un rendimento solido di 5.400 crediti al giorno. Non si preoccupi di tirare fuori il portafoglio: ho tirato qualche filo con i nostri amici in banca. Sono disposti a strutturare un prestito per lei attraverso la nostra Divisione Finanziaria, senza pagamento anticipato. Le basterà firmare qualche documento per avviare le cose."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He slides a document over to you, with a sleek pen ready for your signature. "Just sign this first document for the loan and then we can talk through the rest of the documents before signing."|8649|0
units.english: He slides a document over to you, with a sleek pen ready for your signature. "Just sign this first document for the loan and then we can talk through the rest of the documents before signing."
units.italian: Fa scivolare verso di te un documento, con una penna elegante pronta per la tua firma. "Firma solo questo primo documento per il prestito, poi possiamo passare in rassegna il resto delle carte prima di firmare."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Sounds good."|8651|0
units.english: "Sounds good."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"I'm done with these deals, I'm leaving."|8653|0
units.english: "I'm done with these deals, I'm leaving."
units.italian: "Ho chiuso con questi affari, me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard's tone carries a hint of impatience. "Alright then. The price for this investment is eleven million credits for a 5400 credit per day return. I've managed to arrange a loan through the bank and our Finance Division, so you won't need to come up with the cash immediately. Just sign these documents to formalize the arrangement."|8656|0
units.english: Howard's tone carries a hint of impatience. "Alright then. The price for this investment is eleven million credits for a 5400 credit per day return. I've managed to arrange a loan through the bank and our Finance Division, so you won't need to come up with the cash immediately. Just sign these documents to formalize the arrangement."
units.italian: Il tono di Howard tradisce un accenno di impazienza. "Va bene allora. Il prezzo di questo investimento è di undici milioni di crediti per un rendimento di 5.400 crediti al giorno. Sono riuscito a organizzare un prestito tramite la banca e la nostra Divisione Finanziaria, così non dovrà procurarsi il contante subito. Firmi solo questi documenti per formalizzare l'accordo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He pushes a document over to you, with a very fancy pen ready for your signature. "Just sign this first document for the loan and then we can talk through the rest of the documents before signing."|8657|0
units.english: He pushes a document over to you, with a very fancy pen ready for your signature. "Just sign this first document for the loan and then we can talk through the rest of the documents before signing."
units.italian: Ti spinge verso un documento, con una penna molto elegante pronta per la tua firma. "Firma solo questo primo documento per il prestito, poi possiamo passare in rassegna il resto delle carte prima di firmare."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Sounds good."|8659|0
units.english: "Sounds good."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"I'm done with these deals, I'm leaving."|8661|0
units.english: "I'm done with these deals, I'm leaving."
units.italian: "Ho chiuso con questi affari, me ne vado."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He takes the document from you and you see the loan terms on the screen behind him: 10M credits, 10 years, 34% rate.|8668|0
units.english: He takes the document from you and you see the loan terms on the screen behind him: 10M credits, 10 years, 34% rate.
units.italian: Prende il documento da te e vedi i termini del prestito sullo schermo alle sue spalle: 10 milioni di crediti, 10 anni, tasso del 34%.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He snatches the document from you with a wicked smile and you see the loan terms on the screen behind him: 11M credits, 10 years, 44% rate.|8675|0
units.english: He snatches the document from you with a wicked smile and you see the loan terms on the screen behind him: 11M credits, 10 years, 44% rate.
units.italian: Ti strappa il documento con un sorriso malvagio e vedi i termini del prestito sullo schermo alle sue spalle: 11 milioni di crediti, 10 anni, tasso del 44%.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard leans back in his chair. "Well done. You're now part of a very select group, one that's about to see some significant returns. As I mentioned, we're leaning towards a conventional expansion for the refueling station on Crossroads. It's a strategic move and it'll serve the steady stream of ships passing through, locking in profits for years to come of about 5400 credits a day, or around 20% a year."|8677|0
units.english: Howard leans back in his chair. "Well done. You're now part of a very select group, one that's about to see some significant returns. As I mentioned, we're leaning towards a conventional expansion for the refueling station on Crossroads. It's a strategic move and it'll serve the steady stream of ships passing through, locking in profits for years to come of about 5400 credits a day, or around 20% a year."
units.italian: Howard si appoggia allo schienale. "Ben fatto. Ora fai parte di un gruppo molto selezionato, che sta per vedere rendimenti significativi. Come dicevo, propendiamo per un ampliamento convenzionale della stazione di rifornimento su Crossroads. È una mossa strategica e servirà il flusso costante di navi di passaggio, assicurando profitti per anni di circa 5.400 crediti al giorno, ovvero intorno al 20% annuo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	He watches you closely, gauging your reaction. "Of course, this is just the standard approach. There's always room to tweak the plan."|8678|0
units.english: He watches you closely, gauging your reaction. "Of course, this is just the standard approach. There's always room to tweak the plan."
units.italian: Ti osserva attentamente, valutando la tua reazione. "Naturalmente questo è solo l'approccio standard. C'è sempre margine per ritoccare il piano."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	Howard pauses, waiting to see if you're interested in taking the conversation further.|8679|0
units.english: Howard pauses, waiting to see if you're interested in taking the conversation further.
units.italian: Howard fa una pausa, aspettando di vedere se sei interessato a portare avanti il discorso.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Sounds like a good plan to me."|8681|0
units.english: "Sounds like a good plan to me."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un buon piano."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"What would it take to boost profits even more?"|8683|0
units.english: "What would it take to boost profits even more?"
units.italian: "Che cosa servirebbe per aumentare ancora i profitti?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"What if I have concerns about the environmental impact?"|8685|0
units.english: "What if I have concerns about the environmental impact?"
units.italian: "E se avessi dubbi sull'impatto ambientale?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8687|0
units.english: plan a
units.italian: plan a

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"The conventional expansion is anything but. We'd work with licensed suppliers and build it by the book. Of course, Crossroads is already a radioactive wasteland of sandstorms, so the book's pretty light, all things considered. It's a solid investment with good returns and minimal risk. Nothing too flashy, but reliable returns of about 5400 credits a day, or around 20% a year."|8688|0
units.english: "The conventional expansion is anything but. We'd work with licensed suppliers and build it by the book. Of course, Crossroads is already a radioactive wasteland of sandstorms, so the book's pretty light, all things considered. It's a solid investment with good returns and minimal risk. Nothing too flashy, but reliable returns of about 5400 credits a day, or around 20% a year."
units.italian: "L'ampliamento convenzionale è tutto fuorché convenzionale. Lavoreremmo con fornitori autorizzati e lo costruiremmo secondo le regole. Certo, Crossroads è già un deserto radioattivo di tempeste di sabbia, quindi le regole sono piuttosto leggere, tutto sommato. È un investimento solido, con buoni rendimenti e rischi minimi. Niente di troppo appariscente, ma rendimenti affidabili di circa 5.400 crediti al giorno, ovvero intorno al 20% annuo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Sounds like a good plan to me."|8690|0
units.english: "Sounds like a good plan to me."
units.italian: "Mi sembra un buon piano."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"What would it take to boost profits even more?"|8692|0
units.english: "What would it take to boost profits even more?"
units.italian: "Che cosa servirebbe per aumentare ancora i profitti?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"And if I have concerns about the environmental impact?"|8696|0
units.english: "And if I have concerns about the environmental impact?"
units.italian: "E se mi preoccupasse l'impatto ambientale?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Could you remind me about the unregulated option?"|8700|0
units.english: "Could you remind me about the unregulated option?"
units.italian: "Mi ricordi l'opzione non regolamentata?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Explain the eco-friendly choice once more."|8704|0
units.english: "Explain the eco-friendly choice once more."
units.italian: "Spiegami ancora una volta la scelta ecologica."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8708|0
units.english: plan b
units.italian: plan b

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"We could tap into some unregulated fuel sources. No oversight, no regulations. The fuel's cheaper and abundant, but it's volatile - one wrong move, and it's a disaster waiting to happen. The profits, though, are through the roof. For the possible cost of a few lives and some bad PR, we can boost returns to around 8200 credits a day, or about 30% a year."|8709|0
units.english: "We could tap into some unregulated fuel sources. No oversight, no regulations.
