The fuel's cheaper and abundant, but it's volatile - one wrong move, and it's a disaster waiting to happen. The profits, though, are through the roof. For the possible cost of a few lives and some bad PR, we can boost returns to around 8200 credits a day, or about 30% a year."
units.italian: "Potremmo attingere a fonti di carburante non regolamentate. Nessun controllo, nessuna norma. Il carburante costa meno ed è abbondante, ma è volatile: basta una mossa sbagliata e si prepara un disastro. I profitti, però, sono alle stelle. Al possibile costo di qualche vita e di un po' di cattiva pubblicità, possiamo portare i rendimenti a circa 8.200 crediti al giorno, ovvero intorno al 30% annuo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Bring on the profits, this unregulated option is the one for me."|8713|0
units.english: "Bring on the profits, this unregulated option is the one for me."
units.italian: "Portatemi i profitti: l'opzione non regolamentata è quella che fa per me."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Tell me about the conventional expansion again."|8715|0
units.english: "Tell me about the conventional expansion again."
units.italian: "Riparlami dell'ampliamento convenzionale."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"And if I have concerns about the environmental impact?"|8717|0
units.english: "And if I have concerns about the environmental impact?"
units.italian: "E se mi preoccupasse l'impatto ambientale?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Explain the eco-friendly choice once more."|8721|0
units.english: "Explain the eco-friendly choice once more."
units.italian: "Spiegami ancora una volta la scelta ecologica."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8725|0
units.english: plan c
units.italian: plan c

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"There's also the eco-friendly route. We'd invest in green energy technologies and refining processes that minimize environmental impact and implement best-in-class workplace safety protocols. It's the most expensive option, and it'll slow our expansion, but it would reduce our environmental liabilities and might give us some goodwill. Easily the worst returns with around 4000 credits a day expected, or just around 15% a year."|8726|0
units.english: "There's also the eco-friendly route. We'd invest in green energy technologies and refining processes that minimize environmental impact and implement best-in-class workplace safety protocols. It's the most expensive option, and it'll slow our expansion, but it would reduce our environmental liabilities and might give us some goodwill. Easily the worst returns with around 4000 credits a day expected, or just around 15% a year."
units.italian: "C'è anche la via ecologica. Investiremmo in tecnologie per l'energia verde e in processi di raffinazione che riducono al minimo l'impatto ambientale, e applicheremmo protocolli di sicurezza sul lavoro all'avanguardia. È l'opzione più costosa e rallenterà l'ampliamento, ma ridurrebbe le nostre passività ambientali e potrebbe darci un po' di buona reputazione. Con ogni probabilità i rendimenti peggiori: circa 4.000 crediti al giorno, ovvero appena intorno al 15% annuo."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"This environmental and safety focused option is the one for me."|8730|0
units.english: "This environmental and safety focused option is the one for me."
units.italian: "L'opzione attenta all'ambiente e alla sicurezza è quella che fa per me."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Tell me about the conventional expansion again."|8732|0
units.english: "Tell me about the conventional expansion again."
units.italian: "Riparlami dell'ampliamento convenzionale."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"What would it take to boost profits even more?"|8734|0
units.english: "What would it take to boost profits even more?"
units.italian: "Che cosa servirebbe per aumentare ancora i profitti?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Could you remind me about the unregulated option?"|8738|0
units.english: "Could you remind me about the unregulated option?"
units.italian: "Mi ricordi l'opzione non regolamentata?"

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8742|0
units.english: chose plan a
units.italian: chose plan a

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|log|8746|0
units.english: Was able to make another investment with Megaparsec, this time ten million credits, after disabling a Marauder for Howard. Out of three investment options, ended up choosing the conventional approach.
units.italian: Ho potuto fare un altro investimento con Megaparsec, questa volta da dieci milioni di crediti, dopo aver disattivato un Marauder per Howard. Fra tre opzioni di investimento, alla fine ho scelto l'approccio convenzionale.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Excellent choice. The conventional expansion is a safe bet with solid returns. It's not the flashiest option, but the steady stream of ships passing through Crossroads will ensure consistent profits. The only drawback is that it won't make headlines - but it'll keep the credits flowing smoothly."|8747|0
units.english: "Excellent choice. The conventional expansion is a safe bet with solid returns. It's not the flashiest option, but the steady stream of ships passing through Crossroads will ensure consistent profits. The only drawback is that it won't make headlines - but it'll keep the credits flowing smoothly."
units.italian: "Ottima scelta. L'ampliamento convenzionale è una scommessa sicura con rendimenti solidi. Non è l'opzione più appariscente, ma il flusso costante di navi che passa per Crossroads garantirà profitti continui. L'unico difetto è che non farà notizia, ma terrà i crediti in movimento senza intoppi."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8749|0
units.english: chose plan b
units.italian: chose plan b

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|log|8753|0
units.english: Was able to make another investment with Megaparsec, this time ten million credits, after disabling a Marauder for Howard. Out of three investment options, ended up choosing the profitable approach.
units.italian: Ho potuto fare un altro investimento con Megaparsec, questa volta da dieci milioni di crediti, dopo aver disattivato un Marauder per Howard. Fra tre opzioni di investimento, alla fine ho scelto l'approccio più redditizio.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Well done. The unregulated option is bold and ambitious - exactly the kind of move the Syndicate prizes. The volatility of this fuel isn't for the faint of heart, but some bad PR is well worth the profits and potential earnings we'll achieve. High risk often means high reward."|8754|0
units.english: "Well done. The unregulated option is bold and ambitious - exactly the kind of move the Syndicate prizes. The volatility of this fuel isn't for the faint of heart, but some bad PR is well worth the profits and potential earnings we'll achieve. High risk often means high reward."
units.italian: "Ben fatto. L'opzione non regolamentata è audace e ambiziosa: esattamente il tipo di mossa che il Sindacato apprezza. La volatilità di questo carburante non è per i deboli di cuore, ma un po' di cattiva pubblicità vale bene i profitti e i guadagni potenziali che otterremo. Alto rischio spesso significa alta ricompensa."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|label|8756|0
units.english: chose plan c
units.italian: chose plan c

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|log|8760|0
units.english: Was able to make another investment with Megaparsec, this time ten million credits, after disabling a Marauder for Howard. Out of three investment options, ended up choosing the eco-friendly approach.
units.italian: Ho potuto fare un altro investimento con Megaparsec, questa volta da dieci milioni di crediti, dopo aver disattivato un Marauder per Howard. Fra tre opzioni di investimento, alla fine ho scelto l'approccio ecologico.

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"An admirable decision. The eco-friendly route won't make the most credits, but it's a forward-thinking investment. It could pay off in other ways, like reduced turnover and environmental liabilities. Objectively the worst investment from a returns perspective, but I suppose you value other things more."|8761|0
units.english: "An admirable decision. The eco-friendly route won't make the most credits, but it's a forward-thinking investment. It could pay off in other ways, like reduced turnover and environmental liabilities. Objectively the worst investment from a returns perspective, but I suppose you value other things more."
units.italian: "Decisione ammirevole. La via ecologica non farà guadagnare il massimo, ma è un investimento lungimirante. Potrebbe ripagare in altri modi, come meno ricambi di personale e meno passività ambientali. Oggettivamente il peggiore degli investimenti quanto a rendimenti, ma suppongo che tu dia valore ad altro."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	"Alright, now that we've settled on your investment, let's get the rest of the paperwork squared away." He slides a stack of documents across the desk. "These cover the remaining loan terms, the investment agreement, and the usual legal fine print. Nothing too complicated, just a few signatures to make it all official." He hands you the same sleek pen from earlier, his expression all business. "Once this is done, you'll be a stakeholder in one of Megaparsec's most promising expansions."|8763|0
units.english: "Alright, now that we've settled on your investment, let's get the rest of the paperwork squared away." He slides a stack of documents across the desk. "These cover the remaining loan terms, the investment agreement, and the usual legal fine print. Nothing too complicated, just a few signatures to make it all official." He hands you the same sleek pen from earlier, his expression all business. "Once this is done, you'll be a stakeholder in one of Megaparsec's most promising expansions."
units.italian: "Bene, ora che abbiamo deciso il tuo investimento, sistemiamo il resto delle carte." Fa scivolare sulla scrivania un mucchio di documenti. "Questi coprono i termini restanti del prestito, il contratto di investimento e le solite clausole legali. Niente di troppo complicato, solo qualche firma per rendere tutto ufficiale." Ti porge la stessa penna elegante di prima, con un'espressione tutta d'affari. "Una volta fatto questo, sarai azionista di uno degli ampliamenti più promettenti di Megaparsec."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	(Sign the paperwork.)|8765|0
units.english: (Sign the paperwork.)
units.italian: (Firma le carte.)

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	With the last signature in place, Howard gives you a nod of approval. "Congratulations. You've made a smart move today. I'll keep you in mind for future investment opportunities. Who knows, maybe I'll need another Marauder-related favor down the line." He gives you a wink and stands, offering his hand. "Until next time, we'll keep in touch."|8766|0
units.english: With the last signature in place, Howard gives you a nod of approval. "Congratulations. You've made a smart move today. I'll keep you in mind for future investment opportunities. Who knows, maybe I'll need another Marauder-related favor down the line." He gives you a wink and stands, offering his hand. "Until next time, we'll keep in touch."
units.italian: Con l'ultima firma apposta, Howard ti fa un cenno di approvazione. "Congratulazioni. Oggi hai fatto una mossa intelligente. Ti terrò presente per future opportunità di investimento. Chissà, magari più avanti avrò bisogno di un altro favore legato a un Marauder." Ti fa l'occhiolino e si alza, porgendoti la mano. "Alla prossima, restiamo in contatto."

units.id: mission:Syndicate Business 5|	After that final goodbye, you leave Howard's office, the quiet hum of the corporate floor giving way to the loud clanging of Sunracer's bustling shipyards and spaceport as you head back to the <ship>.|8767|0
units.english: After that final goodbye, you leave Howard's office, the quiet hum of the corporate floor giving way to the loud clanging of Sunracer's bustling shipyards and spaceport as you head back to the <ship>.
units.italian: Dopo quell'ultimo saluto lasci l'ufficio di Howard, con il quieto ronzio del piano aziendale che lascia il posto al fragore dei cantieri e dello spazioporto di Sunracer mentre torni alla <ship>.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|Upon completing your jump, one of your internal sensors begins to beep. You flick off the siren and check the diagnostic report: apparently there is a non-negligible heat source detected in the food storage of your ship.|8790|0
units.english: Upon completing your jump, one of your internal sensors begins to beep. You flick off the siren and check the diagnostic report: apparently there is a non-negligible heat source detected in the food storage of your ship.
units.italian: Al termine del tuo salto, uno dei sensori interni comincia a bucare. Spegni la sirena e controlli il rapporto diagnostico: a quanto pare c'è una fonte di calore non trascurabile rilevata nella dispensa alimentare della nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|Upon taking off, one of your internal sensors begins to beep. You flick off the siren and check the diagnostic report: apparently there is a non-negligible heat source detected in the food storage of your ship.|8793|0
units.english: Upon taking off, one of your internal sensors begins to beep. You flick off the siren and check the diagnostic report: apparently there is a non-negligible heat source detected in the food storage of your ship.
units.italian: Al momento del decollo, uno dei sensori interni comincia a bucare. Spegni la sirena e controlli il rapporto diagnostico: a quanto pare c'è una fonte di calore non trascurabile rilevata nella dispensa alimentare della nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	As problems go, it is not a particularly alarming one: there are plenty of reasons there may be a heat spike in storage, and most of them would not require the captain of the ship to investigate.|8796|0
units.english: As problems go, it is not a particularly alarming one: there are plenty of reasons there may be a heat spike in storage, and most of them would not require the captain of the ship to investigate.
units.italian: Fra i tanti problemi possibili, non è particolarmente allarmante: ci sono molte ragioni per cui la temperatura può salire in dispensa, e la maggior parte non richiederebbe che il capitano della nave indaghi di persona.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	It is unusual, however.|8797|0
units.english: It is unusual, however.
units.italian: È però insolito.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	(Investigate.)|8799|0
units.english: (Investigate.)
units.italian: (Indaga.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	(Ignore the sensor.)|8801|0
units.english: (Ignore the sensor.)
units.italian: (Ignora il sensore.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	You turn off the alarm and return your focus to piloting your ship.|8806|0
units.english: You turn off the alarm and return your focus to piloting your ship.
units.italian: Spegni l'allarme e torni a concentrarti sul pilotaggio della nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	After a short search, and the rearranging of quite a few deceptively heavy boxes, you are able to track the heat signature to a foodstuff crate you recently took on. It has yet to be opened, but you can tell its seal has already been tampered with.|8810|0
units.english: After a short search, and the rearranging of quite a few deceptively heavy boxes, you are able to track the heat signature to a foodstuff crate you recently took on. It has yet to be opened, but you can tell its seal has already been tampered with.
units.italian: Dopo una breve ricerca e aver spostato parecchie casse ingannevolmente pesanti, riesci a risalire alla fonte di calore: una cassa di derrate alimentari che hai caricato di recente. Non è ancora stata aperta, ma ti accorgi che il sigillo è già stato manomesso.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	(Open the crate.)|8812|0
units.english: (Open the crate.)
units.italian: (Apri la cassa.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	(Dump the crate out the airlock.)|8814|0
units.english: (Dump the crate out the airlock.)
units.italian: (Butta la cassa fuori dalla camera stagna.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	As the crate tumbles out into lifeless space your onboard sensors quickly note the anomalous heat signature disappear. Whatever was in that crate is no longer your problem, and probably won't be anyone else's either.|8818|0
units.english: As the crate tumbles out into lifeless space your onboard sensors quickly note the anomalous heat signature disappear. Whatever was in that crate is no longer your problem, and probably won't be anyone else's either.
units.italian: Mentre la cassa precipita nello spazio senza vita, i sensori di bordo notano subito che la firma termica anomala scompare. Qualunque cosa ci fosse in quella cassa non è più un tuo problema, e probabilmente non lo sarà nemmeno per nessun altro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	You pry open the crate. It should be full of meals for your journey, but after removing the lid you discover a dirty, disheveled man.|8822|0
units.english: You pry open the crate. It should be full of meals for your journey, but after removing the lid you discover a dirty, disheveled man.
units.italian: Forzi la cassa. Dovrebbe essere piena di razioni per il viaggio, ma dopo aver tolto il coperchio scopri un uomo sporco e malconcio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	Before you have a chance to say anything, the man looks up at you with narrowed, pained eyes, and whimpers. "P-p-please. I just had to get away. I-I-It wasn't safe. I had to get away." He weakly holds up his hands.|8823|0
units.english: Before you have a chance to say anything, the man looks up at you with narrowed, pained eyes, and whimpers. "P-p-please. I just had to get away. I-I-It wasn't safe. I had to get away." He weakly holds up his hands.
units.italian: Prima che tu possa dire qualcosa, l'uomo alza lo sguardo verso di te con occhi socchiusi e dolenti, e piagnucola. "P-p-per favore. Dovevo solo andarmene. N-n-non era sicuro. Dovevo andarmene." Alza debolmente le mani.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	"Who are you?"|8825|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	"Where's my food?"|8826|0
units.english: "Where's my food?"
units.italian: "Dov'è il mio cibo?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	"T-T-Timothy Radrickson. I-I tossed your food out to make room. I am sorry. I am so sorry. I have no money to pay you back. I just h-h-had to leave. They were after me. I owed money. I had nothing. Please. Any other world will do. I just need to get away. I just need to start anew. I'll p-p-pay you back, I swear. I swear. I will. I swear."|8828|0
units.english: "T-T-Timothy Radrickson. I-I tossed your food out to make room. I am sorry. I am so sorry. I have no money to pay you back. I just h-h-had to leave. They were after me. I owed money. I had nothing. Please. Any other world will do. I just need to get away. I just need to start anew. I'll p-p-pay you back, I swear. I swear. I will. I swear."
units.italian: "T-t-timothy Radrickson. H-ho buttato fuori il tuo cibo per fare spazio. Mi dispiace. Mi dispiace tanto. Non ho soldi per ripagarti. Dovevo solo a-a-andarmene. Mi stavano cercando. Avevo dei debiti. Non avevo niente. Ti prego. Va bene qualsiasi altro mondo. Devo solo andarmene. Devo solo ricominciare. T-t-ti ripagherò, lo giuro. Lo giuro. Lo farò. Lo giuro."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	"Is there somewhere you'd like to go?"|8830|0
units.english: "Is there somewhere you'd like to go?"
units.italian: "C'è un posto dove vorresti andare?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	"Fine. I'll drop you off at the next port."|8832|0
units.english: "Fine. I'll drop you off at the next port."
units.italian: "Va bene. Ti lascio al prossimo porto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	"I know where you're going. The airlock."|8834|0
units.english: "I know where you're going. The airlock."
units.italian: "So io dove stai andando. La camera stagna."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	The feeble man screams as you drag him out of the crate and toward the airlock. He ineptly squirms as you shove him past the bulkhead seals. He falls to his knees shuddering, and he scrunches up with terror. You close the airlock, silencing his shrill screams, and hit the button to open the outside airlock. The man is promptly sucked out into cold, cruel space and crystallizes before becoming this system's newest comet.|8838|0
units.english: The feeble man screams as you drag him out of the crate and toward the airlock. He ineptly squirms as you shove him past the bulkhead seals. He falls to his knees shuddering, and he scrunches up with terror. You close the airlock, silencing his shrill screams, and hit the button to open the outside airlock. The man is promptly sucked out into cold, cruel space and crystallizes before becoming this system's newest comet.
units.italian: L'uomo fragile urla mentre lo trascini fuori dalla cassa verso la camera stagna. Si dimena goffamente mentre lo spingi oltre i sigilli delle paratie. Cade in ginocchio tremando e si rannicchia terrorizzato. Chiudi la camera stagna, zittendo le sue urla acute, e premi il pulsante per aprire quella esterna. L'uomo viene subito risucchiato nello spazio freddo e crudele e si cristallizza prima di diventare la nuova cometa di questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	"Thank you," he whispers as tears squeeze out of his eyes. "Thank you."|8845|0
units.english: "Thank you," he whispers as tears squeeze out of his eyes. "Thank you."
units.italian: "Grazie," sussurra mentre le lacrime gli escono dagli occhi. "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	You get the man cleaned up and settled, and then go back to running your ship.|8846|0
units.english: You get the man cleaned up and settled, and then go back to running your ship.
units.italian: Fai ripulire e sistemare l'uomo, poi torni a governare la nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	Timothy looks at you, his eyes wide and full of tears. "Rand," he whispers. "Rand. I can make good money there. I can turn my life around. B-b-but I'd be okay with anywhere. You d-d-don't have to.."|8852|0
units.english: Timothy looks at you, his eyes wide and full of tears. "Rand," he whispers. "Rand. I can make good money there. I can turn my life around. B-b-but I'd be okay with anywhere. You d-d-don't have to.."
units.italian: Timothy ti guarda, con gli occhi sgranati e pieni di lacrime. "Rand," sussurra. "Rand. Là posso guadagnare bene. Posso cambiare la mia vita. M-m-ma andrebbe bene anche qualsiasi altro posto. N-n-non devi..."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	You cut him off. "It's fine, Timothy. I'll take you to Rand."|8853|0
units.english: You cut him off. "It's fine, Timothy. I'll take you to Rand."
units.italian: Lo interrompi. "Va bene, Timothy. Ti porto su Rand."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	Timothy breaks down in tears. "Thank you. Thank you. Thank you..." he mumbles over and over again.|8854|0
units.english: Timothy breaks down in tears. "Thank you. Thank you. Thank you..." he mumbles over and over again.
units.italian: Timothy scoppia in lacrime. "Grazie. Grazie. Grazie..." mormora più e più volte.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	You help him out of the crate and get him cleaned up.|8855|0
units.english: You help him out of the crate and get him cleaned up.
units.italian: Lo aiuti a uscire dalla cassa e lo fai ripulire.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|log|8859|0
units.english: A stowaway I found on my ship. He requested a trip to Rand to start a new life, promising to pay back the money he owes.
units.italian: Un clandestino che ho trovato sulla mia nave. Ha chiesto un passaggio fino a Rand per ricominciare una nuova vita, promettendo di restituire i soldi che deve.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|log|8860|0
units.english: Discovered Timothy, a stowaway, in my ship, and decided to take him where he needed to go. Never learned what Timothy had been fleeing, who he had been, or what he had done that lead him to such dire straits.
units.italian: Ho scoperto Timothy, un clandestino, sulla mia nave, e ho deciso di portarlo dove doveva andare. Non ho mai saputo che cosa stesse fuggendo Timothy, chi fosse stato né che cosa avesse fatto per ridursi in condizioni così disperate.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|During the trip Timothy's spirits and health improved, and by the time you arrive on Rand he seems like a different man. Before he steps out of the airlock he turns to you one more time. "Thank you so much, Captain <last>." He shakes your hand.|8864|0
units.english: During the trip Timothy's spirits and health improved, and by the time you arrive on Rand he seems like a different man. Before he steps out of the airlock he turns to you one more time. "Thank you so much, Captain <last>." He shakes your hand.
units.italian: Durante il viaggio l'umore e la salute di Timothy sono migliorati, e quando arrivi su Rand sembra un altro uomo. Prima di uscire dalla camera stagna si volta un'ultima volta verso di te. "Grazie mille, Capitano <last>." Ti stringe la mano.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	"I mean it, from the bottom of my heart. You've saved my life, and given me hope. I won't forget this; or you. I could never thank you enough."|8865|0
units.english: "I mean it, from the bottom of my heart. You've saved my life, and given me hope. I won't forget this; or you. I could never thank you enough."
units.italian: "Lo dico sul serio, dal profondo del cuore. Mi hai salvato la vita e mi hai dato speranza. Non lo dimenticherò, né te. Non potrò mai ringraziarti abbastanza."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1: Stowaway|	His eyes glistening, Timothy turns from you and exits your ship.|8866|0
units.english: His eyes glistening, Timothy turns from you and exits your ship.
units.italian: Con gli occhi lucidi, Timothy si volta e lascia la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1a: Accepted|name|8871|0
units.english: Stowaway to <planet>
units.italian: Clandestino per <planet>

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 1a: Accepted|description|8872|0
units.english: You found a man named Timothy on your ship stowed away in a foodstuff crate, on the run from somebody. He would like you to bring him to <destination>, where he can find work.
units.italian: Hai trovato sulla tua nave un uomo di nome Timothy, nascosto in una cassa di derrate alimentari, in fuga da qualcuno. Vorrebbe che lo portassi su <destination>, dove può trovare lavoro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: mummy|For days there's been an odd lingering scent filtering in from your pressurized cargo, but finally the smell has permeated your command deck. A ship-wide search leads you to a unopened foodstuff crate. Although the crate is unopened, the seal on it appears tampered with and you surmise that the food has gone bad.|8895|0
units.english: For days there's been an odd lingering scent filtering in from your pressurized cargo, but finally the smell has permeated your command deck. A ship-wide search leads you to a unopened foodstuff crate. Although the crate is unopened, the seal on it appears tampered with and you surmise that the food has gone bad.
units.italian: Per giorni un odore strano e persistente è filtrato dal carico pressurizzato, ma alla fine la puzza ha impregnato il ponte di comando. Una ricerca in tutta la nave ti porta a una cassa di derrate alimentari non aperta. Anche se la cassa è chiusa, il sigillo sembra manomesso e supponi che il cibo sia andato a male.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: mummy|	Upon opening it you discover that is in fact, not the case. Instead you discover the decaying body of a dead and forgotten stowaway; the entire crate promptly finds its way to your airlock. Despite the diligent work of your ship's air filters, you can't quite rid the ship of the smell.|8896|0
units.english: Upon opening it you discover that is in fact, not the case. Instead you discover the decaying body of a dead and forgotten stowaway; the entire crate promptly finds its way to your airlock. Despite the diligent work of your ship's air filters, you can't quite rid the ship of the smell.
units.italian: Aprendola scopri che non è affatto così. Trovi invece il corpo in decomposizione di un clandestino morto e dimenticato; l'intera cassa finisce subito verso la tua camera stagna. Nonostante il lavoro diligente dei filtri dell'aria, non riesci a liberare del tutto la nave dall'odore.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Interlude|Blinking at the light, Timothy shuffles toward the exit. "Th-th-thank you. Thank you so much," Timothy mumbles.|8908|0
units.english: Blinking at the light, Timothy shuffles toward the exit. "Th-th-thank you. Thank you so much," Timothy mumbles.
units.italian: Socchiudendo gli occhi per la luce, Timothy si trascina verso l'uscita. "G-g-grazie. Grazie mille," mormora Timothy.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Interlude|	Timothy opens the hatch and looks back at you. "You s-s-saved my life. I won't forget. I won't."|8909|0
units.english: Timothy opens the hatch and looks back at you. "You s-s-saved my life. I won't forget. I won't."
units.italian: Timothy apre il portello e si volta a guardarti. "M-m-mi hai salvato la vita. Non lo dimenticherò. No."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Interlude|	With that, Timothy exits your ship and begins his new life.|8910|0
units.english: With that, Timothy exits your ship and begins his new life.
units.italian: Detto questo, Timothy esce dalla tua nave e comincia la sua nuova vita.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|log|8921|0
units.english: Timothy kept his promise, sending 50,000 credits to pay for his trip.
units.italian: Timothy ha mantenuto la promessa, inviandomi 50.000 crediti per pagare il suo viaggio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|log|8922|0
units.english: Despite starting over with nothing, Timothy has sent credits for that passage I gave him over a year ago.
units.italian: Pur ricominciando da zero, Timothy mi ha inviato i crediti per quel passaggio che gli diedi oltre un anno fa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|After your ship touches down you notice a light blinking on your dashboard. You have a cached message waiting for you to play.|8927|0
units.english: After your ship touches down you notice a light blinking on your dashboard. You have a cached message waiting for you to play.
units.italian: Dopo che la nave si posa, noti una luce che lampeggia sul cruscotto. C'è un messaggio in cache che aspetta di essere riprodotto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|	(Play the message.)|8929|0
units.english: (Play the message.)
units.italian: (Riproduci il messaggio.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|	The screen lights up with a somewhat familiar man, but it is only when you see the name of the sender that you realize that this is the fuller face of a healthy Timothy Radrickson, whom you last met as a stowaway on your ship.|8931|0
units.english: The screen lights up with a somewhat familiar man, but it is only when you see the name of the sender that you realize that this is the fuller face of a healthy Timothy Radrickson, whom you last met as a stowaway on your ship.
units.italian: Lo schermo si illumina con un uomo in parte familiare, ma è solo quando vedi il nome del mittente che capisci che si tratta del viso più pieno di un Timothy Radrickson in salute, che avevi conosciuto come clandestino sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|	"Captain <last>. Let me just reiterate my thanks to you for what you did for me. Most captains would have airlocked me, or dropped me off wherever, but you really gave me a chance."|8932|0
units.english: "Captain <last>. Let me just reiterate my thanks to you for what you did for me. Most captains would have airlocked me, or dropped me off wherever, but you really gave me a chance."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>. Mi permetta di rinnovarle la mia gratitudine per quello che ha fatto per me. La maggior parte dei capitani mi avrebbe buttato fuori dalla camera stagna, o mi avrebbe lasciato in qualche posto qualsiasi, ma lei mi ha dato davvero una possibilità."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|	He stops and grins at the camera for a moment. "And that chance, it really has made all the difference. It's been a year of hard work, but I've saved some money and made some investments, and things really are turning around."|8933|0
units.english: He stops and grins at the camera for a moment. "And that chance, it really has made all the difference. It's been a year of hard work, but I've saved some money and made some investments, and things really are turning around."
units.italian: Si ferma e sorride alla telecamera per un momento. "E quella possibilità ha fatto davvero tutta la differenza. È stato un anno di duro lavoro, ma ho messo da parte qualche soldo e fatto qualche investimento, e le cose stanno davvero girando per il verso giusto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|	"By way of thanks," he continues, "I've included <payment> with this message. That should cover the cost of transporting me to Rand, but it doesn't come close to what I really owe. Which is, in all honesty, my very life."|8934|0
units.english: "By way of thanks," he continues, "I've included <payment> with this message. That should cover the cost of transporting me to Rand, but it doesn't come close to what I really owe. Which is, in all honesty, my very life."
units.italian: "Come ringraziamento," continua, "ho incluso <payment> con questo messaggio. Dovrebbe coprire il costo del trasporto fino a Rand, ma non si avvicina nemmeno a quello che le devo davvero. Che, a essere onesti, è la mia stessa vita."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|	He pauses, as if he's trying to remember something. "Anyways, thank you again, and know I'll never forget what you did for me."|8935|0
units.english: He pauses, as if he's trying to remember something. "Anyways, thank you again, and know I'll never forget what you did for me."
units.italian: Fa una pausa, come se cercasse di ricordare qualcosa. "Comunque, grazie ancora, e sappia che non dimenticherò mai quello che ha fatto per me."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 2: Good Interlude|	Timothy waves, and the video ends.|8936|0
units.english: Timothy waves, and the video ends.
units.italian: Timothy saluta con la mano, e il video finisce.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3: Governor Notification|name|8944|0
units.english: Visit the Governor of <planet>
units.italian: Fare visita al Governatore di <planet>

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3: Governor Notification|description|8945|0
units.english: The governor of <planet> has invited you to speak with them.
units.italian: Il governatore di <planet> ti ha invitato a parlare con lui.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3: Governor Notification|An indicator light is blinking on your main panel. There is a cached message waiting for you to play.|8953|0
units.english: An indicator light is blinking on your main panel. There is a cached message waiting for you to play.
units.italian: Una spia luminosa lampeggia sul pannello principale. C'è un messaggio in cache che aspetta di essere riprodotto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3: Governor Notification|	(Play the message.)|8955|0
units.english: (Play the message.)
units.italian: (Riproduci il messaggio.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3: Governor Notification|	A young woman in very professional clothing appears on the screen. "Captain <last>, I am pleased to inform you that the Governor of Rand requests your presence. Please come to Rand at your earliest convenience.|8956|0
units.english: A young woman in very professional clothing appears on the screen. "Captain <last>, I am pleased to inform you that the Governor of Rand requests your presence. Please come to Rand at your earliest convenience.
units.italian: Sullo schermo compare una giovane donna in abiti molto professionali. "Capitano <last>, sono lieta di informarla che il Governatore di Rand richiede la sua presenza. La prego di venire su Rand appena le è possibile.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3: Governor Notification|Upon landing you are met by a squat, heavy-set woman in her late forties. She reaches out a calloused hand to shake yours. "Welcome to Rand, Captain <last>. It is a pleasure, and honor, to have someone of your status here on our little world. I am Regina, the mayor of this town, and one of the major company-bosses here. I've been instructed to escort you to the Governor's mansion. I have a vehicle waiting for you just outside the spaceport. Meet me there when you're ready."|8961|0
units.english: Upon landing you are met by a squat, heavy-set woman in her late forties. She reaches out a calloused hand to shake yours. "Welcome to Rand, Captain <last>. It is a pleasure, and honor, to have someone of your status here on our little world. I am Regina, the mayor of this town, and one of the major company-bosses here. I've been instructed to escort you to the Governor's mansion. I have a vehicle waiting for you just outside the spaceport. Meet me there when you're ready."
units.italian: All'atterraggio ti accoglie una donna bassa e robusta, sulla tarda quarantina. Ti tende una mano piena di calli per stringere la tua. "Benvenuto su Rand, Capitano <last>. È un piacere, e un onore, avere qui sul nostro piccolo mondo qualcuno del suo calibro. Sono Regina, la sindaca di questa città, e una dei principali capi aziendali di qui. Ho ricevuto istruzioni di accompagnarla alla villa del Governatore. Ho un veicolo che l'aspetta appena fuori dallo spazioporto. Mi raggiunga là quando è pronto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|name|8965|0
units.english: Rescue <origin> convoy
units.italian: Salvare il convoglio di <origin>

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|description|8966|0
units.english: <origin>'s largest ever convoy was intercepted on its way to Tarazed. Merchants report that a large pirate fleet escorting a freighter convoy went to <destination>. Governor Tim has asked you to try and save it before the pirates can plunder it completely.
units.italian: Il più grande convoglio mai allestito da <origin> è stato intercettato mentre era diretto a Tarazed. I mercanti riferiscono che una grande flotta pirata che scortava un convoglio di mercantili è andata su <destination>. Il Governatore Tim ti ha chiesto di provare a salvarlo prima che i pirati possano saccheggiarlo del tutto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|Regina, her driver, and a sleek black vehicle are all waiting for you outside the worn down and substandard spaceport. You slide into the comfortable seating and look out the window as the dry, ugly landscape of Rand passes you by. From time to time you see a strip mine or a camp of workers' barracks, but rarely anything else. Behind your vehicle there is a huge plume of half-frozen dust. Apparently low gravity and thin topsoil is a terrible combination.|8976|0
units.english: Regina, her driver, and a sleek black vehicle are all waiting for you outside the worn down and substandard spaceport. You slide into the comfortable seating and look out the window as the dry, ugly landscape of Rand passes you by. From time to time you see a strip mine or a camp of workers' barracks, but rarely anything else. Behind your vehicle there is a huge plume of half-frozen dust. Apparently low gravity and thin topsoil is a terrible combination.
units.italian: Regina, il suo autista e un elegante veicolo nero ti aspettano fuori dallo spazioporto malridotto e sotto la media. Ti infili nei sedili comodi e guardi fuori dal finestrino mentre il paesaggio arido e brutto di Rand scorre. Ogni tanto vedi una miniera a cielo aperto o un campo di baracche per gli operai, ma raramente altro. Dietro il veicolo si alza un'enorme colonna di polvere semigelata. A quanto pare la bassa gravità e il suolo sottile sono una combinazione terribile.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	After an hour of driving you notice the landscape suddenly shift. The first tendrils of greenery invade the otherwise brown-yellow desert. Upon closer inspection, the green plants are accompanied by all manner of technology to help and promote their growth. Money, it seems, is turning just a little bit of this parched place green.|8977|0
units.english: After an hour of driving you notice the landscape suddenly shift. The first tendrils of greenery invade the otherwise brown-yellow desert. Upon closer inspection, the green plants are accompanied by all manner of technology to help and promote their growth. Money, it seems, is turning just a little bit of this parched place green.
units.italian: Dopo un'ora di guida noti che il paesaggio cambia all'improvviso. I primi viticci di verde invadono il deserto altrimenti bruno-giallo. A guardar bene, le piante verdi sono accompagnate da ogni tipo di tecnologia per aiutarle e favorirne la crescita. Il denaro, a quanto pare, sta rendendo un po' più verde questo luogo riarso.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Beyond the suddenly green hills sits a huge sprawling complex. You recognize a few massive structures outside the building as artificial gravity drives; the same sort of drives ships use to maintain gravity onboard, but for an entire estate.|8978|0
units.english: Beyond the suddenly green hills sits a huge sprawling complex. You recognize a few massive structures outside the building as artificial gravity drives; the same sort of drives ships use to maintain gravity onboard, but for an entire estate.
units.italian: Oltre le colline improvvisamente verdi si trova un enorme complesso tentacolare. Riconosci alcune strutture imponenti all'esterno dell'edificio come motori a gravità artificiale: gli stessi tipi di motori che le navi usano per mantenere la gravità a bordo, ma per un'intera tenuta.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Say nothing.)|8980|0
units.english: (Say nothing.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Ask about the artificial gravity drives.)|8982|0
units.english: (Ask about the artificial gravity drives.)
units.italian: (Chiedi dei motori a gravità artificiale.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Regina flashes a toothy smile. "The gravity here, it is... taxing. The governor's mansion, and a few other important buildings and housing complexes, use artificial gravity drives to make things more manageable for us hard-working 'servants of the state.'" The way she says "servants of the state" makes it sound like some kind of inside joke. She turns away from you before you have a chance to say anything else.|8984|0
units.english: Regina flashes a toothy smile. "The gravity here, it is... taxing. The governor's mansion, and a few other important buildings and housing complexes, use artificial gravity drives to make things more manageable for us hard-working 'servants of the state.'" The way she says "servants of the state" makes it sound like some kind of inside joke. She turns away from you before you have a chance to say anything else.
units.italian: Regina sfodera un sorriso dentato. "La gravità qui è... pesante. La villa del governatore, e altri importanti edifici e complessi residenziali, usano motori a gravità artificiale per renderla più gestibile per noi operosi 'servi dello Stato'." Il modo in cui dice "servi dello Stato" la fa sembrare una specie di battuta interna. Si volta dall'altra parte prima che tu possa dire altro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	The vehicle pulls up to a grandiose entrance near the center of the huge structure. An attendant opens the door, and you're ushered outside the vehicle.|8987|0
units.english: The vehicle pulls up to a grandiose entrance near the center of the huge structure. An attendant opens the door, and you're ushered outside the vehicle.
units.italian: Il veicolo si ferma davanti a un ingresso grandioso vicino al centro dell'enorme struttura. Un attendente apre la porta e vi fa scendere dal veicolo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Regina does not get out. She smiles politely through the opened door. "Only you were invited to enter the Governor's Mansion. I am afraid this as far as I am allowed to go. Take care, Captain <last>. It truly was an honor meeting you."|8988|0
units.english: Regina does not get out. She smiles politely through the opened door. "Only you were invited to enter the Governor's Mansion. I am afraid this as far as I am allowed to go. Take care, Captain <last>. It truly was an honor meeting you."
units.italian: Regina non scende. Sorride cortesemente dalla porta aperta. "Solo lei è stato invitato a entrare nella Villa del Governatore. Temo che sia fin qui che mi è consentito arrivare. Si riguardi, Capitano <last>. È stato davvero un onore conoscerla."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	With that the door shuts, and a few moments later the black vehicle departs, leaving you and the attendant at the mansion's entrance.|8989|0
units.english: With that the door shuts, and a few moments later the black vehicle departs, leaving you and the attendant at the mansion's entrance.
units.italian: Detto questo la porta si chiude e, qualche momento dopo, il veicolo nero parte, lasciando te e l'attendente davanti all'ingresso della villa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	The attendant bows deeply. "Please, Captain <last>. If you would follow me." He turns and heads into the building.|8990|0
units.english: The attendant bows deeply. "Please, Captain <last>. If you would follow me." He turns and heads into the building.
units.italian: L'attendente si inchina profondamente. "Prego, Capitano <last>. Se vuole seguirmi." Si volta ed entra nell'edificio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Follow the attendant.)|8992|0
units.english: (Follow the attendant.)
units.italian: (Segui l'attendente.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Upon entering the mansion you feel your weight shift. It's still a little less than 1 g, but close. There's a young well-dressed woman, the same who you saw in your message, waiting for you inside. The attendant leaves you with her.|8994|0
units.english: Upon entering the mansion you feel your weight shift. It's still a little less than 1 g, but close. There's a young well-dressed woman, the same who you saw in your message, waiting for you inside. The attendant leaves you with her.
units.italian: Entrando nella villa senti il tuo peso cambiare. È ancora un po' meno di 1 g, ma vicino. Dentro ti aspetta una giovane donna ben vestita, la stessa che hai visto nel messaggio. L'attendente ti lascia con lei.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	The woman smiles pleasantly. "We are all so pleased you could make it here. Forgive me for not meeting you outside, but I find the gravity of this world distressing. I am Wynnafrith, the governor's executive assistant, and will be pleased to announce that you are here.|8995|0
units.english: The woman smiles pleasantly. "We are all so pleased you could make it here. Forgive me for not meeting you outside, but I find the gravity of this world distressing. I am Wynnafrith, the governor's executive assistant, and will be pleased to announce that you are here.
units.italian: La donna sorride piacevolmente. "Siamo tutti così contenti che sia riuscito a venire. Mi perdoni se non l'ho incontrata fuori, ma trovo angosciante la gravità di questo mondo. Sono Wynnafrith, assistente esecutiva del governatore, e sarò lieta di annunciare il suo arrivo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Wynnafrith says a few quiet words into an intercom, and a door behind her opens. "The Governor is ready for you."|8996|0
units.english: Wynnafrith says a few quiet words into an intercom, and a door behind her opens. "The Governor is ready for you."
units.italian: Wynnafrith dice qualche parola a voce bassa in un interfono, e una porta dietro di lei si apre. "Il Governatore è pronto a riceverla."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Enter the room.)|8998|0
units.english: (Enter the room.)
units.italian: (Entra nella stanza.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	You enter a large, richly furnished room. At the center of the room is an imposing desk, with a slightly graying man seated behind it. There is something immediately familiar about his face.|9000|0
units.english: You enter a large, richly furnished room. At the center of the room is an imposing desk, with a slightly graying man seated behind it. There is something immediately familiar about his face.
units.italian: Entri in una grande stanza arredata con ricchezza. Al centro c'è un'imponente scrivania, con un uomo un po' ingrigito seduto dietro. C'è qualcosa di immediatamente familiare nel suo viso.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"Ah, Captain <last>. At last we can meet face to face, and I can thank you properly." The Governor stands. "You may not remember me, for it has been some years since you last laid eyes on me, and," the governor gestures to himself, "I looked quite different back then."|9001|0
units.english: "Ah, Captain <last>. At last we can meet face to face, and I can thank you properly." The Governor stands. "You may not remember me, for it has been some years since you last laid eyes on me, and," the governor gestures to himself, "I looked quite different back then."
units.italian: "Ah, Capitano <last>. Finalmente possiamo incontrarci faccia a faccia, e posso ringraziarla come si deve." Il Governatore si alza. "Forse non si ricorda di me, perché sono passati alcuni anni dall'ultima volta che mi ha visto e," il governatore accenna a sé, "allora avevo un aspetto molto diverso."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"I was a stowaway on your ship. You found me in a food crate, and you took me here. I'm Timothy Radrickson, Governor Timothy Radrickson now."|9002|0
units.english: "I was a stowaway on your ship. You found me in a food crate, and you took me here. I'm Timothy Radrickson, Governor Timothy Radrickson now."
units.italian: "Ero un clandestino sulla sua nave. Mi ha trovato in una cassa di cibo e mi ha portato qui. Sono Timothy Radrickson, ora Governatore Timothy Radrickson."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Timothy sits back down and indicates that you should do the same. "It took me some time. But through some good decisions, and quite a bit of luck, I've been able to claw my way to a level of respectability and wealth. I've really been able to make something of myself."|9003|0
units.english: Timothy sits back down and indicates that you should do the same. "It took me some time. But through some good decisions, and quite a bit of luck, I've been able to claw my way to a level of respectability and wealth. I've really been able to make something of myself."
units.italian: Timothy si risiede e ti fa cenno di fare lo stesso. "Mi ci è voluto del tempo. Ma con qualche buona decisione e parecchia fortuna sono riuscito a farmi strada fino a un livello di rispettabilità e benessere. Sono davvero riuscito a costruire qualcosa di me."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	His face opens up into a large grin. "Then again, compared to what you've done in all this time, my successes hardly register. Still, as meager as they may be, I owe it all to you and your kind gesture. Which is why I've invited you here, to thank you and pay you back properly."|9004|0
units.english: His face opens up into a large grin. "Then again, compared to what you've done in all this time, my successes hardly register. Still, as meager as they may be, I owe it all to you and your kind gesture. Which is why I've invited you here, to thank you and pay you back properly."
units.italian: Il suo viso si apre in un gran sorriso. "D'altra parte, rispetto a quello che hai fatto in tutto questo tempo, i miei successi contano poco. Eppure, per quanto modesti, li devo tutti a te e al tuo gesto di gentilezza. Ed è per questo che ti ho invitato qui: per ringraziarti e ripagarti come si deve."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Timothy taps a display on his desk. "First, I am transferring 125,000 credits to your account to pay you back for the crate of food, the fuel, and the additional expenses of taking care of me on your ship; plus interest, of course."|9005|0
units.english: Timothy taps a display on his desk. "First, I am transferring 125,000 credits to your account to pay you back for the crate of food, the fuel, and the additional expenses of taking care of me on your ship; plus interest, of course."
units.italian: Timothy tocca un display sulla scrivania. "Primo, sto trasferendo 125.000 crediti sul tuo conto per ripagarti della cassa di cibo, del carburante e delle spese aggiuntive per prenderti cura di me sulla tua nave; più gli interessi, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Accept the money.)|9007|0
units.english: (Accept the money.)
units.italian: (Accetta i soldi.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Refuse the money.)|9009|0
units.english: (Refuse the money.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta i soldi.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	You begin to refuse the generous offer, but Timothy holds up a hand to stop you. "I am doing quite well, and this discharges a debt that has been weighing on me. Besides, the money's already been sent!"|9011|0
units.english: You begin to refuse the generous offer, but Timothy holds up a hand to stop you. "I am doing quite well, and this discharges a debt that has been weighing on me. Besides, the money's already been sent!"
units.italian: Cominci a rifiutare la generosa offerta, ma Timothy alza una mano per fermarti. "Me la cavo piuttosto bene, e questo salda un debito che mi pesava. E poi i soldi sono già stati inviati!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|label|9013|0
units.english: money accept
units.italian: money accept

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Timothy pulls out a bottle beneath his desk and two glass cups. "To celebrate our reunion."|9014|0
units.english: Timothy pulls out a bottle beneath his desk and two glass cups. "To celebrate our reunion."
units.italian: Timothy tira fuori da sotto la scrivania una bottiglia e due bicchieri. "Per celebrare il nostro incontro."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	He pours the brown liquid in the cups and pushes one to you. "Things have gone well for me, and are only going to get better from here on out."|9015|0
units.english: He pours the brown liquid in the cups and pushes one to you. "Things have gone well for me, and are only going to get better from here on out."
units.italian: Versa il liquido bruno nei bicchieri e te ne spinge uno. "Le cose sono andate bene per me, e da qui in poi andranno solo meglio."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	He takes a sip and says, "We've just launched our largest freighter fleet to date." He sits back in his desk, relaxed, and gets a dreamy look in his eyes. "When it returns from Wayfarer, the government of Rand will finally have enough credits to make some real changes around here. Give something back to the working man."|9016|0
units.english: He takes a sip and says, "We've just launched our largest freighter fleet to date." He sits back in his desk, relaxed, and gets a dreamy look in his eyes. "When it returns from Wayfarer, the government of Rand will finally have enough credits to make some real changes around here. Give something back to the working man."
units.italian: Ne prende un sorso e dice: "Abbiamo appena varato la nostra flotta di mercantili più grande di sempre." Si appoggia allo schienale, rilassato, con uno sguardo sognante. "Quando tornerà da Wayfarer, il governo di Rand avrà finalmente abbastanza crediti per fare dei veri cambiamenti qui. Restituire qualcosa al lavoratore."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"Congratulations Timothy. You've really outdone yourself."|9018|0
units.english: "Congratulations Timothy. You've really outdone yourself."
units.italian: "Congratulazioni Timothy. Ti sei davvero superato."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Take a sip from my glass.)|9019|0
units.english: (Take a sip from my glass.)
units.italian: (Prendi un sorso dal mio bicchiere.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"Don't forget your humble beginnings, Timothy. The workers here seem to be suffering, while the rich thrive."|9020|0
units.english: "Don't forget your humble beginnings, Timothy. The workers here seem to be suffering, while the rich thrive."
units.italian: "Non dimenticare le tue umili origini, Timothy. Qui gli operai sembrano soffrire, mentre i ricchi prosperano."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"You're proof that hard work is all it takes to succeed. I don't know how you can stand living on a world filled with lazy workers all demanding hand outs."|9021|0
units.english: "You're proof that hard work is all it takes to succeed. I don't know how you can stand living on a world filled with lazy workers all demanding hand outs."
units.italian: "Sei la prova che il duro lavoro basta per avere successo. Non so come tu faccia a sopportare di vivere su un mondo pieno di operai pigri che chiedono solo elemosina."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	His eyes refocus on you. "You'd be proud, <first>. I am going to make a real difference here..."|9023|0
units.english: His eyes refocus on you. "You'd be proud, <first>. I am going to make a real difference here..."
units.italian: I suoi occhi tornano a metterti a fuoco. "Ne andresti fiero, <first>. Farò davvero la differenza, qui..."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Timothy is suddenly interrupted by an incessant notification coming from his desk. He glowers and says, "Excuse me for a moment, <last>," sits up straight, turns on his ear piece and answers the call.|9024|0
units.english: Timothy is suddenly interrupted by an incessant notification coming from his desk. He glowers and says, "Excuse me for a moment, <last>," sits up straight, turns on his ear piece and answers the call.
units.italian: Timothy viene improvvisamente interrotto da una notifica incessante dalla scrivania. Si rabbuia e dice: "Mi scusi un momento, <last>," si raddrizza, accende l'auricolare e risponde alla chiamata.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"What?!" He nearly shouts after ten seconds of listening, followed by "How can that be?" and finally, "What about the Navy or the militias, where are they!?" His face goes from red to white as the color drains out of him, and he finishes the call with a few unhappy "uh huhs" before finally hanging up.|9025|0
units.english: "What?!" He nearly shouts after ten seconds of listening, followed by "How can that be?" and finally, "What about the Navy or the militias, where are they!?" His face goes from red to white as the color drains out of him, and he finishes the call with a few unhappy "uh huhs" before finally hanging up.
units.italian: "Che cosa?!" Quasi urla dopo dieci secondi di ascolto, seguito da "Come è possibile?" e infine "E la Marina o le milizie, dove sono?!" Il viso gli passa dal rosso al bianco mentre il colore lo abbandona, e chiude la chiamata con qualche "uh uh" infelice prima di riattaccare.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"Never mind." He rubs his forehead and closes his eyes before saying, "Rand's future is gone. It's just been hijacked by marauders."|9026|0
units.english: "Never mind." He rubs his forehead and closes his eyes before saying, "Rand's future is gone. It's just been hijacked by marauders."
units.italian: "Non importa." Si strofina la fronte e chiude gli occhi prima di dire: "Il futuro di Rand è perduto. È appena stato dirottato dai predoni."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	He stands up and starts pacing around the room. "I'm sorry. We're going to have to cut this reunion short. Our freighter fleet, filled to the brim with all of Rand's mineral wealth, has been taken. To make matters worse, in order to make this shipment happen I had to hire a private outfit from the Deep, and neither the Navy nor the Free Worlds militias are going to intervene on their behalf. Which means this entire world, and myself, are finished."|9027|0
units.english: He stands up and starts pacing around the room. "I'm sorry. We're going to have to cut this reunion short. Our freighter fleet, filled to the brim with all of Rand's mineral wealth, has been taken. To make matters worse, in order to make this shipment happen I had to hire a private outfit from the Deep, and neither the Navy nor the Free Worlds militias are going to intervene on their behalf. Which means this entire world, and myself, are finished."
units.italian: Si alza e comincia a camminare avanti e indietro per la stanza. "Mi dispiace. Dovremo interrompere qui il nostro incontro. La nostra flotta di mercantili, piena fino all'orlo di tutta la ricchezza mineraria di Rand, è stata presa. E a peggiorare le cose, per realizzare questa spedizione ho dovuto ingaggiare una compagnia privata dal Deep, e né la Marina né le milizie dei Free Worlds interverranno per loro conto. Il che significa che questo intero mondo, e io stesso, siamo finiti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	He collapses back in his chair with his head in his hands. "I'm sorry. There will be a car waiting for you at the entrance."|9028|0
units.english: He collapses back in his chair with his head in his hands. "I'm sorry. There will be a car waiting for you at the entrance."
units.italian: Crolla di nuovo sulla sedia con la testa fra le mani. "Mi dispiace. Ci sarà un'auto ad aspettarla all'ingresso."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"I could help you recover the fleet."|9030|0
units.english: "I could help you recover the fleet."
units.italian: "Potrei aiutarti a recuperare la flotta."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Apologize for his predicament and leave.)|9032|0
units.english: (Apologize for his predicament and leave.)
units.italian: (Scusati per la sua situazione e vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Leave without saying anything.)|9033|0
units.english: (Leave without saying anything.)
units.italian: (Vattene senza dire nulla.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	The doors behind you open back up, and you are led back outside to a waiting vehicle. You ride it in silence through the dust-thick landscape, back to the dirty, shabby spaceport where your ship awaits.|9036|0
units.english: The doors behind you open back up, and you are led back outside to a waiting vehicle. You ride it in silence through the dust-thick landscape, back to the dirty, shabby spaceport where your ship awaits.
units.italian: Le porte alle tue spalle si riaprono e vieni riportato fuori verso un veicolo in attesa. Lo percorri in silenzio attraverso il paesaggio denso di polvere, fino allo spazioporto sporco e malmesso dove ti attende la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|label|9039|0
units.english: help tim
units.italian: help tim

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Timothy jerks up to look at you, his eyes wide and searching. "Really? I... Rand... we don't have anything left to pay you, and who knows how dangerous those marauders are... but we'll take any help we can get if you're up for it."|9040|0
units.english: Timothy jerks up to look at you, his eyes wide and searching. "Really? I... Rand... we don't have anything left to pay you, and who knows how dangerous those marauders are... but we'll take any help we can get if you're up for it."
units.italian: Timothy scatta a guardarti, con gli occhi sgranati e indagatori. "Davvero? Io... Rand... non ci resta niente per pagarti, e chissà quanto sono pericolosi quei predoni... ma accetteremo qualsiasi aiuto se te la senti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Agree to help.)|9042|0
units.english: (Agree to help.)
units.italian: (Accetta di aiutare.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	(Back out.)|9044|0
units.english: (Back out.)
units.italian: (Tirati indietro.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	The light drains from his eyes and he nods tiredly. "I understand."|9046|0
units.english: The light drains from his eyes and he nods tiredly. "I understand."
units.italian: La luce gli si spegne negli occhi e annuisce stanco. "Capisco."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|label|9049|0
units.english: agree help
units.italian: agree help

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	Color returns to Timothy's face and he immediately straightens up. "Hroar's Haulers were contracted to deliver our freight to Wayfarer. We lost contact with them in the Peacock system. There was a report from some local merchants who sighted a large group of marauders in Lesath escorting a freighter fleet in merchant colors. They tracked their movements to Shaula."|9050|0
units.english: Color returns to Timothy's face and he immediately straightens up. "Hroar's Haulers were contracted to deliver our freight to Wayfarer. We lost contact with them in the Peacock system. There was a report from some local merchants who sighted a large group of marauders in Lesath escorting a freighter fleet in merchant colors. They tracked their movements to Shaula."
units.italian: Il colore torna sul viso di Timothy e lui si raddrizza subito. "Gli Hroar's Haulers erano stati ingaggiati per consegnare il nostro carico a Wayfarer. Abbiamo perso i contatti con loro nel sistema Peacock. C'è stato il rapporto di alcuni mercanti locali che hanno avvistato un folto gruppo di predoni su Lesath, mentre scortavano una flotta di mercantili con i colori dei commercianti. Ne hanno seguito gli spostamenti fino a Shaula."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	He frowns as he considers something, then says, "If you hurry, you might be able to get there before they've had time to move the goods or deal with their crews... no more than a week at most... but who knows, they're pirates." Timothy hits a few more buttons on his display screen, then he continues, "I've just sent your ship the tracking beacon for our fleet. It should help you find them once you're in Greenrock's atmosphere."|9051|0
units.english: He frowns as he considers something, then says, "If you hurry, you might be able to get there before they've had time to move the goods or deal with their crews... no more than a week at most... but who knows, they're pirates." Timothy hits a few more buttons on his display screen, then he continues, "I've just sent your ship the tracking beacon for our fleet. It should help you find them once you're in Greenrock's atmosphere."
units.italian: Si acciglia considerando qualcosa, poi dice: "Se ti sbrighi, potresti arrivare prima che abbiano avuto il tempo di spostare la merce o di sbrigare i loro equipaggi... una settimana al massimo... ma chissà, sono pirati." Timothy preme altri pulsanti sul suo schermo, poi continua: "Ho appena inviato alla tua nave il segnale di localizzazione della nostra flotta. Dovrebbe aiutarti a trovarla una volta nell'atmosfera di Greenrock."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3a: Rescue the Convoy|	"I am sorry I can't offer you more help." He stands up and hits the button opening up the exit door. "But, please, save that fleet."|9052|0
units.english: "I am sorry I can't offer you more help." He stands up and hits the button opening up the exit door. "But, please, save that fleet."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace di non poterti offrire più aiuto." Si alza e preme il pulsante che apre la porta d'uscita. "Ma, per favore, salva quella flotta."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|name|9061|0
units.english: Defeat the pirate fleet
units.italian: Sconfiggere la flotta pirata

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|description|9062|0
units.english: Destroy the pirate fleet that is holding Rand's convoy hostage, then try and recover it.
units.italian: Distruggi la flotta pirata che tiene in ostaggio il convoglio di Rand, poi prova a recuperarlo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|Your ship skims Greenrock's choppy atmosphere and your terrestrial navigation computer suddenly hums to life as it picks up the lost freighter fleet's tracking beacon. It locks on to a large encampment situated in a valley a bit under fifty kilometers northeast of the planetary spaceport - close enough to do business, but far enough away to maintain strict security.|9069|0
units.english: Your ship skims Greenrock's choppy atmosphere and your terrestrial navigation computer suddenly hums to life as it picks up the lost freighter fleet's tracking beacon. It locks on to a large encampment situated in a valley a bit under fifty kilometers northeast of the planetary spaceport - close enough to do business, but far enough away to maintain strict security.
units.italian: La tua nave sfiora l'atmosfera turbolenta di Greenrock e il computer di navigazione terrestre si risveglia all'improvviso captando il segnale di localizzazione della flotta di mercantili perduta. Si aggancia a un grande accampamento situato in una valle a poco meno di cinquanta chilometri a nord-est dello spazioporto planetario: abbastanza vicino per fare affari, ma abbastanza lontano per mantenere una sicurezza rigorosa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	As you approach the beacon's ping from the safety of the hills around the valley, you survey the base from afar. It clearly appears to be built around a set of underground blast doors, from where the beacon - and presumably the fleet - is located. Your ship also identifies numerous parked pirate vessels inside and outside the base.|9070|0
units.english: As you approach the beacon's ping from the safety of the hills around the valley, you survey the base from afar. It clearly appears to be built around a set of underground blast doors, from where the beacon - and presumably the fleet - is located. Your ship also identifies numerous parked pirate vessels inside and outside the base.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini al ping del segnale dal riparo delle colline intorno alla valle, osservi la base da lontano. Sembra chiaramente costruita intorno a una serie di porte stagne sotterranee, da dove proviene il segnale e presumibilmente la flotta. La tua nave individua anche numerose navi pirata parcheggiate dentro e fuori la base.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	The pirates haven't realized you're hostile yet, and you have an opportunity to seize the initiative and do a surprise attack. Or, you could get closer and continue surveying the base to see if there's any way in.|9071|0
units.english: The pirates haven't realized you're hostile yet, and you have an opportunity to seize the initiative and do a surprise attack. Or, you could get closer and continue surveying the base to see if there's any way in.
units.italian: I pirati non si sono ancora accorti che sei ostile, e hai l'opportunità di prendere l'iniziativa e sferrare un attacco a sorpresa. Oppure potresti avvicinarti e continuare a osservare la base per vedere se c'è un modo per entrare.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	(Do a surprise attack!)|9073|0
units.english: (Do a surprise attack!)
units.italian: (Fai un attacco a sorpresa!)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	(Get closer.)|9077|0
units.english: (Get closer.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	(Hail the pirates and use diplomacy.)|9078|0
units.english: (Hail the pirates and use diplomacy.)
units.italian: (Chiama i pirati e usa la diplomazia.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	(This is too dangerous. Leave.)|9080|0
units.english: (This is too dangerous. Leave.)
units.italian: (È troppo pericoloso. Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	Getting as far as you can toward the base without compromising your position, you notice the base is surrounded by an array of laser turrets and ground-to-air missile systems, which makes further approach highly risky. Furthermore, the ships outside the base appear to be highly modified. You don't see any other entrance to the base, however; it looks like you'll have to force the pirates out, one way or another.|9083|0
units.english: Getting as far as you can toward the base without compromising your position, you notice the base is surrounded by an array of laser turrets and ground-to-air missile systems, which makes further approach highly risky. Furthermore, the ships outside the base appear to be highly modified. You don't see any other entrance to the base, however; it looks like you'll have to force the pirates out, one way or another.
units.italian: Avanzando il più possibile verso la base senza compromettere la tua posizione, noti che è circondata da una serie di torrette laser e sistemi missilistici terra-aria, il che rende un ulteriore avvicinamento molto rischioso. Inoltre le navi fuori dalla base sembrano pesantemente modificate. Non vedi però altre entrate: sembra che dovrai stanare i pirati, in un modo o nell'altro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	It still seems as if the pirates don't see you. With a little movement, you could strafe the encampment and take out a fair few of the parked ships if you can avoid the turrets.|9084|0
units.english: It still seems as if the pirates don't see you. With a little movement, you could strafe the encampment and take out a fair few of the parked ships if you can avoid the turrets.
units.italian: Sembra ancora che i pirati non ti vedano. Con un piccolo spostamento potresti mitragliare l'accampamento e distruggere parecchie navi parcheggiate, se riesci a evitare le torrette.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	(Strafe the parked pirate vessels.)|9086|0
units.english: (Strafe the parked pirate vessels.)
units.italian: (Mitraglia le navi pirata parcheggiate.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	(Hail the pirates and use diplomacy.)|9089|0
units.english: (Hail the pirates and use diplomacy.)
units.italian: (Chiama i pirati e usa la diplomazia.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	(This is too dangerous. Leave.)|9091|0
units.english: (This is too dangerous. Leave.)
units.italian: (È troppo pericoloso. Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	Carefully maneuvering into position, your ship flies out of the hills that hid it and lets loose a withering barrage over the parked pirate vessels. You manage to destroy a number of the ships while their shields are down, before the defense turrets force you to fly back up into space as the surviving ships sortie after you.|9096|0
units.english: Carefully maneuvering into position, your ship flies out of the hills that hid it and lets loose a withering barrage over the parked pirate vessels. You manage to destroy a number of the ships while their shields are down, before the defense turrets force you to fly back up into space as the surviving ships sortie after you.
units.italian: Manovrando con cautela in posizione, la tua nave esce dalle colline che la nascondevano e scatena un fuoco devastante sulle navi pirata parcheggiate. Riesci a distruggere diverse navi mentre i loro scudi sono abbassati, prima che le torrette difensive ti costringano a risalire nello spazio mentre le navi superstiti ti si lanciano dietro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	You broadcast a message to the ships parked in the encampment, declaring that you wish them no harm and inviting them to parley over the Rand convoy.|9103|0
units.english: You broadcast a message to the ships parked in the encampment, declaring that you wish them no harm and inviting them to parley over the Rand convoy.
units.italian: Trasmetti un messaggio alle navi parcheggiate nell'accampamento, dichiarando che non vuoi fare loro del male e invitandole a un negoziato sul convoglio di Rand.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	Their only response is to launch their entire fleet after you. You're forced back into space to fight them.|9104|0
units.english: Their only response is to launch their entire fleet after you. You're forced back into space to fight them.
units.italian: La loro unica risposta è lanciare l'intera flotta contro di te. Sei costretto a tornare nello spazio per combatterle.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	You shunt your thrusters to full speed and fly into the valley, straight for the largest cluster of parked ships outside the blast doors.|9110|0
units.english: You shunt your thrusters to full speed and fly into the valley, straight for the largest cluster of parked ships outside the blast doors.
units.italian: Mandi i propulsori a piena velocità e voli nella valle, dritto verso il gruppo più numeroso di navi parcheggiate fuori dalle porte stagne.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|	That is, until your sensors run hot with a multitude of approaching enemy warnings and missile locks. Without the protection of the hills that were hiding your ship, it looks like the pirates' early warning system detected you before you could get into position to attack. You're forced to turn back as an entire fleet of marauders fire up their engines and chase you into space.|9111|0
units.english: That is, until your sensors run hot with a multitude of approaching enemy warnings and missile locks. Without the protection of the hills that were hiding your ship, it looks like the pirates' early warning system detected you before you could get into position to attack. You're forced to turn back as an entire fleet of marauders fire up their engines and chase you into space.
units.italian: Fino a quando i tuoi sensori non si accendono di una moltitudine di avvisi di nemici in avvicinamento e agganci missilistici. Senza la protezione delle colline che nascondevano la nave, sembra che il sistema di allarme precoce dei pirati ti abbia individuato prima che potessi metterti in posizione per attaccare.
