Sei costretto a tornare indietro mentre un'intera flotta di predoni accende i motori e ti insegue nello spazio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|dialog|9115|0
units.english: There are still marauder ships flying overhead. Take off and defeat them before finding the fleet.
units.italian: Ci sono ancora navi predone che volano sopra la testa. Decolla e sconfiggile prima di cercare la flotta.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|dialog|9139|0
units.english: After destroying the last of the marauder ships you feel you can safely return to the base.
units.italian: Dopo aver distrutto l'ultima delle navi predone, senti di poter tornare alla base in sicurezza.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3b: Pirate Base|dialog|9160|0
units.english: After destroying the last of the marauder ships you feel you can safely return to the base.
units.italian: Dopo aver distrutto l'ultima delle navi predone, senti di poter tornare alla base in sicurezza.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|name|9164|0
units.english: Escort the Convoy
units.italian: Scortare il convoglio

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|description|9165|0
units.english: Escort the Hroar's Haulers Convoy from <origin> to <destination>.
units.italian: Scorta il convoglio degli Hroar's Haulers da <origin> a <destination>.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|The sky burns red as detritus from the fierce battle rains down on Greenrock. The destruction of a major pirate gang's fleet has resulted in panic and chaos over the region as rival pirate groups battle it out in the skies to claim the defeated's turf. Although a few ships take pot shots at you as you descend into the atmosphere, everybody is too busy brawling to notice you as you approach the pirates' encampment from where you still register the ping of the beacon.|9172|0
units.english: The sky burns red as detritus from the fierce battle rains down on Greenrock. The destruction of a major pirate gang's fleet has resulted in panic and chaos over the region as rival pirate groups battle it out in the skies to claim the defeated's turf. Although a few ships take pot shots at you as you descend into the atmosphere, everybody is too busy brawling to notice you as you approach the pirates' encampment from where you still register the ping of the beacon.
units.italian: Il cielo brucia rosso mentre i detriti della feroce battaglia piovono su Greenrock. La distruzione della flotta di una grande banda pirata ha provocato panico e caos nella regione, mentre gruppi rivali si contendono il territorio del sconfitto nei cieli. Anche se qualche nave ti spara mentre scendi nell'atmosfera, tutti sono troppo impegnati a fare a botte per notarti mentre ti avvicini all'accampamento dei pirati, da dove registri ancora il ping del segnale.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	The valley where the encampment is located, however, is surprisingly quiet, though it's similarly littered with the remains of small ships. As you move towards it you notice that the blast doors of the underground base have been opened. What you also notice is that the defense turrets are all still working and are very much trained upon you.|9173|0
units.english: The valley where the encampment is located, however, is surprisingly quiet, though it's similarly littered with the remains of small ships. As you move towards it you notice that the blast doors of the underground base have been opened. What you also notice is that the defense turrets are all still working and are very much trained upon you.
units.italian: La valle in cui si trova l'accampamento, però, è sorprendentemente tranquilla, anche se disseminata allo stesso modo di resti di piccole navi. Mentre ti avvicini noti che le porte stagne della base sotterranea sono state aperte. Noti anche che le torrette difensive funzionano ancora tutte e sono decisamente puntate su di te.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	(Hail the occupants of the base.)|9175|0
units.english: (Hail the occupants of the base.)
units.italian: (Chiama gli occupanti della base.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	(Approach the base.)|9176|0
units.english: (Approach the base.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati alla base.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	(Leave.)|9178|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"This is Captain <last>, commander of the <ship>," you say. "We have defeated the fleet that occupies this base and demand entry. Disable your turrets or we will fire upon them."|9181|0
units.english: "This is Captain <last>, commander of the <ship>," you say. "We have defeated the fleet that occupies this base and demand entry. Disable your turrets or we will fire upon them."
units.italian: "Sono il Capitano <last>, comandante della <ship>," dici. "Abbiamo sconfitto la flotta che occupava questa base e pretendiamo di entrare. Disattivate le vostre torrette o apriremo il fuoco su di loro."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	You receive a response promptly. "And what makes you think we will let ya' in?"|9185|0
units.english: You receive a response promptly. "And what makes you think we will let ya' in?"
units.italian: Ricevi subito una risposta. "E che cosa ti fa pensare che ti lasceremo entrare?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|label|9188|0
units.english: did it already
units.italian: did it already

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	This time, you get a response promptly. "And what makes you think we will let ya' in?"|9189|0
units.english: This time, you get a response promptly. "And what makes you think we will let ya' in?"
units.italian: Questa volta ricevi subito una risposta. "E che cosa ti fa pensare che ti lasceremo entrare?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	You advance towards the encampment for about five seconds before you receive a hail coming from behind the blast doors. "Hey, hey! What makes you think we'll let ya' in?"|9193|0
units.english: You advance towards the encampment for about five seconds before you receive a hail coming from behind the blast doors. "Hey, hey! What makes you think we'll let ya' in?"
units.italian: Avanzi verso l'accampamento per circa cinque secondi prima di ricevere una chiamata da dietro le porte stagne. "Ehi, ehi! Che cosa ti fa pensare che ti lasceremo entrare?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"Right of conquest."|9197|0
units.english: "Right of conquest."
units.italian: "Diritto di conquista."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"Because I defeated your fleet."|9199|0
units.english: "Because I defeated your fleet."
units.italian: "Perché ho sconfitto la vostra flotta."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"Because I'm here to rescue the Rand convoy, and you can't stop me."|9201|0
units.english: "Because I'm here to rescue the Rand convoy, and you can't stop me."
units.italian: "Perché sono qui per salvare il convoglio di Rand, e non potete fermarmi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	You hear a hearty laugh from the other end. "What makes you think they're still here?" the voice replies.|9203|0
units.english: You hear a hearty laugh from the other end. "What makes you think they're still here?" the voice replies.
units.italian: Senti una risata di cuore dall'altro capo. "Che cosa ti fa pensare che siano ancora qui?" risponde la voce.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	You hear a hearty laugh from the other end. "Right of conquest? I thought you were here to save us!" the voice replies.|9207|0
units.english: You hear a hearty laugh from the other end. "Right of conquest? I thought you were here to save us!" the voice replies.
units.italian: Senti una risata di cuore dall'altro capo. "Diritto di conquista? Pensavo fossi qui per salvarci!" risponde la voce.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|label|9210|0
units.english: defeated your fleet
units.italian: defeated your fleet

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	You hear a hearty laugh from the other end. "That fleet? Just a trifle. We've got the Sol Home Fleet behind these doors," the voice replies.|9211|0
units.english: You hear a hearty laugh from the other end. "That fleet? Just a trifle. We've got the Sol Home Fleet behind these doors," the voice replies.
units.italian: Senti una risata di cuore dall'altro capo. "Quella flotta? Una bazzeccola. Dietro queste porte abbiamo la Home Fleet di Sol," risponde la voce.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	A moment passes before it says, "We're just pulling your leg, <last>. We can see your tracking beacon reflecting our own, so we know it's you. Come on in." The turrets shortly depower and you gently put your ship down through the blast doors.|9214|0
units.english: A moment passes before it says, "We're just pulling your leg, <last>. We can see your tracking beacon reflecting our own, so we know it's you. Come on in." The turrets shortly depower and you gently put your ship down through the blast doors.
units.italian: Passa un momento prima che dica: "Ti stiamo solo prendendo in giro, <last>. Vediamo il tuo segnale di localizzazione riflettere il nostro, quindi sappiamo che sei tu. Entra pure." Le torrette si spengono poco dopo e posi la nave con delicatezza attraverso le porte stagne.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	Inside the bay's walls you can make out the moored and apparently intact freighter fleet. The ships are surrounded by various loaders, but they appear to have been abandoned before they could begin the process of offloading the goods. The pirates must have been too busy going after you.|9215|0
units.english: Inside the bay's walls you can make out the moored and apparently intact freighter fleet. The ships are surrounded by various loaders, but they appear to have been abandoned before they could begin the process of offloading the goods. The pirates must have been too busy going after you.
units.italian: Dentro le pareti della baia distingui la flotta di mercantili ormeggiata e apparentemente intatta. Le navi sono circondate da vari carrelli di carico, ma sembra che siano stati abbandonati prima che potessero iniziare a scaricare la merce. I pirati dovevano essere troppo impegnati a inseguire te.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	As you exit your ship a woman wearing a captain's hat approaches you and then flashes a reluctant smile at you. "Name's Hrodny. Capt'n Hrodny of Hroar's Haulers. You probably heard Alan on the radio," she says, flicking her eyes to the control room.|9216|0
units.english: As you exit your ship a woman wearing a captain's hat approaches you and then flashes a reluctant smile at you. "Name's Hrodny. Capt'n Hrodny of Hroar's Haulers. You probably heard Alan on the radio," she says, flicking her eyes to the control room.
units.italian: Mentre esci dalla nave ti si avvicina una donna con il berretto da capitano, che poi ti rivolge un sorriso riluttante. "Mi chiamo Hrodny. Capitano Hrodny degli Hroar's Haulers. Probabilmente hai sentito Alan alla radio," dice, lanciando un'occhiata verso la sala di controllo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"Well, thanks for the distraction. Once you got the fleet out of here we overpowered what little detail they kept here and took control of the turrets." She looks around to the blast doors where the depowered turrets once guarded. "Been waitin' for the right moment to move outta this place."|9217|0
units.english: "Well, thanks for the distraction. Once you got the fleet out of here we overpowered what little detail they kept here and took control of the turrets." She looks around to the blast doors where the depowered turrets once guarded. "Been waitin' for the right moment to move outta this place."
units.italian: "Beh, grazie per la distrazione. Appena hai portato la flotta fuori di qui abbiamo sopraffatto quel poco di scorta che avevano lasciato e ci siamo presi le torrette." Guarda verso le porte stagne, un tempo sorvegliate dalle torrette ora spente. "Aspettavamo il momento giusto per uscire da 'sto posto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	Hrodny turns her piercing green eyes back on you. "We got 'em in here easy, but we can't fight past whatever is out there. I'm presuming you're not just a lost mercenary and are in fact our cavalry?"|9218|0
units.english: Hrodny turns her piercing green eyes back on you. "We got 'em in here easy, but we can't fight past whatever is out there. I'm presuming you're not just a lost mercenary and are in fact our cavalry?"
units.italian: Hrodny riporta su di te i suoi occhi verdi e penetranti. "Li abbiamo fatti entrare qui facilmente, ma non possiamo combattere contro qualunque cosa ci sia là fuori. Presumo che tu non sia solo un mercenario disperso e che sia davvero la nostra cavalleria?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"Don't worry. I can escort your fleet to Wayfarer."|9220|0
units.english: "Don't worry. I can escort your fleet to Wayfarer."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti. Posso scortare la tua flotta fino a Wayfarer."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"It's your lucky day. Getting you to Wayfarer will be a piece of cake."|9221|0
units.english: "It's your lucky day. Getting you to Wayfarer will be a piece of cake."
units.italian: "È il tuo giorno fortunato. Portarvi a Wayfarer sarà un gioco da ragazzi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"I've been sent to get you to Wayfarer, and that's what I will do."|9222|0
units.english: "I've been sent to get you to Wayfarer, and that's what I will do."
units.italian: "Mi hanno mandato a portarvi a Wayfarer, e questo farò."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"You do your job. I'll do mine."|9223|0
units.english: "You do your job. I'll do mine."
units.italian: "Tu fai il tuo lavoro. Io faccio il mio."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	Hrodny grins. "Great. We weren't too keen on stickin' around these parts anyhow."|9225|0
units.english: Hrodny grins. "Great. We weren't too keen on stickin' around these parts anyhow."
units.italian: Hrodny ghigna. "Ottimo. Comunque non avevamo molta voglia di restare da 'ste parti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	She looks back at her ships, whistles, and points toward the ships. A group of Haulers turn and run toward them, preparing them for takeoff. She then looks back at you. "Ya know, those pirates parked us right in the middle of their treasure trove. It'd be rude not take advantage of their hospitality." You notice the loaders behind Hrodny whirring around and moving all sorts of goods into the ships, while a number of crew are draining the base's deuterium tanks and filling up the ships inside.|9226|0
units.english: She looks back at her ships, whistles, and points toward the ships. A group of Haulers turn and run toward them, preparing them for takeoff. She then looks back at you. "Ya know, those pirates parked us right in the middle of their treasure trove. It'd be rude not take advantage of their hospitality." You notice the loaders behind Hrodny whirring around and moving all sorts of goods into the ships, while a number of crew are draining the base's deuterium tanks and filling up the ships inside.
units.italian: Si volta verso le sue navi, fischia e le indica. Un gruppo di Haulers si gira e corre verso di loro, preparandole al decollo. Poi torna a guardarti. "Sai, quei pirati ci hanno parcheggiati proprio in mezzo al loro tesoro. Sarebbe scortese non approfittare della loro ospitalità." Noti i carrelli dietro Hrodny che ronzano e caricano ogni sorta di merce sulle navi, mentre vari membri dell'equipaggio svuotano i serbatoi di deuterio della base e riempiono le navi dentro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"Hazard pay," Hrodny says, winking at you. "You head back your ship, and by the time you get there we'll be ready to launch. We'll follow ya out."|9227|0
units.english: "Hazard pay," Hrodny says, winking at you. "You head back your ship, and by the time you get there we'll be ready to launch. We'll follow ya out."
units.italian: "Indennità di rischio," dice Hrodny, facendoti l'occhiolino. "Torna alla tua nave, e quando arrivi saremo pronti a partire. Ti seguiamo fuori."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	She gives you a final mock salute and then turns and jogs toward her ships. There's nothing for you to do but head back toward yours.|9228|0
units.english: She gives you a final mock salute and then turns and jogs toward her ships. There's nothing for you to do but head back toward yours.
units.italian: Ti fa un ultimo saluto scherzoso e poi si volta e corre verso le sue navi. Non ti resta che tornare alla tua.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|The freighter fleet sets down to some minor fanfare; there are likely more than a few middlemen here who would have been hard-pressed by the loss of the fleet's valuable cargo.|9233|0
units.english: The freighter fleet sets down to some minor fanfare; there are likely more than a few middlemen here who would have been hard-pressed by the loss of the fleet's valuable cargo.
units.italian: La flotta di mercantili si posa fra una certa fanfara; qui ci saranno probabilmente più di un intermediario che sarebbero stati messi in difficoltà dalla perdita del prezioso carico della flotta.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	Not long after landing, Captain Hrodny seeks you out. "Didn't have much time back there for pleasantries, but gotta say I am mighty thankful you showed up when you did."|9234|0
units.english: Not long after landing, Captain Hrodny seeks you out. "Didn't have much time back there for pleasantries, but gotta say I am mighty thankful you showed up when you did."
units.italian: Non molto dopo l'atterraggio, il capitano Hrodny ti cerca. "Là dietro non avevo molto tempo per le cortesie, ma devo dire che sono immensamente grata che tu sia arrivato quando l'hai fatto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	She extends her hand to you.|9235|0
units.english: She extends her hand to you.
units.italian: Ti tende la mano.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	(Shake Hrodny's hand.)|9237|0
units.english: (Shake Hrodny's hand.)
units.italian: (Stringi la mano di Hrodny.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	(Don't shake her hand.)|9239|0
units.english: (Don't shake her hand.)
units.italian: (Non stringerle la mano.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	She shrugs and withdraws her hand. "Different customs I suppose."|9241|0
units.english: She shrugs and withdraws her hand. "Different customs I suppose."
units.italian: Fa spallucce e ritira la mano. "Suppongo che abbiate usanze diverse."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	Hrodny pauses for a moment, then says, "Gotta say you handled yourself well out there. Always good to see a capt'n worth more than the dust on their boots." She gives you an approving nod.|9242|0
units.english: Hrodny pauses for a moment, then says, "Gotta say you handled yourself well out there. Always good to see a capt'n worth more than the dust on their boots." She gives you an approving nod.
units.italian: Hrodny fa una pausa, poi dice: "Devo dire che te la sei cavata bene là fuori. Fa sempre bene vedere un capitano che vale più della polvere sui suoi stivali." Ti fa un cenno di approvazione.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	Her hand vigorously shakes yours. "Gotta say you handled yourself well out there. Always good to see a capt'n worth more than the dust on their boots." She gives you an approving nod.|9246|0
units.english: Her hand vigorously shakes yours. "Gotta say you handled yourself well out there. Always good to see a capt'n worth more than the dust on their boots." She gives you an approving nod.
units.italian: La sua mano stringe vigorosamente la tua. "Devo dire che te la sei cavata bene là fuori. Fa sempre bene vedere un capitano che vale più della polvere sui suoi stivali." Ti fa un cenno di approvazione.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|label|9248|0
units.english: next up
units.italian: next up

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	"I got word from Rand they are more than a little pleased with your heroics. They'd like you to head on over to the spaceport on Rand when you can. Probably have some credits or a photo op or something fancy and tedious waiting for you."|9249|0
units.english: "I got word from Rand they are more than a little pleased with your heroics. They'd like you to head on over to the spaceport on Rand when you can. Probably have some credits or a photo op or something fancy and tedious waiting for you."
units.italian: "Ho avuto notizie da Rand: sono più che un po' soddisfatti delle tue imprese eroiche. Vorrebbero che passassi allo spazioporto di Rand quando puoi. Probabilmente avrai dei crediti o una foto di rito o qualcosa di elegante e noioso che ti aspetta."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	She shrugs, and winks, "Anyways, I got plenty of work that needs doing. Take care of yourself, Capt'n."|9250|0
units.english: She shrugs, and winks, "Anyways, I got plenty of work that needs doing. Take care of yourself, Capt'n."
units.italian: Fa spallucce e ti fa l'occhiolino. "Comunque ho un sacco di lavoro da fare. Abbi cura di te, capitano."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3c: Escort the Convoy|	With that she heads back to her freighter fleet.|9251|0
units.english: With that she heads back to her freighter fleet.
units.italian: Detto questo torna alla sua flotta di mercantili.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|name|9273|0
units.english: Return to Rand
units.italian: Tornare su Rand

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|description|9274|0
units.english: Now that you've finished escorting the Hroar's Haulers Convoy, visit <destination> for your reward.
units.italian: Ora che hai finito di scortare il convoglio degli Hroar's Haulers, fai visita a <destination> per la tua ricompensa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|Instead of Regina you are met by Timothy's executive secretary, Wynnafrith. She is clearly a little uncomfortable in Rand's low gravity, but is doing her best to push through it.|9281|0
units.english: Instead of Regina you are met by Timothy's executive secretary, Wynnafrith. She is clearly a little uncomfortable in Rand's low gravity, but is doing her best to push through it.
units.italian: Invece di Regina ti accoglie la segretaria esecutiva di Timothy, Wynnafrith. È chiaramente un po' a disagio nella bassa gravità di Rand, ma fa del suo meglio per sopportarla.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"Captain <last>! You're the talk of the world! The savior of Rand." She gives you an open and earnest smile.|9282|0
units.english: "Captain <last>! You're the talk of the world! The savior of Rand." She gives you an open and earnest smile.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>! È sulla bocca di tutti sul pianeta! Il salvatore di Rand." Ti rivolge un sorriso aperto e sincero.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"I've been sent by the Governor to drive you straight to his estate. Please come with me."|9283|0
units.english: "I've been sent by the Governor to drive you straight to his estate. Please come with me."
units.italian: "Il Governatore mi ha mandato a portarla direttamente alla sua tenuta. La prego di venire con me."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Go to the Governor's Mansion.)|9285|0
units.english: (Go to the Governor's Mansion.)
units.italian: (Vai alla Villa del Governatore.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	In the evening the passing landscape is too dark to see, so instead you focus on the glittering stars overhead. Eventually your ride slows as you seem to be caught up in traffic near the Governor's mansion. As you approach you pass streets crowded with parked personal vehicles.|9287|0
units.english: In the evening the passing landscape is too dark to see, so instead you focus on the glittering stars overhead. Eventually your ride slows as you seem to be caught up in traffic near the Governor's mansion. As you approach you pass streets crowded with parked personal vehicles.
units.italian: La sera il paesaggio che scorre è troppo buio per essere visto, così ti concentri sulle stelle scintillanti sopra la testa. Alla fine il veicolo rallenta, sembra che tu sia finito nel traffico vicino alla villa del Governatore. Avvicinandoti passi per strade affollate di veicoli personali parcheggiati.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	The mansion is lit up with dozens of flood lights, and brimming with fabulously dressed people. Wynnafrith turns her vehicle over to a valet and opens your door to let you out.|9288|0
units.english: The mansion is lit up with dozens of flood lights, and brimming with fabulously dressed people. Wynnafrith turns her vehicle over to a valet and opens your door to let you out.
units.italian: La villa è illuminata da dozzine di riflettori ed è piena di persone vestite in modo favoloso. Wynnafrith affida il veicolo a un parcheggiatore e apre la tua portiera per farti scendere.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	She gives you a mischievous grin. "Apologies, Captain <last>. I forgot to mention the Governor was holding a little get-together. Please follow me."|9289|0
units.english: She gives you a mischievous grin. "Apologies, Captain <last>. I forgot to mention the Governor was holding a little get-together. Please follow me."
units.italian: Ti fa un sorriso birichino. "Mi scusi, Capitano <last>. Ho dimenticato di menzionare che il Governatore dava una piccola festa. La prego di seguirmi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Follow Wynnafrith.)|9291|0
units.english: (Follow Wynnafrith.)
units.italian: (Segui Wynnafrith.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	She leads you through an army of valets, waiters, and attendants as you weave in and out of the various rooms and halls. Many of the guests appear to recognize you and offer you earnest congratulations. Eventually you are ushered to the table of honor where Wynnafrith introduces you to a half dozen company bosses, senior executives, political operatives, and the like. You notice Regina here as well, but she is seated at a table in the back, on the fringes of the upper crust of society.|9292|0
units.english: She leads you through an army of valets, waiters, and attendants as you weave in and out of the various rooms and halls. Many of the guests appear to recognize you and offer you earnest congratulations. Eventually you are ushered to the table of honor where Wynnafrith introduces you to a half dozen company bosses, senior executives, political operatives, and the like. You notice Regina here as well, but she is seated at a table in the back, on the fringes of the upper crust of society.
units.italian: Ti guida attraverso un esercito di parcheggiatori, camerieri e attendenti, fra le varie stanze e i corridoi. Molti degli ospiti sembrano riconoscerti e ti rivolgono congratulazioni sincere. Alla fine vieni condotto al tavolo d'onore, dove Wynnafrith ti presenta a una mezza dozzina di capi aziendali, dirigenti di alto livello, operatori politici e simili. Noti qui anche Regina, ma è seduta a un tavolo in fondo, ai margini dell'alta società.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	Not long after being seated Governor Timothy appears, and after making small talk with many of the gathered illuminaries, sits beside you. "I have something to admit," he says quietly to you.|9293|0
units.english: Not long after being seated Governor Timothy appears, and after making small talk with many of the gathered illuminaries, sits beside you. "I have something to admit," he says quietly to you.
units.italian: Non molto dopo esserti seduto compare il Governatore Timothy che, dopo aver scambiato qualche parola con molti dei notabili riuniti, si siede accanto a te. "Devo ammettere una cosa," ti dice piano.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	He gives you a sheepish smile and says, "This is a celebration in your honor, Hero of Rand."|9294|0
units.english: He gives you a sheepish smile and says, "This is a celebration in your honor, Hero of Rand."
units.italian: Ti fa un sorriso timido e dice: "Questa è una festa in tuo onore, Eroe di Rand."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"Hero of Rand?"|9296|0
units.english: "Hero of Rand?"
units.italian: "Eroe di Rand?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"What do you mean?"|9297|0
units.english: "What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"So you lied to me."|9298|0
units.english: "So you lied to me."
units.italian: "Quindi mi hai mentito."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	He shrugs. "I just thought it would be more fun this way. Who doesn't like surprises?"|9299|0
units.english: He shrugs. "I just thought it would be more fun this way. Who doesn't like surprises?"
units.italian: Fa spallucce. "Ho solo pensato che così fosse più divertente. A chi non piacciono le sorprese?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"Without you the entire planet would have defaulted. Our creditors were circling like vultures eager to assume ownership of all our production capabilities, and turn the population into indentured servants. The whole world would have been their debtor's prison."|9300|0
units.english: "Without you the entire planet would have defaulted. Our creditors were circling like vultures eager to assume ownership of all our production capabilities, and turn the population into indentured servants. The whole world would have been their debtor's prison."
units.italian: "Senza di te l'intero pianeta sarebbe andato in default. I nostri creditori giravano come avvoltoi impazienti di assumere la proprietà di tutte le nostre capacità produttive e di trasformare la popolazione in servi a contratto. Il mondo intero sarebbe stata la loro prigione per debitori."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	He pauses to consider his words. "I mean, the language they would have used would be different, but that is what it would have amounted to. But you saved us, and more than that, we're now quite a bit more wealthy than we were before."|9301|0
units.english: He pauses to consider his words. "I mean, the language they would have used would be different, but that is what it would have amounted to. But you saved us, and more than that, we're now quite a bit more wealthy than we were before."
units.italian: Fa una pausa per soppesare le parole. "Voglio dire, il linguaggio che avrebbero usato sarebbe stato diverso, ma a questo sarebbe ammontato. Invece ci hai salvati e, in più, ora siamo parecchio più ricchi di prima."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	Timothy snatches a glass and holds it up to you and says, "From ruin to riches! The Hero of Rand!"|9302|0
units.english: Timothy snatches a glass and holds it up to you and says, "From ruin to riches! The Hero of Rand!"
units.italian: Timothy afferra un bicchiere e lo alza verso di te dicendo: "Dalla rovina alla ricchezza! L'Eroe di Rand!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	A few others lift their glasses as well. They clink and Timothy then gulps the whole thing down, and after that the group breaks apart into smaller conversations.|9303|0
units.english: A few others lift their glasses as well. They clink and Timothy then gulps the whole thing down, and after that the group breaks apart into smaller conversations.
units.italian: Parecchi altri alzano il bicchiere. Fanno tintinnare i vetri e Timothy ne trangugia il contenuto, poi il gruppo si divide in conversazioni più piccole.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	Eventually, the party settles down and Timothy leaves you to step up to the podium. He launches into a speech highlighting your career. The great changes you have wrought, the battles you have won, the legends of your ship. The crowd eats it all up, many having heard of some, or all of these exploits. But then Timothy takes a more somber note. He talks quietly about the troubles on his old world. On how as a starving, homeless fugitive he had recklessly hidden aboard the first ship he could find. How you had found him, half dead, in an empty crate. And how, instead of tossing him out an airlock, or dropping off at the nearest world, you took him where he asked. How you took care of him, and how through your generosity, you had given him a second chance.|9304|0
units.english: Eventually, the party settles down and Timothy leaves you to step up to the podium. He launches into a speech highlighting your career. The great changes you have wrought, the battles you have won, the legends of your ship. The crowd eats it all up, many having heard of some, or all of these exploits. But then Timothy takes a more somber note. He talks quietly about the troubles on his old world. On how as a starving, homeless fugitive he had recklessly hidden aboard the first ship he could find. How you had found him, half dead, in an empty crate. And how, instead of tossing him out an airlock, or dropping off at the nearest world, you took him where he asked. How you took care of him, and how through your generosity, you had given him a second chance.
units.italian: Alla fine la festa si calma e Timothy ti lascia per salire al podio. Parte con un discorso che ripercorre la tua carriera. I grandi cambiamenti che hai portato, le battaglie che hai vinto, le leggende della tua nave. La folla se lo divora, e molti hanno sentito parlare di alcune o di tutte queste imprese. Ma poi Timothy prende un tono più grave. Parla piano dei guai del suo vecchio mondo. Di come, affamato e senza casa, si era nascosto con imprudenza sulla prima nave che aveva trovato. Di come tu l'avevi trovato, mezzo morto, in una cassa vuota. E di come, invece di buttarlo fuori dalla camera stagna o di lasciarlo sul mondo più vicino, l'avevi portato dove ti aveva chiesto. Di come ti eri preso cura di lui, e di come, con la tua generosità, gli avevi dato una seconda possibilità.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	Light reflects off the tears that cling to Timothy's eyes as he tells the assembled crowd that, for him, that was your greatest moment, your most heroic action, that nothing you've done, or ever will do, compares to that simple act of mercy. And that this, to him, alone, is what makes you great.|9305|0
units.english: Light reflects off the tears that cling to Timothy's eyes as he tells the assembled crowd that, for him, that was your greatest moment, your most heroic action, that nothing you've done, or ever will do, compares to that simple act of mercy. And that this, to him, alone, is what makes you great.
units.italian: La luce si riflette sulle lacrime che si aggrappano agli occhi di Timothy mentre racconta alla folla riunita che, per lui, quello è stato il tuo momento più grande, la tua azione più eroica, che nulla di ciò che hai fatto, o farai mai, si può paragonare a quel semplice atto di clemenza. E che questo, solo per lui, è ciò che ti rende grande.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	From here his story shifts to your selfless offer to help save Rand, even though they could promise no reward, of your stunning victory over Greenrock, and your daring liberation of the fleet on the ground. He ends with you triumphant, and Rand saved.|9306|0
units.english: From here his story shifts to your selfless offer to help save Rand, even though they could promise no reward, of your stunning victory over Greenrock, and your daring liberation of the fleet on the ground. He ends with you triumphant, and Rand saved.
units.italian: Da qui la sua storia passa alla tua offerta disinteressata di aiutare a salvare Rand, anche se non potevano prometterti alcuna ricompensa, alla tua strepitosa vittoria su Greenrock e alla tua audace liberazione della flotta a terra. Chiude con te trionfante e Rand salvata.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	The assembled guests stand, clap and cheer. They look at you, at your seat of honor, and raise their glasses to you. Eventually as the cheers and hoots die down, the Governor declares you a Hero of Rand, and thanks you for your service.|9307|0
units.english: The assembled guests stand, clap and cheer. They look at you, at your seat of honor, and raise their glasses to you. Eventually as the cheers and hoots die down, the Governor declares you a Hero of Rand, and thanks you for your service.
units.italian: Gli ospiti riuniti si alzano, applaudono ed esultano. Ti guardano, al tuo posto d'onore, e alzano i bicchieri verso di te. Alla fine, mentre applausi e urla si spengono, il Governatore ti dichiara Eroe di Rand e ti ringrazia per il tuo servizio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Say a few words.)|9309|0
units.english: (Say a few words.)
units.italian: (Di' qualche parola.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Mingle with the crowd.)|9310|0
units.english: (Mingle with the crowd.)
units.italian: (Mescolati alla folla.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Skip the party.)|9312|0
units.english: (Skip the party.)
units.italian: (Salta la festa.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	You walk up to the podium, past the governor and turn to address the assembled guests.|9315|0
units.english: You walk up to the podium, past the governor and turn to address the assembled guests.
units.italian: Sali al podio, oltrepassi il governatore e ti volti a parlare agli ospiti riuniti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Humbly thank them.)|9317|0
units.english: (Humbly thank them.)
units.italian: (Ringraziali con modestia.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Tell them it is well deserved.)|9319|0
units.english: (Tell them it is well deserved.)
units.italian: (Di' loro che te lo meriti.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Dress them down for being capitalist pigs.)|9321|0
units.english: (Dress them down for being capitalist pigs.)
units.italian: (Fai loro la paternale per essere porci capitalisti.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	You address the crowd. You compliment them on how well dressed they all are, how lavish this mansion is, how wealthy they all appear. They clap, and laugh at your apt observations. But, then you talk about how poor, dirty, and shabby things are outside of this mansion, with its fake gravity, and fake greenery. You declare you want no praise from them, no flattery, and no accolades. There are a million Heroes of Rand, outside these baroque walls, toiling away in dirty, dangerous mines. All for what? So that these company-bosses and fat-cat politicians can pat each other on the back and live in obscene luxury in the middle of a squalid world? You rail, you rant, you break them down, and you dare them to do something about it. Instead of angry shouts, or acidic boos, you are met with condescending indifference. Even the serving staff look bored, as though they've heard it all before. Finally, your speech ends with not with applause, or even angry glares, but with the sounds of numerous muffled conversations. You've been forgotten, and ignored.|9323|0
units.english: You address the crowd. You compliment them on how well dressed they all are, how lavish this mansion is, how wealthy they all appear. They clap, and laugh at your apt observations. But, then you talk about how poor, dirty, and shabby things are outside of this mansion, with its fake gravity, and fake greenery. You declare you want no praise from them, no flattery, and no accolades. There are a million Heroes of Rand, outside these baroque walls, toiling away in dirty, dangerous mines. All for what? So that these company-bosses and fat-cat politicians can pat each other on the back and live in obscene luxury in the middle of a squalid world? You rail, you rant, you break them down, and you dare them to do something about it. Instead of angry shouts, or acidic boos, you are met with condescending indifference. Even the serving staff look bored, as though they've heard it all before. Finally, your speech ends with not with applause, or even angry glares, but with the sounds of numerous muffled conversations. You've been forgotten, and ignored.
units.italian: Ti rivolgi alla folla. Li complimenti per quanto sono tutti ben vestiti, per quanto è sfarzosa questa villa, per quanto sembrano tutti ricchi. Applaudono e ridono delle tue osservazioni azzeccate. Ma poi parli di quanto siano poveri, sporchi e malmessi i luoghi fuori da questa villa, con la sua gravità finta e il suo verde finto. Dichiari che non vuoi le loro lodi, né adulazioni, né riconoscimenti. Ci sono un milione di Eroi di Rand, fuori da queste mura barocche, che si affannano in miniere sporche e pericolose. E per che cosa? Perché questi capi aziendali e politicanti grassi possano darsi pacche sulle spalle e vivere in un lusso osceno in mezzo a un mondo squallido? Ti scagli, ti infervori, li smonti e li sfidi a fare qualcosa. Invece di urla rabbiose o fischi acidi, ricevi un'indifferenza condiscendente. Persino il personale di servizio sembra annoiato, come se avesse già sentito tutto. Alla fine il tuo discorso si chiude non con applausi, né con sguardi adirati, ma con il suono di numerose conversazioni smorzate. Sei stato dimenticato e ignorato.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	Before you have time to say more, Timothy and Wynnafrith have whisked you away from the podium. Timothy, clearly embarrassed by your speech, helps you into an unmarked vehicle that takes you away from the party, and back toward the spaceport and your ship.|9324|0
units.english: Before you have time to say more, Timothy and Wynnafrith have whisked you away from the podium. Timothy, clearly embarrassed by your speech, helps you into an unmarked vehicle that takes you away from the party, and back toward the spaceport and your ship.
units.italian: Prima che tu abbia il tempo di dire altro, Timothy e Wynnafrith ti allontanano dal podio. Timothy, chiaramente imbarazzato dal tuo discorso, ti aiuta a salire su un veicolo senza contrassegni che ti porta via dalla festa, verso lo spazioporto e la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|label|9327|0
units.english: thank them
units.italian: thank them

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	You thank your host, and the assembled notables for their gracious fanfare. You note, however, that you are just one person, and you've done nothing that any one else in your shoes wouldn't have done. The guests clap as you step away from the podium.|9328|0
units.english: You thank your host, and the assembled notables for their gracious fanfare. You note, however, that you are just one person, and you've done nothing that any one else in your shoes wouldn't have done. The guests clap as you step away from the podium.
units.italian: Ringrazi il tuo ospite e i notabili riuniti per la loro cortese fanfara. Fai notare, però, che sei solo una persona e che non hai fatto nulla che chiunque altro al tuo posto non avrebbe fatto. Gli ospiti applaudono mentre ti allontani dal podio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	You launch into a speech about how you alone are special. How most people are cold and empty robots, but that a fire burns inside your breast. That you are the linchpin that the entire galaxy hinges on, and that every human from here to Farpoint owes their future to you. The crowd's excitement wanes and a smattering of lackluster applause punctuates the end of your speech.|9332|0
units.english: You launch into a speech about how you alone are special. How most people are cold and empty robots, but that a fire burns inside your breast. That you are the linchpin that the entire galaxy hinges on, and that every human from here to Farpoint owes their future to you. The crowd's excitement wanes and a smattering of lackluster applause punctuates the end of your speech.
units.italian: Parti con un discorso su come solo tu sia speciale. Su come la maggior parte delle persone siano robot freddi e vuoti, mentre nel tuo petto arde un fuoco. Che tu sei il perno su cui ruota l'intera galassia, e che ogni essere umano da qui a Farpoint deve il proprio futuro a te. L'entusiasmo della folla si affievolisce e un applauso scarso e fiacco punteggia la fine del tuo discorso.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|log|9337|0
units.english: Despite starting with nothing, Timothy had somehow become the powerful and well respected governor of an entire world. He made his own way on Rand and became its civic ruler, but he also didn't forget my help. Was invited to a lavish celebration and named the Hero of Rand.
units.italian: Pur partendo dal nulla, Timothy era in qualche modo diventato il potente e rispettato governatore di un intero mondo. Si è fatto strada da solo su Rand ed è diventato il suo capo civile, ma non ha dimenticato il mio aiuto. Sono stato invitato a una festa sfarzosa e nominato Eroe di Rand.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	You excuse yourself from the table and duck into the first empty room you find. You sit in one of the comfortable chairs; you notice a large wooden desk covered in screens and ledgers. You can still hear the muffled sounds of laughter, speeches, and general chatter from behind the walls. You sit for a while in a dark meditative silence.|9342|0
units.english: You excuse yourself from the table and duck into the first empty room you find. You sit in one of the comfortable chairs; you notice a large wooden desk covered in screens and ledgers. You can still hear the muffled sounds of laughter, speeches, and general chatter from behind the walls. You sit for a while in a dark meditative silence.
units.italian: Ti congedi dal tavolo e ti infili nella prima stanza vuota che trovi. Ti siedi su una delle comode poltrone; noti una grande scrivania di legno coperta di schermi e registri. Senti ancora i suoni attutiti di risate, discorsi e chiacchiere generali da dietro le pareti. Resti seduto per un po' in un silenzio scuro e meditativo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	After a while, a gentle knock on the door and Timothy pushes his way into the room.|9343|0
units.english: After a while, a gentle knock on the door and Timothy pushes his way into the room.
units.italian: Dopo un po', un colpo leggero alla porta e Timothy entra nella stanza.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"I see you've found my office, Captain <last>. I'd like to apologize. I was hoping you'd appreciate the party, but, I realize it's not exactly everyone's scene. There's more then a few vipers in that crowd, and there are things I've had to do for them I am not proud of..." He trails off.|9344|0
units.english: "I see you've found my office, Captain <last>. I'd like to apologize. I was hoping you'd appreciate the party, but, I realize it's not exactly everyone's scene. There's more then a few vipers in that crowd, and there are things I've had to do for them I am not proud of..." He trails off.
units.italian: "Vedo che hai trovato il mio ufficio, Capitano <last>. Vorrei scusarmi. Speravo che la festa ti piacesse, ma mi rendo conto che non è esattamente il genere di tutti. In quella folla ci sono più di una vipera, e ci sono cose che ho dovuto fare per loro di cui non vado fiero..." Si perde.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"But still, I'm glad you're here. Even tucked away in my office. I wanted to let you know that there are credits associated with tonight's prize. You will be given 1 million credits and a daily stipend of 200 credits, as a gift from Rand, and more specifically, from me.|9345|0
units.english: "But still, I'm glad you're here. Even tucked away in my office. I wanted to let you know that there are credits associated with tonight's prize. You will be given 1 million credits and a daily stipend of 200 credits, as a gift from Rand, and more specifically, from me.
units.italian: "Ma comunque, sono contento che tu sia qui. Anche rintanato nel mio ufficio. Volevo farti sapere che al premio di stasera sono associati dei crediti. Ti saranno dati 1 milione di crediti e uno stipendio giornaliero di 200 crediti, come dono di Rand e, più precisamente, mio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|log|9350|0
units.english: Timothy has since become the governor of Rand.
units.italian: Da allora Timothy è diventato governatore di Rand.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|log|9351|0
units.english: Despite starting with nothing, Timothy had somehow become the powerful and well respected governor of an entire world. He made his own way on Rand and became its civic ruler, but he also didn't forget my help. Was invited to a lavish celebration and named the Hero of Rand.
units.italian: Pur partendo dal nulla, Timothy era in qualche modo diventato il potente e rispettato governatore di un intero mondo. Si è fatto strada da solo su Rand ed è diventato il suo capo civile, ma non ha dimenticato il mio aiuto. Sono stato invitato a una festa sfarzosa e nominato Eroe di Rand.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	With the speeches done, you mingle with the crowd, making small talk with various dignitaries and company-bosses. You even say a few words to Regina. Everyone is pleased to meet you, and a few people ask for your autograph. Finally, Timothy makes his way to you and takes you to a quieter room off to the side.|9355|0
units.english: With the speeches done, you mingle with the crowd, making small talk with various dignitaries and company-bosses. You even say a few words to Regina. Everyone is pleased to meet you, and a few people ask for your autograph. Finally, Timothy makes his way to you and takes you to a quieter room off to the side.
units.italian: Finiti i discorsi, ti mescoli alla folla, scambiando qualche parola con vari dignitari e capi aziendali. Dici anche qualche parola a Regina. Tutti sono contenti di conoscerti, e qualcuno ti chiede un autografo. Alla fine Timothy si fa largo fino a te e ti porta in una stanza più tranquilla, in disparte.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"Captain <last>, I hope you've found the night agreeable. I've noticed you have your fair share of fans here. I also wanted to let you know that there is cash associated with tonight's reward. You will be given 1 million credits and a daily stipend of 200 credits, as a gift from Rand, and more specifically, from me."|9356|0
units.english: "Captain <last>, I hope you've found the night agreeable. I've noticed you have your fair share of fans here. I also wanted to let you know that there is cash associated with tonight's reward. You will be given 1 million credits and a daily stipend of 200 credits, as a gift from Rand, and more specifically, from me."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>, spero che la serata le sia gradita. Ho notato che ha qui la sua buona quota di ammiratori. Volevo anche informarla che alla ricompensa di stasera sono associati dei contanti. Le saranno dati 1 milione di crediti e uno stipendio giornaliero di 200 crediti, come dono di Rand e, più precisamente, mio."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|label|9358|0
units.english: jump skip
units.italian: jump skip

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	Timothy pats you on the back. "Just another way for me to thank you for saving me all those years ago, and now my world as well."|9359|0
units.english: Timothy pats you on the back. "Just another way for me to thank you for saving me all those years ago, and now my world as well."
units.italian: Timothy ti dà una pacca sulla schiena. "È solo un altro modo per ringraziarti di avermi salvato tutti quegli anni fa, e ora anche il mio mondo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	You nod politely, and your eyes scan the wall of his office. You see pictures of your ship, and you, from various news articles, printed and framed along the walls."|9360|0
units.english: You nod politely, and your eyes scan the wall of his office. You see pictures of your ship, and you, from various news articles, printed and framed along the walls."
units.italian: Annuisci cortesemente e i tuoi occhi scorrono la parete del suo ufficio. Vedi foto della tua nave e di te, da vari articoli di giornale, stampate e incorniciate lungo le pareti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"Thanks for inviting me. I've had a great time."|9362|0
units.english: "Thanks for inviting me. I've had a great time."
units.italian: "Grazie per avermi invitato. Mi sono divertito molto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"Are you a stalker?"|9364|0
units.english: "Are you a stalker?"
units.italian: "Sei un maniaco?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	Timothy puts his glass down and holds his hands out pleading. "No, no. It's not like that."|9366|0
units.english: Timothy puts his glass down and holds his hands out pleading. "No, no. It's not like that."
units.italian: Timothy posa il bicchiere e tende le mani in segno di supplica. "No, no. Non è così."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	He gestures towards the images on the wall. "I had no family, I had no... past. My life, my life started with you. This is my way of celebrating my past. No, don't you worry, I am not infatuated or anything."|9367|0
units.english: He gestures towards the images on the wall. "I had no family, I had no... past. My life, my life started with you. This is my way of celebrating my past. No, don't you worry, I am not infatuated or anything."
units.italian: Accenna alle immagini sulla parete. "Non avevo famiglia, non avevo... passato. La mia vita è cominciata con te. Questo è il mio modo di celebrare il mio passato. No, non preoccuparti, non sono infatuato né nulla del genere."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	You realize that it has been almost a decade since you heard from him last.|9368|0
units.english: You realize that it has been almost a decade since you heard from him last.
units.italian: Ti rendi conto che sono passati quasi dieci anni dall'ultima volta che hai avuto sue notizie.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"Thanks for inviting me. I've had a great time."|9370|0
units.english: "Thanks for inviting me. I've had a great time."
units.italian: "Grazie per avermi invitato. Mi sono divertito molto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Go back to my ship.)|9371|0
units.english: (Go back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	"Oh, it's nothing compared to what you did for me. What you saved me from, and what you did to bring me here. And then how you bailed me and Rand out again." Timothy glances away from you, as if embarrassed all he did tonight wasn't enough.|9375|0
units.english: "Oh, it's nothing compared to what you did for me. What you saved me from, and what you did to bring me here. And then how you bailed me and Rand out again." Timothy glances away from you, as if embarrassed all he did tonight wasn't enough.
units.italian: "Oh, non è niente rispetto a quello che hai fatto per me. Da cosa mi hai salvato, e cosa hai fatto per portarmi qui. E poi come hai tirato fuori dai guai me e Rand un'altra volta." Timothy distoglie lo sguardo, come imbarazzato che tutto ciò che ha fatto stasera non sia abbastanza.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Keep talking with Timothy.)|9377|0
units.english: (Keep talking with Timothy.)
units.italian: (Continua a parlare con Timothy.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	(Excuse myself and go back to my ship.)|9378|0
units.english: (Excuse myself and go back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Congedati e torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	You talk with him for hours. About his life on Rand, the hardships of the mines, how he clawed his way out of it. But also about you, the challenges of running a ship, the battles, the close calls, and the joys of triumph.|9381|0
units.english: You talk with him for hours. About his life on Rand, the hardships of the mines, how he clawed his way out of it. But also about you, the challenges of running a ship, the battles, the close calls, and the joys of triumph.
units.italian: Parli con lui per ore. Della sua vita su Rand, delle durezze delle miniere, di come ne è uscito a fatica. Ma anche di te, delle sfide di mandare avanti una nave, delle battaglie, delle occasioni mancate per un soffio e delle gioie del trionfo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	As you talk you come to realize there is a sadness at the edges of Timothy's stories about being governor. His words seem tinged with regret, though he says nothing specifically regretful. You get the feeling he isn't telling you the whole story.|9382|0
units.english: As you talk you come to realize there is a sadness at the edges of Timothy's stories about being governor. His words seem tinged with regret, though he says nothing specifically regretful. You get the feeling he isn't telling you the whole story.
units.italian: Parlando ti accorgi che c'è una tristezza ai margini dei racconti di Timothy sul suo essere governatore. Le sue parole sembrano venate di rimpianto, anche se non dice nulla di specificamente pentito. Hai la sensazione che non ti stia raccontando tutta la storia.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	As the sun rises your conversation winds to a close. Timothy escorts you back to a waiting vehicle and you say your farewells. The dark vehicle drives off into the bright desert, leaving behind an island of green and warmth.|9385|0
units.english: As the sun rises your conversation winds to a close. Timothy escorts you back to a waiting vehicle and you say your farewells. The dark vehicle drives off into the bright desert, leaving behind an island of green and warmth.
units.italian: Al sorgere del sole la vostra conversazione si avvia alla fine. Timothy ti accompagna a un veicolo in attesa e vi salutate. Il veicolo scuro si allontana nel deserto luminoso, lasciandosi dietro un'isola di verde e di calore.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 3d: Return to Rand|	Timothy acquiesces and escorts you back to a waiting vehicle, and you say your farewells. The dark vehicle drives off into the bright desert, leaving behind an island of green and warmth.|9389|0
units.english: Timothy acquiesces and escorts you back to a waiting vehicle, and you say your farewells. The dark vehicle drives off into the bright desert, leaving behind an island of green and warmth.
units.italian: Timothy acconsente e ti accompagna a un veicolo in attesa, e vi salutate. Il veicolo scuro si allontana nel deserto luminoso, lasciandosi dietro un'isola di verde e di calore.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|As you stroll through the spaceport, a name blaring on a nearby news screen catches your attention.|9406|0
units.english: As you stroll through the spaceport, a name blaring on a nearby news screen catches your attention.
units.italian: Mentre passeggi per lo spazioporto, un nome che risuona su uno schermo notizie vicino cattura la tua attenzione.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	(Watch the news.)|9408|0
units.english: (Watch the news.)
units.italian: (Guarda le notizie.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	(Ignore it.)|9410|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignorale.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	You keep walking. It's probably nothing worth your time.|9411|0
units.english: You keep walking. It's probably nothing worth your time.
units.italian: Continui a camminare. Probabilmente non è niente che valga il tuo tempo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	You turn to check out the screen. The talking heads are discussing some sort of huge scandal and the arrest of a prominent governor.|9414|0
units.english: You turn to check out the screen. The talking heads are discussing some sort of huge scandal and the arrest of a prominent governor.
units.italian: Ti volti a controllare lo schermo. I conduttori stanno discutendo di una specie di enorme scandalo e dell'arresto di un importante governatore.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	"That's right, Ann," the anchor on the screen says. "With 8 counts of tax evasion, racketeering, and various corruption charges, Timothy Radrickson - former Governor of Rand - will likely spend the next 20 years behind bars."|9415|0
units.english: "That's right, Ann," the anchor on the screen says. "With 8 counts of tax evasion, racketeering, and various corruption charges, Timothy Radrickson - former Governor of Rand - will likely spend the next 20 years behind bars."
units.italian: "Esatto, Ann," dice l'anchor sullo schermo. "Con 8 capi d'imputazione per evasione fiscale, associazione a delinquere e varie accuse di corruzione, Timothy Radrickson, ex governatore di Rand, passerà probabilmente i prossimi 20 anni dietro le sbarre."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	"Where he's going there will be no bars, Tom," Ann quips. "They plan to send him to a work detail on Oblivion."|9416|0
units.english: "Where he's going there will be no bars, Tom," Ann quips. "They plan to send him to a work detail on Oblivion."
units.italian: "Dove lo mandano non ci saranno sbarre, Tom," ribatte Ann. "Hanno in programma di mandarlo ai lavori forzati su Oblivion."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	Tom gives that sort of news anchor laugh that's neither committal nor haughty. "In that case, forget what I said about 20 years. Anything more than 5 years on Oblivion is a life sentence."|9417|0
units.english: Tom gives that sort of news anchor laugh that's neither committal nor haughty. "In that case, forget what I said about 20 years. Anything more than 5 years on Oblivion is a life sentence."
units.italian: Tom fa quella risata da conduttore televisivo che non è né impegnativa né altezzosa. "In tal caso, dimentica quello che ho detto sui 20 anni. Più di 5 anni su Oblivion sono una condanna a vita."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	Both news anchors laugh, and then segue into a story about highly intelligent ferrets that have learned to sing in German.|9418|0
units.english: Both news anchors laugh, and then segue into a story about highly intelligent ferrets that have learned to sing in German.
units.italian: Entrambi i conduttori ridono, poi passano a un servizio su furetti molto intelligenti che hanno imparato a cantare in tedesco.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|log|9421|0
units.english: Charged with corruption and mired in scandal, Timothy has been disgraced and exiled to Oblivion.
units.italian: Accusato di corruzione e travolto dallo scandalo, Timothy è stato disonorato ed esiliato su Oblivion.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|log|9422|0
units.english: Oblivion had not been kind to Timothy. The last time he had been seen alive he was dying the slow, toxic death that world is famed for. Asked me to help him.
units.italian: Oblivion non era stata gentile con Timothy. L'ultima volta che era stato visto vivo stava morendo della lenta e tossica morte per cui quel mondo è famoso. Mi ha chiesto aiuto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|Your ship descends through the beautiful, toxic horizon and lands in the dirty, dismal spaceport outside of the provincial capital, Tukayyid. The clumped together warehouses they liberally call a spaceport are used as a central clearing house by all on-world industries, and workers from every industry filter in and out of this never-ending boom town. In the shadows, and on the fringes, the sick and infirm linger, looking for a handout; the price of progress on such a hostile world.|9426|0
units.english: Your ship descends through the beautiful, toxic horizon and lands in the dirty, dismal spaceport outside of the provincial capital, Tukayyid. The clumped together warehouses they liberally call a spaceport are used as a central clearing house by all on-world industries, and workers from every industry filter in and out of this never-ending boom town. In the shadows, and on the fringes, the sick and infirm linger, looking for a handout; the price of progress on such a hostile world.
units.italian: La tua nave scende attraverso l'orizzonte bellissimo e tossico e atterra nello spazioporto sporco e squallido fuori dalla capitale provinciale, Tukayyid. I magazzini ammassati che chiamano generosamente spazioporto servono da centro di smistamento per tutte le industrie del pianeta, e operai di ogni settore entrano ed escono da questa città in espansione senza fine. Nell'ombra e ai margini indugiano i malati e gli infermi, in cerca di un'elemosina: il prezzo del progresso su un mondo così ostile.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	Among the crowd one face draws your attention. A worker, unsupervised, is moving around a trolley of minerals by your ship as you have it refueled. His complexion is sallow, and his skin seems to droop off his bones. His blood red eyes, noticing your attention, languidly rise to look at you. Despite the damage, you realize you recognize him.|9427|0
units.english: Among the crowd one face draws your attention. A worker, unsupervised, is moving around a trolley of minerals by your ship as you have it refueled. His complexion is sallow, and his skin seems to droop off his bones. His blood red eyes, noticing your attention, languidly rise to look at you. Despite the damage, you realize you recognize him.
units.italian: Fra la folla un volto attira la tua attenzione. Un operaio, senza sorveglianza, muove un carrello di minerali vicino alla tua nave mentre la fai rifornire. Ha la carnagione giallastra e la pelle sembra cascargli dalle ossa. I suoi occhi rosso sangue, notando la tua attenzione, si alzano languidamente a guardarti. Nonostante il degrado, ti accorgi che lo riconosci.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	"Captain <last>," he says, suffering a coughing fit. There's now red specks on his lips.|9428|0
units.english: "Captain <last>," he says, suffering a coughing fit. There's now red specks on his lips.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>," dice, preso da un attacco di tosse. Ora ha macchioline rosse sulle labbra.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	"It's me. Timothy, remember? Boy, it's been a while. I'm a prisoner now. Chain-ganged here. Probably until the end." He spits his words out in short bursts, careful not to start coughing again.|9429|0
units.english: "It's me. Timothy, remember? Boy, it's been a while. I'm a prisoner now. Chain-ganged here. Probably until the end." He spits his words out in short bursts, careful not to start coughing again.
units.italian: "Sono io. Timothy, ricordi? Ragazzo, quanto tempo. Ora sono un prigioniero. Incatenato qui ai lavori. Probabilmente fino alla fine." Sputa le parole a brevi raffiche, attento a non ricominciare a tossire.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	"I'm sorry, Timothy."|9431|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, Timothy."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, Timothy."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	"Is there any way I can help?"|9432|0
units.english: "Is there any way I can help?"
units.italian: "C'è un modo in cui posso aiutarti?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	"Shouldn't have broken the law."|9433|0
units.english: "Shouldn't have broken the law."
units.italian: "Non avresti dovuto infrangere la legge."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	"I could use your help. Just to buy some things. Might help." His red eyes glance side to side before he says, conspiratorially, "Meet me tonight in the spaceport. Outside the Stephenson warehouse. Stephenson. I'll tell you what I need."|9434|0
units.english: "I could use your help. Just to buy some things. Might help." His red eyes glance side to side before he says, conspiratorially, "Meet me tonight in the spaceport. Outside the Stephenson warehouse. Stephenson. I'll tell you what I need."
units.italian: "Un aiuto mi servirebbe. Solo per comprare delle cose. Potrebbe aiutare." I suoi occhi rossi guizzano da una parte all'altra prima che dica, in tono cospiratorio: "Vediamoci stanotte allo spazioporto. Fuori dal magazzino Stephenson. Stephenson. Ti dirò di che cosa ho bisogno."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 4: Imprisoned|	With that, he returns to moving the mineral trolley, leaving you to yourself.|9435|0
units.english: With that, he returns to moving the mineral trolley, leaving you to yourself.
units.italian: Detto questo torna a spostare il carrello di minerali, lasciandoti solo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|name|9440|0
units.english: Meet Tim's contact on <planet>
units.italian: Incontrare il contatto di Tim su <planet>

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|description|9441|0
units.english: Tim would like you to collect some supplies for him, but first he asked you to meet someone on <stopovers> who could help you out. Tim has 18 days (<date>) before he is reassigned to a camp down south.
units.italian: Tim vorrebbe che tu gli procurassi delle provviste, ma prima ti ha chiesto di incontrare qualcuno su <stopovers> che possa aiutarti. Tim ha 18 giorni (<date>) prima di essere trasferito in un campo a sud.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|Even after donning a particulate mask, Oblivion's toxic atmosphere is so thick it seems as if you could swallow it; it doesn't help that the air somehow feels even denser at night. The warehouse marked "Stephenson Heavy Industries" turns out to be at the very edge of the spaceport's boundary, and all you see when you get there is a lone box truck parked in the loading bay.|9455|0
units.english: Even after donning a particulate mask, Oblivion's toxic atmosphere is so thick it seems as if you could swallow it; it doesn't help that the air somehow feels even denser at night. The warehouse marked "Stephenson Heavy Industries" turns out to be at the very edge of the spaceport's boundary, and all you see when you get there is a lone box truck parked in the loading bay.
units.italian: Anche indossando una maschera antiparticolato, l'atmosfera tossica di Oblivion è così densa che sembra di poterla inghiottire; non aiuta che l'aria sembri ancora più densa di notte. Il magazzino con la scritta "Stephenson Heavy Industries" si trova proprio al limite estremo dello spazioporto, e quando arrivi vedi solo un camioncino solitario parcheggiato nella baia di carico.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Approach the truck.)|9457|0
units.english: (Approach the truck.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati al camion.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Leave. Tim doesn't deserve another chance.)|9458|0
units.english: (Leave. Tim doesn't deserve another chance.)
units.italian: (Vattene. Tim non merita un'altra possibilità.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	By the truck you make out the silhouette of a man heaving heavy equipment in the dim light of the loading bay. He turns to look at you as you come closer.|9461|0
units.english: By the truck you make out the silhouette of a man heaving heavy equipment in the dim light of the loading bay. He turns to look at you as you come closer.
units.italian: Vicino al camion distingui la sagoma di un uomo che solleva attrezzature pesanti nella luce fioca della baia. Si volta a guardarti mentre ti avvicini.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Captain?"|9462|0
units.english: "Captain?"
units.italian: "Capitano?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"It's me, <last>."|9464|0
units.english: "It's me, <last>."
units.italian: "Sono io, <last>."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Say nothing, turn away and leave.)|9465|0
units.english: (Say nothing, turn away and leave.)
units.italian: (Non dire nulla, voltati e vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Timothy leans against the nearest wall, and for a moment the only noise in the darkness is his ragged breathing. Finally he says, "In a couple of weeks I go south. Far side of the world. I'll last maybe months. Probably less. I need a chance. I need to get out."|9468|0
units.english: Timothy leans against the nearest wall, and for a moment the only noise in the darkness is his ragged breathing. Finally he says, "In a couple of weeks I go south. Far side of the world. I'll last maybe months. Probably less. I need a chance. I need to get out."
units.italian: Timothy si appoggia alla parete più vicina, e per un momento l'unico rumore nel buio è il suo respiro affannato. Alla fine dice: "Fra un paio di settimane vado a sud. Dall'altra parte del mondo. Resisterò forse mesi. Probabilmente meno. Mi serve una possibilità. Devo uscire."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	His voice gets more animated as he speaks and he nearly launches into another coughing fit before catching himself and taking several uneven breaths. "They're watching me. I can't leave with you. But with the right supplies. Right tools. I can make it."|9469|0
units.english: His voice gets more animated as he speaks and he nearly launches into another coughing fit before catching himself and taking several uneven breaths. "They're watching me. I can't leave with you. But with the right supplies. Right tools. I can make it."
units.italian: La voce si anima mentre parla e quasi parte con un altro attacco di tosse prima di trattenersi e prendere diversi respiri irregolari. "Mi tengono d'occhio. Non posso andarmene con te. Ma con le provviste giuste. Gli strumenti giusti. Posso farcela."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	His red eyes rimmed with bloody tears look directly into yours. "Please. Don't let me die here. At least.. give me a chance."|9470|0
units.english: His red eyes rimmed with bloody tears look directly into yours. "Please. Don't let me die here. At least.. give me a chance."
units.italian: I suoi occhi rossi, cerchiati di lacrime sanguigne, guardano dritti nei tuoi. "Ti prego. Non lasciarmi morire qui. Almeno... dammi una possibilità."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Alright. What do you need?"|9472|0
units.english: "Alright. What do you need?"
units.italian: "Va bene. Di che cosa hai bisogno?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Refuse to help him.)|9474|0
units.english: (Refuse to help him.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta di aiutarlo.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You shake your head slowly. "I'm sorry, Timothy. But you broke the law, and this is your punishment. My hands are tied. Maybe when you're out we'll reconnect."|9476|0
units.english: You shake your head slowly. "I'm sorry, Timothy. But you broke the law, and this is your punishment. My hands are tied. Maybe when you're out we'll reconnect."
units.italian: Scuoti lentamente la testa. "Mi dispiace, Timothy. Ma hai infranto la legge, e questa è la tua punizione. Ho le mani legate. Magari, quando sarai fuori, ci ritroveremo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	What little strength he has seems to deflate, a crimson tear winds down his cracked face. "When I'm out?" He almost laughs, "When I'm out!"|9477|0
units.english: What little strength he has seems to deflate, a crimson tear winds down his cracked face. "When I'm out?" He almost laughs, "When I'm out!"
units.italian: La poca forza che gli resta sembra sgonfiarsi, una lacrima cremisi gli scende sul viso screpolato. "Quando sarò fuori?" Quasi ride, "Quando sarò fuori!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	He turns his face towards the truck, before looking back at you. "Goodbye, old friend."|9478|0
units.english: He turns his face towards the truck, before looking back at you. "Goodbye, old friend."
units.italian: Volta il viso verso il camion, poi torna a guardarti. "Addio, vecchio amico."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	The weak, broken man returns to loading up the heavy equipment, slower than before.|9479|0
units.english: The weak, broken man returns to loading up the heavy equipment, slower than before.
units.italian: L'uomo debole e spezzato torna a caricare l'attrezzatura pesante, più lentamente di prima.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Looking sideways first, Timothy takes a piece of yellowed paper from his pocket and hastily writes something down on it before handing it to you. "Have to go off world. Here's a list of what I need. Go to Rand first - address on paper. Norwen mines. Old friend. She will point you in the right direction."|9483|0
units.english: Looking sideways first, Timothy takes a piece of yellowed paper from his pocket and hastily writes something down on it before handing it to you. "Have to go off world. Here's a list of what I need. Go to Rand first - address on paper. Norwen mines. Old friend. She will point you in the right direction."
units.italian: Dopo aver dato prima un'occhiata di lato, Timothy prende dalla tasca un pezzo di carta ingiallita e vi scrive in fretta qualcosa prima di porgertela. "Devo andare fuori dal pianeta. Ecco la lista di quello che mi serve. Vai prima su Rand: l'indirizzo è sulla carta. Miniere Norwen. Una vecchia amica. Ti indicherà la strada giusta."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	He abruptly turns away from you and goes back to loading equipment, but slower now, buying for time.|9484|0
units.english: He abruptly turns away from you and goes back to loading equipment, but slower now, buying for time.
units.italian: Si volta bruscamente da te e torna a caricare attrezzature, ma ora più lentamente, per guadagnare tempo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Eighteen days," he says wearily. "Then I go south. Lost in the maze of rigs." He pauses before saying more quietly, "and then I die." He looks back at you one last time. "Always owe you." His face cracks in one painful looking grin. "Good luck, my good friend."|9485|0
