units.english: "Eighteen days," he says wearily. "Then I go south. Lost in the maze of rigs." He pauses before saying more quietly, "and then I die." He looks back at you one last time. "Always owe you." His face cracks in one painful looking grin. "Good luck, my good friend."
units.italian: "Diciotto giorni," dice con stanchezza. "Poi vado a sud. Perso nel labirinto delle trivelle." Fa una pausa prima di aggiungere, più piano, "e poi muoio." Ti guarda un'ultima volta. "Sempre in debito con te." Il viso gli si crepa in un sorriso che sembra doloroso. "Buona fortuna, buon amico mio."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	As you walk away from the Stephenson warehouse you take a look at his list. Initially it's various survival items; backpacks, camping equipment and the like. There's also a specialized survival suit, and some heavy duty detoxification medication here as well. More alarmingly, however, are the industrial chemical compounds that would easily create a bomb, not to mention the gun at the bottom.|9486|0
units.english: As you walk away from the Stephenson warehouse you take a look at his list. Initially it's various survival items; backpacks, camping equipment and the like. There's also a specialized survival suit, and some heavy duty detoxification medication here as well. More alarmingly, however, are the industrial chemical compounds that would easily create a bomb, not to mention the gun at the bottom.
units.italian: Mentre ti allontani dal magazzino Stephenson dai un'occhiata alla lista. All'inizio sono vari articoli di sopravvivenza: zaini, attrezzatura da campeggio e simili. C'è anche una tuta di sopravvivenza specializzata e dei farmaci disintossicanti pesanti. Più allarmanti, però, sono i composti chimici industriali che basterebbero facilmente a fabbricare una bomba, per non parlare della pistola in fondo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You're not sure exactly what his crimes were, but you seem to recall them being mostly white-collar. Yet, you could potentially be arming a terrorist with these items.|9487|0
units.english: You're not sure exactly what his crimes were, but you seem to recall them being mostly white-collar. Yet, you could potentially be arming a terrorist with these items.
units.italian: Non sei sicuro di quali fossero esattamente i suoi reati, ma ti sembra di ricordare che fossero per lo più di tipo economico. Eppure, con questi articoli potresti potenzialmente armare un terrorista.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Keep the list.)|9489|0
units.english: (Keep the list.)
units.italian: (Tieni la lista.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Throw away the list.)|9491|0
units.english: (Throw away the list.)
units.italian: (Butta via la lista.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You toss the crumpled list into the trash and leave Timothy to his fate.|9493|0
units.english: You toss the crumpled list into the trash and leave Timothy to his fate.
units.italian: Butti la lista accartocciata nella spazzatura e lasci Timothy al suo destino.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You decide to give Timothy another chance. You put the list back into your pocket and walk back to your ship.|9497|0
units.english: You decide to give Timothy another chance. You put the list back into your pocket and walk back to your ship.
units.italian: Decidi di dare a Timothy un'altra possibilità. Rimetti la lista in tasca e torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	As you walk away, you hear the sound of a large garage door shuttering, the racket reverberating around the yard, followed shortly by the rumble of a truck's unhealthy engine revving up for a one way trip.|9501|0
units.english: As you walk away, you hear the sound of a large garage door shuttering, the racket reverberating around the yard, followed shortly by the rumble of a truck's unhealthy engine revving up for a one way trip.
units.italian: Mentre ti allontani, senti il rumore di una grande porta da garage che si abbassa, il frastuono che rimbomba nel cortile, seguito poco dopo dal rombo del motore malandato di un camion che si avvia per un viaggio di sola andata.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|The Norwen mines are on no current map, and your initial searches for it come up empty. Eventually you're able to find an old news article about a company mining town by the name of Norwen that attempted to unionize, and how the authorities heroically and humanely put down the uprising. The article briefly mentions that the mine was closed down shortly afterward for unrelated reasons. You're able to use the information from the article and the shakily scrawn partial address that Timothy wrote down to get a good idea where to find the mine.|9506|0
units.english: The Norwen mines are on no current map, and your initial searches for it come up empty. Eventually you're able to find an old news article about a company mining town by the name of Norwen that attempted to unionize, and how the authorities heroically and humanely put down the uprising. The article briefly mentions that the mine was closed down shortly afterward for unrelated reasons. You're able to use the information from the article and the shakily scrawn partial address that Timothy wrote down to get a good idea where to find the mine.
units.italian: Le miniere Norwen non compaiono su nessuna mappa attuale, e le tue prime ricerche non danno risultati. Alla fine riesci a trovare un vecchio articolo di giornale su una città mineraria aziendale di nome Norwen che aveva tentato di sindacalizzarsi, e su come le autorità avevano eroicamente e umanamente represso la rivolta. L'articolo accenna brevemente al fatto che la miniera fu chiusa poco dopo per ragioni non correlate. Usando le informazioni dell'articolo e l'indirizzo parziale scritto con mano tremante da Timothy riesci a farti un'idea precisa di dove trovare la miniera.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	As your ship approaches the mine you can't help but notice the burnt out remains of a gutted and abandoned town. A few minutes later your ship rattles down outside the mine's entrance.|9507|0
units.english: As your ship approaches the mine you can't help but notice the burnt out remains of a gutted and abandoned town. A few minutes later your ship rattles down outside the mine's entrance.
units.italian: Mentre la nave si avvicina alla miniera non puoi fare a meno di notare i resti bruciati di una città svuotata e abbandonata. Qualche minuto dopo la nave si posa traballando davanti all'ingresso della miniera.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Leave my ship.)|9509|0
units.english: (Leave my ship.)
units.italian: (Esci dalla nave.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	It's dark and dusty outside. The planet's low gravity makes you feel languid, and the air uncomfortably light in your lungs. The entrance to the mine looms large before you and seems suddenly quite menacing. Perhaps this wasn't the best idea...|9510|0
units.english: It's dark and dusty outside. The planet's low gravity makes you feel languid, and the air uncomfortably light in your lungs. The entrance to the mine looms large before you and seems suddenly quite menacing. Perhaps this wasn't the best idea...
units.italian: Fuori è buio e polveroso. La bassa gravità del pianeta ti fa sentire languido, e l'aria è scomodamente leggera nei polmoni. L'ingresso della miniera si staglia grande davanti a te e all'improvviso sembra piuttosto minaccioso. Forse non era la migliore delle idee...

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Don't move, or we will end you!" comes a shout from within the darkness of the mine. "Identify yourself, now!"|9511|0
units.english: "Don't move, or we will end you!" comes a shout from within the darkness of the mine. "Identify yourself, now!"
units.italian: "Non muoverti, o ti ammazziamo!" arriva un urlo dalle tenebre della miniera. "Identificati, subito!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"I'm Captain <last>, veteran of the human civil war!"|9513|0
units.english: "I'm Captain <last>, veteran of the human civil war!"
units.italian: "Sono il Capitano <last>, veterano della guerra civile umana!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"I'm a friend of Timothy Radrickson!"|9515|0
units.english: "I'm a friend of Timothy Radrickson!"
units.italian: "Sono un amico di Timothy Radrickson!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"I'm the Hero of Rand!"|9517|0
units.english: "I'm the Hero of Rand!"
units.italian: "Sono l'Eroe di Rand!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"I'm just a merchant! My name's Captain <last>!"|9521|0
units.english: "I'm just a merchant! My name's Captain <last>!"
units.italian: "Sono solo un mercante! Mi chiamo Capitano <last>!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Mind your own business, I answer to no one!"|9523|0
units.english: "Mind your own business, I answer to no one!"
units.italian: "Fatti i fatti tuoi, non rispondo a nessuno!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Run back to my ship.)|9524|0
units.english: (Run back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Corri di nuovo alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Your response is followed by a short moment of stunned silence, a snicker, and then the click of a trigger.|9527|0
units.english: Your response is followed by a short moment of stunned silence, a snicker, and then the click of a trigger.
units.italian: Alla tua risposta segue un breve momento di silenzio sbalordito, una risatina e poi il clic di un grilletto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	There is a brief, almost pleasant, moment of calm as the inevitability of the situation sinks in... unfortunately, that is the last moment of calm you ever experience, as your body is riddled with bullet rounds mere seconds later.|9528|0
units.english: There is a brief, almost pleasant, moment of calm as the inevitability of the situation sinks in... unfortunately, that is the last moment of calm you ever experience, as your body is riddled with bullet rounds mere seconds later.
units.italian: C'è un breve momento di calma, quasi piacevole, mentre l'inevitabilità della situazione si fa strada... purtroppo è l'ultimo momento di calma che tu possa mai vivere, perché il tuo corpo viene crivellato di proiettili pochi secondi dopo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|label|9531|0
units.english: tims bud
units.italian: tims bud

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	There is a brief, low conversation, followed by what sounds like a voice on a radio. Then finally, "If you're who you say you are, how did you first meet Governor Radrickson?"|9532|0
units.english: There is a brief, low conversation, followed by what sounds like a voice on a radio. Then finally, "If you're who you say you are, how did you first meet Governor Radrickson?"
units.italian: Segue una breve conversazione a bassa voce, poi quello che sembra un tizio alla radio. Alla fine: "Se sei chi dici di essere, come hai conosciuto il Governatore Radrickson?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"I ran into him at the Rand spaceport."|9534|0
units.english: "I ran into him at the Rand spaceport."
units.italian: "L'ho incontrato allo spazioporto di Rand."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"He sent me a message that he wanted to meet me."|9535|0
units.english: "He sent me a message that he wanted to meet me."
units.italian: "Mi ha mandato un messaggio dicendo che voleva incontrarmi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"I found him in an old equipment locker."|9536|0
units.english: "I found him in an old equipment locker."
units.italian: "L'ho trovato in un vecchio armadietto delle attrezzature."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"He was hiding in a food crate on my ship."|9537|0
units.english: "He was hiding in a food crate on my ship."
units.italian: "Si nascondeva in una cassa di cibo sulla mia nave."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You hear someone swear and say, "We gotta move now! Everything we can't carry, burn; they're onto us!" Some commotion ensues and you hear a few individuals run into the cave.|9540|0
units.english: You hear someone swear and say, "We gotta move now! Everything we can't carry, burn; they're onto us!" Some commotion ensues and you hear a few individuals run into the cave.
units.italian: Senti qualcuno imprecare e dire: "Dobbiamo muoverci adesso! Tutto quello che non possiamo portare, brucialo; ci hanno scoperti!" Segue un po' di trambusto e senti alcune persone correre dentro la caverna.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	The remaining guard hears something on the radio and then says, "No loose ends. Got it."|9541|0
units.english: The remaining guard hears something on the radio and then says, "No loose ends. Got it."
units.italian: La guardia rimasta sente qualcosa alla radio e poi dice: "Nessun testimone. Ricevuto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Run after them into the cave.)|9543|0
units.english: (Run after them into the cave.)
units.italian: (Corri dietro a loro nella caverna.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Run back to my ship.)|9544|0
units.english: (Run back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Corri di nuovo alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You run straight for the cave, hand on pistol and heart racing. Unfortunately for you, instead of the cave you run right into a bullet. The last thing you see is the guard's dirtied face looking over your body before he finishes the job.|9546|0
units.english: You run straight for the cave, hand on pistol and heart racing. Unfortunately for you, instead of the cave you run right into a bullet. The last thing you see is the guard's dirtied face looking over your body before he finishes the job.
units.italian: Corri dritto verso la caverna, con la mano sulla pistola e il cuore che batte forte. Sfortunatamente per te, invece della caverna trovi un proiettile. L'ultima cosa che vedi è il viso sporco della guardia che si china sul tuo corpo prima di finire il lavoro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|label|9549|0
units.english: to the ship
units.italian: to the ship

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You turn around and dash back to your ship, and find that a few bullet rounds followed you as well. You quickly take off, expecting ships to come after you; however, none do.|9550|0
units.english: You turn around and dash back to your ship, and find that a few bullet rounds followed you as well. You quickly take off, expecting ships to come after you; however, none do.
units.italian: Ti volti e corri di nuovo alla tua nave, e scopri che anche lì ti hanno seguito alcuni proiettili. Decolli in fretta, aspettandoti che delle navi ti inseguano; invece nessuna lo fa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Despite not being able to see your potential assailants you can feel an immediate shift in the tension.|9554|0
units.english: Despite not being able to see your potential assailants you can feel an immediate shift in the tension.
units.italian: Anche se non riesci a vedere i tuoi potenziali assalitori, senti un cambiamento immediato nella tensione.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Good," one of them says, seemingly more to themselves than to you. "That's real good." You hear a loud sigh and then, "Alright, Hero of Rand, you're good to approach. The boss wants to see you."|9555|0
units.english: "Good," one of them says, seemingly more to themselves than to you. "That's real good." You hear a loud sigh and then, "Alright, Hero of Rand, you're good to approach. The boss wants to see you."
units.italian: "Bene," dice uno di loro, apparentemente più a sé stesso che a te. "Davvero bene." Senti un sospiro sonoro e poi: "Va bene, Eroe di Rand, puoi avvicinarti. Il capo vuole vederti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Dark shapes materialize from the corners of the entrance, and one of them gently ushers you forward further into the oppressive atmosphere of the old mine.|9558|0
units.english: Dark shapes materialize from the corners of the entrance, and one of them gently ushers you forward further into the oppressive atmosphere of the old mine.
units.italian: Dagli angoli dell'ingresso si materializzano sagome scure, e una di loro ti accompagna gentilmente più a fondo nell'atmosfera opprimente della vecchia miniera.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Follow them into the mine.)|9560|0
units.english: (Follow them into the mine.)
units.italian: (Seguili nella miniera.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You walk in darkness over uneven terrain for what seems like hours before seeing the first glimmers of light.|9562|0
units.english: You walk in darkness over uneven terrain for what seems like hours before seeing the first glimmers of light.
units.italian: Cammini nel buio su un terreno irregolare per quello che sembra un'eternità prima di vedere i primi bagliori di luce.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	The dull fluorescent lights reveal a small group of haggard young men and women moonlighting as soldiers. There is nothing uniform about the costumes they are wearing, and what little equipment they have looks old, broken or cobbled together. Everything stinks, and the people themselves look stoned, miserable or both.|9563|0
units.english: The dull fluorescent lights reveal a small group of haggard young men and women moonlighting as soldiers. There is nothing uniform about the costumes they are wearing, and what little equipment they have looks old, broken or cobbled together. Everything stinks, and the people themselves look stoned, miserable or both.
units.italian: Le fioche luci fluorescenti rivelano un piccolo gruppo di giovani uomini e donne emaciati che fanno i soldati per sbarcare il lunario. Non c'è nulla di uniforme nei loro abiti, e quel poco di attrezzatura che hanno sembra vecchio, rotto o rattoppato. Tutto puzza, e le persone stesse sembrano stordite, infelici o entrambe le cose.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Finally your escort stops outside a door built into the cavern walls. "She's just in here. Behave."|9564|0
units.english: Finally your escort stops outside a door built into the cavern walls. "She's just in here. Behave."
units.italian: Alla fine la tua scorta si ferma davanti a una porta ricavata nelle pareti della caverna. "È qua dentro. Comportati bene."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Walk inside.)|9566|0
units.english: (Walk inside.)
units.italian: (Entra.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	The woman before you is middle-aged and unusually gaunt, with the hollowed out appearance of a person who's lived too long in Rand's frail gravity. She's attractive though, and there is something very familiar about her face. You've met her before...|9568|0
units.english: The woman before you is middle-aged and unusually gaunt, with the hollowed out appearance of a person who's lived too long in Rand's frail gravity. She's attractive though, and there is something very familiar about her face. You've met her before...
units.italian: La donna davanti a te è di mezza età e insolitamente scarnita, con l'aspetto svuotato di chi ha vissuto troppo a lungo nella gracile gravità di Rand. È però attraente, e c'è qualcosa di molto familiare nel suo viso. L'hai già incontrata...

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Captain <last>!" she says with a genuine grin. "I doubt you recognize me, but I was Governor Radrickson's secretary, Wynnafrith. We met years back at your banquet."|9569|0
units.english: "Captain <last>!" she says with a genuine grin. "I doubt you recognize me, but I was Governor Radrickson's secretary, Wynnafrith. We met years back at your banquet."
units.italian: "Capitano <last>!" dice con un sorriso sincero. "Dubito che mi riconosca, ma ero la segretaria del Governatore Radrickson, Wynnafrith. Ci siamo conosciuti anni fa, al suo banchetto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She glances down at herself as if recognizing her body's transformation from healthy offworlder to Rander waif. "I dare say the world has changed me now that I'm away from the gravity generators.|9570|0
units.english: She glances down at herself as if recognizing her body's transformation from healthy offworlder to Rander waif. "I dare say the world has changed me now that I'm away from the gravity generators.
units.italian: Si guarda addosso, come se riconoscesse la trasformazione del suo corpo da forestiera in salute a randiana smunta. "Oserei dire che il mondo mi ha cambiata, ora che sono lontana dai generatori di gravità.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Although I am no longer a secretary, I am Union-Colonel Wynnafrith, one of the leaders of the Underground Workers Union!" Her eyes sparkle and her words ring with a deadly seriousness.|9571|0
units.english: "Although I am no longer a secretary, I am Union-Colonel Wynnafrith, one of the leaders of the Underground Workers Union!" Her eyes sparkle and her words ring with a deadly seriousness.
units.italian: "Anche se non sono più una segretaria, sono la Colonnella Sindacale Wynnafrith, una dei leader del Sindacato Operaio Clandestino!" Gli occhi le brillano e le sue parole risuonano di una serietà mortale.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She tilts her head slightly. "But that's enough about me. What possible reason could you have for coming here?" Her face is open and friendly, but she casually rests her hand on her side arm.|9572|0
units.english: She tilts her head slightly. "But that's enough about me. What possible reason could you have for coming here?" Her face is open and friendly, but she casually rests her hand on her side arm.
units.italian: Inclina leggermente la testa. "Ma basta parlare di me. Quale possibile motivo potresti avere per venire qui?" Il viso è aperto e amichevole, ma appoggia con noncuranza la mano sull'arma al fianco.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Tell her about Timothy.)|9574|0
units.english: (Tell her about Timothy.)
units.italian: (Le parli di Timothy.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Tell her I just wanted to say hi.)|9576|0
units.english: (Tell her I just wanted to say hi.)
units.italian: (Le dica che volevo solo salutarla.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Tell her it is none of her business.)|9577|0
units.english: (Tell her it is none of her business.)
units.italian: (Le dica che non sono affari suoi.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She frowns and aims her gun squarely at your chest. "It's been too long since I've last seen you. And though you were once Governor Radrickson's friend, things have changed quite a bit since then."|9579|0
units.english: She frowns and aims her gun squarely at your chest. "It's been too long since I've last seen you. And though you were once Governor Radrickson's friend, things have changed quite a bit since then."
units.italian: Si acciglia e punta l'arma dritta al tuo petto. "È troppo tempo che non ti vedo. E anche se un tempo eri amico del Governatore Radrickson, le cose sono cambiate parecchio da allora."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She gives you a nonchalant shrug. "If that's all you have to say, then I am afraid there is no good reason to let you leave here alive." She favors you with a brief smile. "Operational security, you know how it goes."|9580|0
units.english: She gives you a nonchalant shrug. "If that's all you have to say, then I am afraid there is no good reason to let you leave here alive." She favors you with a brief smile. "Operational security, you know how it goes."
units.italian: Ti fa spallucce con noncuranza. "Se è tutto quello che hai da dire, temo che non ci sia un buon motivo per lasciarti uscire vivo di qui." Ti concede un breve sorriso. "Sicurezza operativa, sai come funziona."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She switches off the safety.|9581|0
units.english: She switches off the safety.
units.italian: Toglie la sicura.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Wait! Timothy sent me!"|9583|0
units.english: "Wait! Timothy sent me!"
units.italian: "Aspetta! Mi manda Timothy!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Take your best shot."|9585|0
units.english: "Take your best shot."
units.italian: "Spara pure, se ci riesci."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She does indeed take her best shot, and the sudden hole in your torso proves to be quite terminal.|9586|0
units.english: She does indeed take her best shot, and the sudden hole in your torso proves to be quite terminal.
units.italian: E ci riesce davvero, a sparare al meglio, e il foro improvviso nel tuo torace si rivela piuttosto letale.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|label|9589|0
units.english: say so
units.italian: say so

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She shakes her head. "Well, why didn't you just say so? What does our Governor ask of us?" She holsters her sidearm.|9590|0
units.english: She shakes her head. "Well, why didn't you just say so? What does our Governor ask of us?" She holsters her sidearm.
units.italian: Scuote la testa. "Beh, perché non l'hai detto subito? Che cosa chiede il nostro Governatore?" Rimette l'arma nella fondina.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Union-Colonel Wynnafrith's eyes get misty as you tell her about Timothy's plight. She shakes her head a few times and then takes the list from you and carefully scrutinizes it.|9593|0
units.english: Union-Colonel Wynnafrith's eyes get misty as you tell her about Timothy's plight. She shakes her head a few times and then takes the list from you and carefully scrutinizes it.
units.italian: Gli occhi della Colonnella Sindacale Wynnafrith si inumidiscono mentre le racconti la situazione di Timothy. Scuote la testa un paio di volte, poi prende la lista da te e la scruta con attenzione.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Ya know, to us he's still the Governor. Don't believe what the company-bosses and their paid politicians tell you. He was a good man." She wipes her eyes for a moment. "All he was trying to do was improve the conditions for workers here on Rand. He'd come up from the mines and he knew what it was like."|9594|0
units.english: "Ya know, to us he's still the Governor. Don't believe what the company-bosses and their paid politicians tell you. He was a good man." She wipes her eyes for a moment. "All he was trying to do was improve the conditions for workers here on Rand. He'd come up from the mines and he knew what it was like."
units.italian: "Sai, per noi è ancora il Governatore. Non credere a quello che ti dicono i capi aziendali e i loro politici pagati. Era un brav'uomo." Si asciuga gli occhi per un momento. "Tutto quello che cercava di fare era migliorare le condizioni degli operai qui su Rand. Veniva dalle miniere e sapeva com'era."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Her free hand tightens into a ball. "The big men didn't like that. But what about the profit margins? They tried to bribe him, to offer him anything he wanted, to just leave things well enough alone. To let the exploitation continue." She says the last words through clenched teeth.|9595|0
units.english: Her free hand tightens into a ball. "The big men didn't like that. But what about the profit margins? They tried to bribe him, to offer him anything he wanted, to just leave things well enough alone. To let the exploitation continue." She says the last words through clenched teeth.
units.italian: La mano libera le si stringe a pugno. "Ai pezzi grossi non è piaciuto. Ma che ne è dei margini di profitto? Hanno cercato di corromperlo, di offrirgli tutto quello che voleva, purché lasciasse le cose come stavano. Purché lo sfruttamento continuasse." Dice le ultime parole a denti stretti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Sure, he made some mistakes. No one becomes governor here without getting a little dirt on their hands. But in the end he refused to give into the company-bosses' demands, and throughout it all he was laboring for the common man." Wynnafrith looks up at you. "You were a good friend to him, it's true, but truth be told, while you may have been his hero, he was ours; he was the real Hero of Rand.|9596|0
units.english: "Sure, he made some mistakes. No one becomes governor here without getting a little dirt on their hands. But in the end he refused to give into the company-bosses' demands, and throughout it all he was laboring for the common man." Wynnafrith looks up at you. "You were a good friend to him, it's true, but truth be told, while you may have been his hero, he was ours; he was the real Hero of Rand.
units.italian: "Certo, ha fatto qualche errore. Nessuno diventa governatore qui senza sporcarsi un po' le mani. Ma alla fine si è rifiutato di cedere alle richieste dei capi aziendali, e per tutto il tempo ha lavorato per la gente comune." Wynnafrith alza lo sguardo su di te. "Eri un buon amico per lui, è vero, ma a dire il vero, anche se tu puoi essere stato il suo eroe, lui era il nostro; lui era il vero Eroe di Rand.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"And when he wouldn't budge they finally got him on trumped up charges and threw him to Oblivion to disappear and die." She shakes her head. "There was nothing we could do. We're still in a..." she hesitates, "... a rebuilding phase."|9597|0
units.english: "And when he wouldn't budge they finally got him on trumped up charges and threw him to Oblivion to disappear and die." She shakes her head. "There was nothing we could do. We're still in a..." she hesitates, "... a rebuilding phase."
units.italian: "E quando non ha voluto piegarsi, alla fine l'hanno preso con accuse inventate e buttato su Oblivion perché sparisse e morisse." Scuote la testa. "Non potevamo fare nulla. Siamo ancora in una fase di..." esita, "...ricostruzione."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She reads the list again. "A few weeks, you say? Well, we already thought he was dead, so if there's a chance we save the Governor then we're in.|9598|0
units.english: She reads the list again. "A few weeks, you say? Well, we already thought he was dead, so if there's a chance we save the Governor then we're in.
units.italian: Rilegge la lista. "Poche settimane, dici? Beh, lo credevamo già morto, quindi se c'è una possibilità di salvare il Governatore, ci stiamo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"We have a few left over explosives and detonators from when this mine was active. That should take care of the bomb he was hoping for." She then unholsters her sidearm and hands it to you.|9599|0
units.english: "We have a few left over explosives and detonators from when this mine was active. That should take care of the bomb he was hoping for." She then unholsters her sidearm and hands it to you.
units.italian: "Ci restano alcuni esplosivi e detonatori da quando questa miniera era attiva. Dovrebbero bastare per la bomba che sperava." Poi sfila l'arma dalla fondina e te la porge.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Take it.)|9601|0
units.english: (Take it.)
units.italian: (Prendila.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"And this should take care of his need for a gun. As for the other items on there..." She turns to a torn and faded star chart taped on the rocky cavern wall.|9603|0
units.english: "And this should take care of his need for a gun. As for the other items on there..." She turns to a torn and faded star chart taped on the rocky cavern wall.
units.italian: "E questo dovrebbe risolvere il suo bisogno di una pistola. Quanto al resto della lista..." Si volta verso una carta stellare strappata e sbiadita incollata alla parete rocciosa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Grabbing a small stick leaning against the wall, she points to Rastaban. "Dancer would be the best world to find a survival suit rated for Oblivion's toxic environment. As for medication..." She looks over the chart for a moment, then points to Dabih. "Your best bet will be New Britain. One of the few worlds in the Belt that can produce complex pharmaceuticals."|9604|0
units.english: Grabbing a small stick leaning against the wall, she points to Rastaban. "Dancer would be the best world to find a survival suit rated for Oblivion's toxic environment. As for medication..." She looks over the chart for a moment, then points to Dabih. "Your best bet will be New Britain. One of the few worlds in the Belt that can produce complex pharmaceuticals."
units.italian: Afferra un bastoncino appoggiato alla parete e indica Rastaban. "Dancer sarebbe il mondo migliore per trovare una tuta di sopravvivenza omologata per l'ambiente tossico di Oblivion. Quanto ai farmaci..." Dà un'occhiata alla carta, poi indica Dabih. "La tua opzione migliore sarà New Britain. Uno dei pochi mondi della Cintura in grado di produrre prodotti farmaceutici complessi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	The stick points at Shaula next. "The best place for a fake ID would be the 'independent' world of Greenrock." She taps her chin before continuing, "It would be tight though getting to all three of these worlds and back to the governor in time. Any of these worlds may also have the other equipment you need, but the quality likely wouldn't be as good."|9605|0
units.english: The stick points at Shaula next. "The best place for a fake ID would be the 'independent' world of Greenrock." She taps her chin before continuing, "It would be tight though getting to all three of these worlds and back to the governor in time. Any of these worlds may also have the other equipment you need, but the quality likely wouldn't be as good."
units.italian: Il bastoncino indica poi Shaula. "Il posto migliore per un documento falso sarebbe il mondo 'indipendente' di Greenrock." Si tocca il mento prima di continuare: "Sarebbe però stretto arrivare su tutti e tre questi mondi e tornare dal governatore in tempo. Ognuno di questi mondi potrebbe anche avere l'altra attrezzatura che ti serve, ma probabilmente la qualità non sarebbe altrettanto buona."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	She turns back to you. "I am sorry we couldn't be more help, but hopefully it's enough."|9606|0
units.english: She turns back to you. "I am sorry we couldn't be more help, but hopefully it's enough."
units.italian: Si volta di nuovo verso di te. "Mi dispiace di non poter aiutare di più, ma spero che basti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	After putting the pointing stick back in its place, Wynnafrith steps through the door, indicating for you to follow her.|9607|0
units.english: After putting the pointing stick back in its place, Wynnafrith steps through the door, indicating for you to follow her.
units.italian: Dopo aver rimesso il bastoncino al suo posto, Wynnafrith varca la porta facendoti cenno di seguirla.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	(Follow her.)|9609|0
units.english: (Follow her.)
units.italian: (Seguila.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Once again in the larger cavern she turns and points at the guard. "Grab our bomb and accompany Captain <last> with it back to their ship."|9611|0
units.english: Once again in the larger cavern she turns and points at the guard. "Grab our bomb and accompany Captain <last> with it back to their ship."
units.italian: Di nuovo nella caverna più grande si volta e indica la guardia. "Prendi la nostra bomba e accompagna il Capitano <last> con essa fino alla sua nave."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	The guard frowns. "But it's our only one..."|9612|0
units.english: The guard frowns. "But it's our only one..."
units.italian: La guardia si acciglia. "Ma è l'unica che abbiamo..."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	"Now!" She cuts him off, and watches as he sullenly slumps away.|9613|0
units.english: "Now!" She cuts him off, and watches as he sullenly slumps away.
units.italian: "Ora!" Lo interrompe, e lo guarda allontanarsi mogio e imbronciato.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	Without looking your way she continues, "It was a pleasure to see you again, Captain <last>, but it's time you were leaving. The governor needs you, and my own glorious revolution needs some attention."|9614|0
units.english: Without looking your way she continues, "It was a pleasure to see you again, Captain <last>, but it's time you were leaving. The governor needs you, and my own glorious revolution needs some attention."
units.italian: Senza guardarti continua: "È stato un piacere rivederti, Capitano <last>, ma è ora che tu vada. Il governatore ha bisogno di te, e la mia gloriosa rivoluzione richiede un po' di attenzione."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|	You leave the dilapidated mines with a bomb, a pistol, and a plan.|9615|0
units.english: You leave the dilapidated mines with a bomb, a pistol, and a plan.
units.italian: Lasci le miniere fatiscenti con una bomba, una pistola e un piano.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5a: Timshank Redemption|log|9617|0
units.english: Met Union-Colonel Wynnafrith, Timothy Radrickson's old secretary on Rand. She appears to have become a revolutionary since I last saw her. Showed her Timothy's list, and she said I could find a survival suit on Dancer, the medication on New Britain, and a fake ID on Shaula. Provided me with the gun and bomb Timothy asked for.
units.italian: Ho conosciuto la Colonnella Sindacale Wynnafrith, l'ex segretaria di Timothy Radrickson su Rand. Sembra essere diventata una rivoluzionaria dall'ultima volta che l'ho vista. Le ho mostrato la lista di Timothy, e mi ha detto che posso trovare una tuta di sopravvivenza su Dancer, i farmaci su New Britain e un documento falso su Shaula. Mi ha procurato la pistola e la bomba che Timothy aveva chiesto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|description|9622|0
units.english: Tim's old secretary Wynnafrith recommended that <destination> would be a good place to find detoxification medication for Tim.
units.italian: L'ex segretaria di Tim, Wynnafrith, ha consigliato <destination> come buon posto per trovare i farmaci disintossicanti per Tim.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|name|9624|0
units.english: Supplies on New Britain
units.italian: Provviste su New Britain

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|With a little effort you're able to navigate New Britain's labyrinthian ziggurat masquerading as a spaceport. The lower levels are dedicated to a bustling trade sector where merchants, traders, and producers from all over the Dirt Belt haggle to sell their raw materials, and purchase complex equipment and refined products.|9631|0
units.english: With a little effort you're able to navigate New Britain's labyrinthian ziggurat masquerading as a spaceport. The lower levels are dedicated to a bustling trade sector where merchants, traders, and producers from all over the Dirt Belt haggle to sell their raw materials, and purchase complex equipment and refined products.
units.italian: Con un po' di fatica riesci a orientarti nel labirintico ziggurat di New Britain che si spaccia per spazioporto. I livelli inferiori sono dedicati a un vivace settore commerciale, dove mercanti, commercianti e produttori di tutta la Dirt Belt contrattano per vendere le loro materie prime e comprare attrezzature complesse e prodotti raffinati.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Find the detoxification medicine.)|9634|0
units.english: (Find the detoxification medicine.)
units.italian: (Trova i farmaci disintossicanti.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Haggle with the medicine salesman again.)|9638|0
units.english: (Haggle with the medicine salesman again.)
units.italian: (Contratta di nuovo con il venditore di farmaci.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Look for the survival suit.)|9643|0
units.english: (Look for the survival suit.)
units.italian: (Cerca la tuta di sopravvivenza.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Return to the shop to buy the survival suit.)|9648|0
units.english: (Return to the shop to buy the survival suit.)
units.italian: (Torna al negozio per comprare la tuta di sopravvivenza.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Find someone that can procure a fake ID for me.)|9653|0
units.english: (Find someone that can procure a fake ID for me.)
units.italian: (Trova qualcuno che possa procurarmi un documento falso.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Leave the trade sector.)|9658|0
units.english: (Leave the trade sector.)
units.italian: (Esci dal settore commerciale.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	You make your way to the pharmaceutical wing, through crowds of representatives from large conglomerates in the process of wrangling with representatives from various worlds, all needing exotic medicine for their innumerable plagues, blights, pandemics, and the like. There's a booth with a slick salesman selling expensive drugs promising to reverse and protect from the effect of toxic air and radiation, and it just so happens that Oblivion is their demonstration planet.|9664|0
units.english: You make your way to the pharmaceutical wing, through crowds of representatives from large conglomerates in the process of wrangling with representatives from various worlds, all needing exotic medicine for their innumerable plagues, blights, pandemics, and the like. There's a booth with a slick salesman selling expensive drugs promising to reverse and protect from the effect of toxic air and radiation, and it just so happens that Oblivion is their demonstration planet.
units.italian: Ti fai strada verso l'ala farmaceutica, fra la folla di rappresentanti di grandi conglomerati che stanno trattando con rappresentanti di vari mondi, tutti bisognosi di medicine esotiche per le loro innumerevoli pestilenze, morie, pandemie e simili. C'è uno stand con un venditore mellifluo che vende farmaci costosi promettendo di invertire e prevenire gli effetti dell'aria tossica e delle radiazioni, e guarda caso il loro pianeta dimostrativo è Oblivion.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	"There's no need to fear Oblivion's deleterious effects so long as you take one of these a day!" the salesman says brightly. "Why, you could walk among your condemned workers unmasked, and demonstrate your superior executive prowess!"|9665|0
units.english: "There's no need to fear Oblivion's deleterious effects so long as you take one of these a day!" the salesman says brightly. "Why, you could walk among your condemned workers unmasked, and demonstrate your superior executive prowess!"
units.italian: "Non c'è bisogno di temere gli effetti deleteri di Oblivion, purché ne prendiate uno al giorno!" dice il venditore con allegria. "Potreste camminare fra i vostri operai condannati senza maschera e dimostrare la vostra superiore capacità dirigenziale!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	You listen on to the salesman, who reckons he can cut you in on a special deal for 140,000 credits.|9666|0
units.english: You listen on to the salesman, who reckons he can cut you in on a special deal for 140,000 credits.
units.italian: Ascolti il venditore, che pensa di poterti fare uno sconto speciale a 140.000 crediti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Purchase the medicine for Tim.)|9668|0
units.english: (Purchase the medicine for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra la medicina per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Haggle for a lower price.)|9670|0

units.italian: Quel prezzo è troppo alto. Torni all'atrio centrale del settore commerciale per valutare le tue opzioni.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|The salesman's eyes narrow and his face suddenly looks vaguely reptilian. "I'm already giving you the best price. The literal shirt off my back!"|9677|0
units.english: The salesman's eyes narrow and his face suddenly looks vaguely reptilian. "I'm already giving you the best price. The literal shirt off my back!"
units.italian: Gli occhi del venditore si restringono e il suo viso assume all'improvviso un'aria vagamente rettiliana. "Le sto già facendo il miglior prezzo. La camicia che ho addosso!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Offer 60,000 for the meds.)|9679|0
units.english: (Offer 60,000 for the meds.)
units.italian: (Offri 60.000 per le medicine.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Offer 120,000 for the meds.)|9680|0
units.english: (Offer 120,000 for the meds.)
units.italian: (Offri 120.000 per le medicine.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Agree to pay 140,000 for the meds.)|9682|0
units.english: (Agree to pay 140,000 for the meds.)
units.italian: (Accetta di pagare 140.000 per le medicine.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The drug salesman's eyes flash with hostility before he breaks out in an angry laugh. "Who do you think you are? What do you think, this is a charity? I already have a buyer lined up for more than twice that!"|9685|0
units.english: The drug salesman's eyes flash with hostility before he breaks out in an angry laugh. "Who do you think you are? What do you think, this is a charity? I already have a buyer lined up for more than twice that!"
units.italian: Gli occhi del venditore di farmaci lampeggiano di ostilità prima che scoppi in una risata rabbiosa. "Chi ti credi di essere? Che pensi, che questa sia beneficenza? Ho già un compratore pronto per più del doppio!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	He begins packing up his equipment. "I'm charging you full price, 140,000 or nothing. Last chance."|9686|0
units.english: He begins packing up his equipment. "I'm charging you full price, 140,000 or nothing. Last chance."
units.italian: Comincia a impacchettare la sua attrezzatura. "Ti faccio pagare il prezzo pieno, 140.000 o niente. Ultima occasione."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Purchase the medicine for Tim.)|9688|0

units.italian: (Compra la medicina per Tim.)

units.italian: Quel prezzo è troppo alto; dovrai vedere se riesci a comprare un farmaco meno potente e più economico altrove. Torni all'atrio centrale del settore commerciale per valutare le altre opzioni.

units.english: just right
units.italian: just right

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The salesman glowers, but nods his head slightly. "Fine! 120,000 credits it is. My family will starve, but at least you'll get your precious drugs." He begins packing them up for you.|9697|0
units.english: The salesman glowers, but nods his head slightly. "Fine! 120,000 credits it is. My family will starve, but at least you'll get your precious drugs." He begins packing them up for you.
units.italian: Il venditore si rabbuia, ma accenna un cenno con la testa. "Va bene! 120.000 crediti. La mia famiglia morirà di fame, ma almeno avrai le tue preziose medicine." Comincia a impacchettarle per te.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	You decide to go back the pharmaceutical wing to reconsider the deal.|9703|0
units.english: You decide to go back the pharmaceutical wing to reconsider the deal.
units.italian: Decidi di tornare nell'ala farmaceutica per ripensare all'accordo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	"Here's the captain again!" says the salesman, as if he'd known you for years. He leans in uncomfortably close to you and says, "I can tell you're a discerning customer, so here's what I will let these go for: 120,000 credits. That's almost wholesale price! I'm barely making a cent, but I really need to unload all these drugs."|9704|0
units.english: "Here's the captain again!" says the salesman, as if he'd known you for years. He leans in uncomfortably close to you and says, "I can tell you're a discerning customer, so here's what I will let these go for: 120,000 credits. That's almost wholesale price! I'm barely making a cent, but I really need to unload all these drugs."
units.italian: "Ecco di nuovo il capitano!" dice il venditore, come se ti conoscesse da anni. Si avvicina scomodamente e dice: "Vedo che è un cliente esigente, quindi le lascio queste a 120.000 crediti. È quasi il prezzo all'ingrosso! Non ci guadagno quasi niente, ma devo davvero sbarazzarmi di tutti questi farmaci."

units.italian: Ti concede un sorriso innaturalmente bianco e dentato.

units.italian: Gli occhi del venditore si sbarrano e il suo viso liscio si copre all'improvviso di brutte rughe. "Va bene. Tanto ho un altro compratore," ti ringhia a mezza voce. Comincia a smontare il banco, borbottando e scuotendo la testa fra sé.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	It doesn't take long for you to find stores stocked with flashy, expensive clothes brands. The ones catering to the wealthy, adventurous types. Hobbyists with something to prove. The gear here is attractive, mass produced, and beneath the lifestyle veneer they give off, somewhat cheap. units.english: It doesn't take long for you to find stores stocked with flashy, expensive clothes brands. The ones catering to the wealthy, adventurous types. Hobbyists with something to prove. The gear here is attractive, mass produced, and beneath the lifestyle veneer they give off, somewhat cheap. They might not be industrial grade, but maybe they'll be good enough for Timothy. Maybe.
units.italian: Ci vuole poco a trovare negozi pieni di marche di abbigliamento appariscenti e costose. Quelli che servono i tipi ricchi e avventurosi. Hobbisti con qualcosa da dimostrare. L'attrezzatura qui è attraente, prodotta in serie e, sotto la vernice dello stile di vita che trasmette, un po' economica. Forse non sarà di qualità industriale, ma magari basterà per Timothy. Magari.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	There's a store named "Explorer's Element" not far from the central atrium which looks promising. The advertised price for the most heavy-duty survival suit they stock is only 99,999 credits, and there are numerous suits on the rack.|9749|0
