units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The suit's value is probably a good indicator of its usefulness, and you pass up on the option to buy it. You return to the central atrium of the trade sector to consider your options.|9754|0
units.english: The suit's value is probably a good indicator of its usefulness, and you pass up on the option to buy it. You return to the central atrium of the trade sector to consider your options.
units.italian: Il valore della tuta è probabilmente un buon indicatore della sua utilità, e rinunci a comprarla. Torni all'atrio centrale del settore commerciale per valutare le opzioni.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	You return to the store and locate the rack filled with the hobbyist survival suits. The price is still 99,999 credits.|9760|0
units.english: You return to the store and locate the rack filled with the hobbyist survival suits. The price is still 99,999 credits.
units.italian: Torni al negozio e trovi il ripiano pieno di tute di sopravvivenza per hobbisti. Il prezzo è ancora 99.999 crediti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Get the survival suit for Tim.)|9762|0
units.english: (Get the survival suit for Tim.)
units.italian: (Prendi la tuta di sopravvivenza per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Pass.)|9764|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	You just can't pull the trigger. You return to the terminal area to consider your other options.|9765|0
units.english: You just can't pull the trigger. You return to the terminal area to consider your other options.
units.italian: Proprio non riesci a deciderlo. Torni all'area del terminale per valutare le altre opzioni.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|label|9768|0
units.english: get suit
units.italian: get suit

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The sales associate is delighted to remove the tags and wrap up your brand new survival suit. He tells you about how his cousin used one just last month to visit a mildly chilly beach a few hours north of the spaceport.|9773|0
units.english: The sales associate is delighted to remove the tags and wrap up your brand new survival suit. He tells you about how his cousin used one just last month to visit a mildly chilly beach a few hours north of the spaceport.
units.italian: Il commesso è felice di staccare i cartellini e incartare la tua nuova tuta di sopravvivenza. Ti racconta di come suo cugino ne abbia usata una il mese scorso per visitare una spiaggia leggermente fresca a qualche ora a nord dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	You pay the <payment>, and he hands you the bag.|9774|0
units.english: You pay the <payment>, and he hands you the bag.
units.italian: Paghi <payment>, e lui ti porge il sacchetto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The trade sector has all manner of ID services and consultants, but you find none of the respectable ones are willing to talk to you after you explain the ID has to be prepared "in absentia," and the unrespectable ones appear to be lacking here given the presence of the spaceport gendarme at every corner. Frustrated, you decide to take a walk outside the spaceport proper.|9780|0
units.english: The trade sector has all manner of ID services and consultants, but you find none of the respectable ones are willing to talk to you after you explain the ID has to be prepared "in absentia," and the unrespectable ones appear to be lacking here given the presence of the spaceport gendarme at every corner. Frustrated, you decide to take a walk outside the spaceport proper.
units.italian: Il settore commerciale ha servizi e consulenti di ogni tipo per i documenti, ma scopri che nessuno di quelli rispettabili vuole parlarti dopo che spieghi che il documento deve essere preparato "in absentia", e quelli non rispettabili sembrano scarseggiare qui, vista la presenza della gendarmeria dello spazioporto a ogni angolo. Frustrato, decidi di fare una passeggiata fuori dallo spazioporto vero e proprio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Give up and go get something else.)|9782|0
units.english: (Give up and go get something else.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia e vai a prendere qualcos'altro.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Keep walking about.)|9784|0
units.english: (Keep walking about.)
units.italian: (Continua a camminare.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	You eventually reach a little forested garden area with a few benches, by one of the parking lots that serve the spaceport. The suns of Dabih are out in full force today, and you're glad to be in the shade.|9785|0
units.english: You eventually reach a little forested garden area with a few benches, by one of the parking lots that serve the spaceport. The suns of Dabih are out in full force today, and you're glad to be in the shade.
units.italian: Alla fine raggiungi una piccola area verde alberata con qualche panchina, vicino a uno dei parcheggi che servono lo spazioporto. Oggi i soli di Dabih sono in gran forma, e sei contento di stare all'ombra.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	As you recover from the heat you notice that, sitting over in the parking lot, there's a few teenagers chatting amongst themselves. The sort that look like they'd know where to get a false ID if they needed one. Perhaps they could give you some pointers.|9786|0
units.english: As you recover from the heat you notice that, sitting over in the parking lot, there's a few teenagers chatting amongst themselves. The sort that look like they'd know where to get a false ID if they needed one. Perhaps they could give you some pointers.
units.italian: Mentre ti riprendi dal caldo noti che, seduti nel parcheggio, ci sono alcuni adolescenti che chiacchierano fra loro. Del tipo che sembra saprebbe dove procurarsi un documento falso, se servisse. Forse potrebbero darti qualche dritta.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Give up and go get something else.)|9788|0
units.english: (Give up and go get something else.)
units.italian: (Rinuncia e vai a prendere qualcos'altro.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Approach the teenagers for help about the ID.)|9790|0
units.english: (Approach the teenagers for help about the ID.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati agli adolescenti per chiedere aiuto sul documento.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The teenagers, two of them boys and one a girl, grin at you like fresh meat as you near them.|9792|0
units.english: The teenagers, two of them boys and one a girl, grin at you like fresh meat as you near them.
units.italian: Gli adolescenti, due ragazzi e una ragazza, ti sorridono come se fossi carne fresca mentre ti avvicini.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The guy in the middle says, "What'dya need, boss? Wanna get high? Wanna get low? Wanna get out?" Apparently this group is used to working with frustrated castouts from the overly legal spaceport emporium.|9793|0
units.english: The guy in the middle says, "What'dya need, boss? Wanna get high? Wanna get low? Wanna get out?" Apparently this group is used to working with frustrated castouts from the overly legal spaceport emporium.
units.italian: Quello in mezzo dice: "Che ti serve, capo? Ti vuoi sballare? Ti vuoi svagare? Ti vuoi squagliare?" A quanto pare il gruppo è abituato a trattare con i frustrati espulsi dall'emporio fin troppo legale dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Ask them about where I could get a fake ID.)|9795|0
units.english: (Ask them about where I could get a fake ID.)
units.italian: (Chiedi dove potrei procurarmi un documento falso.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Politely decline and head back to my ship.)|9797|0
units.english: (Politely decline and head back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta cortesemente e torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Threaten to call the police.)|9799|0
units.english: (Threaten to call the police.)
units.italian: (Minaccia di chiamare la polizia.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	They back away from you and frown. The middle one lowers his hand to some concealed weapon, but stops himself when he notices your own holstered gun.|9801|0
units.english: They back away from you and frown. The middle one lowers his hand to some concealed weapon, but stops himself when he notices your own holstered gun.
units.italian: Si ritraggono e si accigliano. Quello in mezzo abbassa la mano verso un'arma nascosta, ma si ferma quando nota la tua pistola nella fondina.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The girl next to him mutters, "Ain't worth it. Let's roll." The kids promptly walk off, leaving you alone in the park.|9802|0
units.english: The girl next to him mutters, "Ain't worth it. Let's roll." The kids promptly walk off, leaving you alone in the park.
units.italian: La ragazza accanto a lui mormora: "Non ne vale la pena. Andiamo." I ragazzi se ne vanno subito, lasciandoti solo nel parco.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Head back to the spaceport.)|9804|0
units.english: (Head back to the spaceport.)
units.italian: (Torna allo spazioporto.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|label|9807|0
units.english: hook me up
units.italian: hook me up

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	The three of them look at each other and then give you a carnivorous grin.|9808|0
units.english: The three of them look at each other and then give you a carnivorous grin.
units.italian: Si guardano fra loro e poi ti rivolgono un ghigno carnivoro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	"Sure thing," he smirks. "Easy as rain. It'll cost ya 'bout 20,000 cred." They look at you expectantly.|9809|0
units.english: "Sure thing," he smirks. "Easy as rain. It'll cost ya 'bout 20,000 cred." They look at you expectantly.
units.italian: "Certo," sogghigna. "Facile come bere un bicchiere d'acqua. Ti costerà sui 20.000 crediti." Ti guardano in attesa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Give them the credits.)|9811|0
units.english: (Give them the credits.)
units.italian: (Dagli i crediti.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	"Wait! Show me how you're going to do it first."|9813|0
units.english: "Wait! Show me how you're going to do it first."
units.italian: "Aspetta! Prima mostrami come farai."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Turn them down.)|9814|0
units.english: (Turn them down.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	He sighs. "Fine. I know a guy in the city, he snags us fake IDs all the time, gets us into bars, clubs, all sorts. All we need is how ya want this false guy to look, we'll take it to him and get the ID, and you'll be sweet.|9817|0
units.english: He sighs. "Fine. I know a guy in the city, he snags us fake IDs all the time, gets us into bars, clubs, all sorts. All we need is how ya want this false guy to look, we'll take it to him and get the ID, and you'll be sweet.
units.italian: Sospira. "Va bene. Conosco uno in città, ci procura documenti falsi in continuazione, ci fa entrare in bar, locali, di tutto. Ci serve solo come vuoi che sia questo tizio falso, lo portiamo da lui, prendiamo il documento e sei a posto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	"So, ya gonna take it?"|9818|0
units.english: "So, ya gonna take it?"
units.italian: "Allora, lo prendi?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Give them the credits.)|9820|0
units.english: (Give them the credits.)
units.italian: (Dagli i crediti.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Turn them down.)|9822|0
units.english: (Turn them down.)
units.italian: (Rifiuta.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|label|9824|0
units.english: refuse id
units.italian: refuse id

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	Collectively they frown. "Your loss," the middle guy says, before leaving you alone to return to the spaceport.|9825|0
units.english: Collectively they frown. "Your loss," the middle guy says, before leaving you alone to return to the spaceport.
units.italian: Si accigliano tutti. "Peggio per te," dice quello in mezzo, prima di lasciarti solo a tornare allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|label|9828|0
units.english: buy id
units.italian: buy id

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	"Alrighty then, it's a done deal," he says, stashing the credit chip away. He then pulls out a datapad and asks you a few questions about what to put on the ID. You try to answer as best you can in regards to Timothy (and change a few of the more obviously incriminating details). They say to meet you here in a couple hours once they've got the ID sorted in the city.|9831|0
units.english: "Alrighty then, it's a done deal," he says, stashing the credit chip away. He then pulls out a datapad and asks you a few questions about what to put on the ID. You try to answer as best you can in regards to Timothy (and change a few of the more obviously incriminating details). They say to meet you here in a couple hours once they've got the ID sorted in the city.
units.italian: "Bene allora, affare fatto," dice, intascando il chip di credito. Poi tira fuori un datapad e ti fa qualche domanda su cosa mettere sul documento. Cerchi di rispondere al meglio riguardo a Timothy (e cambi qualche dettaglio fin troppo incriminante). Dicono di vederti qui fra un paio d'ore, quando avranno sistemato il documento in città.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Wait.)|9833|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	Two and a half hours pass as you wait for the teens in the garden, but there's no sign of them yet. You wonder if you've just given 20,000 credits away for nothing.|9835|0
units.english: Two and a half hours pass as you wait for the teens in the garden, but there's no sign of them yet. You wonder if you've just given 20,000 credits away for nothing.
units.italian: Passano due ore e mezza mentre aspetti i ragazzi nel giardino, ma non si vede ancora nessuno. Ti chiedi se hai appena regalato 20.000 crediti per niente.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Leave.)|9837|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	(Wait.)|9839|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	Another thirty minutes pass, but just as you're about to leave the three teens show themselves again, ID in hand.|9841|0
units.english: Another thirty minutes pass, but just as you're about to leave the three teens show themselves again, ID in hand.
units.italian: Passano altri trenta minuti, ma proprio mentre stai per andartene i tre ragazzi si rifanno vedere, documento in mano.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	"We thought you're gonna bail out on us for bein' late. Thankfully you got the sense not to. And now ya get the goods in exchange." The middle kid hands you the ID. "Good dealin' with ya," he says as they walk off.|9842|0
units.english: "We thought you're gonna bail out on us for bein' late. Thankfully you got the sense not to. And now ya get the goods in exchange." The middle kid hands you the ID. "Good dealin' with ya," he says as they walk off.
units.italian: "Pensavamo che ci avresti piantato per il ritardo. Meno male che hai avuto buon senso. E ora ti becchi la merce in cambio." Il ragazzo in mezzo ti consegna il documento. "Buon affare con te," dice mentre si allontanano.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	As you go back to the spaceport, you take a look at the ID for the first time.|9843|0
units.english: As you go back to the spaceport, you take a look at the ID for the first time.
units.italian: Mentre torni allo spazioporto, dai un'occhiata al documento per la prima volta.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	Whoever made this clearly wasn't a professional. It looks like they've somehow botched the bar code, given the smear on the print, and the duplication of the emblem of the planetary authority of New Britain on the back is rather dodgy. But unless you can find a better alternative, it'll have to do.|9844|0
units.english: Whoever made this clearly wasn't a professional. It looks like they've somehow botched the bar code, given the smear on the print, and the duplication of the emblem of the planetary authority of New Britain on the back is rather dodgy. But unless you can find a better alternative, it'll have to do.
units.italian: Chiunque l'abbia fatto non era chiaramente un professionista. Sembra che abbiano in qualche modo pasticciato il codice a barre, vista la sbavatura nella stampa, e la duplicazione dell'emblema dell'autorità planetaria di New Britain sul retro è piuttosto discutibile. Ma a meno di trovare un'alternativa migliore, dovrà bastare.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|label|9847|0
units.english: leave id
units.italian: leave id

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	You sigh, having learnt a lesson that teenagers in parking lots probably aren't the most trustworthy of people. Back to the spaceport.|9848|0
units.english: You sigh, having learnt a lesson that teenagers in parking lots probably aren't the most trustworthy of people. Back to the spaceport.
units.italian: Sospiri, avendo imparato una lezione: gli adolescenti nei parcheggi non sono probabilmente le persone più affidabili. Di nuovo allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5b: New Britain|	After a long day of walking about the New British spaceport and wading through the crowds of hustlers and travellers, you return to the relatively calmer terminal area at the top of the pyramid.|9858|0
units.english: After a long day of walking about the New British spaceport and wading through the crowds of hustlers and travellers, you return to the relatively calmer terminal area at the top of the pyramid.
units.italian: Dopo una lunga giornata a girare per lo spazioporto di New Britain e a farti largo fra la folla di imbroglioni e viaggiatori, torni all'area del terminale, relativamente più calma, in cima alla piramide.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|description|9867|0
units.english: Tim's old secretary Wynnafrith recommended that <destination> would be a good place to find a survival suit for Tim.
units.italian: L'ex segretaria di Tim, Wynnafrith, ha consigliato <destination> come buon posto per trovare una tuta di sopravvivenza per Tim.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|name|9868|0
units.english: Supplies on Dancer
units.italian: Provviste su Dancer

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|Your ship shakes as it descends into Dancer's mad weather. Lightning crackles beyond your sturdy bulkheads and a panoply of colorful clouds rushes past as you boost down into in the dull overcast light of a subdued day on Dancer.|9876|0
units.english: Your ship shakes as it descends into Dancer's mad weather. Lightning crackles beyond your sturdy bulkheads and a panoply of colorful clouds rushes past as you boost down into in the dull overcast light of a subdued day on Dancer.
units.italian: La nave trema mentre scende nel clima folle di Dancer. I fulmini crepitano oltre le tue robuste paratie e una teoria di nuvole colorate ti sfreccia accanto mentre scendi nella luce grigia e coperta di una giornata spenta su Dancer.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Around the quiet spaceport there's a smattering of low reinforced buildings linked together by weather-worn trails dug into the ground with protective earth on either side. You see one leading to a spacious, if squat, clearing house.|9877|0
units.english: Around the quiet spaceport there's a smattering of low reinforced buildings linked together by weather-worn trails dug into the ground with protective earth on either side. You see one leading to a spacious, if squat, clearing house.
units.italian: Intorno al tranquillo spazioporto c'è una spolverata di bassi edifici rinforzati, collegati da sentieri consumati dal tempo e scavati nel terreno con terra protettiva su entrambi i lati. Ne vedi uno che porta a un centro di smistamento spazioso, anche se tozzo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Enter the clearing house.)|9879|0
units.english: (Enter the clearing house.)
units.italian: (Entra nel centro di smistamento.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	There is an eclectic assortment of gear, goods, supplies and equipment here, some new, some used to the point of ruin. Unsurprisingly, given the primary industry of this world, much of it is scientific.|9880|0
units.english: There is an eclectic assortment of gear, goods, supplies and equipment here, some new, some used to the point of ruin. Unsurprisingly, given the primary industry of this world, much of it is scientific.
units.italian: C'è un assortimento eterogeneo di attrezzature, merci, provviste ed equipaggiamenti, alcuni nuovi, altri usati fino alla rovina. Come prevedibile, vista l'industria principale di questo mondo, molta è di tipo scientifico.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	A middle aged woman with deep windburned scars and a striking shock of white between her otherwise dark hair greets you as you come in. "Anything worth having on Dancer can be found here. Just take a look around and let Bertha know if you find anything to your liking."|9881|0
units.english: A middle aged woman with deep windburned scars and a striking shock of white between her otherwise dark hair greets you as you come in. "Anything worth having on Dancer can be found here. Just take a look around and let Bertha know if you find anything to your liking."
units.italian: Una donna di mezza età, con profonde cicatrici da vento e un ciuffo bianco sorprendente fra i capelli altrimenti scuri, ti accoglie mentre entri. "Tutto quello che vale la pena avere su Dancer si trova qui. Dia un'occhiata in giro e faccia sapere a Bertha se trova qualcosa di suo gradimento."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|label|9882|0
units.english: dancer options
units.italian: dancer options

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Look at the survival suits.)|9884|0
units.english: (Look at the survival suits.)
units.italian: (Guarda le tute di sopravvivenza.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Look at the survival suits again.)|9888|0
units.english: (Look at the survival suits again.)
units.italian: (Guarda di nuovo le tute di sopravvivenza.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Check the medicine shelves.)|9893|0
units.english: (Check the medicine shelves.)
units.italian: (Controlla gli scaffali delle medicine.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Return to the medicine shelves.)|9898|0
units.english: (Return to the medicine shelves.)
units.italian: (Torna agli scaffali delle medicine.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Rummage around for old IDs.)|9903|0
units.english: (Rummage around for old IDs.)
units.italian: (Fruga in cerca di vecchi documenti.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Go back to where I found the ID.)|9908|0
units.english: (Go back to where I found the ID.)
units.italian: (Torna dove ho trovato il documento.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Leave the clearing house.)|9913|0
units.english: (Leave the clearing house.)
units.italian: (Esci dal centro di smistamento.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	There are a handful of survival suits on display here. These are durable, hand-crafted suits carefully checked and rated to ensure the highest chance of survival against the fierce uncaring winds of Dancer.|9919|0
units.english: There are a handful of survival suits on display here. These are durable, hand-crafted suits carefully checked and rated to ensure the highest chance of survival against the fierce uncaring winds of Dancer.
units.italian: Ci sono alcune tute di sopravvivenza in esposizione. Sono tute resistenti, fatte a mano, controllate e omologate con cura per garantire le migliori probabilità di sopravvivenza contro i venti feroci e spietati di Dancer.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha notices your attention and walks up to you. "Going anywhere overland on Dancer without one of these beauties is a death wish."|9920|0
units.english: Bertha notices your attention and walks up to you. "Going anywhere overland on Dancer without one of these beauties is a death wish."
units.italian: Bertha nota la tua attenzione e ti si avvicina. "Andare via terra su Dancer senza una di queste bellezze è un desiderio di morte."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	She winks at you, as if she knows something you don't. "Worry not though, hun. We only sell the highest rated and best-tested suits here. I won't have anyone's death on my conscience - 'sides, it's bad for business."|9921|0
units.english: She winks at you, as if she knows something you don't. "Worry not though, hun. We only sell the highest rated and best-tested suits here. I won't have anyone's death on my conscience - 'sides, it's bad for business."
units.italian: Ti fa l'occhiolino, come se sapesse qualcosa che tu non sai. "Non ti preoccupare però, tesoro. Qui vendiamo solo le tute più omologate e collaudate. Non avrò la morte di nessuno sulla coscienza; e poi fa male agli affari."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	She pinches some of the dense microwoven fabric of the nearest suit. "It's not cheap, but neither is your life. I'll sell ya one of these for 300,000 credits."|9922|0
units.english: She pinches some of the dense microwoven fabric of the nearest suit. "It's not cheap, but neither is your life. I'll sell ya one of these for 300,000 credits."
units.italian: Pizzica un pezzo del tessuto denso microtessuto della tuta più vicina. "Non è a buon mercato, ma nemmeno la tua vita lo è. Te ne vendo una a 300.000 crediti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Purchase a survival suit for Tim.)|9924|0
units.english: (Purchase a survival suit for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra una tuta di sopravvivenza per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Haggle to try and lower the price.)|9926|0
units.english: (Haggle to try and lower the price.)
units.italian: (Contratta per provare a far scendere il prezzo.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Pass.)|9928|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	You decide that 300,000 credits is way too much. The woman shrugs and steps away as you turn your attention back to the rest of the store.|9930|0
units.english: You decide that 300,000 credits is way too much. The woman shrugs and steps away as you turn your attention back to the rest of the store.
units.italian: Decidi che 300.000 crediti sono davvero troppi. La donna fa spallucce e si allontana mentre riporti l'attenzione sul resto del negozio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha gives you a sad smile and shakes her head slowly. "No room here for haggling, hun. These are the best of the best and they are worth every red cent. I am sure you can find bottom bin ones elsewhere, but here you pay for quality."|9934|0
units.english: Bertha gives you a sad smile and shakes her head slowly. "No room here for haggling, hun. These are the best of the best and they are worth every red cent. I am sure you can find bottom bin ones elsewhere, but here you pay for quality."
units.italian: Bertha ti rivolge un sorriso triste e scuote lentamente la testa. "Qui non c'è spazio per contrattare, tesoro. Queste sono il meglio del meglio e valgono ogni singolo credito. Sono sicura che altrove troverai quelle del cesto delle occasioni, ma qui paghi la qualità."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	She folds her arms. "Now, it's 300,000 credits or nothing."|9935|0
units.english: She folds her arms. "Now, it's 300,000 credits or nothing."
units.italian: Incrocia le braccia. "Ora: 300.000 crediti o niente."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Purchase the survival suit for Tim.)|9937|0
units.english: (Purchase the survival suit for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra la tuta di sopravvivenza per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Pass.)|9939|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha sighs and then shrugs, and leaves you alone to continue browsing through her clearing house.|9941|0
units.english: Bertha sighs and then shrugs, and leaves you alone to continue browsing through her clearing house.
units.italian: Bertha sospira e fa spallucce, lasciandoti solo a continuare a curiosare nel suo centro di smistamento.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	You loop back to where the well-crafted survival suits hang. The price is still 300,000 credits.|9947|0
units.english: You loop back to where the well-crafted survival suits hang. The price is still 300,000 credits.
units.italian: Torni dove sono appese le tute di sopravvivenza ben fatte. Il prezzo è ancora 300.000 crediti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Purchase a survival suit for Tim.)|9949|0
units.english: (Purchase a survival suit for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra una tuta di sopravvivenza per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Go back to browsing.)|9951|0
units.english: (Go back to browsing.)
units.italian: (Torna a curiosare.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Not ready to make a purchase, you return to perusing the store.|9953|0
units.english: Not ready to make a purchase, you return to perusing the store.
units.italian: Non sei pronto a comprare, quindi torni a girare per il negozio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|label|9956|0
units.english: get suit
units.italian: get suit

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha is happy to ring you up, and gives you the carefully packaged and sealed survival suit for <payment>.|9961|0
units.english: Bertha is happy to ring you up, and gives you the carefully packaged and sealed survival suit for <payment>.
units.italian: Bertha è felice di battere lo scontrino e ti dà la tuta di sopravvivenza accuratamente imballata e sigillata per <payment>.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	There's numerous shelves filled with all kinds of drugs, and it takes you a few minutes to find the detoxification medicine. By then Bertha is at your side.|9967|0
units.english: There's numerous shelves filled with all kinds of drugs, and it takes you a few minutes to find the detoxification medicine. By then Bertha is at your side.
units.italian: Ci sono numerosi scaffali pieni di ogni tipo di farmaci, e ti servono un paio di minuti per trovare il disintossicante. A quel punto Bertha è già al tuo fianco.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	"Foul winds are known to kick up toxic dust in the atmosphere, and if you plan on staying here long you're likely going to need to take a few of these." She looks at you curiously, and then adds, "However, you may find them less useful on other worlds."|9968|0
units.english: "Foul winds are known to kick up toxic dust in the atmosphere, and if you plan on staying here long you're likely going to need to take a few of these." She looks at you curiously, and then adds, "However, you may find them less useful on other worlds."
units.italian: "Si sa che i venti infami sollevano polvere tossica nell'atmosfera, e se pensi di restare qui a lungo probabilmente dovrai prenderne qualcuno." Ti guarda incuriosita, poi aggiunge: "Però potrebbero esserti meno utili su altri mondi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	"Still, if you think you could use them I'd sell them to you for 10,000 credits," she adds helpfully.|9969|0
units.english: "Still, if you think you could use them I'd sell them to you for 10,000 credits," she adds helpfully.
units.italian: "Comunque, se pensi che ti servano te le venderei a 10.000 crediti," aggiunge premurosa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Buy Dancer's medicine for Tim.)|9971|0
units.english: (Buy Dancer's medicine for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra le medicine di Dancer per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Pass.)|9973|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha nods. "You have the windless look of a tourist. Best to leave these for those who are going to spend some real time on Dancer."|9975|0
units.english: Bertha nods. "You have the windless look of a tourist. Best to leave these for those who are going to spend some real time on Dancer."
units.italian: Bertha annuisce. "Hai l'aria senza vento di un turista. Meglio lasciarle a chi passerà un po' di tempo serio su Dancer."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	The shelves of medication are just where you left them. You can grab a kit of Dancer detoxification drugs for 10,000 credits.|9981|0
units.english: The shelves of medication are just where you left them. You can grab a kit of Dancer detoxification drugs for 10,000 credits.
units.italian: Gli scaffali dei farmaci sono dove li hai lasciati. Puoi prendere un kit di disintossicanti di Dancer per 10.000 crediti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Buy Dancer's medicine for Tim.)|9983|0
units.english: (Buy Dancer's medicine for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra le medicine di Dancer per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Pass.)|9985|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	You leave the drugs where they are and return to looking through the clearance house.|9987|0
units.english: You leave the drugs where they are and return to looking through the clearance house.
units.italian: Lasci i farmaci dove sono e torni a curiosare nel centro di smistamento.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|label|9990|0
units.english: get med
units.italian: get med

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha packages the drugs for you and looks at with mild concern. "Remember. These really are only rated for Dancer. I do not advise using them offworld."|9994|0
units.english: Bertha packages the drugs for you and looks at with mild concern. "Remember. These really are only rated for Dancer. I do not advise using them offworld."
units.italian: Bertha ti impacchetta i farmaci e ti guarda con lieve preoccupazione. "Ricordati. Questi sono davvero omologati solo per Dancer. Non consiglio di usarli fuori dal pianeta."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	She takes your <payment>, and hands you the drugs.|9995|0
units.english: She takes your <payment>, and hands you the drugs.
units.italian: Prende il tuo <payment> e ti consegna i farmaci.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Toward the back you find various bins that are filled with what look like the unsorted personal belongings of scientists.|10001|0
units.english: Toward the back you find various bins that are filled with what look like the unsorted personal belongings of scientists.
units.italian: Verso il retro trovi vari bidoni pieni di quelli che sembrano gli effetti personali non ordinati di scienziati.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha sees you in the back but doesn't join you. Instead she just hollers, "Scientists are always coming and going and sometimes leave a lot behind. I'd be as pleased as a wind vane on a calm day if you took any of that off my hands. Whatever you find I'll give to ya for 1,000 credits."|10002|0
units.english: Bertha sees you in the back but doesn't join you. Instead she just hollers, "Scientists are always coming and going and sometimes leave a lot behind. I'd be as pleased as a wind vane on a calm day if you took any of that off my hands. Whatever you find I'll give to ya for 1,000 credits."
units.italian: Bertha ti vede sul retro ma non ti raggiunge. Si limita a gridare: "Gli scienziati vanno e vengono di continuo e a volte lasciano un sacco di roba. Sarei felice come una banderuola in un giorno di calma se ti portassi via qualcosa. Qualunque cosa trovi te la do per 1.000 crediti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	You sift through the items - which are mostly clothes and old lab coats - before coming across a scientist's ID card. The name reads 'Skounce Yarling' and the picture, to your surprise, looks a little like Timothy's.|10003|0
units.english: You sift through the items - which are mostly clothes and old lab coats - before coming across a scientist's ID card. The name reads 'Skounce Yarling' and the picture, to your surprise, looks a little like Timothy's.
units.italian: Frughi fra gli oggetti, che sono per lo più vestiti e vecchi camici da laboratorio, finché non ti imbatti nel tesserino di uno scienziato. Il nome è 'Skounce Yarling' e la foto, con tua sorpresa, somiglia un po' a Timothy.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Buy the old ID.)|10005|0
units.english: (Buy the old ID.)
units.italian: (Compra il vecchio tesserino.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Pass.)|10007|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	The old ID might work, but it would also be quite a risk. You leave it where you found it and go back to wandering around the store.|10009|0
units.english: The old ID might work, but it would also be quite a risk. You leave it where you found it and go back to wandering around the store.
units.italian: Il vecchio tesserino potrebbe funzionare, ma sarebbe anche un bel rischio. Lo lasci dove l'hai trovato e torni a girare per il negozio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	You return to the bin with Skounce Yarling's ID sitting on the top of his forlorn refuse.|10015|0
units.english: You return to the bin with Skounce Yarling's ID sitting on the top of his forlorn refuse.
units.italian: Torni al bidone con il tesserino di Skounce Yarling in cima ai suoi tristi rifiuti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Buy the ID for Tim.)|10017|0
units.english: (Buy the ID for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra il tesserino per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	(Pass.)|10019|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	You let sleeping IDs lie, and return to the rest of the store.|10020|0
units.english: You let sleeping IDs lie, and return to the rest of the store.
units.italian: Lasci dormire i tesserini che dormono, e torni al resto del negozio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|label|10023|0
units.english: get id
units.italian: get id

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha favors you with a mischievous grin and combs her black hair behind her ears. "I must admit, I have a thing for danger." Her eyes sparkle and her voice is a little huskier than before as she says, "I'm not sure whatchya need this for, and I certainly don't want you to tell me. But I hope you pull it off."|10028|0
units.english: Bertha favors you with a mischievous grin and combs her black hair behind her ears. "I must admit, I have a thing for danger." Her eyes sparkle and her voice is a little huskier than before as she says, "I'm not sure whatchya need this for, and I certainly don't want you to tell me. But I hope you pull it off."
units.italian: Bertha ti concede un sorriso birichino e si sistema i capelli neri dietro le orecchie. "Devo ammettere che il pericolo mi piace." Gli occhi le brillano e la voce è un po' più roca di prima quando dice: "Non sono sicura di che cosa ti serva, e di certo non voglio che me lo dici. Ma spero che ti riesca."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	She takes your <payment> and hands you the old ID, her eyes lingering on you.|10029|0
units.english: She takes your <payment> and hands you the old ID, her eyes lingering on you.
units.italian: Prende il tuo <payment> e ti consegna il vecchio tesserino, con gli occhi che indugiano su di te.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5c: Dancer|	Bertha gives you a friendly nod as you make your way back outside into Dancer's foreboding weather, and the rest of the spaceport.|10040|0
units.english: Bertha gives you a friendly nod as you make your way back outside into Dancer's foreboding weather, and the rest of the spaceport.
units.italian: Bertha ti fa un cenno amichevole mentre torni fuori nel clima sinistro di Dancer e nel resto dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|name|10049|0
units.english: Supplies on <planet>
units.italian: Provviste su <planet>

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|description|10050|0
units.english: Tim's old secretary Wynnafrith recommended that <destination> would be a good place to find a fake ID for Tim.
units.italian: L'ex segretaria di Tim, Wynnafrith, ha consigliato <destination> come buon posto per trovare un documento falso per Tim.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|You feel the pressure of many unseen eyes watching you as you leave the spaceport and enter into the sprawling stalls of Greenrock's rowdy emporium, where everything and everyone is for sale.|10059|0
units.english: You feel the pressure of many unseen eyes watching you as you leave the spaceport and enter into the sprawling stalls of Greenrock's rowdy emporium, where everything and everyone is for sale.
units.italian: Senti il peso di molti occhi invisibili che ti osservano mentre lasci lo spazioporto ed entri nei banchi sterminati del chiassoso emporio di Greenrock, dove tutto e tutti sono in vendita.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	Greenrock looks a little more civil than when you were racing around saving captured freighter fleets, but only just a little. There is a wildness here and violence simmers just beneath the surface of every interaction. Luckily, no one seems to remember or care about the fleet you destroyed.|10060|0
units.english: Greenrock looks a little more civil than when you were racing around saving captured freighter fleets, but only just a little. There is a wildness here and violence simmers just beneath the surface of every interaction. Luckily, no one seems to remember or care about the fleet you destroyed.
units.italian: Greenrock sembra un po' più civile di quando correvi in giro a salvare flotte di mercantili catturate, ma solo un po'. C'è una selvatichezza qui e la violenza ribolle appena sotto la superficie di ogni interazione. Per fortuna nessuno sembra ricordare o interessarsi della flotta che hai distrutto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	The civic infrastructure leaves something to be desired; you can pretty much taste the city's squalid sewer in the air. While trying to get a sense of the area, you weave past various hucksters all trying to get your attention for whatever or whoever they're selling.|10063|0
units.english: The civic infrastructure leaves something to be desired; you can pretty much taste the city's squalid sewer in the air. While trying to get a sense of the area, you weave past various hucksters all trying to get your attention for whatever or whoever they're selling.
units.italian: Le infrastrutture civiche lasciano a desiderare; puoi praticamente sentire nell'aria la fogna squallida della città. Mentre cerchi di capire la zona, ti fai largo fra vari imbonitori che cercano tutti di attirare la tua attenzione per qualunque cosa, o chiunque, stiano vendendo.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	Finally you reach the center of the emporium and discover a crudely drawn map of the spaceport. It's not much, but at least it tells you where you can find what you're looking for.|10064|0
units.english: Finally you reach the center of the emporium and discover a crudely drawn map of the spaceport. It's not much, but at least it tells you where you can find what you're looking for.
units.italian: Alla fine raggiungi il centro dell'emporio e scopri una mappa dello spazioporto disegnata alla grossolana. Non è granché, ma almeno ti dice dove puoi trovare quello che cerchi.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|label|10065|0
units.english: green options
units.italian: green options

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Find someone that can produce a fake ID for me.)|10067|0
units.english: (Find someone that can produce a fake ID for me.)
units.italian: (Trova qualcuno che possa produrmi un documento falso.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Go back to Ivaldur's forging stall for the fake ID.)|10071|0
units.english: (Go back to Ivaldur's forging stall for the fake ID.)
units.italian: (Torna al banco di falsificazione di Ivaldur per il documento falso.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Look for a survival suit.)|10076|0
units.english: (Look for a survival suit.)
units.italian: (Cerca una tuta di sopravvivenza.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Return to the shop to buy the survival suit.)|10081|0
units.english: (Return to the shop to buy the survival suit.)
units.italian: (Torna al negozio per comprare la tuta di sopravvivenza.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Find the detoxification medicine.)|10086|0
units.english: (Find the detoxification medicine.)
units.italian: (Trova i farmaci disintossicanti.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Go back to the drug dealer to get the detoxification medicine.)|10091|0
units.english: (Go back to the drug dealer to get the detoxification medicine.)
units.italian: (Torna dallo spacciatore per i farmaci disintossicanti.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Leave the emporium.)|10096|0
units.english: (Leave the emporium.)
units.italian: (Esci dall'emporio.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	There's more than a half dozen stalls all advertising their high skills and production value when it comes to the art of crafting fake IDs. Most the stalls and their employees have a garish, sloppy, and boastful manner, but one with a more professional and constrained feel attracts your attention; it's run by an older gentleman who has the look of a respectable watchmaker.|10102|0
units.english: There's more than a half dozen stalls all advertising their high skills and production value when it comes to the art of crafting fake IDs. Most the stalls and their employees have a garish, sloppy, and boastful manner, but one with a more professional and constrained feel attracts your attention; it's run by an older gentleman who has the look of a respectable watchmaker.
units.italian: Ci sono più di una mezza dozzina di banchi che pubblicizzano tutti le loro grandi capacità e il loro valore produttivo nell'arte di fabbricare documenti falsi. La maggior parte dei banchi e dei loro impiegati ha un modo sgargiante, sciatto e vanaglorioso, ma uno, più professionale e compassato, attira la tua attenzione: lo gestisce un signore anziano che ha l'aria di un rispettabile orologiaio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He nods at you politely as you approach. "Good day to you. I am Ivaldur the Forger, and what can I do for you?"|10103|0
units.english: He nods at you politely as you approach. "Good day to you. I am Ivaldur the Forger, and what can I do for you?"
units.italian: Ti fa un cenno cortese mentre ti avvicini. "Buongiorno. Sono Ivaldur il Falsario, e che cosa posso fare per lei?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Ask about producing a fake ID.)|10105|0
units.english: (Ask about producing a fake ID.)
units.italian: (Chiedi di produrre un documento falso.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Turn around and leave.)|10107|0
units.english: (Turn around and leave.)
units.italian: (Voltati e vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	For whatever reason you are not interested in doing business with Ivaldur the Forger, and promptly head back out into the emporium.|10109|0
units.english: For whatever reason you are not interested in doing business with Ivaldur the Forger, and promptly head back out into the emporium.
units.italian: Per qualche ragione non ti interessa fare affari con Ivaldur il Falsario, e torni subito fuori nell'emporio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	The old man smiles at you good-naturedly. "Simple enough request. I can provide you with an ID, and a complex matching background that will pass all but the most exhaustive of checks."|10113|0
units.english: The old man smiles at you good-naturedly. "Simple enough request. I can provide you with an ID, and a complex matching background that will pass all but the most exhaustive of checks."
units.italian: L'anziano ti sorride bonariamente. "Richiesta semplice. Posso fornirle un documento e un retroterra complesso e coerente che supererà tutti i controlli tranne i più esaustivi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He gives off an aura of quiet confidence as he speaks. "My service is thorough and, as you'll find, quite unmatched. Unless your friend is someone being hunted by Navy Intelligence, he will be able to seamlessly integrate into life on any human world."|10114|0
units.english: He gives off an aura of quiet confidence as he speaks. "My service is thorough and, as you'll find, quite unmatched. Unless your friend is someone being hunted by Navy Intelligence, he will be able to seamlessly integrate into life on any human world."
units.italian: Mentre parla emana un'aura di quieta sicurezza. "Il mio servizio è scrupoloso e, come vedrà, senza pari. A meno che il suo amico non sia qualcuno braccato dall'Intelligence della Marina, potrà integrarsi senza problemi nella vita di qualsiasi mondo umano."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He pauses as if considering something, and then adds, "If he is also a war criminal on the run from someone like, I don't know, Deep Security or Republic Intelligence... I could also come up with something, but that would be a premium service I doubt you need at the moment."|10115|0
units.english: He pauses as if considering something, and then adds, "If he is also a war criminal on the run from someone like, I don't know, Deep Security or Republic Intelligence... I could also come up with something, but that would be a premium service I doubt you need at the moment."
units.italian: Fa una pausa come se valutasse qualcosa, poi aggiunge: "Se poi è anche un criminale di guerra in fuga da gente come, non so, la Sicurezza del Deep o l'Intelligence della Repubblica... potrei anche tirar fuori qualcosa, ma sarebbe un servizio premium di cui dubito lei abbia bisogno al momento."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	Ivaldur adjusts his spectacles thoughtfully. "The going rate for my basic service is 350,000 credits."|10116|0
units.english: Ivaldur adjusts his spectacles thoughtfully. "The going rate for my basic service is 350,000 credits."
units.italian: Ivaldur si sistema gli occhiali pensieroso. "La tariffa corrente per il mio servizio base è di 350.000 crediti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He looks at you expectantly and waits.|10117|0
units.english: He looks at you expectantly and waits.
units.italian: Ti guarda in attesa e aspetta.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Pay 350,000 credits for a fake ID and history for Tim.)|10119|0
units.english: (Pay 350,000 credits for a fake ID and history for Tim.)
units.italian: (Paga 350.000 crediti per un documento falso e un passato per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Pass.)|10121|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He simply nods and gives you a knowing look. "I acknowledge the fee seems high, but rest assured the service I provide is well worth it.|10123|0
units.english: He simply nods and gives you a knowing look. "I acknowledge the fee seems high, but rest assured the service I provide is well worth it.
units.italian: Si limita ad annuire e ti lancia uno sguardo complice. "Riconosco che la cifra sembri alta, ma mi creda, il servizio che offro li vale tutti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"I'll be here if you change your mind."|10124|0
units.english: "I'll be here if you change your mind."
units.italian: "Sarò qui se cambia idea."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	Your return to Ivaldur the Forger's stall, and the old man gives you a curt nod as you approach. "Back so soon? I hope you have made your decision."|10130|0
units.english: Your return to Ivaldur the Forger's stall, and the old man gives you a curt nod as you approach. "Back so soon? I hope you have made your decision."
units.italian: Torni al banco di Ivaldur il Falsario, e l'anziano ti fa un cenno secco mentre ti avvicini. "Già di ritorno? Spero che abbia preso la sua decisione."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Pay 350,000 credits for a fake ID and history for Tim.)|10132|0
units.english: (Pay 350,000 credits for a fake ID and history for Tim.)
units.italian: (Paga 350.000 crediti per un documento falso e un passato per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Pass.)|10134|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	Without speaking you again leave Ivaldur's stall.|10136|0
units.english: Without speaking you again leave Ivaldur's stall.
units.italian: Senza parlare lasci di nuovo il banco di Ivaldur.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|label|10139|0
units.english: get id
units.italian: get id

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	Ivaldur's eyes light up and he immediately gets to work. From his panel he backdoors his way into various databases, diving into the code with an obvious alacrity and unbridled joy.|10144|0
units.english: Ivaldur's eyes light up and he immediately gets to work. From his panel he backdoors his way into various databases, diving into the code with an obvious alacrity and unbridled joy.
units.italian: Gli occhi di Ivaldur si illuminano e si mette subito al lavoro. Dal suo pannello si apre una porta di servizio in vari database, tuffandosi nel codice con evidente alacrità e gioia sfrenata.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	Whole histories, lives, records and attachments burst into existence in a dozen corners of official networks and reports. It becomes apparent that he is not really creating a fake ID; the ID he creates is real. It is sanctioned, stamped, and endorsed by multiple governing bodies, uploaded to and referenced by institutional records, and given the appropriate checks and markers.|10145|0
units.english: Whole histories, lives, records and attachments burst into existence in a dozen corners of official networks and reports. It becomes apparent that he is not really creating a fake ID; the ID he creates is real. It is sanctioned, stamped, and endorsed by multiple governing bodies, uploaded to and referenced by institutional records, and given the appropriate checks and markers.
units.italian: Interi passati, vite, registri e collegamenti prendono forma in una dozzina di angoli di reti e archivi ufficiali. Diventa evidente che non sta davvero creando un documento falso: il documento che crea è reale. È autorizzato, timbrato e convalidato da più organi di governo, caricato e richiamato nei registri istituzionali e dotato dei controlli e dei contrassegni appropriati.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	In fact, what Ivaldur has done is create a fake person, and this is that person's real ID.|10146|0
units.english: In fact, what Ivaldur has done is create a fake person, and this is that person's real ID.
units.italian: In effetti, quello che Ivaldur ha fatto è creare una persona falsa, e questo è il documento reale di quella persona.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	When he finishes he says nothing and instead basks in a job well done. Finally, he turns to you for payment. <payment> is transferred into his account, and he hands you Tim's brand new ID card.|10147|0
units.english: When he finishes he says nothing and instead basks in a job well done. Finally, he turns to you for payment. <payment> is transferred into his account, and he hands you Tim's brand new ID card.
units.italian: Quando finisce non dice nulla e si crogiola nel lavoro ben fatto. Alla fine si volta verso di te per il pagamento. <payment> vengono trasferiti sul suo conto, e lui ti porge il tesserino nuovo di zecca di Tim.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"It was a pleasure," he says in a satisfied voice, and bids you well.|10148|0
units.english: "It was a pleasure," he says in a satisfied voice, and bids you well.
units.italian: "È stato un piacere," dice con voce soddisfatta, e ti augura ogni bene.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	You find a large stall boasting all the survival equipment an enterprising pirate could ever need. Inside there's various used gear, some more used than others, and only a few well weathered survival suits.|10154|0
units.english: You find a large stall boasting all the survival equipment an enterprising pirate could ever need. Inside there's various used gear, some more used than others, and only a few well weathered survival suits.
units.italian: Trovi un grande banco che vanta tutta l'attrezzatura di sopravvivenza che un pirata intraprendente possa mai desiderare. Dentro c'è varia attrezzatura usata, un po' più usata di altra, e solo poche tute di sopravvivenza ben stagionate.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	The proprietor appears out of nowhere and immediately begins flogging his goods to you. "Ah! Yes, with any of these you can survive the harshest of climates!"|10155|0
units.english: The proprietor appears out of nowhere and immediately begins flogging his goods to you. "Ah! Yes, with any of these you can survive the harshest of climates!"
units.italian: Il proprietario compare dal nulla e comincia subito a rifilarti la sua merce. "Ah! Sì, con una di queste può sopravvivere ai climi più duri!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He takes one suit off the rack and begins, "Notice the intricate mesh weave on this state of the art-" the suit comes apart at its seams in his hands. The proprietor frowns, but then quickly tosses it to the side.|10156|0
units.english: He takes one suit off the rack and begins, "Notice the intricate mesh weave on this state of the art-" the suit comes apart at its seams in his hands. The proprietor frowns, but then quickly tosses it to the side.
units.italian: Prende una tuta dal ripiano e comincia: "Noti la trama intricata di questa meraviglia all'avanguardia..." la tuta gli si sfalda fra le mani. Il proprietario si acciglia, ma poi la butta subito da parte.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"A, uh, defunct specimen. Happens from time to time. Rest assured I never would have sold it to you." He looks at you unconvincingly.|10157|0
units.english: "A, uh, defunct specimen. Happens from time to time. Rest assured I never would have sold it to you." He looks at you unconvincingly.
units.italian: "Un, ehm, esemplare difettoso. Capita ogni tanto. Le assicuro che non gliel'avrei mai venduta." Ti guarda in modo poco convincente.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He pulls another suit down which, to his obvious relief, doesn't simply fall apart in his hands.|10158|0
units.english: He pulls another suit down which, to his obvious relief, doesn't simply fall apart in his hands.
units.italian: Ne tira giù un'altra che, con suo evidente sollievo, non gli si sfalda semplicemente fra le mani.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"Now as I was saying, top of the line mesh weaves. Great comfort and breathability. For tough spots..."|10159|0
units.english: "Now as I was saying, top of the line mesh weaves. Great comfort and breathability. For tough spots..."
units.italian: "Dunque, come dicevo, trame del massimo livello. Gran comfort e traspirabilità. Per le situazioni difficili..."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	You look carefully at the suit as the proprietor's words drift uselessly out of his mouth. It has patches on top of patches, and its seals look worn and corroded. It looks like a death trap.|10160|0
units.english: You look carefully at the suit as the proprietor's words drift uselessly out of his mouth. It has patches on top of patches, and its seals look worn and corroded. It looks like a death trap.
units.italian: Guardi con attenzione la tuta mentre le parole del proprietario ti scivolano addosso inutilmente. Ha toppe sopra le toppe, e i sigilli sembrano usurati e corrosi. Sembra una trappola mortale.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"...and look just how clean it looks inside." The proprietor opens up one the seals, revealing quite a bit of dried blood staining its insides. He quickly closes the seal and wipes some sweat from his brow.|10161|0
units.english: "...and look just how clean it looks inside." The proprietor opens up one the seals, revealing quite a bit of dried blood staining its insides. He quickly closes the seal and wipes some sweat from his brow.
units.italian: "...e guardi quanto è pulita all'interno." Il proprietario apre uno dei sigilli, rivelando parecchio sangue secco che macchia l'interno. Richiude subito il sigillo e si asciuga un po' di sudore dalla fronte.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"Perfectly normal to find in a suit. Totally unrelated to its operation. You know, pirates... just bleed a lot in general. Part of the lifestyle and all that."|10162|0
units.english: "Perfectly normal to find in a suit. Totally unrelated to its operation. You know, pirates... just bleed a lot in general. Part of the lifestyle and all that."
units.italian: "Perfettamente normale trovarne in una tuta. Totalmente estraneo al suo funzionamento. Sa com'è, i pirati... sanguinano molto in generale. Fa parte dello stile di vita e cose così."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He looks at you with earnest, bulging eyes. "So what do you think? I'd be willing to sell this baby to you for 400,000 credits."|10163|0
units.english: He looks at you with earnest, bulging eyes. "So what do you think? I'd be willing to sell this baby to you for 400,000 credits."
units.italian: Ti guarda con occhi sinceri e sbarrati. "Allora, che ne pensa? Sarei disposto a venderle questa bellezza per 400.000 crediti."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Purchase the patched survival suit for Tim.)|10165|0
units.english: (Purchase the patched survival suit for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra la tuta di sopravvivenza rattoppata per Tim.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Haggle for a lower price.)|10167|0
units.english: (Haggle for a lower price.)
units.italian: (Contratta per un prezzo più basso.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Pass.)|10169|0
units.english: (Pass.)
units.italian: (Passa oltre.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	That death trap might hasten Tim's demise, not guard against it. You leave the sweating proprietor behind and head back into the emporium at large.|10171|0
units.english: That death trap might hasten Tim's demise, not guard against it. You leave the sweating proprietor behind and head back into the emporium at large.
units.italian: Quella trappola mortale potrebbe affrettare la fine di Tim, non proteggerlo. Lasci alle spalle il proprietario sudato e torni nell'emporio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	The proprietor's eyes dart back and forth, and then he nods vigorously.|10175|0
units.english: The proprietor's eyes dart back and forth, and then he nods vigorously.
units.italian: Gli occhi del proprietario guizzano da una parte all'altra, poi annuisce vigorosamente.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"Of course. Of course. Given its... condition. It only makes sense that a discerning privateer such as yourself get a discount."|10176|0
units.english: "Of course. Of course. Given its... condition. It only makes sense that a discerning privateer such as yourself get a discount."
units.italian: "Certamente. Certamente. Vista la sua... condizione. È logico che un corsaro esigente come lei ottenga uno sconto."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"But, uh, if anyone asks about where you got this suit from. Given the obscene value you're getting from me, do me the favor of not disclosing where you got it. I wouldn't want anyone thinking they could get a deal like this."|10177|0
units.english: "But, uh, if anyone asks about where you got this suit from. Given the obscene value you're getting from me, do me the favor of not disclosing where you got it. I wouldn't want anyone thinking they could get a deal like this."
units.italian: "Ma, ehm, se qualcuno le chiede dove ha preso questa tuta. Visto l'assurdo valore che ne sta ricavando, mi faccia la cortesia di non rivelare dove l'ha presa. Non vorrei che qualcuno pensasse di poter ottenere un affare simile."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	He gives a nervous yet earnest smile.|10178|0
units.english: He gives a nervous yet earnest smile.
units.italian: Ti rivolge un sorriso nervoso ma sincero.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Offer 20,000 for the suit.)|10180|0
units.english: (Offer 20,000 for the suit.)
units.italian: (Offri 20.000 per la tuta.)

units.english: (Offer 100,000 for the suit.)

units.italian: Quella trappola mortale potrebbe affrettare la fine di Tim, non proteggerlo. Lasci alle spalle il proprietario sudato e torni nell'emporio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	You return to the clothing stall, where the proprietor immediately hounds you again for the suit. The suit you were shown before looks just as patched, worn and corroded as before. The few other options next to it are even worse.|10194|0
units.english: You return to the clothing stall, where the proprietor immediately hounds you again for the suit. The suit you were shown before looks just as patched, worn and corroded as before. The few other options next to it are even worse.
units.italian: Torni al banco di abbigliamento, dove il proprietario ti assilla subito di nuovo per la tuta. La tuta che ti era stata mostrata sembra altrettanto rattoppata, usurata e corrosa di prima. Le poche altre opzioni accanto sono persino peggiori.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	The proprietor reminds you the price is still 400,000 credits for this 'lightly used' and 'field tested' state of the art survival suit.|10195|0
units.english: The proprietor reminds you the price is still 400,000 credits for this 'lightly used' and 'field tested' state of the art survival suit.
units.italian: Il proprietario ti ricorda che il prezzo è ancora 400.000 crediti per questa tuta di sopravvivenza all'avanguardia 'leggermente usata' e 'collaudata sul campo'.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	There are many stalls loudly advertising all kinds of illegal drugs, and it takes some work to sift through them until you come across one selling legal drugs as well. The man running it is sallow and pock-marked, but his eyes are keen. He almost hisses as he greets you.|10245|0
units.english: There are many stalls loudly advertising all kinds of illegal drugs, and it takes some work to sift through them until you come across one selling legal drugs as well. The man running it is sallow and pock-marked, but his eyes are keen. He almost hisses as he greets you.
units.italian: Ci sono molti banchi che pubblicizzano a gran voce ogni tipo di droga illegale, e ci vuole un po' di lavoro per setacciarli finché non ne trovi uno che vende anche farmaci legali. L'uomo che lo gestisce è giallastro e butterato, ma ha occhi acuti. Quasi sibila mentre ti saluta.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"Whatever you need, wherever you're going, I have you covered."|10246|0
units.english: "Whatever you need, wherever you're going, I have you covered."
units.italian: "Qualunque cosa ti serva, ovunque tu vada, ci penso io."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Ask about detoxification medicine for Oblivion.)|10248|0
units.english: (Ask about detoxification medicine for Oblivion.)
units.italian: (Chiedi dei farmaci disintossicanti per Oblivion.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Leave.)|10250|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	This is not the place for you. You take your leave and return to the emporium at large.|10252|0
units.english: This is not the place for you. You take your leave and return to the emporium at large.
units.italian: Questo non è il posto per te. Ti congedi e torni nell'emporio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|label|10255|0
units.english: ask drugs
units.italian: ask drugs

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	The drug dealer flashes you with his yellow teeth and unnerving smile. "For every kind of toxic environment under any sun." He jolts towards his little wall of drawers, pulling out one labeled "Oblivion detoxifiers." From the drawer he picks a bottle up, checking its label.|10256|0
units.english: The drug dealer flashes you with his yellow teeth and unnerving smile. "For every kind of toxic environment under any sun." He jolts towards his little wall of drawers, pulling out one labeled "Oblivion detoxifiers." From the drawer he picks a bottle up, checking its label.
units.italian: Lo spacciatore ti mostra i denti gialli e un sorriso inquietante. "Per ogni tipo di ambiente tossico sotto qualsiasi sole." Scatta verso la sua piccola parete di cassetti e ne tira fuori uno con l'etichetta "Disintossicanti per Oblivion". Dal cassetto prende una boccetta e ne controlla l'etichetta.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"It says it expired a few years ago, but that's just so the corpos can squeeze the common man, ya know? Stuff's still good." He shrugs.|10257|0
units.english: "It says it expired a few years ago, but that's just so the corpos can squeeze the common man, ya know? Stuff's still good." He shrugs.
units.italian: "Dice che è scaduto qualche anno fa, ma è solo perché le corporazioni possano spremere la gente comune, sai? La roba è ancora buona." Fa spallucce.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"So what'dya say? It'll cost'ya a cool 50,000 credits. But trust me, that's way cheaper than what you'll find elsewhere."|10258|0
units.english: "So what'dya say? It'll cost'ya a cool 50,000 credits. But trust me, that's way cheaper than what you'll find elsewhere."
units.italian: "Allora, che ne dici? Ti costerà la modica cifra di 50.000 crediti. Ma credimi, è molto meno di quello che troverai altrove."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	(Buy the expired detoxification medicine for Tim.)|10260|0
units.english: (Buy the expired detoxification medicine for Tim.)
units.italian: (Compra i farmaci disintossicanti scaduti per Tim.)

units.italian: Mentre ti allontani lo spacciatore dice: "Non troverai un affare migliore di questo. Sarò qui se cambi idea."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	The drug-dealer's knowing smile is almost a sneer as you return to his stall. He waits to see if you're ready to buy something.|10270|0

units.italian: Il sorriso complice dello spacciatore è quasi uno sbuffo di disprezzo quando torni al suo banco. Aspetta di vedere se sei pronto a comprare qualcosa.
