units.italian: get med

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	"Trust me, it's still good," the drug-dealer says as he takes your <payment>. He hands you the drugs with a smirk.|10284|0
units.english: "Trust me, it's still good," the drug-dealer says as he takes your <payment>. He hands you the drugs with a smirk.
units.italian: "Fidati, è ancora buona," dice lo spacciatore prendendo il tuo <payment>. Ti consegna i farmaci con un sorriso sfrontato.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5d: Greenrock|	It's never wise to linger in a place like this, especially aimlessly. With your business concluded you leave Greenrock's stalls behind.|10295|0
units.english: It's never wise to linger in a place like this, especially aimlessly. With your business concluded you leave Greenrock's stalls behind.
units.italian: Non è mai saggio indugiare in un posto come questo, soprattutto senza scopo. Conclusi i tuoi affari, lasci alle spalle i banchi di Greenrock.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|Your ship touches down beneath Oblivion's toxic ammonia-blue sky. Night or day, there is a constant flurry of workers loading, unloading, building, and expanding the ever growing boom-town of Tukayyid. You unload all of Timothy's gear onto a dolly and push it out into the busy street.|10311|0
units.english: Your ship touches down beneath Oblivion's toxic ammonia-blue sky. Night or day, there is a constant flurry of workers loading, unloading, building, and expanding the ever growing boom-town of Tukayyid. You unload all of Timothy's gear onto a dolly and push it out into the busy street.
units.italian: La tua nave si posa sotto il cielo blu-ammoniaca e tossico di Oblivion. Notte o giorno, c'è un viavai costante di operai che caricano, scaricano, costruiscono ed espandono la città in crescita perenne di Tukayyid. Scarichi tutta l'attrezzatura di Timothy su un carrello e la spingi nella strada affollata.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	Your presence goes unnoticed among the general ruckus and you're able to slip into the off-loading warehouses unseen. You find Timothy there, leaning over a pile of hose hookups, breathing heavily. His blood-red eyes rise to meet yours, and despite their milky gloss, a glimmer of hope burns within them.|10312|0
units.english: Your presence goes unnoticed among the general ruckus and you're able to slip into the off-loading warehouses unseen. You find Timothy there, leaning over a pile of hose hookups, breathing heavily. His blood-red eyes rise to meet yours, and despite their milky gloss, a glimmer of hope burns within them.
units.italian: La tua presenza passa inosservata nel chiasso generale e riesci a infilarti nei magazzini di scarico senza essere visto. Trovi Timothy lì, chino su un mucchio di raccordi per tubi, che respira affannosamente. I suoi occhi rosso sangue si alzano verso di te e, nonostante la patina lattiginosa, vi brucia dentro un barlume di speranza.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	"You did it?" His words more strained than the last time you spoke. "You got the gear?"|10313|0
units.english: "You did it?" His words more strained than the last time you spoke. "You got the gear?"
units.italian: "Ce l'hai fatta?" Le sue parole sono più tese dell'ultima volta che avete parlato. "Hai preso l'attrezzatura?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	He looks down at your dolly expectantly.|10314|0
units.english: He looks down at your dolly expectantly.
units.italian: Guarda il tuo carrello con aspettativa.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	"It's all here."|10316|0
units.english: "It's all here."
units.italian: "È tutto qui."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	"Of course I did."|10317|0
units.english: "Of course I did."
units.italian: "Certo che ce l'ho fatta."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	"Yep, but you owe me big."|10318|0
units.english: "Yep, but you owe me big."
units.italian: "Sì, ma mi devi un favore grosso."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	He nearly drops to his knees and starts sorting through the gear. He takes heart when you tell him about Wynnafrith's gun and bomb, and how highly she still thinks of him.|10320|0
units.english: He nearly drops to his knees and starts sorting through the gear. He takes heart when you tell him about Wynnafrith's gun and bomb, and how highly she still thinks of him.
units.italian: Quasi cade in ginocchio e comincia a frugare fra l'attrezzatura. Si rincuora quando gli racconti della pistola e della bomba di Wynnafrith, e di quanto lei lo stimi ancora.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	"Good secretary. Better friend." He wheezes as he checks out the rest of your gear.|10321|0
units.english: "Good secretary. Better friend." He wheezes as he checks out the rest of your gear.
units.italian: "Buona segretaria. Amica migliore." Ansima mentre controlla il resto della tua attrezzatura.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	As he inspects the suit, drugs, and ID you can see his demeanor shift. He seems to deflate a little.|10333|0
units.english: As he inspects the suit, drugs, and ID you can see his demeanor shift. He seems to deflate a little.
units.italian: Mentre esamina tuta, farmaci e documento vedi il suo atteggiamento cambiare. Sembra sgonfiarsi un po'.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	Finally, he straightens back up. "You did the best you could. I'm sure." He eyes the gear wearily. "At least it's a chance."|10334|0
units.english: Finally, he straightens back up. "You did the best you could. I'm sure." He eyes the gear wearily. "At least it's a chance."
units.italian: Alla fine si raddrizza. "Hai fatto il meglio che potevi. Ne sono certo." Guarda l'attrezzatura con stanchezza. "Almeno è una possibilità."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|label|10337|0
units.english: decently prepared
units.italian: decently prepared

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	As he inspects the suit, drugs, and ID you he nods to himself satisfactorily.|10338|0
units.english: As he inspects the suit, drugs, and ID you he nods to himself satisfactorily.
units.italian: Mentre esamina tuta, farmaci e documento annuisce fra sé con soddisfazione.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	Finally, he straightens back up. "It'll do," he says as he eyes the gear. "It'll do."|10339|0
units.english: Finally, he straightens back up. "It'll do," he says as he eyes the gear. "It'll do."
units.italian: Alla fine si raddrizza. "Andrà bene," dice guardando l'attrezzatura. "Andrà bene."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|label|10342|0
units.english: well prepared
units.italian: well prepared

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	As he inspects the suit, drugs, and ID you can see his demeanor shift. He looks less weak, less sickly, and more confident.|10343|0
units.english: As he inspects the suit, drugs, and ID you can see his demeanor shift. He looks less weak, less sickly, and more confident.
units.italian: Mentre esamina tuta, farmaci e documento vedi il suo atteggiamento cambiare. Sembra meno debole, meno malato e più sicuro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	Finally, he straightens back up. "It's perfect." He eyes the gear with awe and shakes his head. "Don't know how you did it. But with this I can't fail."|10344|0
units.english: Finally, he straightens back up. "It's perfect." He eyes the gear with awe and shakes his head. "Don't know how you did it. But with this I can't fail."
units.italian: Alla fine si raddrizza. "È perfetto." Guarda l'attrezzatura con meraviglia e scuote la testa. "Non so come tu abbia fatto. Ma con questo non posso fallire."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	Timothy turns from you and uses the dolly to load the gear into one of the trucks in the warehouse. Once done he turns back to you, his eyes wide and rimmed with bloody tears. "Always at my lowest." He swallows a cough, and then continues. "It's you who saves me. When I am at my lowest. It's you."|10347|0
units.english: Timothy turns from you and uses the dolly to load the gear into one of the trucks in the warehouse. Once done he turns back to you, his eyes wide and rimmed with bloody tears. "Always at my lowest." He swallows a cough, and then continues. "It's you who saves me. When I am at my lowest. It's you."
units.italian: Timothy si volta da te e usa il carrello per caricare l'attrezzatura su uno dei camion del magazzino. Fatto questo si volta di nuovo verso di te, con gli occhi sgranati e cerchiati di lacrime sanguigne. "Sempre nel mio momento più basso." Ingioia un colpo di tosse, poi continua. "Sei tu che mi salvi. Quando sono nel mio momento più basso. Sei tu."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	Timothy looks like he wants to hug you, but he just nods. He hits a button on the wall and the garage door opens, exposing the warehouse to the night air.|10348|0
units.english: Timothy looks like he wants to hug you, but he just nods. He hits a button on the wall and the garage door opens, exposing the warehouse to the night air.
units.italian: Timothy sembra volerti abbracciare, ma si limita ad annuire. Preme un pulsante sul muro e la porta del garage si apre, esponendo il magazzino all'aria notturna.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 5e: Back to Oblivion|	"Captain," he says in way of a farewell, and then he climbs aboard the truck and drives off.|10349|0
units.english: "Captain," he says in way of a farewell, and then he climbs aboard the truck and drives off.
units.italian: "Capitano," dice a mo' di addio, poi sale sul camion e parte.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 6: News of Death|log|10360|0
units.english: Tried to help Timothy escape from his prison sentence there.
units.italian: Ho cercato di aiutare Timothy a fuggire dalla sua condanna ai lavori forzati.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 6: News of Death|log|10361|0
units.english: Timothy is dead - or at least that is what's being reported in the news. Perhaps the plot to break him free really did work.
units.italian: Timothy è morto, o almeno è quello che riportano le notizie. Forse il piano per farlo fuggire ha davvero funzionato.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 6: News of Death|A spaceport is a symphony of smells, sounds, and images in constant motion. Somewhere in the din, a news report is playing, and a familiar name leaps out at you. Your attention piqued, you turn to watch.|10365|0
units.english: A spaceport is a symphony of smells, sounds, and images in constant motion. Somewhere in the din, a news report is playing, and a familiar name leaps out at you. Your attention piqued, you turn to watch.
units.italian: Uno spazioporto è una sinfonia di odori, suoni e immagini in costante movimento. Da qualche parte nel frastuono va un notiziario, e un nome familiare ti salta all'orecchio. Con l'attenzione risvegliata, ti volti a guardare.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 6: News of Death|	"News out of Oblivion today. A minor explosion has claimed the life of Timothy Radrickson, former disgraced Governor of Rand. Sentenced to prison-labor on Oblivion, a hard but fair justice for a man who..."|10366|0
units.english: "News out of Oblivion today. A minor explosion has claimed the life of Timothy Radrickson, former disgraced Governor of Rand. Sentenced to prison-labor on Oblivion, a hard but fair justice for a man who..."
units.italian: "Notizie da Oblivion oggi. Una piccola esplosione ha causato la morte di Timothy Radrickson, l'ex governatore di Rand caduto in disgrazia. Condannato ai lavori forzati su Oblivion, una giustizia dura ma equa per un uomo che..."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 6: News of Death|	The news broadcast continues to blare, but you aren't able to follow any more than that.|10367|0
units.english: The news broadcast continues to blare, but you aren't able to follow any more than that.
units.italian: Il notiziario continua a strepitare, ma non riesci a seguire altro.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|A group of monks passes you by in the spaceport, and one stops to look at you curiously.|10383|0
units.english: A group of monks passes you by in the spaceport, and one stops to look at you curiously.
units.italian: Un gruppo di monaci ti passa accanto nello spazioporto, e uno si ferma a guardarti con curiosità.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Are you Captain <last>?" he asks.|10384|0
units.english: "Are you Captain <last>?" he asks.
units.italian: "È lei il Capitano <last>?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Why?"|10386|0
units.english: "Why?"
units.italian: "Perché?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Yes."|10388|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"None of your business."|10390|0
units.english: "None of your business."
units.italian: "Non sono affari suoi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Of course," the monk says. He drops his head and rejoins his brothers.|10392|0
units.english: "Of course," the monk says. He drops his head and rejoins his brothers.
units.italian: "Certamente," dice il monaco. China il capo e si ricongiunge ai fratelli.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	The monk lowers his head in a sign of respect. "Although we live in the mountains and interact rarely with outsiders, we have heard much of your exploits. You are an agent of change, and worthy of consideration."|10396|0
units.english: The monk lowers his head in a sign of respect. "Although we live in the mountains and interact rarely with outsiders, we have heard much of your exploits. You are an agent of change, and worthy of consideration."
units.italian: Il monaco abbassa il capo in segno di rispetto. "Anche se viviamo fra i monti e abbiamo raramente contatti con gli estranei, abbiamo sentito molto parlare delle sue imprese. Lei è un agente del cambiamento, e degno di considerazione."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"I thank you for giving us much to ponder on. I also have one small request; there is one within our monastery who is a great admirer of yours. It would mean much if you would be willing to meet him."|10397|0
units.english: "I thank you for giving us much to ponder on. I also have one small request; there is one within our monastery who is a great admirer of yours. It would mean much if you would be willing to meet him."
units.italian: "La ringrazio per averci dato molto su cui riflettere. Ho anche una piccola richiesta: nel nostro monastero c'è qualcuno che è un suo grande ammiratore. Significherebbe molto se lei accettasse di incontrarlo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"I'd be honored to meet him."|10399|0
units.english: "I'd be honored to meet him."
units.italian: "Sarei onorato di incontrarlo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Why not. I got nothing to better to do."|10401|0
units.english: "Why not. I got nothing to better to do."
units.italian: "Perché no. Non ho niente di meglio da fare."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"I don't have time for fans."|10403|0
units.english: "I don't have time for fans."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo per gli ammiratori."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Of course," the monk says, "you are a busy person." He returns to his brothers.|10405|0
units.english: "Of course," the monk says, "you are a busy person." He returns to his brothers.
units.italian: "Certamente," dice il monaco, "lei è una persona impegnata." Torna dai suoi fratelli.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|label|10408|0
units.english: why yes
units.italian: why yes

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	The monk beams. "Wonderful. It'll be a bit of a hike, but the views are worth it."|10409|0
units.english: The monk beams. "Wonderful. It'll be a bit of a hike, but the views are worth it."
units.italian: Il monaco si illumina. "Meraviglioso. Sarà un po' di cammino, ma il panorama vale la pena."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	He leads you into the mountains beyond the spaceport. You travel up various narrow passes and steep cliff sides. It's a difficult trail, but the scenery is remarkable. Your views are filled with broken mountains, jagged rocks, vibrant green life, and distant valleys.|10410|0
units.english: He leads you into the mountains beyond the spaceport. You travel up various narrow passes and steep cliff sides. It's a difficult trail, but the scenery is remarkable. Your views are filled with broken mountains, jagged rocks, vibrant green life, and distant valleys.
units.italian: Ti guida fra i monti oltre lo spazioporto. Viaggi su vari passi stretti e fianchi di scogliera ripidi. È un sentiero difficile, ma il paesaggio è notevole. Le tue viste sono piene di montagne spezzate, rocce frastagliate, vita verde vibrante e valli lontane.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	After several arduous hours, you clear a peak, and discover a vast stone building waiting for you. "We have arrived," the guide says almost anticlimactically. Perhaps the fact he lives here makes it less grand to him than it ought to be.|10411|0
units.english: After several arduous hours, you clear a peak, and discover a vast stone building waiting for you. "We have arrived," the guide says almost anticlimactically. Perhaps the fact he lives here makes it less grand to him than it ought to be.
units.italian: Dopo parecchie ore faticose superi una vetta e scopri un vasto edificio di pietra che ti aspetta. "Siamo arrivati," dice la guida quasi in modo anticlimatico. Forse il fatto che viva qui glielo rende meno grandioso di quanto dovrebbe essere.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	Your guide leaves you outside the entrance, and disappears within for a few minutes before returning with another monk.|10412|0
units.english: Your guide leaves you outside the entrance, and disappears within for a few minutes before returning with another monk.
units.italian: La tua guida ti lascia fuori dall'ingresso e sparisce all'interno per qualche minuto prima di tornare con un altro monaco.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	The new monk looks at you with an open, serene expression, that quickly breaks into a wide grin. Although much about his face has changed, whether from wear or surgery, you recognize that grin.|10413|0
units.english: The new monk looks at you with an open, serene expression, that quickly breaks into a wide grin. Although much about his face has changed, whether from wear or surgery, you recognize that grin.
units.italian: Il nuovo monaco ti guarda con un'espressione aperta e serena, che presto si apre in un gran sorriso. Anche se molto del suo viso è cambiato, per l'usura o per la chirurgia, riconosci quel sorriso.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Timothy!"|10415|0
units.english: "Timothy!"
units.italian: "Timothy!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Oh, it's you."|10416|0
units.english: "Oh, it's you."
units.italian: "Oh, sei tu."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	Timothy Radrickson, former prison-worker on Oblivion, Governor of Rand, and stowaway of your ship, hugs you.|10418|0
units.english: Timothy Radrickson, former prison-worker on Oblivion, Governor of Rand, and stowaway of your ship, hugs you.
units.italian: Timothy Radrickson, ex lavoratore carcerario su Oblivion, Governatore di Rand e clandestino della tua nave, ti abbraccia.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Captain <last>. I always hoped I would see you again. Given my tenuous legal situation, I can't leave here, and I can't send any messages." He steps back to look at you.|10419|0
units.english: "Captain <last>. I always hoped I would see you again. Given my tenuous legal situation, I can't leave here, and I can't send any messages." He steps back to look at you.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>. Ho sempre sperato di rivederti. Data la mia precaria situazione legale, non posso andarmene da qui e non posso mandare messaggi." Fa un passo indietro per guardarti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"The years have been kind to you, Captain; you hardly look any different from when we first met! Perhaps I should have invested in ship life, instead of staying terrestrial!" He laughs at his own joke, but only modestly.|10420|0
units.english: "The years have been kind to you, Captain; you hardly look any different from when we first met! Perhaps I should have invested in ship life, instead of staying terrestrial!" He laughs at his own joke, but only modestly.
units.italian: "Gli anni sono stati gentili con te, Capitano; sembri quasi identico a quando ci siamo conosciuti! Forse avrei dovuto investire nella vita di bordo invece di restare a terra!" Ride della propria battuta, ma solo con misura.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"It was difficult for me to speak when last we met on Oblivion, but you're my oldest and best friend. At my lowest points you were always there for me. I just wanted to thank you for that."|10421|0
units.english: "It was difficult for me to speak when last we met on Oblivion, but you're my oldest and best friend. At my lowest points you were always there for me. I just wanted to thank you for that."
units.italian: "Mi era difficile parlare l'ultima volta che ci siamo visti su Oblivion, ma tu sei il mio più vecchio e migliore amico. Nei miei momenti più bassi ci sei sempre stato. Volevo solo ringraziarti per questo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	You spend the day chatting with Timothy, before it's time to leave.|10422|0
units.english: You spend the day chatting with Timothy, before it's time to leave.
units.italian: Passi la giornata a chiacchierare con Timothy, prima che sia ora di andare.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	"Thank you for coming here. I wish I had something to give you, but I own nothing anymore, even though I owe you everything. Take care out there, and I'll do my best to keep out of trouble in here."|10423|0
units.english: "Thank you for coming here. I wish I had something to give you, but I own nothing anymore, even though I owe you everything. Take care out there, and I'll do my best to keep out of trouble in here."
units.italian: "Grazie per essere venuto fin qui. Vorrei avere qualcosa da darti, ma non possiedo più nulla, anche se ti devo tutto. Abbi cura di te là fuori, e io farò del mio meglio per non cacciarmi nei guai qui dentro."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	(Offer to transfer the Hero of Rand award and stipend to Timothy.)|10426|0
units.english: (Offer to transfer the Hero of Rand award and stipend to Timothy.)
units.italian: (Offriti di trasferire a Timothy il premio e lo stipendio da Eroe di Rand.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	(Shake his hand and say goodbye.)|10431|0
units.english: (Shake his hand and say goodbye.)
units.italian: (Stringigli la mano e salutalo.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	(Give him a hug and say goodbye.)|10433|0
units.english: (Give him a hug and say goodbye.)
units.italian: (Dagli un abbraccio e salutalo.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	You lean in and give him a warm, earnest bear hug. He wraps his arms around you and squeezes you back. When he finally breaks free, you see his eyes are blurry with tears. He nods to you once, and then walks back into the monastery. You begin your slow descent down the mountain, and back to civilization.|10437|0
units.english: You lean in and give him a warm, earnest bear hug. He wraps his arms around you and squeezes you back. When he finally breaks free, you see his eyes are blurry with tears. He nods to you once, and then walks back into the monastery. You begin your slow descent down the mountain, and back to civilization.
units.italian: Ti avvicini e gli dai un abbraccio caloroso e sincero, da orso. Lui ti cinge con le braccia e ricambia con forza. Quando alla fine si stacca, vedi che ha gli occhi offuscati dalle lacrime. Ti fa un cenno e poi rientra nel monastero. Cominci la lenta discesa dalla montagna, verso la civiltà.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	You shake his hand; he swallows and clears his throat as he tries to keep himself from crying, nods to you one last time, and then walks back into the monastery. You begin your slow descent down the mountain, and back to civilization.|10443|0
units.english: You shake his hand; he swallows and clears his throat as he tries to keep himself from crying, nods to you one last time, and then walks back into the monastery. You begin your slow descent down the mountain, and back to civilization.
units.italian: Gli stringi la mano; lui deglutisce e si schiarisce la voce cercando di non piangere, ti fa un ultimo cenno e poi rientra nel monastero. Cominci la lenta discesa dalla montagna, verso la civiltà.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	Timothy's eyes go wide. "No, you couldn't. It's yours. You've given me too much already."|10449|0
units.english: Timothy's eyes go wide. "No, you couldn't. It's yours. You've given me too much already."
units.italian: Gli occhi di Timothy si sbarrano. "No, non potresti. È tuo. Mi hai già dato troppo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	(Tell him about what Wynnafrith said, and how he is the real Hero of Rand.)|10451|0
units.english: (Tell him about what Wynnafrith said, and how he is the real Hero of Rand.)
units.italian: (Raccontagli quello che ha detto Wynnafrith, e che il vero Eroe di Rand è lui.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	(Tell him I don't need the money, but he does.)|10453|0
units.english: (Tell him I don't need the money, but he does.)
units.italian: (Digli che i soldi non servono a me, ma a lui sì.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	(Agree with him and rescind my offer.)|10455|0
units.english: (Agree with him and rescind my offer.)
units.italian: (Dagli ragione e ritira la mia offerta.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|log|10460|0
units.english: Found Timothy alive and well on New Tibet, living a simple, but happy life as a monk.
units.italian: Ho trovato Timothy vivo e in salute su New Tibet, dove vive una vita semplice ma felice come monaco.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|log|10461|0
units.english: Timothy Radrickson survived his faked death on Oblivion and escaped to New Tibet, where, thanks to my help, he now lives as a simple monk. He seems happy.
units.italian: Timothy Radrickson è sopravvissuto alla sua morte simulata su Oblivion ed è fuggito su New Tibet, dove, grazie al mio aiuto, ora vive come un semplice monaco. Sembra felice.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	As you speak Timothy shakes his head slowly, tears streaming down his face. Finally, as you finish, he wraps his arms around you in an earnest, heartfelt hug.|10464|0
units.english: As you speak Timothy shakes his head slowly, tears streaming down his face. Finally, as you finish, he wraps his arms around you in an earnest, heartfelt hug.
units.italian: Mentre parli Timothy scuote lentamente la testa, con le lacrime che gli rigano il viso. Alla fine, quando hai finito, ti cinge con le braccia in un abbraccio sincero e sentito.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	He tries to speak, but his voice fails him. Instead he just shakes his teary-eyed head at you and gives you a deep solemn bow.|10465|0
units.english: He tries to speak, but his voice fails him. Instead he just shakes his teary-eyed head at you and gives you a deep solemn bow.
units.italian: Prova a parlare, ma la voce gli manca. Si limita a scuotere la testa piena di lacrime verso di te e a farti un profondo inchino solenne.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Monk|	Timothy stays to watch as you begin your slow descent down the mountain, and back to civilization.|10466|0
units.english: Timothy stays to watch as you begin your slow descent down the mountain, and back to civilization.
units.italian: Timothy resta a guardarti mentre cominci la lenta discesa dalla montagna, verso la civiltà.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|A group of monks passes you by in the spaceport, and one stops to look at you curiously.|10480|0
units.english: A group of monks passes you by in the spaceport, and one stops to look at you curiously.
units.italian: Un gruppo di monaci ti passa accanto nello spazioporto, e uno si ferma a guardarti con curiosità.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Are you Captain <last>?" he asks.|10481|0
units.english: "Are you Captain <last>?" he asks.
units.italian: "È lei il Capitano <last>?" chiede.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Why?"|10483|0
units.english: "Why?"
units.italian: "Perché?"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Yes."|10485|0
units.english: "Yes."
units.italian: "Sì."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"None of your business."|10487|0
units.english: "None of your business."
units.italian: "Non sono affari suoi."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Of course," the monk says. He drops his head and rejoins his brothers.|10489|0
units.english: "Of course," the monk says. He drops his head and rejoins his brothers.
units.italian: "Certamente," dice il monaco. China il capo e si ricongiunge ai fratelli.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	The monk lowers his head in a sign of respect. "Although we spend most our time mediating and healing the sick, we have heard much of your exploits. You are an agent of change, and worthy of consideration."|10493|0
units.english: The monk lowers his head in a sign of respect. "Although we spend most our time mediating and healing the sick, we have heard much of your exploits. You are an agent of change, and worthy of consideration."
units.italian: Il monaco abbassa il capo in segno di rispetto. "Anche se passiamo la maggior parte del tempo a meditare e a curare i malati, abbiamo sentito molto parlare delle sue imprese. Lei è un agente del cambiamento, e degno di considerazione."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"I thank you for giving us much to ponder on. I also have one small request; there is one within our hospital who is a great admirer of yours. It would mean much if you would be willing to meet him."|10494|0
units.english: "I thank you for giving us much to ponder on. I also have one small request; there is one within our hospital who is a great admirer of yours. It would mean much if you would be willing to meet him."
units.italian: "La ringrazio per averci dato molto su cui riflettere. Ho anche una piccola richiesta: nel nostro ospedale c'è qualcuno che è un suo grande ammiratore. Significherebbe molto se lei accettasse di incontrarlo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"I'd be honored to meet him."|10496|0
units.english: "I'd be honored to meet him."
units.italian: "Sarei onorato di incontrarlo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Why not. I've got nothing to better to do."|10498|0
units.english: "Why not. I've got nothing to better to do."
units.italian: "Perché no. Non ho proprio niente di meglio da fare."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"I don't have time for fans."|10500|0
units.english: "I don't have time for fans."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo per gli ammiratori."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Of course," the monk says, "you are a busy person." He returns to his brothers.|10502|0
units.english: "Of course," the monk says, "you are a busy person." He returns to his brothers.
units.italian: "Certamente," dice il monaco, "lei è una persona impegnata." Torna dai suoi fratelli.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|label|10505|0
units.english: why yes
units.italian: why yes

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	The monk beams. "Wonderful. It's not far from here."|10506|0
units.english: The monk beams. "Wonderful. It's not far from here."
units.italian: Il monaco si illumina. "Meraviglioso. Non è lontano da qui."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	You take the spaceport train with him to a nearby hospital, beneath the impressive jungled mountains of New Tibet. In contrast with the other worlds of the Dirt Belt, this hospital is new, clean, and filled with a slew of monks, doctors, and patients. Your escort leads wildly past crowded bedsides and through diverse rooms until, at last, you arrive at a respiration and burns unit situated deep in the hospital's guts.|10507|0
units.english: You take the spaceport train with him to a nearby hospital, beneath the impressive jungled mountains of New Tibet. In contrast with the other worlds of the Dirt Belt, this hospital is new, clean, and filled with a slew of monks, doctors, and patients. Your escort leads wildly past crowded bedsides and through diverse rooms until, at last, you arrive at a respiration and burns unit situated deep in the hospital's guts.
units.italian: Prendi con lui il treno dello spazioporto fino a un ospedale vicino, sotto le impressionanti montagne ricoperte di giungla di New Tibet. In contrasto con gli altri mondi della Dirt Belt, questo ospedale è nuovo, pulito e pieno di monaci, medici e pazienti. La tua scorta ti guida a passo svelto fra letti affollati e stanze diverse finché, alla fine, arrivi a un reparto per la respirazione e le ustioni, situato nel profondo dell'ospedale.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"We have arrived," your guide says, and as soon as you look into the ward he seems to disappear into the crowds of the sprawling hospital.|10508|0
units.english: "We have arrived," your guide says, and as soon as you look into the ward he seems to disappear into the crowds of the sprawling hospital.
units.italian: "Siamo arrivati," dice la guida, e appena ti affacci al reparto sembra sparire fra la folla dello sterminato ospedale.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	In the ward you find a maimed man with burn scars and slightly labored breathing. His face lights up when he looks at you, and despite his scars you recognize him. It's Timothy Radrickson.|10509|0
units.english: In the ward you find a maimed man with burn scars and slightly labored breathing. His face lights up when he looks at you, and despite his scars you recognize him. It's Timothy Radrickson.
units.italian: Nel reparto trovi un uomo menomato, con cicatrici da ustione e il respiro leggermente affaticato. Il viso gli si illumina quando ti guarda, e nonostante le cicatrici lo riconosci. È Timothy Radrickson.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Timothy!"|10511|0
units.english: "Timothy!"
units.italian: "Timothy!"

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Oh, it's you."|10512|0
units.english: "Oh, it's you."
units.italian: "Oh, sei tu."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	Timothy Radrickson, former prison-worker on Oblivion, Governor of Rand, and stowaway of your ship, beckons you step closer to him with his good hand.|10514|0
units.english: Timothy Radrickson, former prison-worker on Oblivion, Governor of Rand, and stowaway of your ship, beckons you step closer to him with his good hand.
units.italian: Timothy Radrickson, ex lavoratore carcerario su Oblivion, Governatore di Rand e clandestino della tua nave, ti fa cenno con la mano buona di avvicinarti.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Captain <last>. I always hoped I would see you again. Given my tenuous legal situation, not to mention my health, I can't leave here, and I can't send any messages." His eyes linger on you, as though he is taking a mental picture. Or just enjoying the sight of a good friend returned.|10515|0
units.english: "Captain <last>. I always hoped I would see you again. Given my tenuous legal situation, not to mention my health, I can't leave here, and I can't send any messages." His eyes linger on you, as though he is taking a mental picture. Or just enjoying the sight of a good friend returned.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>. Ho sempre sperato di rivederti. Data la mia precaria situazione legale, per non parlare della mia salute, non posso andarmene da qui e non posso mandare messaggi." I suoi occhi indugiano su di te, come se stesse fissando un'immagine nella mente. O solo godendosi la vista di un buon amico ritrovato.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"The years have been kind to you, Captain; you hardly look any different from when we first met! Perhaps I should have invested in ship life, instead of staying terrestrial!" He laughs at his own joke, but only weakly given his condition. He coughs a bit, and takes a few slow, deep breaths before continuing.|10516|0
units.english: "The years have been kind to you, Captain; you hardly look any different from when we first met! Perhaps I should have invested in ship life, instead of staying terrestrial!" He laughs at his own joke, but only weakly given his condition. He coughs a bit, and takes a few slow, deep breaths before continuing.
units.italian: "Gli anni sono stati gentili con te, Capitano; sembri quasi identico a quando ci siamo conosciuti! Forse avrei dovuto investire nella vita di bordo invece di restare a terra!" Ride della propria battuta, ma debolmente, viste le condizioni. Tossisce un po' e prende qualche respiro lento e profondo prima di continuare.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"It's still a little difficult for me to speak, but I feel much better than when last we met on Oblivion. I just wanted you to know you're my oldest and best friend. At my lowest points you were always there for me. So thank you for that."|10517|0
units.english: "It's still a little difficult for me to speak, but I feel much better than when last we met on Oblivion. I just wanted you to know you're my oldest and best friend. At my lowest points you were always there for me. So thank you for that."
units.italian: "Mi è ancora un po' difficile parlare, ma mi sento molto meglio dell'ultima volta che ci siamo visti su Oblivion. Volevo solo che sapessi che sei il mio più vecchio e migliore amico. Nei miei momenti più bassi ci sei sempre stato. Quindi grazie."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	You spend the day in the hospital room chatting with Timothy, before finally having to leave.|10518|0
units.english: You spend the day in the hospital room chatting with Timothy, before finally having to leave.
units.italian: Passi la giornata nella stanza d'ospedale a chiacchierare con Timothy, prima di dover partire.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Thank you for coming here. I wish I had something to give you, but I own nothing anymore, even though I owe you everything. Take care out there, and I'll do my best to keep out of trouble in here."|10519|0
units.english: "Thank you for coming here. I wish I had something to give you, but I own nothing anymore, even though I owe you everything. Take care out there, and I'll do my best to keep out of trouble in here."
units.italian: "Grazie per essere venuto fin qui. Vorrei avere qualcosa da darti, ma non possiedo più nulla, anche se ti devo tutto. Abbi cura di te là fuori, e io farò del mio meglio per non cacciarmi nei guai qui dentro."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	(Offer to transfer the Hero of Rand award and stipend to Timothy.)|10522|0
units.english: (Offer to transfer the Hero of Rand award and stipend to Timothy.)
units.italian: (Offriti di trasferire a Timothy il premio e lo stipendio da Eroe di Rand.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	(Shake his hand and say goodbye.)|10527|0
units.english: (Shake his hand and say goodbye.)
units.italian: (Stringigli la mano e salutalo.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	(Give him a hug and say goodbye.)|10529|0
units.english: (Give him a hug and say goodbye.)
units.italian: (Dagli un abbraccio e salutalo.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	You lean over and give him a partial hug in his sick bed. He wraps his one good arm around you and squeezes. When he finally breaks free you see a tear.|10533|0
units.english: You lean over and give him a partial hug in his sick bed. He wraps his one good arm around you and squeezes. When he finally breaks free you see a tear.
units.italian: Ti chini e gli dai un abbraccio parziale sul letto di malattia. Lui ti cinge con il suo unico braccio buono e ti stringe. Quando alla fine si stacca vedi una lacrima.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	You leave him bedridden in the hospital, and to your surprise you find your guide waiting for you outside the room. "His is a tough case. Perhaps one day he will recover enough to leave this place." The monk pauses, thoughtfully. "Or perhaps not."|10534|0
units.english: You leave him bedridden in the hospital, and to your surprise you find your guide waiting for you outside the room. "His is a tough case. Perhaps one day he will recover enough to leave this place." The monk pauses, thoughtfully. "Or perhaps not."
units.italian: Lo lasci costretto a letto in ospedale, e con tua sorpresa trovi la tua guida che ti aspetta fuori dalla stanza. "Il suo è un caso difficile. Forse un giorno si riprenderà abbastanza da lasciare questo posto." Il monaco fa una pausa pensierosa. "O forse no."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	He leads you back to the train station, and from there you take brief journey back to New Tibet's spaceport.|10535|0
units.english: He leads you back to the train station, and from there you take brief journey back to New Tibet's spaceport.
units.italian: Ti riaccompagna alla stazione dei treni, e da lì fai un breve viaggio di ritorno allo spazioporto di New Tibet.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	You lean in to shake his good hand. He swallows and clears his throat, trying to keep himself from crying.|10541|0
units.english: You lean in to shake his good hand. He swallows and clears his throat, trying to keep himself from crying.
units.italian: Ti avvicini per stringergli la mano buona. Lui deglutisce e si schiarisce la voce, cercando di non piangere.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	You leave him bedridden in the hospital, and to your surprise find your guide waiting for you outside the room. "His is a tough case. Perhaps one day he will recover enough to leave this place." The monk pauses, thoughtfully. "Or perhaps not."|10542|0
units.english: You leave him bedridden in the hospital, and to your surprise find your guide waiting for you outside the room. "His is a tough case. Perhaps one day he will recover enough to leave this place." The monk pauses, thoughtfully. "Or perhaps not."
units.italian: Lo lasci costretto a letto in ospedale, e con tua sorpresa trovi la guida che ti aspetta fuori dalla stanza. "Il suo è un caso difficile. Forse un giorno si riprenderà abbastanza da lasciare questo posto." Il monaco fa una pausa pensierosa. "O forse no."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	He leads you back to the train station, and from there you take brief journey back to New Tibet's spaceport.|10543|0
units.english: He leads you back to the train station, and from there you take brief journey back to New Tibet's spaceport.
units.italian: Ti riaccompagna alla stazione dei treni, e da lì fai un breve viaggio di ritorno allo spazioporto di New Tibet.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	Timothy's eyes go wide. "No, you couldn't. It's yours. You've given me too much already."|10549|0
units.english: Timothy's eyes go wide. "No, you couldn't. It's yours. You've given me too much already."
units.italian: Gli occhi di Timothy si sbarrano. "No, non potresti. È tuo. Mi hai già dato troppo."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	(Tell him about what Wynnafrith said, and how he is the real Hero of Rand.)|10551|0
units.english: (Tell him about what Wynnafrith said, and how he is the real Hero of Rand.)
units.italian: (Raccontagli quello che ha detto Wynnafrith, e che il vero Eroe di Rand è lui.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	(Tell him I don't need the money, but he does.)|10553|0
units.english: (Tell him I don't need the money, but he does.)
units.italian: (Digli che i soldi non servono a me, ma a lui sì.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	(Agree with him and rescind my offer.)|10555|0
units.english: (Agree with him and rescind my offer.)
units.italian: (Dagli ragione e ritira la mia offerta.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|log|10560|0
units.english: Found Timothy alive, but not in great shape. He is thankful for the rescue nonetheless. Can't shake the feeling that there was more that I could have done for him.
units.italian: Ho trovato Timothy vivo, ma non in gran forma. È comunque grato per il salvataggio. Non riesco a togliermi la sensazione che avrei potuto fare di più per lui.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|log|10561|0
units.english: Once a stowaway, governor, and prisoner, Timothy Radrickson now resides incognito on New Tibet. Unfortunately, some of the equipment I acquired for him was faulty, and he spends his days in a hospital ward as an invalid.
units.italian: Un tempo clandestino, governatore e prigioniero, Timothy Radrickson ora vive in incognito su New Tibet. Purtroppo parte dell'attrezzatura che gli ho procurato era difettosa, e passa le giornate in un reparto d'ospedale come invalido.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	As you speak Timothy shakes his head slowly, tears streaming down his face. Finally, as you finish, he reaches out to you with his one good arm and pulls you in for a hug.|10564|0
units.english: As you speak Timothy shakes his head slowly, tears streaming down his face. Finally, as you finish, he reaches out to you with his one good arm and pulls you in for a hug.
units.italian: Mentre parli Timothy scuote lentamente la testa, con le lacrime che gli rigano il viso. Alla fine, quando hai finito, ti tende il suo unico braccio buono e ti tira a sé per un abbraccio.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	He tries to speak, but his voice fails him. Instead he just shakes his teary-eyed head and bows it before you in deep respect.|10565|0
units.english: He tries to speak, but his voice fails him. Instead he just shakes his teary-eyed head and bows it before you in deep respect.
units.italian: Prova a parlare, ma la voce gli manca. Si limita a scuotere la testa piena di lacrime e a chinarla davanti a te in profondo rispetto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"Always." He manages to whisper through phlegm and weakened lungs as you turn to leave, "always you."|10566|0
units.english: "Always." He manages to whisper through phlegm and weakened lungs as you turn to leave, "always you."
units.italian: "Sempre." Riesce a sussurrare fra il catarro e i polmoni indeboliti mentre ti volti per uscire, "sempre tu."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	You leave him bedridden in the hospital, and to your surprise find your guide waiting for you outside the room.|10567|0
units.english: You leave him bedridden in the hospital, and to your surprise find your guide waiting for you outside the room.
units.italian: Lo lasci costretto a letto in ospedale, e con tua sorpresa trovi la tua guida che ti aspetta fuori dalla stanza.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	"His is a tough case. Perhaps one day he will recover enough to leave this place." The monk pauses, thoughtfully. "Or perhaps not."|10568|0
units.english: "His is a tough case. Perhaps one day he will recover enough to leave this place." The monk pauses, thoughtfully. "Or perhaps not."
units.italian: "Il suo è un caso difficile. Forse un giorno si riprenderà abbastanza da lasciare questo posto." Il monaco fa una pausa, pensieroso. "O forse no."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Hospice|	He leads you back to the train station, and from there you take the brief journey back to New Tibet's spaceport.|10569|0
units.english: He leads you back to the train station, and from there you take the brief journey back to New Tibet's spaceport.
units.italian: Ti riaccompagna alla stazione dei treni, e da lì fai il breve viaggio di ritorno allo spazioporto di New Tibet.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|Oblivion's spaceport is the kind of place that, despite being in constant motion, never really changes. Humanity, driven by its constant thirst for resources, scurries over this unremarkable world like a hive of angry bees, but for all their furious effort it looks no different than any of the previous times you've been here.|10582|0
units.english: Oblivion's spaceport is the kind of place that, despite being in constant motion, never really changes. Humanity, driven by its constant thirst for resources, scurries over this unremarkable world like a hive of angry bees, but for all their furious effort it looks no different than any of the previous times you've been here.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di Oblivion è il tipo di posto che, pur essendo in costante movimento, non cambia mai davvero. L'umanità, spinta dalla sua sete costante di risorse, brulica su questo mondo anonimo come uno sciame di api arrabbiate, ma con tutto il loro sforzo furioso il posto non appare diverso dalle altre volte in cui sei stato qui.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	Except, of course, the lack of one familiar face. A doomed and disgraced ex-governor who had been sent here, and last you heard, had died here.|10583|0
units.english: Except, of course, the lack of one familiar face. A doomed and disgraced ex-governor who had been sent here, and last you heard, had died here.
units.italian: Tranne, naturalmente, per l'assenza di un volto familiare. Un ex governatore condannato e disonorato che era stato mandato qui e, stando alle ultime notizie, era morto qui.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	With that heavy thought on your mind you notice a sign which promises to lead you to the local graveyard.|10584|0
units.english: With that heavy thought on your mind you notice a sign which promises to lead you to the local graveyard.
units.italian: Con quel pensiero pesante in mente noti un cartello che promette di portarti al cimitero locale.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	(Head to the graveyard.)|10586|0
units.english: (Head to the graveyard.)
units.italian: (Vai al cimitero.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	(Head back to my ship.)|10588|0
units.english: (Head back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla nave.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	You see no point in wasting your time at this place's graveyard, so you head back to your ship.|10590|0
units.english: You see no point in wasting your time at this place's graveyard, so you head back to your ship.
units.italian: Non vedi alcun motivo di perdere tempo al cimitero di questo posto, così torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	Oblivion's evening sky is lit up by unnumbered rigs and natural gas burners that dot the region. These red fires turn the normally dark blue atmosphere a shade of smoldering purple.|10594|0
units.english: Oblivion's evening sky is lit up by unnumbered rigs and natural gas burners that dot the region. These red fires turn the normally dark blue atmosphere a shade of smoldering purple.
units.italian: Il cielo serale di Oblivion è illuminato da innumerevoli trivelle e bruciatori di gas naturale sparsi nella regione. Questi fuochi rossi trasformano l'atmosfera normalmente blu scuro in una tonalità di viola fumante.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	It's beneath that purple hue you see a countless expanse of small flat gravestones uniformly placed in Oblivion's sterile dirt. Despite the number of headstones there is no one else here, and only a few graves show any evidence of being visited.|10595|0
units.english: It's beneath that purple hue you see a countless expanse of small flat gravestones uniformly placed in Oblivion's sterile dirt. Despite the number of headstones there is no one else here, and only a few graves show any evidence of being visited.
units.italian: È sotto quella tinta viola che vedi una distesa sterminata di piccole lapidi piatte, disposte con uniformità nella terra sterile di Oblivion. Nonostante il numero di pietre tombali non c'è nessun altro qui, e solo poche tombe mostrano segni di essere state visitate.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	It seems as though those buried here are mostly forgotten.|10596|0
units.english: It seems as though those buried here are mostly forgotten.
units.italian: Sembra che quelli sepolti qui siano per lo più dimenticati.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	(Search for Timothy Radrickson's grave.)|10598|0
units.english: (Search for Timothy Radrickson's grave.)
units.italian: (Cerca la tomba di Timothy Radrickson.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	(Leave.)|10600|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	You've seen all you wanted to see of this place, and you leave this unloved graveyard to its forlorn dead.|10602|0
units.english: You've seen all you wanted to see of this place, and you leave this unloved graveyard to its forlorn dead.
units.italian: Hai visto tutto quello che volevi vedere di questo posto, e lasci questo cimitero senza amore ai suoi morti sconsolati.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|log|10607|0
units.english: Timothy is dead. It seems the plan to break him free failed.
units.italian: Timothy è morto. Sembra che il piano per farlo fuggire sia fallito.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|log|10608|0
units.english: From stowaway, to governor, to prisoner, to corpse: the tale of Timothy is complete. The equipment I acquired for him failed, and his remains are buried beneath a neat unremarkable gravestone on Oblivion.
units.italian: Da clandestino a governatore, a prigioniero, a cadavere: la storia di Timothy è completa. L'attrezzatura che gli ho procurato ha fallito, e i suoi resti sono sepolti sotto una lapide ordinata e anonima su Oblivion.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	The index is easy to find, and has all the hallmarks of having never been used. The graveyard is set up in a carefully regimented grid system and despite the large number of graves, it is surprisingly easy to find Timothy's.|10609|0
units.english: The index is easy to find, and has all the hallmarks of having never been used. The graveyard is set up in a carefully regimented grid system and despite the large number of graves, it is surprisingly easy to find Timothy's.
units.italian: L'indice è facile da trovare, e ha tutte le caratteristiche di non essere mai stato usato. Il cimitero è disposto in un rigido sistema a griglia e, nonostante il gran numero di tombe, è sorprendentemente facile trovare quella di Timothy.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	You walk across the forgotten memorial to find a small, flat unremarkable stone, hemmed in amongst other unremarkable stones, pressed into the dead ground. The text laser-chiseled onto it reads, "Timothy Radrickson. Prisoner - 645631-4C."|10610|0
units.english: You walk across the forgotten memorial to find a small, flat unremarkable stone, hemmed in amongst other unremarkable stones, pressed into the dead ground. The text laser-chiseled onto it reads, "Timothy Radrickson. Prisoner - 645631-4C."
units.italian: Attraversi il memoriale dimenticato fino a una piccola lapide piatta e anonima, incastrata fra altre pietre anonime, premuta nella terra morta. Il testo inciso al laser dice: "Timothy Radrickson. Prigioniero - 645631-4C."

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	That's all. Nothing about his meteoric rise, about being the Governor of Rand, or even how or when his death occurred here. Just another dead prisoner.|10611|0
units.english: That's all. Nothing about his meteoric rise, about being the Governor of Rand, or even how or when his death occurred here. Just another dead prisoner.
units.italian: Tutto qui. Niente sulla sua ascesa meteora, sull'essere stato Governatore di Rand, né su come o quando sia avvenuta la sua morte qui. Solo un altro prigioniero morto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	(Stay a while and contemplate.)|10613|0
units.english: (Stay a while and contemplate.)
units.italian: (Resta un po' a riflettere.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	(Leave.)|10614|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	The slow moving evening clouds have cast the entire world in a strange purple twilight. Timothy's grave sits before you, nestled in the poison ground, and you alone in the vast empty graveyard.|10617|0
units.english: The slow moving evening clouds have cast the entire world in a strange purple twilight. Timothy's grave sits before you, nestled in the poison ground, and you alone in the vast empty graveyard.
units.italian: Le nuvole della sera che avanzano lentamente hanno calato il mondo intero in uno strano crepuscolo viola. La tomba di Timothy è davanti a te, annidata nella terra avvelenata, e tu solo nello sterminato cimitero vuoto.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	Your thoughts drift to the man buried beneath your feet.|10618|0
units.english: Your thoughts drift to the man buried beneath your feet.
units.italian: I tuoi pensieri vagano verso l'uomo sepolto sotto i tuoi piedi.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson 7: Grave|	The shadows turn a darker shade of purple as you leave the graveyard of the forgotten dead for the familiar confines of your ship.|10620|0
units.english: The shadows turn a darker shade of purple as you leave the graveyard of the forgotten dead for the familiar confines of your ship.
units.italian: Le ombre si fanno di un viola più scuro mentre lasci il cimitero dei morti dimenticati per i confini familiari della tua nave.

units.id: mission:Timothy Radrickson: Log Fix 1|log|10634|0
units.english: A stowaway I found on my ship. He requested a trip to Rand to start a new life, promising to pay back the money he owes.
units.italian: Un clandestino che ho trovato sulla mia nave. Ha chiesto un passaggio fino a Rand per ricominciare una nuova vita, promettendo di restituire i soldi che deve.

units.english: Tried to help Timothy escape from his prison sentence there.
units.italian: Ho cercato di aiutare Timothy a fuggire dalla sua condanna ai lavori forzati.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|name|10708|0
units.english: Bring Tosti's stone to <planet>
units.italian: Portare la pietra di Tosti su <planet>

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|description|10709|0
units.english: Take Tosti's family stone to <destination>, where the Snaiwaz clan used to live before they immigrated to <origin>.
units.italian: Porta la pietra di famiglia di Tosti su <destination>, dove viveva il clan Snaiwaz prima di emigrare su <origin>.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|There is a certain comfort to be found in the familiar swaying of Norn's spaceport. The creaking bridges no longer feel intimidating or threatening, only welcoming. There's never many staff here, but the few you do run into greet you warmly. Word has apparently spread that you've all but been adopted into the Hlewagasti family.|10719|0
units.english: There is a certain comfort to be found in the familiar swaying of Norn's spaceport. The creaking bridges no longer feel intimidating or threatening, only welcoming. There's never many staff here, but the few you do run into greet you warmly. Word has apparently spread that you've all but been adopted into the Hlewagasti family.
units.italian: C'è una certa consolazione nel familiare ondeggiare dello spazioporto di Norn. I ponti scricchiolanti non sembrano più intimidatori né minacciosi, solo accoglienti. Non c'è mai molto personale qui, ma i pochi che incontri ti salutano con calore. A quanto pare si è sparsa la voce che sei stato praticamente adottato dalla famiglia Hlewagasti.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Helm, with his sandy hair and short beard, approaches you with a young man in tow. "<first>! It is well to see you again.|10720|0
units.english: Helm, with his sandy hair and short beard, approaches you with a young man in tow. "<first>! It is well to see you again.
units.italian: Helm, con i capelli sabbiosi e la barba corta, ti si avvicina con un giovanotto al seguito. "<first>! È bello rivederti.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"So..." he says conspiratorially, "... there is no date yet, but a certain red-haired stoic and his exotic Alfheimian girlfriend may be looking at wedding dates."|10721|0
units.english: "So..." he says conspiratorially, "... there is no date yet, but a certain red-haired stoic and his exotic Alfheimian girlfriend may be looking at wedding dates."
units.italian: "Dunque..." dice in tono cospiratorio, "... non c'è ancora una data, ma un certo stoico dai capelli rossi e la sua esotica fidanzata alfheimiana potrebbero stare guardando delle date per il matrimonio."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"That's great news!"|10723|0
units.english: "That's great news!"
units.italian: "È un'ottima notizia!"

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Do you know when?"|10724|0
units.english: "Do you know when?"
units.italian: "Sai quando?"

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Who are you talking about?"|10725|0
units.english: "Who are you talking about?"
units.italian: "Di chi stai parlando?"

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"I don't really care."|10727|0
units.english: "I don't really care."
units.italian: "Non mi interessa davvero."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Like I said, there is no date yet, and with those two it could be years before they finally land on a date. Time's different out on the algae islands." He shrugs.|10730|0
units.english: "Like I said, there is no date yet, and with those two it could be years before they finally land on a date. Time's different out on the algae islands." He shrugs.
units.italian: "Come dicevo, non c'è ancora una data, e con quei due potrebbero volerci anni prima che ne fissino una. Il tempo è diverso sulle isole di alghe." Fa spallucce.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"But I thought you'd appreciate a small update on Thorleif." He smiles and then glances at the young man next to him. "Anyways, that's not actually why I sought you out."|10731|0
units.english: "But I thought you'd appreciate a small update on Thorleif." He smiles and then glances at the young man next to him. "Anyways, that's not actually why I sought you out."
units.italian: "Ma ho pensato che ti facesse piacere un piccolo aggiornamento su Thorleif." Sorride e poi dà un'occhiata al giovanotto accanto a lui. "Comunque, non è davvero per questo che ti ho cercato."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"You don't remember Thorleif? My cousin out on the algae islands?" He frowns, but regains his composure and glances at the young man next to him. "Anyways, that's not actually why I sought you out."|10735|0
units.english: "You don't remember Thorleif? My cousin out on the algae islands?" He frowns, but regains his composure and glances at the young man next to him. "Anyways, that's not actually why I sought you out."
units.italian: "Non ti ricordi Thorleif? Mio cugino, sulle isole di alghe?" Si acciglia, ma recupera la compostezza e dà un'occhiata al giovanotto accanto a lui. "Comunque, non è davvero per questo che ti ho cercato."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Helm frowns and takes a step back like he's been struck. After a moment he regains his composure and replies, "If you say so. In that case I have another matter to discuss with you."|10739|0
units.english: Helm frowns and takes a step back like he's been struck. After a moment he regains his composure and replies, "If you say so. In that case I have another matter to discuss with you."
units.italian: Helm si acciglia e fa un passo indietro come se fosse stato colpito. Dopo un momento recupera la compostezza e risponde: "Se dici così. In tal caso ho un'altra questione di cui parlarti."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|label|10741|0
units.english: hope stone
units.italian: hope stone

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Standing beside Helm is an unremarkable young man with a sunburnt face, calloused hands, and threadbare garb. "Ca-Captain <last>?" he says nervously, "I'm sorry to be a bothering you, ser. But I heard tell what you did for Thorleif, and I thought maybe you were the like to do a good turn by me."|10742|0
units.english: Standing beside Helm is an unremarkable young man with a sunburnt face, calloused hands, and threadbare garb. "Ca-Captain <last>?" he says nervously, "I'm sorry to be a bothering you, ser. But I heard tell what you did for Thorleif, and I thought maybe you were the like to do a good turn by me."
units.italian: Accanto a Helm c'è un giovanotto anonimo, con il viso bruciato dal sole, le mani callose e abiti consunti. "Ca-Capitano <last>?" dice nervosamente, "mi scusi se la disturbo, signore. Ma ho sentito dire quello che ha fatto per Thorleif, e ho pensato che forse lei fosse il tipo da rendermi un favore."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Sensing his discomfort, Helm puts an arm on the young man's shoulder. "It's alright, Tosti, we're all friends on Norn."|10743|0
units.english: Sensing his discomfort, Helm puts an arm on the young man's shoulder. "It's alright, Tosti, we're all friends on Norn."
units.italian: Percependo il suo disagio, Helm gli mette un braccio sulla spalla. "Va tutto bene, Tosti, su Norn siamo tutti amici."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	The young man staightens up a bit at Helm's reassurance and looks you in the eyes. "My da, well, he liked the waves well enough, but never really settled here, you see? In his heart that is.|10744|0
units.english: The young man staightens up a bit at Helm's reassurance and looks you in the eyes. "My da, well, he liked the waves well enough, but never really settled here, you see? In his heart that is.
units.italian: Il giovanotto si raddrizza un po' alle rassicurazioni di Helm e ti guarda negli occhi. "Mio padre, beh, gli piacevano abbastanza le onde, ma non si è mai davvero stabilito qui, capisce? Nel cuore, intendo.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"He never really left our old home. We were refugees and were ever so glad to be taken in by Norn, but he never felt so tall as when he thought about Hope, about home."|10745|0
units.english: "He never really left our old home. We were refugees and were ever so glad to be taken in by Norn, but he never felt so tall as when he thought about Hope, about home."
units.italian: "Non ha mai davvero lasciato la nostra vecchia casa. Eravamo profughi e siamo stati così felici di essere accolti su Norn, ma non si è mai sentito così in alto come quando pensava a Hope, a casa."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"What are you going on about?"|10747|0
units.english: "What are you going on about?"
units.italian: "Dove vuoi arrivare?"

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	(Wait for him to get the point.)|10749|0
units.english: (Wait for him to get the point.)
units.italian: (Aspetta che arrivi al punto.)

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Leave me alone. I'm not interested."|10751|0
units.english: "Leave me alone. I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Lasciami in pace. Non mi interessa."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Crestfallen, the young man stumbles over his words attempting to apologize for the intrusion and slinks away from you in an ungraceful hurry.|10752|0
units.english: Crestfallen, the young man stumbles over his words attempting to apologize for the intrusion and slinks away from you in an ungraceful hurry.
units.italian: Costernato, il giovanotto inciampa nelle parole cercando di scusarsi per l'intrusione e si allontana da te in una fretta poco elegante.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Helm watches him go with an unhappy frown upon his face. "You could have at least heard him out."|10753|0
units.english: Helm watches him go with an unhappy frown upon his face. "You could have at least heard him out."
units.italian: Helm lo guarda andare via con un'espressione infelice. "Avresti almeno potuto ascoltarlo."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	He shakes his head and turns from you before saying, "I thought better of you."|10754|0
units.english: He shakes his head and turns from you before saying, "I thought better of you."
units.italian: Scuote la testa e si volta da te prima di dire: "Ti credevo migliore."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Tosti suddenly stops, and takes a deep breath. "We're from Hope, ser. My family. We're refugees and we had to leave everything behind. But da, he never really left Hope."|10758|0
units.english: Tosti suddenly stops, and takes a deep breath. "We're from Hope, ser. My family. We're refugees and we had to leave everything behind. But da, he never really left Hope."
units.italian: Tosti si ferma di colpo e prende un respiro profondo. "Veniamo da Hope, signore. La mia famiglia. Siamo profughi e abbiamo dovuto lasciare tutto. Ma papà, lui non ha mai davvero lasciato Hope."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	The young refugee pulls out a stone criss-crossed in tiny chiseled letters. The familiar engraved story of a life now ended. "This is his stone, and well, he - he'd want his stone left on Hope. I was hoping that was something you could do."|10759|0
units.english: The young refugee pulls out a stone criss-crossed in tiny chiseled letters. The familiar engraved story of a life now ended. "This is his stone, and well, he - he'd want his stone left on Hope. I was hoping that was something you could do."
units.italian: Il giovane profugo tira fuori una pietra incisa da una fitta rete di piccole lettere cesellate. La familiare storia incisa di una vita ormai finita. "Questa è la sua pietra e, beh, lui... lui avrebbe voluto che la sua pietra restasse su Hope. Speravo che potesse farlo lei."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	With the words he swallows and looks at you earnestly.|10760|0
units.english: With the words he swallows and looks at you earnestly.
units.italian: Con quelle parole deglutisce e ti guarda con sincerità.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|label|10761|0
units.english: hope options
units.italian: hope options

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"I can take the stone to Hope."|10763|0
units.english: "I can take the stone to Hope."
units.italian: "Posso portare la pietra su Hope."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"I can take the stone to Hope, for a price."|10765|0
units.english: "I can take the stone to Hope, for a price."
units.italian: "Posso portare la pietra su Hope, a un prezzo."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"I thought Family-Cairns were exclusive to the Deep. Why would there be one on Hope?"|10767|0
units.english: "I thought Family-Cairns were exclusive to the Deep. Why would there be one on Hope?"
units.italian: "Pensavo che i Family-Cairn fossero esclusivi del Deep. Perché ce ne sarebbe uno su Hope?"

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Hire a courier. I have more important things to do."|10771|0
units.english: "Hire a courier. I have more important things to do."
units.italian: "Assumi un corriere. Ho cose più importanti da fare."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"No."|10772|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|label|10774|0
units.english: hope no
units.italian: hope no

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Helm sighs and tries to pat the young man on the back before he entirely deflates. "Captain <last> is a very busy man. I am sure we can find someone else to make the journey. There is no shame in asking for help."|10777|0
units.english: Helm sighs and tries to pat the young man on the back before he entirely deflates. "Captain <last> is a very busy man. I am sure we can find someone else to make the journey. There is no shame in asking for help."
units.italian: Helm sospira e cerca di dare una pacca sulla schiena al giovanotto prima che si sgonfi del tutto. "Il Capitano <last> è un uomo molto impegnato. Sono sicuro che troveremo qualcun altro per fare il viaggio. Non c'è vergogna nel chiedere aiuto."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Tosti is red and shaking, and mumbles some apologies before slinking away from you and Helm.|10778|0
units.english: Tosti is red and shaking, and mumbles some apologies before slinking away from you and Helm.
units.italian: Tosti è rosso e tremante, mormora qualche scusa prima di allontanarsi da te e da Helm.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Helm gives you a nod and says, "Thank you for listening, at least."|10779|0
units.english: Helm gives you a nod and says, "Thank you for listening, at least."
units.italian: Helm ti fa un cenno e dice: "Grazie almeno per aver ascoltato."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|label|10782|0
units.english: why hope
units.italian: why hope

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Lots of the first folks who settled Hope came from the Deep." Helm answers, getting a far off look in his eyes. "It wasn't like most worlds in the south. It was going to be different. At least, that's what they believed."|10785|0
units.english: "Lots of the first folks who settled Hope came from the Deep." Helm answers, getting a far off look in his eyes. "It wasn't like most worlds in the south. It was going to be different. At least, that's what they believed."
units.italian: "Molti dei primi coloni che si stabilirono su Hope venivano dal Deep." Risponde Helm, con lo sguardo che si perde lontano. "Non era come la maggior parte dei mondi del sud. Sarebbe stata diversa. Almeno, è quello che credevano."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	He shrugs, "Many of them didn't forget where they came from. Brought the old ways with them. Some refugees, like Tosti's family, even found their way back here when Hope was lost.|10786|0
units.english: He shrugs, "Many of them didn't forget where they came from. Brought the old ways with them. Some refugees, like Tosti's family, even found their way back here when Hope was lost.
units.italian: Fa spallucce: "Molti di loro non hanno dimenticato da dove venivano. Si sono portati dietro le vecchie usanze. Alcuni profughi, come la famiglia di Tosti, hanno persino trovato la strada per tornare qui quando Hope è stata perduta.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Anyways, that's why you can find Family-Cairns on Hope - because our people were there. Now, getting back to the matter at hand, you willing to help Tosti out?"|10787|0
units.english: "Anyways, that's why you can find Family-Cairns on Hope - because our people were there. Now, getting back to the matter at hand, you willing to help Tosti out?"
units.italian: "Comunque, è per questo che puoi trovare Family-Cairn su Hope: perché la nostra gente era là. Ora, tornando alla questione: sei disposto ad aiutare Tosti?"

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|label|10790|0
units.english: hope price
units.italian: hope price

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	He grimaces, "I am sorry, ser. Work is hard to come by for us refugees. I thought - I thought I'd just ask. In case you were near. In case it was within your power is all."|10791|0
units.english: He grimaces, "I am sorry, ser. Work is hard to come by for us refugees. I thought - I thought I'd just ask. In case you were near. In case it was within your power is all."
units.italian: Fa una smorfia. "Mi dispiace, signore. Per noi profughi il lavoro è difficile da trovare. Pensavo... pensavo solo di chiedere. Caso mai lei fosse da queste parti. Caso mai fosse in suo potere, tutto qui."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"I might be in the area. No promises though."|10793|0
units.english: "I might be in the area. No promises though."
units.italian: "Potrei trovarmi da quelle parti. Nessuna promessa, però."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Alright. I'll do it."|10794|0
units.english: "Alright. I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene. Lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Sorry. I don't work for free."|10795|0
units.english: "Sorry. I don't work for free."
units.italian: "Spiacente. Non lavoro gratis."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|label|10798|0
units.english: hope yes
units.italian: hope yes

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	The young man's eyes light up. "Really? Truly? I didn't dare hope..."|10801|0
units.english: The young man's eyes light up. "Really? Truly? I didn't dare hope..."
units.italian: Gli occhi del giovanotto si illuminano. "Davvero? Sul serio? Non osavo sperare..."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	His body weight shifts and it looks as though he's about to hug you before he abruptly stops himself and tries to regain a little composure.|10802|0
units.english: His body weight shifts and it looks as though he's about to hug you before he abruptly stops himself and tries to regain a little composure.
units.italian: Il peso del corpo si sposta e sembra sul punto di abbracciarti, prima di fermarsi di colpo e cercare di recuperare un po' di compostezza.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	"Thorleif was right about you," he says as he presses the small, cool stone into your hand. "The Family-Cairn is not far from where the last spaceport used to be. Just by the cliffs, and the family name was Snaiwaz."|10803|0
units.english: "Thorleif was right about you," he says as he presses the small, cool stone into your hand. "The Family-Cairn is not far from where the last spaceport used to be. Just by the cliffs, and the family name was Snaiwaz."
units.italian: "Thorleif aveva ragione su di te," dice premendoti in mano la piccola pietra fredda. "Il Family-Cairn non è lontano da dove c'era il vecchio spazioporto. Proprio vicino alle scogliere, e il cognome della famiglia era Snaiwaz."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	With the stone firmly in your fist, he thanks you one last time, and then takes his leave.|10804|0
units.english: With the stone firmly in your fist, he thanks you one last time, and then takes his leave.
units.italian: Con la pietra ben stretta nel pugno, ti ringrazia un'ultima volta e poi si congeda.

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	Helm silently watches him go and then turns back to you, shaking his head. "You're not like any off-worlder I've ever known. Most would have laughed in that boy's face, let alone done him a good turn for free."|10805|0
units.english: Helm silently watches him go and then turns back to you, shaking his head. "You're not like any off-worlder I've ever known. Most would have laughed in that boy's face, let alone done him a good turn for free."
units.italian: Helm lo guarda andare via in silenzio, poi si volta verso di te scuotendo la testa. "Non sei come nessun forestiero che abbia mai conosciuto. La maggior parte gli avrebbe riso in faccia, figuriamoci fargli un favore gratis."

units.id: mission:Stone to Hope|	He smiles at you and says, "You really are one of us."|10806|0
units.english: He smiles at you and says, "You really are one of us."
units.italian: Ti sorride e dice: "Sei davvero uno di noi."
